zh: 患者到院后先完成预检分诊，护士按分级结果引导其前往相应区域。
en: The patient was triaged on arrival, and the nurse directed him to the appropriate area according to the triage level.

zh: 麻烦您在分诊台稍等，我们按预检分诊的结果依次叫号。
en: Please wait at the triage desk; we will call patients in the order of their triage results.

zh: 分诊台完成信息登记后，患者信息会自动进入急诊系统。
en: After registration at the triage desk, the patient's information is entered into the emergency system automatically.

zh: 您先到分诊台登记一下，护士马上给您安排。
en: Please register at the triage desk first; the nurse will arrange everything for you right away.

zh: 分诊护士依据病情表现与分级标准决定患者的就诊顺序。
en: The triage nurse determines the order of care based on the patient's presentation and the triage criteria.

zh: 分诊护士马上过来看您，请先坐下休息。
en: The triage nurse will come to see you shortly; please sit down and rest.

zh: 医院每年更新一次分诊标准，并对护士进行培训。
en: The hospital updates its triage criteria once a year and trains the nursing staff accordingly.

zh: 按分诊标准，您这种情况属于需要尽快处理的级别。
en: Under our triage criteria, your condition is at a level that needs prompt attention.

zh: 分诊记录显示患者到院十分钟内即被送入抢救室。
en: The triage record shows the patient was sent to the resuscitation room within ten minutes of arrival.

zh: 请把分诊记录补全，写清楚到院时间和分级。
en: Please complete the triage record and note clearly the arrival time and acuity level.

zh: 批量伤员到院时启动快速分诊，三十秒内完成一人。
en: Rapid triage is activated when multiple casualties arrive, with one patient assessed every thirty seconds.

zh: 现在人多，我们做快速分诊，先看最危险的。
en: It is busy now, so we are doing rapid triage and will see the most seriously ill first.

zh: 车祸伤员送到后立即实施批量分诊，优先处理红色标识者。
en: Mass casualty triage was started as soon as the crash victims arrived, with red-tagged patients treated first.

zh: 外面送来一批伤员，马上启动批量分诊。
en: A group of casualties is coming in; start mass casualty triage immediately.

zh: 二次分诊发现患者病情加重，立即将分级上调。
en: Secondary triage revealed that the patient had deteriorated, so the acuity level was raised immediately.

zh: 到诊室后医生还会做一次二次分诊，请您配合。
en: The doctor will do a secondary triage once you are in the room, so please cooperate.

zh: 候诊患者每三十分钟接受一次再评估，并记录结果。
en: Waiting patients undergo periodic reassessment every thirty minutes, and the findings are documented.

zh: 我们再做一次再评估，您如果更难受请马上说。
en: Let us do one more periodic reassessment of your condition; tell me at once if you feel worse.

zh: 症状分诊表把发热、腹痛等症状分别对应到不同诊区。
en: The symptom-based triage chart maps symptoms such as fever and abdominal pain to different treatment areas.

zh: 请说一下您最难受的地方，我们按症状分诊安排。
en: Tell me what bothers you most; we will arrange your visit by symptom-based triage.

zh: 传染病预检发现患者有接触史，立即引导至隔离诊室。
en: Screening for infectious diseases found a relevant contact history, and the patient was taken to an isolation room.

zh: 我们正在做传染病预检，请先填表并说明有没有接触过发热病人。
en: We are doing screening for infectious diseases, so please fill in this form and tell me about any contact with fever patients.

zh: 发热预检点设在急诊门口，所有患者均需接受筛查。
en: A fever screening point is set up at the emergency entrance, and all patients must be screened.

zh: 请您到发热预检那边测一下温度，很快就好。
en: Please go to the fever screening point to have your temperature taken; it will be quick.

zh: 流行病学史筛查结果阴性，患者按普通流程就诊。
en: The epidemiological screening was negative, so the patient followed the routine pathway.

zh: 麻烦您如实回答流行病学史筛查的几个问题。
en: Please answer the questions in the epidemiological screening truthfully.

zh: 科室每月抽查分诊准确性，并将结果纳入质控报告。
en: The department audits triage accuracy every month and reports the results in its quality review.

zh: 我们复核分诊准确性，是为了让危重病人不被漏掉。
en: We review triage accuracy so that critically ill patients are not missed.

zh: 该例分诊不足导致患者等待超过一小时，已列入不良事件分析。
en: Undertriage in this case delayed care by more than an hour and was reviewed as an adverse event.

zh: 这个病人脸色这么差，别分诊不足了，赶紧叫医生。
en: This patient looks very unwell; do not undertriage him, call the doctor now.

zh: 过度分诊会挤占抢救资源，需要在质控中持续监测。
en: Overtriage consumes resuscitation resources and must be monitored continuously in quality control.

zh: 这不是过度分诊，他确实喘得厉害，必须优先看。
en: This is not overtriage; he really is short of breath and must be seen first.

zh: 急诊平均等待时间已缩短至二十五分钟。
en: The average emergency waiting time has been reduced to twenty-five minutes.

zh: 您这个分级等待时间会比较长，请耐心一些。
en: Your acuity level means a fairly long waiting time, so please be patient.

zh: 分诊等级分为五档，数字越小病情越重。
en: Triage levels run from one to five, and the lower the number, the more serious the condition.

zh: 您的分诊等级是三级，前面还有抢救病人。
en: Your triage level is three, and there are resuscitation patients ahead of you.

zh: 预检评估在患者踏入急诊的三十秒内完成。
en: The preliminary assessment is completed within thirty seconds of the patient entering the emergency department.

zh: 我先做个预检评估，您能听见我说话吗？
en: I will do a preliminary assessment first; can you hear me?

zh: 接诊台负责登记患者信息并指引其前往分诊区。
en: The reception desk registers patient information and directs them to the triage area.

zh: 您先去接诊台登记，然后到分诊台排队。
en: Please register at the reception desk first, then queue at the triage desk.

zh: 急诊入口设有明显标识，夜间保持照明。
en: The emergency entrance is clearly marked and stays lit at night.

zh: 您从急诊入口进来右转就是分诊台。
en: Come in through the emergency entrance and turn right to find the triage desk.

zh: 步行入院患者约占急诊总量的七成。
en: Walk-in patients account for about seventy percent of emergency visits.

zh: 我是步行入院自己走过来的，没叫救护车。
en: I came in as a walk-in; I walked here myself and did not call an ambulance.

zh: 目测评估发现患者面色苍白、大汗，立即提高分级。
en: Visual assessment revealed pallor and heavy sweating, so the acuity level was raised at once.

zh: 我先做个目测评估，看他能不能自己坐稳。
en: Let me do a visual assessment first to see whether he can sit upright by himself.

zh: 分诊访谈控制在两分钟内，只问最关键的问题。
en: The triage interview is kept under two minutes and covers only the most critical questions.

zh: 分诊访谈时请尽量说清楚哪里疼、疼了多久。
en: During the triage interview, please tell me clearly where it hurts and for how long.

zh: 分诊分区把急诊分成红区、黄区和绿区，救治能力随颜色递减。
en: The triage zone system divides the emergency department into red, yellow, and green areas with decreasing intensity.

zh: 您被分到黄区，这是按分诊分区安排的。
en: You have been assigned to the yellow zone under our triage zone arrangement.

zh: 分诊决策需在患者到院五分钟内作出。
en: The triage decision must be made within five minutes of the patient's arrival.

zh: 这个分诊决策我拿不准，请高年资护士复核。
en: I am not sure about this triage decision, so please ask the senior nurse to review it.

zh: 新版分诊指南强调对老年患者放宽分级阈值。
en: The new triage guideline stresses a lower threshold for assigning acuity to older patients.

zh: 我们按分诊指南执行，不是个人经验说了算。
en: We follow the triage guideline; it is not just a matter of personal experience.

zh: 分诊差错需在两小时内上报护理部。
en: Triage errors must be reported to the nursing department within two hours.

zh: 这次分诊差错我们会上报，也会重新培训。
en: We will report this triage error and provide retraining.

zh: 儿童分诊需结合年龄判断，不能照搬成人标准。
en: Pediatric triage must take age into account and cannot simply follow adult criteria.

zh: 孩子走儿童分诊通道，护士会先看。
en: Children go through pediatric triage, and the nurse will see them first.

zh: 电话分诊记录需注明来电时间与建议内容。
en: Telephone triage records must note the time of the call and the advice given.

zh: 电话分诊只能给建议，不能代替面诊。
en: Telephone triage can only offer advice and cannot replace an in-person assessment.

zh: 他的分诊分级是二级，需要在十分钟内接诊。
en: His acuity level is two, so he must be seen within ten minutes.

zh: 您的分诊分级比较靠后，前面还有两个危重病人。
en: Your acuity level is lower, and there are two critically ill patients ahead of you.

zh: 该院采用五级分级标准，与国际通行做法一致。
en: The hospital uses a five-level triage scale consistent with international practice.

zh: 分级标准写得很清楚，二级病人十分钟内必须看到。
en: The triage scale is clear: level two patients must be seen within ten minutes.

zh: 五级分诊体系由一级最重到五级最轻依次排列。
en: The five-level triage system runs from level one, the most urgent, to level five, the least.

zh: 我们用的是五级分诊，您目前是四级。
en: We use five-level triage, and you are currently level four.

zh: 病情分级结果决定患者进入哪个诊区。
en: The severity classification determines which treatment area the patient enters.

zh: 病情分级不是一成不变的，随时可能调整。
en: Severity classification is not fixed and may be adjusted at any time.

zh: 危急级别患者绕过候诊区直接进入抢救室。
en: Patients in the resuscitation category bypass the waiting area and go straight to the resuscitation room.

zh: 这个病人是危急级别，马上推抢救室。
en: This patient is in the resuscitation category; take him to the resuscitation room now.

zh: 危重患者由专人护送，途中不得中断监护。
en: Critically ill patients are escorted by a dedicated staff member with monitoring maintained throughout.

zh: 这位是危重患者，先安排床位。
en: This is a critically ill patient; arrange a bed first.

zh: 急症患者应在三十分钟内接诊。
en: Urgent patients should be seen within thirty minutes.

zh: 您是急症患者，不用排那么久。
en: You are an urgent patient, so you will not have to wait that long.

zh: 非紧急患者安排在绿区候诊，按叫号顺序就诊。
en: Non-urgent patients wait in the green zone and are seen in calling order.

zh: 您属于非紧急患者，可能要等一两个小时。
en: You are a non-urgent patient, so the wait may be one or two hours.

zh: 分级颜色与腕带颜色一致，便于各区快速识别。
en: The color code matches the wristband color so that each area can identify acuity at a glance.

zh: 腕带上的分级颜色变了，说明病情重新评估过。
en: The color code on the wristband has changed, which means the patient was reassessed.

zh: 红色分级患者到院后不得在候诊区停留。
en: Patients in the red category must not remain in the waiting area after arrival.

zh: 他是红色分级，直接进抢救室，不用排队。
en: He is in the red category and goes straight to the resuscitation room without queueing.

zh: 黄色分级患者应在三十分钟内完成接诊。
en: Patients in the yellow category should be assessed within thirty minutes.

zh: 您是黄色分级，先坐着等，我们会尽快叫您。
en: You are in the yellow category; please sit and wait, and we will call you as soon as we can.

zh: 绿色分级患者可在普通诊区按序就诊。
en: Patients in the green category can be seen in the general area in order.

zh: 您是绿色分级，可以去那边坐着等叫号。
en: You are in the green category, so you can sit over there and wait to be called.

zh: 复评发现病情变化，护士立即执行分级升级。
en: Repeat assessment showed a change, so the nurse immediately carried out an acuity upgrade.

zh: 他说胸口更闷了，赶紧做分级升级。
en: He says the chest tightness is worse, so do an acuity upgrade now.

zh: 症状缓解后经医生同意执行分级降级。
en: After symptoms eased, an acuity downgrade was carried out with the doctor's agreement.

zh: 您好多了，可以做个分级降级，但还要再观察。
en: You are much better, so we can do an acuity downgrade, but we still need to observe you.

zh: 分级复核由组长在十分钟内完成。
en: The level review is completed by the team leader within ten minutes.

zh: 这个病人我请组长做分级复核。
en: I will ask the team leader to do a level review for this patient.

zh: 发生分级争议时，应重新评估并说明判定依据。
en: When an acuity dispute arises, the patient should be reassessed and the rationale explained.

zh: 您对分级有疑问可以提，分级争议我们会重新评估。
en: You may question the grading; we will reassess this acuity dispute.

zh: 老年患者采用更宽松的分级阈值，以免延误救治。
en: A more generous acuity threshold is used for older patients to avoid delaying care.

zh: 这个指标够不够分级阈值，需要再看一遍。
en: Whether this indicator meets the acuity threshold needs another look.

zh: 分级判定以最危重的指标为准，不取平均值。
en: Acuity determination relies on the most severe indicator rather than an average.

zh: 这个分级判定有点勉强，我再看一眼病历。
en: This acuity determination seems a bit off; let me look at the chart again.

zh: 分级登记完成后系统会自动计算应诊时限。
en: Once acuity registration is complete, the system calculates the target time to be seen.

zh: 分级登记我这边做，您先去缴费。
en: I will handle the acuity registration; you go and pay first.

zh: 分级腕带须在患者到院后立即佩戴并核对信息。
en: The acuity wristband must be applied immediately on arrival and its details checked.

zh: 请把手伸出来，我给您戴上分级腕带。
en: Please hold out your wrist so I can put on your acuity wristband.

zh: 分级优先顺序以病情为准，与到院先后无关。
en: The priority order is based on the condition, not on who arrived first.

zh: 分级优先顺序不能因为熟人插队而改变。
en: The priority order must not be changed because someone knows a staff member.

zh: 分级一致性通过双人独立分诊来测量。
en: Triage reliability is measured by having two nurses triage the same patient independently.

zh: 我们查分级一致性，是为了发现培训盲点。
en: We check triage reliability to find gaps in training.

zh: 分级质控每月抽查一百份分诊记录。
en: Acuity quality control reviews one hundred triage records each month.

zh: 分级质控发现问题，会反馈给当班护士。
en: When acuity quality control finds a problem, it is fed back to the nurse on duty.

zh: 新入职护士须完成分级培训并考核合格。
en: Newly recruited nurses must complete triage training and pass the assessment.

zh: 下周有分级培训，您记得排班。
en: There is triage training next week, so please arrange your roster accordingly.

zh: 分级告知应在分诊完成后立即进行。
en: Acuity notification should take place right after triage is completed.

zh: 分级告知我已经说了，他还是不太理解。
en: I have done the acuity notification, but he still does not quite understand.

zh: 分级标识由护士在分诊时统一粘贴。
en: The acuity marker is applied by the nurse during triage.

zh: 床头分级标识掉了，麻烦补一张。
en: The acuity marker at the bedside has fallen off; please put up a new one.

zh: 分级信息系统与挂号系统实时对接。
en: The triage information system connects to the registration system in real time.

zh: 分级信息系统卡住了，先手工记录。
en: The triage information system is frozen, so record it by hand for now.

zh: 分级响应时限为二级十分钟、三级三十分钟。
en: The response time target is ten minutes for level two and thirty minutes for level three.

zh: 已经超过分级响应时限了，赶紧催一下医生。
en: The response time target has already been exceeded, so please urge the doctor.

zh: 急诊挂号需出示有效证件并说明主要不适。
en: Emergency registration requires a valid identity document and a brief statement of the main problem.

zh: 您先做完分诊，再去急诊挂号。
en: Please finish triage first, then go to emergency registration.

zh: 挂号处二十四小时开放，夜间由一人值班。
en: The registration desk is open around the clock, with one staff member on duty at night.

zh: 挂号处在哪边？我转了两圈没找到。
en: Where is the registration desk? I have walked around twice and cannot find it.

zh: 三号挂号窗口专门办理急诊业务。
en: Registration window three handles emergency cases only.

zh: 请到二号挂号窗口排队，这边暂停服务。
en: Please queue at registration window two; this one is closed for now.

zh: 挂号单请妥善保管，就诊和缴费都要用。
en: Please keep the registration slip safe; it is needed for the consultation and for payment.

zh: 挂号单丢了怎么办？还能补吗？
en: What if I lose the registration slip? Can it be replaced?

zh: 挂号费按医院等级与医师职称分别定价。
en: The registration fee is set according to hospital grade and physician rank.

zh: 挂号费是十五块，可以扫码付。
en: The registration fee is fifteen yuan and can be paid by scanning the code.

zh: 现场挂号在高峰时段需要排队半小时以上。
en: On-site registration can require more than half an hour of queueing at peak times.

zh: 我没在网上约，只能现场挂号。
en: I did not book online, so I can only do on-site registration.

zh: 自助挂号机旁有志愿者协助老年患者操作。
en: Volunteers help older patients use the self-service registration kiosks.

zh: 您可以在自助挂号机上操作，不用排长队。
en: You can use the self-service registration kiosk instead of waiting in a long queue.

zh: 补挂号需先结清欠费，再重新打印凭条。
en: Re-registration requires settling the outstanding balance and then printing a new slip.

zh: 系统里没您的号，得补挂号。
en: There is no record of your registration in the system, so you need re-registration.

zh: 退号须在未接诊前办理，逾期不予受理。
en: Registration cancellation must be done before the consultation; late requests are not accepted.

zh: 我不看了，可以办退号吗？
en: I have decided not to be seen; can I apply for registration cancellation?

zh: 建卡时需要录入姓名、证件号与联系方式。
en: Patient card creation requires the name, document number, and contact details.

zh: 第一次来要先建卡，很快的。
en: Your first visit requires patient card creation; it is quick.

zh: 就诊卡请随身携带，每次就诊都要刷卡。
en: Please carry your hospital card with you; it is swiped at every visit.

zh: 就诊卡消磁了，需要到窗口重新写卡。
en: The hospital card has lost its data, so it needs to be rewritten at the counter.

zh: 电子健康卡可在手机上调出，全国通用。
en: The electronic health card can be displayed on a phone and is accepted nationwide.

zh: 您有电子健康卡吗？没有的话我帮您申领。
en: Do you have an electronic health card? If not, I can help you apply for one.

zh: 急诊号按分级而非挂号先后叫号。
en: The emergency ticket is called by acuity rather than by registration order.

zh: 您的急诊号是四十七号，请留意屏幕。
en: Your emergency ticket number is forty-seven; please watch the screen.

zh: 加号需经接诊医生同意并在系统中登记。
en: An extra slot requires the agreement of the attending doctor and must be logged in the system.

zh: 今天号满了，我帮您问问能不能加号。
en: The slots are full today; let me ask whether an extra slot is possible.

zh: 挂号员核对证件后为患者打印凭条。
en: The registration clerk checks the identity document and then prints the slip for the patient.

zh: 挂号员说系统坏了，让我等一会儿。
en: The registration clerk said the system is down and asked me to wait.

zh: 急诊号源全天开放，不设预约限制。
en: Emergency appointment slots are open all day with no booking limit.

zh: 上午号源已经放完了，只能等下午。
en: There are no appointment slots left in the morning, so you will have to wait for the afternoon.

zh: 实名挂号可避免冒用他人医保卡就诊。
en: Real-name registration prevents people from using another person's insurance card.

zh: 现在都是实名挂号，请出示身份证。
en: Real-name registration is required now, so please show your identity card.

zh: 挂号信息有误会直接影响后续检查与取药。
en: Errors in registration information directly affect later tests and medication collection.

zh: 请核对一下挂号信息，姓名和年龄对不对？
en: Please check your registration information; are the name and age correct?

zh: 信息录入错误会导致报告无法关联到患者。
en: A data entry error can prevent reports from being linked to the patient.

zh: 信息录入我来做，您把证件放这儿就行。
en: I will do the data entry; just leave your document here.

zh: 发现录入错误应立即更正并留下修改痕迹。
en: An entry error should be corrected immediately with a record of the change.

zh: 年龄写成一百岁了，这是录入错误。
en: The age was entered as one hundred; that is an entry error.

zh: 代办挂号须同时提供患者与代办人的证件。
en: Proxy registration requires the documents of both the patient and the person acting for them.

zh: 老人来不了，我可以代办挂号吗？
en: The older patient cannot come; may I do proxy registration for him?

zh: 无卡挂号患者需在下次就诊时补录卡片信息。
en: Patients who complete registration without a card must have the card details added at their next visit.

zh: 卡没带也能无卡挂号，报身份证号就行。
en: You can still do registration without a card; just give your identity card number.

zh: 首诊登记需完整填写住址与联系电话。
en: First-visit registration requires a complete address and contact telephone number.

zh: 您是首诊登记，需要多填一张表。
en: This is your first-visit registration, so you need to fill in one more form.

zh: 复诊登记可直接调取上次的诊断与用药记录。
en: Return-visit registration can retrieve the previous diagnosis and medication records directly.

zh: 您是复诊登记，报一下上次的就诊号。
en: This is a return-visit registration; please give your previous visit number.

zh: 挂号类型选错会影响报销比例。
en: Choosing the wrong registration type affects the reimbursement rate.

zh: 挂号类型我给您选急诊，这样能优先看。
en: I will set the registration type to emergency so that you are seen sooner.

zh: 收费项目须在系统中与诊疗行为一一对应。
en: Each charge item must correspond to an actual service in the system.

zh: 这个收费项目我没做过，麻烦帮我核对。
en: I did not receive this charge item; please check it for me.

zh: 挂号凭条是退号与报销的必要凭证。
en: The registration receipt is required for cancellation and reimbursement.

zh: 挂号凭条请拿好，别弄丢了。
en: Please keep the registration receipt safe and do not lose it.

zh: 身份核验不通过时，需由两名工作人员共同确认。
en: When identity verification fails, two staff members must confirm the patient together.

zh: 请配合做身份核验，摘下口罩看一下。
en: Please cooperate with identity verification and take off your mask for a moment.

zh: 身份证信息将与挂号系统自动比对。
en: The identity card information is automatically matched against the registration system.

zh: 身份证带了吗？挂号要用。
en: Did you bring your identity card? It is needed for registration.

zh: 外籍患者须出示护照原件并留存复印件。
en: Foreign patients must present their original passport and a copy is kept on file.

zh: 我的护照在酒店，可以先看病吗？
en: My passport is at the hotel; can I be seen first?

zh: 港澳通行证上的姓名拼写须与挂号信息一致。
en: The name on the Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau must match the registration information.

zh: 我用港澳通行证挂号，可以吗？
en: Can I register with my Exit-Entry Permit for Travelling to and from Hong Kong and Macau?

zh: 台胞证号码需完整录入挂号系统。
en: The Taiwan Compatriot Permit number must be entered in full into the registration system.

zh: 台胞证刷不出来，我手工输入号码。
en: The Taiwan Compatriot Permit does not scan, so I will type the number manually.

zh: 护照号码须逐位核对，避免字母与数字混淆。
en: The passport number must be checked digit by digit to avoid confusing letters with numbers.

zh: 请把护照号码写在这里，字迹清楚一点。
en: Please write the passport number here, and make it legible.

zh: 证件类型选错会导致实名核验失败。
en: Choosing the wrong document type causes real-name verification to fail.

zh: 证件类型这里选护照，不是身份证。
en: For document type, choose passport here, not identity card.

zh: 证件号码含字母时须区分大小写录入。
en: When the document number contains letters, case must be entered correctly.

zh: 证件号码最后一位是字母，请再念一遍。
en: The last character of the document number is a letter; please read it again.

zh: 姓名核对发现同音不同字，需按证件更正。
en: The name check found a homophone with a different character, so it was corrected to match the document.

zh: 我念一下您的名字，做个姓名核对。
en: Let me read out your name to do a name check.

zh: 姓名拼写与证件不一致时，须以证件为准修改。
en: When the name spelling differs from the document, it must be corrected to match the document.

zh: 请您把姓名拼写念一遍，我核对一下。
en: Please read out your name spelling so I can check it.

zh: 出生日期与证件不符会导致检查报告无法归档。
en: A date of birth that does not match the document prevents reports from being filed correctly.

zh: 请说一下出生日期，我核对一下年龄。
en: Please tell me your date of birth so I can check your age.

zh: 国籍一栏需与护照信息完全一致。
en: The nationality field must match the passport exactly.

zh: 请问您的国籍是哪里？我登记一下。
en: What is your nationality? I need to record it.

zh: 人证合一核验由挂号员与保安共同完成。
en: Identity matching is carried out jointly by the registration clerk and the security officer.

zh: 人证合一没通过，请到旁边再核对一次。
en: Identity matching did not pass, so please step aside for another check.

zh: 人脸识别失败时，可改用人工核对证件。
en: When facial recognition fails, staff can check the document manually instead.

zh: 请看着摄像头，做人脸识别。
en: Please look at the camera for facial recognition.

zh: 指纹核验用于无法提供有效证件时的辅助确认。
en: Fingerprint verification is used as a supplementary check when no valid document can be provided.

zh: 请您按一下指纹核验仪器。
en: Please place your finger on the fingerprint verification device.

zh: 无证件患者先按无名氏建档，后续补录身份信息。
en: A patient without identification is first filed under an unnamed record, with details added later.

zh: 我是无证件患者，证件被偷了，还能看吗？
en: I am a patient without identification because my documents were stolen; can I still be seen?

zh: 身份不明的伤员按危急级别先行抢救。
en: An unidentified person is resuscitated first under the critical category.

zh: 身份不明也要先救人，身份后面再查。
en: An unidentified person is still treated first; identity can be established later.

zh: 无名氏患者的腕带只写编号，不写姓名。
en: The wristband of an unnamed patient shows only a number, not a name.

zh: 系统里先登记为无名氏，等家属来了再改。
en: Register the patient as an unnamed patient in the system and change it when relatives arrive.

zh: 临时身份有效期为七十二小时，逾期须补正。
en: A temporary identity is valid for seventy-two hours and must be corrected afterwards.

zh: 先用临时身份给您建个档，别耽误检查。
en: We will create a temporary identity for you first so that tests are not delayed.

zh: 监护人确认后方可为未成年患者办理挂号。
en: Guardian confirmation is required before registration can be completed for a minor patient.

zh: 孩子看病需要监护人确认，请您出示一下证件。
en: A child's visit requires guardian confirmation, so please show your document.

zh: 代办人须出示本人证件与患者授权材料。
en: The authorized agent must present their own document and the patient's authorization.

zh: 您是代办人吗？请在这边签个字。
en: Are you the authorized agent? Please sign here.

zh: 就诊人信息与代办人不一致时需单独标注。
en: When the patient registrant differs from the agent, this must be noted separately.

zh: 请确认就诊人是您本人还是孩子。
en: Please confirm whether the patient registrant is you or your child.

zh: 关系证明可为户口簿、出生证明或公证书。
en: Proof of relationship may be a household register, birth certificate, or notarized document.

zh: 没有关系证明的话，代办手续会麻烦一些。
en: Without proof of relationship, proxy paperwork becomes more complicated.

zh: 签证有效期不足时，需提醒患者及时办理延期。
en: When the visa validity is running out, the patient should be reminded to apply for an extension.

zh: 我看一下您的签证有效期，登记要用。
en: Let me check your visa validity; it is needed for registration.

zh: 同名患者须用出生日期与证件号加以区分。
en: A same-name patient must be distinguished from others by date of birth and document number.

zh: 今天还有一个同名患者，别把报告贴错了。
en: There is another same-name patient today, so do not attach the reports to the wrong chart.

zh: 身份信息采集须遵循最小必要原则。
en: Identity data collection must follow the principle of minimal necessity.

zh: 身份信息采集很快，扫一下证件就行。
en: Identity data collection is quick; just scan your document.

zh: 医保结算窗口在急诊大厅东侧。
en: The medical insurance settlement window is on the east side of the emergency hall.

zh: 您这个能走医保结算，不用先全额付。
en: This can go through medical insurance settlement, so you do not have to pay in full first.

zh: 该药不在医保目录内，需患者自费。
en: This drug is not in the medical insurance formulary, so the patient must pay for it.

zh: 我帮您查一下这个药在不在医保目录。
en: Let me check whether this drug is in the medical insurance formulary.

zh: 异地医保需先办理备案才能直接结算。
en: Out-of-town medical insurance requires prior registration before direct settlement is possible.

zh: 我是异地医保，能不能直接刷？
en: I have out-of-town medical insurance; can I use it directly here?

zh: 缴费可通过窗口、自助机或手机完成。
en: Payment can be made at the counter, at a kiosk, or on a mobile phone.

zh: 请先去缴费，缴完再去做检查。
en: Please make the payment first, then go for the examination.

zh: 缴费窗口在夜间只保留一个。
en: Only one cashier window stays open at night.

zh: 缴费窗口排队太长，能用手机付吗？
en: The cashier window queue is too long; can I pay by phone?

zh: 移动支付支持微信、支付宝与银行卡。
en: Mobile payment supports WeChat, Alipay, and bank cards.

zh: 移动支付扫这个码就行，很方便。
en: For mobile payment, just scan this code; it is very convenient.

zh: 扫码支付成功后系统会自动打印凭条。
en: After QR code payment succeeds, the system prints a receipt automatically.

zh: 扫码支付可以吗？我没带现金。
en: Can I use QR code payment? I did not bring cash.

zh: 现金支付需当面点清并索取收据。
en: With cash payment, the amount should be counted on the spot and a receipt requested.

zh: 我只带了现金，现金支付行不行？
en: I only brought cash; is cash payment acceptable?

zh: 刷卡支付可支持银联与境外银行卡。
en: Card payment supports UnionPay and some foreign bank cards.

zh: 刷卡支付要输入密码，请在这里按。
en: For card payment you need to enter your PIN; please press here.

zh: 收据与发票不同，不能直接用于报销。
en: A receipt differs from an invoice and cannot be used directly for reimbursement.

zh: 收据请收好，丢了不好补。
en: Please keep the receipt; it is hard to replace if lost.

zh: 费用查询可在自助机或手机端完成。
en: Charge inquiry can be done at a kiosk or on a mobile phone.

zh: 我想做个费用查询，看看花了多少。
en: I would like to do a charge inquiry to see how much has been spent.

zh: 出现费用不足时，系统会暂停开立新的检查项目。
en: When there are insufficient funds, the system suspends new examination orders.

zh: 提示费用不足，还需要再交一点。
en: It shows insufficient funds, so a little more needs to be paid.

zh: 应急救助适用于身份明确但暂时无力缴费的急危患者。
en: Emergency assistance applies to critically ill patients who are identified but temporarily unable to pay.

zh: 您这种情况可以先走应急救助，救命要紧。
en: In your situation we can use emergency assistance first; saving your life comes first.

zh: 应急救助基金由卫生健康部门统一管理。
en: The emergency assistance fund is managed centrally by the health authority.

zh: 这笔费用可以申请应急救助基金。
en: This cost can be covered by an application to the emergency assistance fund.

zh: 退费须经科室确认后由财务办理。
en: A refund requires departmental confirmation and is then processed by the finance office.

zh: 这项检查没做，能退费吗？
en: This examination was not done; can I get a refund?

zh: 支付方式可在自助机上随时更改。
en: The payment method can be changed at any time on the self-service kiosk.

zh: 您选哪种支付方式？现金还是扫码？
en: Which payment method would you like, cash or QR code?

zh: 结算单需患者签字确认后存档。
en: The settlement statement is signed by the patient and then filed.

zh: 结算单给您一份，自己留好。
en: Here is a copy of the settlement statement for you to keep.

zh: 就诊流程张贴在急诊大厅的显眼位置。
en: The patient flow is displayed prominently in the emergency hall.

zh: 我第一次来，不太清楚就诊流程。
en: This is my first visit, so I am not familiar with the patient flow.

zh: 急诊接诊须在患者到院后立即启动。
en: Emergency reception must begin as soon as the patient arrives.

zh: 急诊接诊的医生马上过来，请稍等。
en: The doctor doing emergency reception will be here shortly; please wait.

zh: 医生接诊时间平均为十二分钟。
en: The average doctor consultation lasts twelve minutes.

zh: 医生接诊的时候请把以前的检查单带上。
en: Please bring your previous test results to the doctor consultation.

zh: 首诊医生需在病历中写明初步判断与处理计划。
en: The first consultation must include a written initial judgement and plan in the chart.

zh: 您是首诊吗？以前在我们医院看过这个病没有？
en: Is this your first consultation with us? Have you been treated here for this problem before?

zh: 就诊序号会显示在候诊区的屏幕上。
en: The visit number is shown on the screen in the waiting area.

zh: 请记一下您的就诊序号，叫到再进。
en: Please note your visit number; come in when it is called.

zh: 转科需由转入科室同意并完成交接。
en: An interdepartmental transfer requires the receiving department's agreement and a completed handover.

zh: 医生说需要转科，我去帮您办手续。
en: The doctor says an interdepartmental transfer is needed; I will help you with the paperwork.

zh: 会诊申请须写明目的与需要回答的问题。
en: A consultation request must state its purpose and the questions to be answered.

zh: 我们已经请外科来会诊了，请稍等。
en: We have asked the surgical team for a consultation; please wait a moment.

zh: 住院办理需先确认床位再缴纳预交金。
en: Admission processing requires confirming a bed before the deposit is paid.

zh: 医生开住院单了，我带您去办住院办理。
en: The doctor has written an admission order; I will take you to start admission processing.

zh: 入院手续包括身份核对、费用预交与物品登记。
en: The admission procedure includes identity checks, deposit payment, and belongings registration.

zh: 入院手续在一楼办理，电梯口右转。
en: The admission procedure is handled on the ground floor, right of the lifts.

zh: 出院办理需核对用药清单并预约复诊。
en: Discharge processing includes checking the medication list and booking a follow-up visit.

zh: 明天上午办出院办理，记得带押金条。
en: Discharge processing is tomorrow morning; remember to bring the deposit receipt.

zh: 检查预约可通过自助机或诊间完成。
en: Examination scheduling can be done at a kiosk or in the consulting room.

zh: 检查预约到下午三点，您先回去休息。
en: Examination scheduling has been set for three in the afternoon, so you can go and rest first.

zh: 危重患者检查陪同须由医护人员全程负责。
en: Examination escort for critically ill patients must be provided by clinical staff throughout.

zh: 需要检查陪同吗？我可以推轮椅带您去。
en: Do you need an examination escort? I can take you there in a wheelchair.

zh: 检查转运前须确认患者身份与随身管路。
en: Before examination transport, the patient's identity and attached lines must be confirmed.

zh: 检查转运的车在门口等，我们现在走。
en: The vehicle for examination transport is waiting at the door; let us go now.

zh: 门诊转急诊需由门诊医生开具转诊单。
en: An outpatient-to-emergency transfer requires a referral note from the outpatient doctor.

zh: 门诊说您得转急诊，我陪您过去。
en: The outpatient clinic says an outpatient-to-emergency transfer is needed; I will go with you.

zh: 急诊转住院需在系统中提交床位申请。
en: Emergency admission requires a bed request to be submitted in the system.

zh: 您这个情况要急诊转住院，先别回家。
en: Your condition requires emergency admission, so please do not go home yet.

zh: 每个就诊环节都需留下时间与操作人记录。
en: Each visit step must record the time and the staff member responsible.

zh: 下一个就诊环节是抽血，请到三楼。
en: The next visit step is blood sampling, so please go to the third floor.

zh: 就诊时长超过四小时的患者需说明原因。
en: Patients whose visit duration exceeds four hours must have the reason documented.

zh: 今天人少，就诊时长应该不会太久。
en: It is quiet today, so the visit duration should not be too long.

zh: 流程优化后高峰时段等候时间下降三成。
en: After process improvement, waiting time at peak hours fell by thirty percent.

zh: 我们正在做流程优化，以后会快一些。
en: We are working on process improvement, so it will be faster in future.

zh: 二次就诊需核对上次的诊断与用药。
en: A repeat visit requires checking the previous diagnosis and medication.

zh: 这是二次就诊，症状一直没好转。
en: This is a repeat visit; the symptoms have not improved at all.

zh: 就诊高峰期集中在晚间八点至十一点。
en: Peak hours are concentrated between eight and eleven in the evening.

zh: 现在正是就诊高峰期，请您多等一会儿。
en: It is peak hours right now, so please wait a little longer.

zh: 就诊状态更新为已接诊后才会进入检查队列。
en: Only after the visit status changes to seen does the patient enter the examination queue.

zh: 我查一下您的就诊状态，看排到哪了。
en: Let me check your visit status to see where you are in the queue.

zh: 就诊完成后系统会推送用药与复诊提醒。
en: After visit completion, the system sends medication and follow-up reminders.

zh: 您的就诊完成了，回去注意休息。
en: Your visit completion is confirmed; go home and rest.

zh: 就诊确认需在自助机或手机端完成。
en: Visit confirmation must be completed at a kiosk or on a mobile phone.

zh: 请在这里做就诊确认，签个名就行。
en: Please do the visit confirmation here; just sign your name.

zh: 就诊秩序由分诊护士与保安共同维护。
en: Department order is maintained jointly by triage nurses and security staff.

zh: 请大家保持就诊秩序，不要围在诊室门口。
en: Please maintain department order and do not crowd around the consulting room door.

zh: 流程公示牌列明了各环节的预计等候时间。
en: The process disclosure board lists the expected waiting time for each step.

zh: 流程公示在墙上，您可以先看一下。
en: The process disclosure is on the wall; you can read it first.

zh: 分诊后就诊按分级顺序进行，不按到院先后。
en: Consultation after triage follows the acuity order rather than arrival order.

zh: 分诊后就诊还要等一会儿，前面有重病人。
en: Consultation after triage will take a while; there are seriously ill patients ahead.

zh: 复诊预约可在离院前由医生直接完成。
en: A follow-up appointment can be arranged directly by the doctor before discharge.

zh: 复诊预约我帮您约在下周三上午。
en: I will book your follow-up appointment for next Wednesday morning.

zh: 候诊期间如症状加重请立即告知护士。
en: If symptoms worsen during waiting for consultation, tell the nurse immediately.

zh: 候诊的时候请不要离开太久，怕叫不到您。
en: Please do not leave for long while waiting for consultation, in case we call you.

zh: 候诊区设有座椅、饮水机与叫号屏幕。
en: The waiting area has seats, a water dispenser, and a calling screen.

zh: 候诊区在左手边，请那边坐。
en: The waiting area is on your left; please sit there.

zh: 三级患者的候诊时长应控制在一小时内。
en: The wait duration for level three patients should be kept under one hour.

zh: 候诊时长屏幕上会显示，您可以随时看。
en: The wait duration is shown on the screen, so you can check it at any time.

zh: 候诊叫号采用电子语音与屏幕同步提示。
en: Queue calling uses electronic voice and screen prompts at the same time.

zh: 候诊叫号声音有点小，您注意看屏幕。
en: The queue calling is a bit quiet, so please watch the screen.

zh: 叫号系统故障时改为人工呼叫。
en: When the queuing system fails, staff call patients manually.

zh: 叫号系统显示前面还有五个人。
en: The queuing system shows five people ahead of you.

zh: 排队时请保持一米间距。
en: Please keep one meter apart while queueing.

zh: 大家都在排队，请不要再往前挤。
en: Everyone is queueing, so please do not push forward.

zh: 插队会被劝阻，情节严重者移交保安处理。
en: Queue jumping is discouraged, and serious cases are referred to security.

zh: 有人插队，请护士过来维持一下。
en: Someone is queue jumping; please ask a nurse to come and keep order.

zh: 候诊序号与挂号序号一致，请勿混淆。
en: The queue number matches the registration number, so do not confuse them.

zh: 您的候诊序号是三十六，看着屏幕。
en: Your queue number is thirty-six; watch the screen.

zh: 候诊屏每十秒刷新一次叫号信息。
en: The display screen refreshes the calling information every ten seconds.

zh: 请看候诊屏，叫到您再进诊室。
en: Please watch the display screen and enter when you are called.

zh: 过号后需到分诊台重新激活排队顺序。
en: After a missed number, the patient must go to the triage desk to reactivate their place.

zh: 您刚才过号了，我帮您重新排。
en: You had a missed number just now; I will help you queue again.

zh: 重新排队需在系统内注明原因。
en: Requeueing requires the reason to be noted in the system.

zh: 过号要重新排队，前面还有三个人。
en: A missed number means you must requeue; there are three people ahead.

zh: 候诊巡视每二十分钟一次，重点看老年患者。
en: Waiting-area rounds take place every twenty minutes, focusing on older patients.

zh: 候诊巡视时发现他脸色不对，马上叫了医生。
en: During waiting-area rounds the nurse noticed he looked unwell and called a doctor at once.

zh: 候诊观察记录需写明观察时间与所见情况。
en: Waiting-area observation records must note the time and what was seen.

zh: 这个病人需要候诊观察，别让他离开视线。
en: This patient needs waiting-area observation, so do not let him out of sight.

zh: 候诊病情变化须立即重新分诊并调整分级。
en: Deterioration while waiting requires immediate re-triage and adjustment of the acuity level.

zh: 他候诊病情变化了，赶紧推到抢救室。
en: He shows deterioration while waiting; take him to the resuscitation room now.

zh: 候诊安全包括防跌倒、防走失与防交叉感染。
en: Waiting-area safety includes preventing falls, wandering, and cross-infection.

zh: 候诊安全提示贴在墙上，请留意。
en: The waiting-area safety notice is on the wall; please take note.

zh: 候诊秩序由叫号系统与现场引导共同维持。
en: Waiting order is maintained by the queuing system and on-site guidance together.

zh: 请保持候诊秩序，不要大声喧哗。
en: Please keep waiting order and do not make loud noise.

zh: 候诊患者每小时复测一次，异常者优先处理。
en: Waiting patients are rechecked hourly, and those with abnormal findings are seen first.

zh: 候诊患者请坐在座位上，不要堵在门口。
en: Waiting patients should stay seated and not block the doorway.

zh: 候诊告知应包含预计时长与病情变化时的求助方式。
en: Waiting information should cover the expected duration and how to get help if symptoms change.

zh: 候诊告知我再说一遍，您大概还要等四十分钟。
en: I will repeat the waiting information: you have about forty minutes to wait.

zh: 候诊宣教内容包括识别危险信号与正确拨打急救电话。
en: Waiting-area education covers recognizing warning signs and calling emergency services correctly.

zh: 候诊宣教的视频在循环播放，您可以看看。
en: The waiting-area education video is playing on a loop; you may watch it.

zh: 候诊环境每两小时巡查一次并记录。
en: The waiting environment is inspected and recorded every two hours.

zh: 候诊环境有点冷，我帮您调一下空调。
en: The waiting environment is a bit cold; I will adjust the air conditioning for you.

zh: 候诊拥挤时启动分流预案，开放备用诊区。
en: When overcrowding occurs, a diversion plan is activated and a backup area opened.

zh: 现在候诊拥挤，请家属到外面等。
en: There is overcrowding now, so please ask family members to wait outside.

zh: 候诊分流可把轻症患者引导至门诊诊区。
en: Waiting-area diversion can send mild cases to the outpatient area.

zh: 这边人太多，我们做候诊分流，请跟我走。
en: It is too crowded here, so we are doing waiting-area diversion; please come with me.

zh: 候诊优先级由分诊等级决定，与排队时间无关。
en: Waiting priority is set by triage level, not by time spent queueing.

zh: 他的候诊优先级高，先叫他。
en: His waiting priority is higher, so call him first.

zh: 候诊流程写在分诊台的提示牌上。
en: The waiting process is written on the notice board at the triage desk.

zh: 候诊流程您看一下，中间不要随意离开。
en: Please read the waiting process and do not leave at will in the meantime.

zh: 座位管理要求为老年与孕产妇预留前排位置。
en: Seat management requires reserving front-row seats for older people and pregnant women.

zh: 座位管理这边我来协调，请给老人让个座。
en: I will coordinate seat management here; please give up your seat to the older person.

zh: 广播叫号在三遍无人应答后转为人工寻找。
en: Loudspeaker calling switches to a manual search after three unanswered announcements.

zh: 广播叫号声音大，请注意听自己的号。
en: The loudspeaker calling is loud, so please listen for your number.

zh: 绿色通道开通后，患者可直接进入抢救室。
en: Once the fast-track pathway is opened, the patient can go straight to the resuscitation room.

zh: 您这个情况可以走绿色通道，不用排队。
en: Your condition qualifies for the fast-track pathway, so you do not need to queue.

zh: 先检查后付费适用于绿色通道患者的影像与化验项目。
en: Examination first, payment later applies to imaging and laboratory items for fast-track patients.

zh: 我们执行先检查后付费，您先去做检查，费用回头再结。
en: We use examination first, payment later, so go for the examination now and settle the cost afterwards.

zh: 批量伤员通道启用后，伤员按红黄绿分区集中处置。
en: Once the mass casualty pathway is opened, casualties are managed in red, yellow, and green areas.

zh: 伤员太多了，赶紧开批量伤员通道。
en: There are too many casualties, so open the mass casualty pathway now.

zh: 直达手术室需在患者到院前完成手术间准备。
en: Direct transfer to operating room requires the theatre to be prepared before the patient arrives.

zh: 这个病人走直达手术室，别送急诊病房。
en: This patient goes by direct transfer to operating room, not to the emergency ward.

zh: 危重孕产妇中心与产科、ICU 建立联动机制。
en: The maternal critical care center has a joint response mechanism with obstetrics and the ICU.

zh: 这位孕妇情况不好，马上联系危重孕产妇中心。
en: This pregnant woman is unstable; contact the maternal critical care center at once.

zh: 新生儿救治中心接到通知后五分钟内到位。
en: The neonatal care center team arrives within five minutes of being notified.

zh: 孩子要转新生儿救治中心，请家长签字。
en: The baby needs transfer to the neonatal care center; please sign as the parent.

zh: 先救治后付费适用于无家属陪伴的急危患者。
en: Treat first and pay later applies to critically ill patients without accompanying relatives.

zh: 这里实行先救治后付费，您先别担心钱。
en: We follow treat first and pay later here, so do not worry about money yet.

zh: 优先接诊对象包括危重患者与高龄老人。
en: Priority reception covers critically ill patients and the very old.

zh: 这位患者优先接诊，请安排到一号诊室。
en: This patient needs priority reception; please arrange room one.

zh: 优先检查需在申请单上标注绿色通道。
en: Priority examination requires the fast-track pathway to be marked on the request form.

zh: 他做了优先检查，结果半小时就出来了。
en: He had a priority examination, and the result came back within half an hour.

zh: 通道启动由急诊值班医生决定并记录时间。
en: Pathway activation is decided by the emergency doctor on duty and the time recorded.

zh: 通道已经启动了，检查单直接送过去。
en: Pathway activation is done, so send the request forms straight over.

zh: 通道时限不达标需在质控会上说明。
en: Failure to meet the pathway time target must be explained at the quality review meeting.

zh: 通道时限快到了，请催一下检查科室。
en: The pathway time target is nearly up, so please chase the examination department.

zh: 门球时间控制在九十分钟以内是胸痛中心的目标。
en: Keeping the door-to-balloon time under ninety minutes is the goal of the chest pain center.

zh: 门球时间每缩短十分钟，救回的人就更多。
en: Every ten minutes cut from the door-to-balloon time saves more lives.

zh: 门针时间超过六十分钟需逐例分析原因。
en: Cases with a door-to-needle time over sixty minutes are analysed individually.

zh: 门针时间是卒中救治的关键指标。
en: The door-to-needle time is a key indicator in stroke care.

zh: 通道标识采用统一绿色，夜间配有反光条。
en: Pathway signage uses a uniform green, with reflective strips at night.

zh: 沿着通道标识走，不要拐错方向。
en: Follow the pathway signage and do not turn the wrong way.

zh: 通道管理由急诊科与相关专科共同负责。
en: Pathway management is shared by the emergency department and the relevant specialties.

zh: 通道管理有问题，我们会定期开会解决。
en: When pathway management has problems, we meet regularly to solve them.

zh: 通道质控报告每季度向院级委员会提交。
en: The pathway quality control report is submitted to the hospital committee every quarter.

zh: 通道质控数据出来了，达标率比上季度高。
en: The pathway quality control data are out, and the compliance rate is higher than last quarter.

zh: 通道协调员负责通知导管室与转运人员。
en: The pathway coordinator notifies the catheterization laboratory and the transport staff.

zh: 有问题找通道协调员，她一直在急诊。
en: If there is a problem, find the pathway coordinator; she is always in the emergency department.

zh: 多学科团队在患者到院前已完成分工。
en: The multidisciplinary care team has already divided tasks before the patient arrives.

zh: 多学科团队马上到，各组准备好。
en: The multidisciplinary care team is arriving; all groups get ready.

zh: 一键启动后相关科室同时收到推送信息。
en: After one-call activation, all relevant departments receive the alert at once.

zh: 情况紧急，马上做一键启动。
en: It is urgent, so do the one-call activation now.

zh: 院前预警内容包括病情、预计到院时间与所需资源。
en: A prehospital alert covers the condition, estimated arrival time, and resources needed.

zh: 收到院前预警了，抢救室先准备床位。
en: The prehospital alert has come in, so prepare a bed in the resuscitation room first.

zh: 绕行急诊可再缩短十分钟的救治时间。
en: Emergency department bypass can shorten treatment time by another ten minutes.

zh: 这个病人走绕行急诊，直接去导管室。
en: This patient goes by emergency department bypass straight to the catheterization laboratory.

zh: 直达导管室需提前通知介入团队待命。
en: Direct transfer to the catheterization laboratory requires the interventional team to be alerted in advance.

zh: 走直达导管室，路上不要停。
en: Use direct transfer to the catheterization laboratory; do not stop on the way.

zh: 优先权仅限本次急诊诊疗期间有效。
en: Priority access applies only during the current emergency visit.

zh: 优先权不是特权，是为了抢时间。
en: Priority access is not a privilege; it is about saving time.

zh: 通道响应时间已纳入科室绩效考核。
en: Response time is now part of the department's performance assessment.

zh: 通道响应时间是十二分钟，达标了。
en: The response time was twelve minutes, which meets the target.

zh: 溶栓时间窗内到院的患者优先处理。
en: Patients arriving within the thrombolysis time window are treated first.

zh: 还在时间窗内，赶紧安排手术。
en: We are still within the time window, so arrange surgery at once.

zh: 应急通道禁止停放车辆与堆放物品。
en: Parking and storage are prohibited on the emergency access route.

zh: 请把车挪开，这是应急通道。
en: Please move your car; this is the emergency access route.

zh: 通道延误需记录原因并追踪整改。
en: A pathway delay must be recorded with its cause and followed up for correction.

zh: 这次通道延误是因为检查科室没接电话。
en: This pathway delay happened because the examination department did not answer the phone.

zh: 转诊前须与接收医院确认床位与接收条件。
en: Before referral, the bed and acceptance conditions must be confirmed with the receiving hospital.

zh: 我们这边治不了，需要转诊。
en: We cannot treat this here, so a referral is needed.

zh: 转诊单须由主管医生填写并签名。
en: The referral form must be completed and signed by the doctor in charge.

zh: 转诊单我给您装好了，别弄丢。
en: I have put the referral form in an envelope for you; do not lose it.

zh: 转诊申请需附上主要检查结果与初步诊断。
en: A referral request must include the main test results and the preliminary diagnosis.

zh: 转诊申请已经发出去了，等对方回复。
en: The referral request has been sent; we are waiting for their reply.

zh: 转诊指征包括本院不具备的诊疗能力。
en: Referral indications include services that this hospital cannot provide.

zh: 这个病人符合转诊指征，可以联系转院。
en: This patient meets the referral indication, so transfer can be arranged.

zh: 转诊评估须在转运前完成并记录结论。
en: Transfer assessment must be completed and its conclusion documented before transport.

zh: 转诊评估还没做，先别急着走。
en: The transfer assessment has not been done yet, so do not rush off.

zh: 转诊登记完成后系统会生成转诊编号。
en: After referral registration is complete, the system generates a referral number.

zh: 转诊登记我来录，您先联系救护车。
en: I will do the referral registration; you contact the ambulance first.

zh: 转诊审批一般在一小时内完成。
en: Transfer approval is usually completed within one hour.

zh: 转诊审批还没下来，先维持治疗。
en: Transfer approval has not come through yet, so continue treatment for now.

zh: 转诊接收须先确认床位与专科能力。
en: Referral acceptance requires first confirming the bed and specialist capacity.

zh: 对方回复转诊接收了，可以出发。
en: They have confirmed referral acceptance, so we can set off.

zh: 接收确认需记录答复人与时间。
en: Acceptance confirmation must record the person who replied and the time.

zh: 接收确认拿到了，我发到群里。
en: I have got the acceptance confirmation and will post it in the group.

zh: 接诊准备包括床位、设备与专科人员到位。
en: Reception preparation includes having the bed, equipment, and specialist staff ready.

zh: 接诊准备做好了，患者到了直接进抢救室。
en: Reception preparation is done, so the patient goes straight into the resuscitation room on arrival.

zh: 床位预留超过两小时未使用须释放。
en: A bed reservation not used within two hours must be released.

zh: 床位预留好了，到院就能直接住。
en: The bed reservation is done, so the patient can be admitted directly on arrival.

zh: 转诊反馈应在患者到院后二十四小时内发出。
en: Referral feedback should be sent within twenty-four hours of the patient's arrival.

zh: 转诊反馈收到了，那边说手术很顺利。
en: The referral feedback has arrived; they say the surgery went smoothly.

zh: 双向转诊可减少患者在大医院长期占用床位。
en: Two-way referral reduces the long-term occupation of beds in large hospitals.

zh: 我们和社区医院有双向转诊，恢复期可以转下去。
en: We have two-way referral with community hospitals, so recovery cases can be sent down.

zh: 上转患者需携带基层机构的诊疗记录。
en: Patients sent by upward referral must bring the records from the primary facility.

zh: 这里条件不够，得做上转。
en: The facilities here are not enough, so an upward referral is needed.

zh: 下转前需评估患者转运风险并做好交接。
en: Before downward referral, transport risk must be assessed and a proper handover made.

zh: 病情稳定了，可以考虑下转回社区。
en: The condition is stable now, so a downward referral back to the community can be considered.

zh: 跨院转诊须由双方医院确认接收安排。
en: Inter-hospital transfer requires both hospitals to confirm the receiving arrangements.

zh: 跨院转诊的手续我们来办，您签字就行。
en: We will handle the inter-hospital transfer paperwork; you just sign.

zh: 跨省转诊需提前联系对方医院并办理异地备案。
en: Interprovincial transfer requires contacting the other hospital in advance and filing out-of-town records.

zh: 跨省转诊路途远，家属要提前商量好。
en: An interprovincial transfer is a long trip, so the family should discuss it in advance.

zh: 国际转诊需协调签证、保险与航空医疗资源。
en: International referral requires coordinating visas, insurance, and air medical resources.

zh: 国际转诊手续复杂，家属要提前准备材料。
en: International referral involves complex paperwork, so the family should prepare the documents early.

zh: 转诊沟通应记录时间、对象与主要内容。
en: Referral communication should record the time, the person contacted, and the main points.

zh: 转诊沟通我来打电话，您把资料整理好。
en: I will handle the referral communication by phone; you get the documents in order.

zh: 转诊电话须使用科室登记的工作号码拨打。
en: A referral call must be made from the department's registered work number.

zh: 转诊电话打通了，对方同意接收。
en: The referral call went through and they agreed to accept the patient.

zh: 转诊风险须在转诊前向家属说明并记录。
en: Transfer risk must be explained to the family and documented before the transfer.

zh: 转诊风险不小，路上必须带监护设备。
en: The transfer risk is significant, so monitoring equipment must be taken on the journey.

zh: 转诊延误原因需在科室例会上分析。
en: The causes of referral delay are analysed at the department meeting.

zh: 这次转诊延误是因为对方没床位。
en: This referral delay happened because the other hospital had no bed.

zh: 转诊绿色通道可让患者到院后直接进入诊区。
en: The referral fast track lets patients go straight into the treatment area on arrival.

zh: 我们走转诊绿色通道，那边已经留好位置了。
en: We are using the referral fast track, and they have already kept a place for us.

zh: 对口医院之间可优先安排转诊床位。
en: Partner hospitals can arrange referral beds on a priority basis.

zh: 这是我们的对口医院，转过去比较快。
en: This is our partner hospital, so the transfer will be quicker.

zh: 医联体内可实现检查结果互认与双向转诊。
en: Within a medical consortium, test results are mutually recognized and two-way referral is possible.

zh: 我们医联体内转诊不用重复检查。
en: Within our medical consortium, referral does not require repeating the tests.

zh: 转诊标准由医院根据专科能力统一制定。
en: Referral criteria are set by the hospital according to its specialist capacity.

zh: 按转诊标准，这个病人应该转到上级医院。
en: Under the referral criteria, this patient should be sent to a higher-level hospital.

zh: 转诊档案随患者一并移交接收医院。
en: The referral file is handed over to the receiving hospital together with the patient.

zh: 转诊档案我复印一份留底。
en: I will photocopy the referral file and keep a copy.

zh: 急救呼叫接通后须在一分钟内完成地址确认。
en: After an emergency call is connected, the address must be confirmed within one minute.

zh: 急救呼叫电话请说清楚地点和病人情况。
en: For the emergency call, please state the location and the patient's condition clearly.

zh: 急救电话在本地为120，境外游客需提前了解。
en: The local emergency number is 120, and visitors from abroad should learn it in advance.

zh: 急救电话是多少？我马上打。
en: What is the emergency number? I will call right away.

zh: 呼叫受理包括地址、伤情与联系电话三项要素。
en: Call intake covers three elements: address, condition, and contact number.

zh: 呼叫受理完成了，车已经派出。
en: Call intake is complete and the ambulance has been dispatched.

zh: 调度员根据病情轻重安排出车顺序。
en: The dispatcher sets the dispatch order according to the severity of the condition.

zh: 调度员说最近的车十分钟到。
en: The dispatcher says the nearest ambulance will arrive in ten minutes.

zh: 出车时间以车辆驶离急救站为准。
en: Ambulance dispatch time is counted from when the vehicle leaves the station.

zh: 已经出车了，请保持电话畅通。
en: Ambulance dispatch has been done, so please keep your phone line free.

zh: 救护车调配以病情紧急程度与车辆位置为依据。
en: Ambulance deployment is based on the urgency of the condition and the position of vehicles.

zh: 救护车调配已经完成，最近的车在路上了。
en: Ambulance deployment is done, and the nearest vehicle is on its way.

zh: 出车时间要求控制在三分钟以内。
en: Dispatch time is required to be kept within three minutes.

zh: 出车时间两分半，符合要求。
en: Dispatch time was two and a half minutes, which meets the requirement.

zh: 到达时间由车载系统自动记录。
en: Arrival time is recorded automatically by the on-board system.

zh: 到达时间是九点十二分，请记一下。
en: The arrival time is nine twelve; please note it down.

zh: 急救现场评估包括环境安全、意识与出血情况。
en: On-scene assessment covers scene safety, consciousness, and bleeding.

zh: 急救现场评估还没做完，先别搬动伤员。
en: The on-scene assessment is not finished, so do not move the casualty yet.

zh: 派车单需与车载记录核对一致。
en: The dispatch order must be checked against the on-board record.

zh: 派车单打好了，司机签字就可以走。
en: The dispatch order is printed; the driver can leave after signing.

zh: 院前医疗急救记录须随患者移交急诊科。
en: The prehospital medical care record must be handed to the emergency department with the patient.

zh: 院前医疗急救已经做了初步处理，到院直接评估。
en: Prehospital medical care has already given initial treatment, so assess directly on arrival.

zh: 预到达通知应说明人数、伤情与预计到达时间。
en: Pre-arrival notification should state the number of patients, their condition, and the estimated arrival time.

zh: 预到达通知发过来了，准备两个抢救位。
en: The pre-arrival notification has come, so prepare two resuscitation bays.

zh: 呼叫优先级分为立即出车、优先出车与常规出车。
en: Call priority is divided into immediate dispatch, priority dispatch, and routine dispatch.

zh: 这个呼叫优先级高，先派车。
en: This call priority is high, so dispatch the ambulance first.

zh: 呼叫记录保存不少于两年。
en: Call records are kept for at least two years.

zh: 呼叫记录调出来听一下，确认地址没错。
en: Let us play back the call record to confirm the address was right.

zh: 电话指导可包括止血、体位与心肺复苏。
en: Telephone instruction may cover bleeding control, positioning, and CPR.

zh: 电话指导您先别搬动他，等我们到。
en: The telephone instruction is not to move him until we arrive.

zh: 急救站按区域布点，缩短到达时间。
en: Ambulance stations are located by district to shorten arrival times.

zh: 最近的急救站离这里三公里。
en: The nearest ambulance station is three kilometres from here.

zh: 急救网络覆盖城区与周边乡镇。
en: The emergency network covers the urban area and surrounding townships.

zh: 急救网络这边信号不好，定位会偏。
en: The emergency network signal is poor here, so the location may be off.

zh: 急救资源在高峰期需统一调配。
en: Emergency resources must be allocated centrally during peak periods.

zh: 现在急救资源紧张，请耐心等待。
en: Emergency resources are stretched right now, so please wait patiently.

zh: 城区急救半径一般不超过五公里。
en: The response radius in urban areas is usually no more than five kilometres.

zh: 超出急救半径的地方，到达时间会久一些。
en: Places beyond the response radius will have a longer arrival time.

zh: 急救调度中心可实时显示车辆位置。
en: The dispatch center shows vehicle locations in real time.

zh: 急救调度中心刚发来指令，让我们改去另一个现场。
en: The dispatch center has just sent an order for us to go to another scene.

zh: 急救指挥中心负责跨区域力量调配。
en: The emergency command center coordinates resources across districts.

zh: 现场由急救指挥统一安排，不要各自行动。
en: The scene is coordinated by emergency command, so do not act independently.

zh: 呼救者需留在现场并保持电话畅通。
en: The caller should stay at the scene and keep the phone line free.

zh: 呼救者说是老人突然倒地，没有呼吸。
en: The caller says an older person suddenly collapsed and is not breathing.

zh: 出诊记录须由出诊医生签字确认。
en: The house call record must be signed by the doctor who attended.

zh: 出诊记录写完了吗？到院要交接。
en: Is the house call record finished? It is needed for the handover on arrival.

zh: 急救车通道禁止社会车辆占用。
en: The ambulance bay must not be occupied by private vehicles.

zh: 急救车通道被堵了，请保安来疏导。
en: The ambulance bay is blocked; please send security to clear it.

zh: 直升机救援适用于交通中断的山区。
en: Helicopter rescue is used in mountain areas where roads are cut off.

zh: 病情太重，需要申请直升机救援。
en: The condition is too severe, so helicopter rescue needs to be requested.

zh: 无线通信中断时改用手机联络。
en: When radio communication fails, mobile phones are used instead.

zh: 无线通信信号不好，请重复一遍。
en: The radio communication signal is poor; please repeat that.

zh: 出车指令包含地点、伤情与注意事项。
en: The dispatch instruction includes the location, the condition, and points to note.

zh: 出车指令收到了，马上出发。
en: The dispatch instruction has been received; we are leaving now.

zh: 陪护须遵守病房作息与探视规定。
en: Accompanying care must follow ward routines and visiting rules.

zh: 需要陪护吗？一个人可能不方便。
en: Do you need accompanying care? It may be difficult on your own.

zh: 陪护证需每日到护士站更换。
en: The caregiver pass must be renewed at the nurses' station each day.

zh: 陪护证丢了，麻烦补办一张。
en: I have lost my caregiver pass; please issue a replacement.

zh: 陪护人员不得随意进入治疗室。
en: Caregivers must not enter the treatment room without permission.

zh: 每位患者只留一名陪护人员。
en: Only one caregiver is allowed per patient.

zh: 探视须在护士站登记并佩戴口罩。
en: Visiting requires registration at the nurses' station and a mask.

zh: 今天可以探视吗？我从外地赶过来的。
en: Is visiting allowed today? I have come from out of town.

zh: 探视时间为每日下午三点至五点。
en: Visiting hours are from three to five in the afternoon each day.

zh: 现在不是探视时间，请在楼下等。
en: It is not visiting hours now, so please wait downstairs.

zh: 探视规定包括限一人进入与禁止携带食物。
en: The visiting policy limits entry to one person and forbids bringing food.

zh: 探视规定贴在门口，请先看一下。
en: The visiting policy is posted at the door; please read it first.

zh: 探视证当日有效，离院时交回。
en: The visitor pass is valid for the day and must be returned on leaving.

zh: 请出示探视证，没有的话不能进。
en: Please show your visitor pass; without one you cannot enter.

zh: 陪护床需在早上七点前收起。
en: The caregiver bed must be folded away before seven in the morning.

zh: 陪护床还有吗？我想租一张。
en: Is there a caregiver bed available? I would like to rent one.

zh: 家属等候区设有信息屏与饮水设施。
en: The family waiting area has an information screen and drinking water.

zh: 家属等候区在走廊尽头，别堵在抢救室门口。
en: The family waiting area is at the end of the corridor, so do not block the resuscitation room door.

zh: 家属陪同可帮助患者完成缴费与取药。
en: Family accompaniment helps the patient complete payment and collect medication.

zh: 需要家属陪同吗？老人一个人不方便。
en: Is family accompaniment needed? It is not easy for the older person alone.

zh: 一人一陪在病区执行得比较严格。
en: One caregiver per patient is enforced fairly strictly in the wards.

zh: 现在是一人一陪，其他家属请回去。
en: It is one caregiver per patient now, so other relatives please go home.

zh: 陪护登记在入院时与患者信息一并完成。
en: Caregiver registration is completed together with the patient's details on admission.

zh: 陪护登记请到护士站办一下。
en: Please go to the nurses' station to complete caregiver registration.

zh: 探视登记需记录来访时间与体温结果。
en: Visitor registration must record the visiting time and the temperature result.

zh: 探视登记在门口办，两分钟就好。
en: Visitor registration is done at the door and takes two minutes.

zh: 探视限制适用于保护性隔离患者。
en: Visiting restrictions apply to patients under protective isolation.

zh: 现在有探视限制，一次只能进一个人。
en: There are visiting restrictions now, so only one person may enter at a time.

zh: 探视暂停期间家属可通过视频联系患者。
en: During the suspension of visiting, relatives can contact the patient by video.

zh: 病区临时探视暂停，请先回去等通知。
en: The suspension of visiting applies temporarily in the ward, so please go home and wait for notice.

zh: 儿童探视需由成人陪同并做好防护。
en: Child visiting requires an adult to accompany the child and protective measures.

zh: 儿童探视一般不建议，怕交叉感染。
en: Child visiting is generally not advised because of the risk of cross-infection.

zh: 远程探视由护士协助患者与家属连线。
en: Virtual visiting is set up by a nurse connecting the patient with relatives.

zh: 家属在外地，可以用远程探视。
en: The family is out of town, so virtual visiting can be used.

zh: 视频探视每日安排两次，每次十五分钟。
en: Video visits are arranged twice a day, fifteen minutes each.

zh: 视频探视的时间到了，我帮您接通。
en: It is time for your video visit; I will connect the call.

zh: 陪护管理纳入病区日常护理工作。
en: Caregiver management is part of daily ward nursing work.

zh: 陪护管理查得严，证件不齐进不去。
en: Caregiver management is strict, so you cannot enter without the full documents.

zh: 探视管理由护士与保安分工负责。
en: Visitor management is shared between nurses and security staff.

zh: 探视管理是为了患者休息，请理解。
en: Visitor management is for the patient's rest, so please understand.

zh: 夜间陪护需在护士站备案并领取折叠床。
en: An overnight caregiver must be registered at the nurses' station and collect a folding bed.

zh: 夜间陪护只能留一个人。
en: Only one overnight caregiver may stay.

zh: 陪护安全包括防跌倒与用电安全提示。
en: Caregiver safety includes advice on preventing falls and using electricity safely.

zh: 陪护安全要注意，走廊地面刚拖过。
en: Mind caregiver safety; the corridor floor was just mopped.

zh: 候诊家属请留一人在场，其余人在等候区。
en: Relatives in the waiting area should keep one person present and the rest there.

zh: 候诊家属不要在诊室门口围观。
en: Relatives in the waiting area should not crowd around the consulting room door.

zh: 陪护须知在入院时随病历一并发放。
en: Caregiver guidelines are given out with the chart on admission.

zh: 陪护须知您看一下，有事按呼叫铃。
en: Please read the caregiver guidelines; if you need anything, press the call bell.

zh: 探视时段分为上午与下午两个单元。
en: Visiting sessions are divided into a morning and an afternoon slot.

zh: 您在第二个探视时段再来吧。
en: Please come back during the second visiting session.

zh: 语言初筛在挂号时完成，结果记入系统。
en: Language screening is completed at registration, and the result is recorded in the system.

zh: 语言初筛问一下，您平时说普通话还是方言？
en: For language screening, may I ask whether you usually speak Mandarin or a dialect?

zh: 语言需求评估后安排相应的翻译服务。
en: After language needs are assessed, the appropriate interpretation service is arranged.

zh: 您的语言需求我记下了，马上安排翻译。
en: I have noted your language needs and will arrange an interpreter at once.

zh: 存在语言障碍时须启用医疗翻译，不得让家属随意代译。
en: When a language barrier exists, a medical interpreter must be used rather than letting relatives translate.

zh: 我们有语言障碍，请找个会说英语的医生。
en: We have a language barrier, so please find a doctor who speaks English.

zh: 翻译服务可通过院内平台一键呼叫。
en: The interpretation service can be called with one click through the hospital platform.

zh: 翻译服务是免费的，您不用担心费用。
en: The interpretation service is free, so do not worry about the cost.

zh: 少数民族语言翻译资源需提前登记。
en: Minority language interpreting resources must be registered in advance.

zh: 患者说少数民族语言，请安排翻译。
en: The patient speaks a minority language; please arrange an interpreter.

zh: 英语沟通能力是涉外急诊岗位的基本要求。
en: English communication is a basic requirement for posts in international emergency care.

zh: 我英语沟通不太行，请帮我叫同事。
en: My English communication is not good, so please call a colleague for me.

zh: 文化初筛内容包括饮食、宗教与性别照护偏好。
en: Cultural screening covers diet, religion, and preferences regarding gender of carers.

zh: 文化初筛问几句就好，主要是避免冒犯。
en: Cultural screening takes only a few questions and mainly avoids offence.

zh: 文化背景会影响患者对治疗方案的接受度。
en: Cultural background affects how readily a patient accepts a treatment plan.

zh: 先了解一下患者的文化背景，沟通会顺一些。
en: Understanding the patient's cultural background first makes communication smoother.

zh: 健康素养偏低者需用图示反复说明。
en: Patients with low health literacy need repeated explanations with pictures.

zh: 他健康素养不高，别一次说太多。
en: His health literacy is not high, so do not explain too much at once.

zh: 识字水平不足时改用语音与图示告知。
en: When the literacy level is limited, voice and pictures are used instead.

zh: 先问一下识字水平，再决定怎么讲解。
en: Ask about literacy level first, then decide how to explain.

zh: 沟通辅助工具包括图示卡、翻译机与手写板。
en: Communication aids include picture cards, translation devices, and writing boards.

zh: 用沟通辅助卡指一下哪里疼。
en: Use the communication aid card to point to where it hurts.

zh: 翻译申请须注明语种与预计使用时长。
en: An interpreter request must state the language and the expected duration.

zh: 翻译申请我提交了，等二十分钟。
en: I have submitted the interpreter request; it will take about twenty minutes.

zh: 翻译设备需每日充电并测试语音质量。
en: Translation devices must be charged daily and their audio quality tested.

zh: 翻译设备没电了，换一台。
en: The translation device is out of power, so swap it for another.

zh: 多语种服务覆盖英语、日语、韩语与俄语。
en: Multilingual service covers English, Japanese, Korean, and Russian.

zh: 我们有多语种服务，您需要哪种语言？
en: We have multilingual service; which language do you need?

zh: 语言偏好应记录在病历首页。
en: Language preference should be recorded on the first page of the chart.

zh: 说一下您的语言偏好，我们好安排。
en: Tell us your language preference so we can arrange it.

zh: 语言标识覆盖挂号、缴费与检查区域。
en: Language signage covers registration, payment, and examination areas.

zh: 跟着语言标识走，就能找到抽血处。
en: Follow the language signage and you will find the blood sampling area.

zh: 翻译错误可能造成用药剂量理解偏差。
en: An interpretation error can lead to misunderstanding of drug doses.

zh: 刚才翻译错误了，我重新确认一遍。
en: There was an interpretation error just now, so let me confirm again.

zh: 特殊人群包括老年人、孕产妇、儿童与残疾人。
en: Special populations include older people, pregnant women, children, and people with disabilities.

zh: 特殊人群可以优先安排，请到这边。
en: Special populations can be given priority; please come this way.

zh: 优先就诊需在分诊时标注并在系统中体现。
en: Priority consultation must be marked at triage and shown in the system.

zh: 老人可以优先就诊，不用排这么久。
en: Older people can have priority consultation and do not need to wait so long.

zh: 优先安排需在系统中留下时间标记。
en: Priority arrangements must leave a time stamp in the system.

zh: 我们已经给您做了优先安排，请稍等。
en: We have made a priority arrangement for you; please wait a moment.

zh: 老年人优先在挂号与检查环节均有提示。
en: Priority for older adults is signposted at both registration and examination.

zh: 这里有老年人优先，您先坐这边。
en: We have priority for older adults here, so please sit here first.

zh: 孕妇优先可减少长时间站立带来的风险。
en: Priority for pregnant women reduces the risk of prolonged standing.

zh: 孕妇优先，请跟我到里面等。
en: Priority for pregnant women applies, so please come inside with me.

zh: 儿童优先与儿科分诊共同执行。
en: Priority for children is applied together with pediatric triage.

zh: 孩子发烧，可以儿童优先吗？
en: The child has a fever; can we use priority for children?

zh: 残疾人优先包括优先使用无障碍设施。
en: Priority for persons with disabilities includes priority use of accessible facilities.

zh: 残疾人优先，请走这边的通道。
en: Priority for persons with disabilities applies, so please use this route.

zh: 军人优先窗口设在挂号处一号。
en: The priority for military personnel window is at registration window one.

zh: 军人优先，请出示军官证。
en: Priority for military personnel applies, so please show your officer's card.

zh: 优抚对象凭有效证件可享受费用减免。
en: Preferential care recipients can receive fee reductions with valid documents.

zh: 您属于优抚对象吗？可以优先安排。
en: Are you a preferential care recipient? Priority can be arranged.

zh: 无障碍通道坡度不超过五度。
en: The accessible route has a slope of no more than five degrees.

zh: 推轮椅请走无障碍通道。
en: Take the wheelchair along the accessible route.

zh: 无障碍设施分布图张贴在导医台旁。
en: The accessibility facilities map is posted next to the information desk.

zh: 无障碍设施在电梯后面，我带您去。
en: The accessibility facilities are behind the lifts; I will take you there.

zh: 轮椅借用需登记姓名与联系方式。
en: Borrowing a wheelchair requires recording the name and contact details.

zh: 需要轮椅吗？我推您过去。
en: Do you need a wheelchair? I will push you there.

zh: 轮椅租借点设在急诊入口右侧。
en: The wheelchair loan point is on the right of the emergency entrance.

zh: 轮椅租借要押证件，用完归还。
en: Wheelchair loan requires a document as a deposit, returned after use.

zh: 听力障碍患者可申请手语或文字沟通。
en: Patients with hearing impairment can request sign language or written communication.

zh: 他有听力障碍，说话请慢一点、大声一点。
en: He has hearing impairment, so please speak slowly and loudly.

zh: 视力障碍患者需由工作人员引导就诊。
en: Patients with visual impairment must be guided through the visit by staff.

zh: 她有视力障碍，请扶着走。
en: She has visual impairment, so please hold her arm as she walks.

zh: 智力障碍患者须由监护人或家属陪同。
en: Patients with intellectual disability must be accompanied by a guardian or relative.

zh: 他有智力障碍，请跟家属确认治疗方案。
en: He has intellectual disability, so confirm the treatment plan with the family.

zh: 失能老人优先安排在靠近诊室的位置候诊。
en: Disabled older adults are seated closer to the consulting room while waiting.

zh: 这位是失能老人，需要人扶着走。
en: This is a disabled older adult who needs someone to support him while walking.

zh: 独居老人就诊后需评估是否需要社会支持。
en: An older adult living alone should be assessed for social support after the visit.

zh: 他是独居老人，回去没人照顾怎么办？
en: He is an older adult living alone; who will look after him at home?

zh: 特殊人群登记在挂号时同步完成。
en: Special population registration is completed at the same time as registration.

zh: 特殊人群登记我帮您勾上，后面会优先叫号。
en: I will tick special population registration for you, and you will be called earlier.

zh: 优先标识采用醒目的橙色底纹。
en: Priority signage uses a prominent orange background.

zh: 看到优先标识就可以直接过来。
en: When you see the priority signage, come straight over.

zh: 爱心窗口可同时办理挂号与缴费。
en: The priority service window handles both registration and payment.

zh: 爱心窗口那边人少，去那边办吧。
en: There are fewer people at the priority service window, so go there.

zh: 志愿服务在急诊高峰时段增加岗位。
en: Volunteer service adds posts during peak hours in the emergency department.

zh: 志愿服务台有志愿者，可以问路。
en: There are volunteers at the volunteer service desk who can give directions.

zh: 医务社工可协助申请医疗救助与临时照护。
en: A medical social worker can help apply for medical assistance and temporary care.

zh: 医务社工马上来，帮您联系社区。
en: The medical social worker will be here soon to contact the community for you.

zh: 无障碍沟通包括大字版材料与语音播报。
en: Accessible communication includes large-print materials and voice announcements.

zh: 我们做无障碍沟通，给您用大字版。
en: We use accessible communication, so here is a large-print version.

zh: 优先顺序由系统自动插入，不需人工干预。
en: The priority sequence is inserted automatically by the system without manual action.

zh: 您的优先顺序在第三位，很快到您。
en: Your position in the priority sequence is third, so it will be your turn soon.

zh: 爱心陪诊覆盖挂号、检查与取药全过程。
en: Accompanied assistance covers registration, examination, and medication collection.

zh: 需要爱心陪诊吗？我们有志愿者陪同。
en: Do you need accompanied assistance? We have volunteers to go with you.

zh: 导医服务覆盖急诊大厅各主要通道。
en: Guide service covers the main corridors of the emergency hall.

zh: 找不到地方就问导医。
en: If you cannot find the place, ask the guide service.

zh: 导医台备有轮椅、老花镜与充电设备。
en: The information desk keeps wheelchairs, reading glasses, and charging facilities.

zh: 导医台在正门进去左手边。
en: The information desk is on the left after the main entrance.

zh: 导诊人员熟悉各科室位置与检查流程。
en: Navigation assistance staff know the location of each department and the examination process.

zh: 需要导诊吗？我陪您走一趟。
en: Do you need navigation assistance? I will go with you.

zh: 问询高峰集中在上午九点至十一点。
en: Inquiry peaks between nine and eleven in the morning.

zh: 问询请到导医台，别在诊室门口问。
en: Please make your inquiry at the information desk, not at the consulting room door.

zh: 指引信息须与院内标识保持一致。
en: Direction information must match the hospital signs.

zh: 我给您指引一下，往前走第二个路口右转。
en: Let me give you directions: go straight and turn right at the second corner.

zh: 楼层指引牌在电梯厅内，随时可查。
en: The floor guide board is in the lift lobby and can be checked at any time.

zh: 楼层指引上写着三楼是检验科。
en: The floor guide says the laboratory is on the third floor.

zh: 科室指引按拼音排序，方便查找。
en: Department guides are sorted alphabetically for easy searching.

zh: 我查一下科室指引，外科在五楼。
en: Let me check the department guide; surgery is on the fifth floor.

zh: 路线指引需考虑无障碍与就近原则。
en: Route guidance must take accessibility and the shortest distance into account.

zh: 给您做条路线指引，这样不会走错。
en: Let me give you route guidance so you do not go the wrong way.

zh: 院内导航可在手机端实时显示位置。
en: In-hospital navigation shows the patient's position in real time on a mobile phone.

zh: 用院内导航扫这个码，跟着箭头走。
en: Use in-hospital navigation by scanning this code and follow the arrows.

zh: 指示牌高度须便于轮椅患者阅读。
en: Signposts must be placed at a height that wheelchair users can read.

zh: 跟着指示牌走就到急诊了。
en: Follow the signposts and you will reach the emergency department.

zh: 投诉受理须记录时间、事由与联系方式。
en: Complaint intake must record the time, the issue, and contact details.

zh: 投诉受理在门诊办公室，我带您去。
en: Complaint intake is at the outpatient office; I will take you there.

zh: 投诉登记后系统自动生成查询编号。
en: After complaint registration, the system generates a reference number automatically.

zh: 投诉登记好了，这是您的编号。
en: Complaint registration is done; here is your reference number.

zh: 投诉反馈须以书面或电话形式完成。
en: Complaint feedback must be given in writing or by telephone.

zh: 投诉反馈我们会打电话告诉您。
en: We will give you complaint feedback by telephone.

zh: 投诉电话在急诊大厅与官网均有公示。
en: The complaint hotline is published in the emergency hall and on the official website.

zh: 投诉电话是哪个？我想反映一下。
en: What is the complaint hotline? I would like to raise something.

zh: 意见箱每周开箱两次并登记。
en: The suggestion box is opened twice a week and the contents recorded.

zh: 有意见可以写下来投到意见箱。
en: If you have comments, write them down and put them in the suggestion box.

zh: 满意度按季度统计并向科室反馈。
en: Satisfaction is measured quarterly and reported back to departments.

zh: 您的满意度对我们很重要，请如实评价。
en: Your satisfaction matters to us, so please give an honest rating.

zh: 服务态度是投诉中最常见的项目。
en: Service attitude is the most common subject of complaints.

zh: 服务态度有问题我们可以反映。
en: If there is a problem with service attitude, we can report it.

zh: 便民服务项目在导医台公示。
en: Convenience service items are listed at the information desk.

zh: 便民服务有充电宝，您要借吗？
en: Convenience service includes power banks; would you like to borrow one?

zh: 失物招领处设在导医台，保留三十天。
en: Lost and found is at the information desk and items are kept for thirty days.

zh: 我的手机丢了，能去失物招领看看吗？
en: I have lost my phone; can I check lost and found?

zh: 首问负责要求不得以不知情为由推诿。
en: First-contact responsibility forbids brushing patients off by claiming ignorance.

zh: 首问负责，您问我我就帮您问到底。
en: Under first-contact responsibility, if you ask me I will follow it through.

zh: 服务窗口实行弹性排班应对高峰。
en: Service windows use flexible staffing to cope with peak periods.

zh: 服务窗口都开着，请分散排队。
en: All service windows are open, so please spread out when queueing.

zh: 服务改进方案由患者服务中心牵头制定。
en: Service improvement plans are drawn up by the patient service center.

zh: 您的意见会用于服务改进。
en: Your comments will be used for service improvement.

zh: 满意度评分低于四分的科室需说明原因。
en: Departments with a satisfaction score below four must explain why.

zh: 满意度评分一共五分，您给几分？
en: The satisfaction score is out of five; how many would you give?

zh: 病历主诉栏记录为胸痛两小时，与现病史一致。
en: The chief complaint was documented as chest pain for two hours.

zh: 请您用一句话说清主诉，就是最难受的地方。
en: Please give me your chief complaint in one sentence.

zh: 病程已有一周，期间症状逐步加重，需详细记录。
en: The duration of illness has been one week, with symptoms worsening gradually.

zh: 这个病程时间您记得准吗，大概从哪天开始。
en: Can you recall the duration of illness, roughly from which day?

zh: 起病时间记录为昨晚十点，距今约六小时。
en: The onset time was recorded as ten last night, about six hours ago.

zh: 起病时间越准确越好，麻烦想想当时在做什么。
en: The more exact the onset time, the better; think what you were doing.

zh: 起病方式对鉴别诊断很重要，请写明是骤起还是渐起。
en: The mode of onset matters for diagnosis; note whether it was abrupt or gradual.

zh: 您这个起病方式是突然一下，还是慢慢加重的。
en: Was the mode of onset sudden, or did it build up slowly?

zh: 突发起病伴大汗提示急性事件，需立即评估。
en: Sudden onset with heavy sweating suggests an acute event needing immediate assessment.

zh: 我这次是突发起病的，正吃饭时一下子就不行了。
en: This was of sudden onset; I went down while eating.

zh: 隐匿起病者常无法给出确切起点，需反复追问。
en: In insidious onset, patients often cannot give an exact starting point.

zh: 这种隐匿起病的情况，往往拖到很重才来医院。
en: With such an insidious onset, people come in only when very ill.

zh: 首发症状为乏力，三天后才出现发热，需写入现病史。
en: The initial symptom was fatigue, with fever appearing three days later.

zh: 您最早出现的首发症状是什么，发热之前有没有别的不舒服。
en: What was your initial symptom before the fever started?

zh: 主要症状是活动后气促，静息时减轻。
en: The chief symptom is breathlessness on exertion, easing at rest.

zh: 您现在哪个是主要症状，最影响生活的那个。
en: Which one is your chief symptom, the one affecting you most?

zh: 记录伴随症状有无恶心、出汗与心悸。
en: Record whether associated symptoms include nausea, sweating, or palpitations.

zh: 除了疼，您还有没有别的伴随症状，比如恶心或者出汗。
en: Apart from the pain, any associated symptoms such as nausea or sweating?

zh: 发病前有前驱症状，表现为乏力与食欲差。
en: There were prodromal symptoms of fatigue and poor appetite.

zh: 之前那几天有没有前驱症状，像感冒那样不舒服。
en: In the days before, any prodromal symptoms like a cold?

zh: 症状持续时间为十分钟左右，可自行缓解。
en: The symptom duration is about ten minutes, resolving on its own.

zh: 每次发作的症状持续时间大概多长，几分钟还是几小时。
en: How long is the symptom duration each time, minutes or hours?

zh: 仔细寻找诱发因素有助于预防复发。
en: Looking carefully for precipitating factors helps prevent recurrence.

zh: 您想想有没有诱发因素，比如一走路就发作。
en: Think if there is a precipitating factor, like attacks when walking.

zh: 记录缓解因素可提示病变部位与性质。
en: Recording relieving factors may point to the site and nature of the lesion.

zh: 什么情况下能好一点，您把缓解因素说给我听。
en: What makes it better? Tell me any relieving factors.

zh: 加重因素包括深呼吸与咳嗽，提示胸膜受累可能。
en: Aggravating factors include deep breathing and coughing, suggesting pleural involvement.

zh: 有没有加重因素，比如翻身或者深呼吸的时候更疼。
en: Any aggravating factors, like worse pain when turning or breathing deeply?

zh: 症状演变呈进行性加重，需记录每个时间节点。
en: The symptom evolution shows progressive worsening; record each time point.

zh: 这几天症状演变是怎样的，是越来越重还是时好时坏。
en: How has the symptom evolution gone, steadily worse or up and down?

zh: 该患者反复发作三次，每次持续数分钟。
en: This patient has had recurrent episodes three times, each lasting minutes.

zh: 您这个病反复发作过几次，一年能有几回。
en: How many recurrent episodes have you had, and how often per year?

zh: 间断发作性头痛，间期无任何不适。
en: Intermittent attacks of headache, with no symptoms between attacks.

zh: 我这个是间断发作，不疼的时候跟好人一样。
en: Mine is an intermittent attack pattern; I am fine in between.

zh: 胸痛持续不缓解超过二十分钟，按高危胸痛处理。
en: Chest pain with persistent symptoms beyond twenty minutes is treated as high risk.

zh: 疼了这么久一直持续不缓解，我实在受不了才来的。
en: It has been persistent symptoms so long that I could not bear it.

zh: 追问有无类似发作，既往两年内有三次相似情况。
en: Ask about similar episodes; there were three in the past two years.

zh: 以前有没有类似发作，上次也是这么疼吗。
en: Have you had a similar episode before, was it the same pain?

zh: 就诊原因为家属发现其意识不清，由救护车送入。
en: The reason for visit was confusion noticed by family, brought by ambulance.

zh: 您今天的就诊原因是什么，是什么让您决定来的。
en: What is your reason for visit today, what made you decide to come?

zh: 问诊应先行开放提问再针对细节追问。
en: A medical interview should start open-ended and then probe for details.

zh: 医生正在问诊，请您在外面稍等一会儿。
en: The doctor is doing a medical interview; please wait outside.

zh: 病史陈述条理清楚，时间顺序与用药情况交代明确。
en: The illness narrative was clear, with a proper timeline and medication details.

zh: 您的病史陈述很详细，我再确认几个时间点。
en: Your illness narrative is detailed; let me confirm a few time points.

zh: 发作前有先兆症状，表现为眼前闪光。
en: There were warning symptoms of flashing lights before the attack.

zh: 犯病之前有没有先兆症状，比如眼前发花。
en: Any warning symptoms before the attack, like blurred vision?

zh: 延迟就诊超过六小时，已错过早期干预时机。
en: Delayed presentation beyond six hours has missed the window for early intervention.

zh: 为什么延迟就诊，是没当回事还是路上耽误了。
en: Why the delayed presentation, did you ignore it or was the trip slow?

zh: 该患者反复就诊，一月内已来四次，需评估依从性。
en: The patient shows frequent attendance, four visits in a month; adherence needs review.

zh: 您最近反复就诊好几次了，是不是药没按时吃。
en: You have had frequent attendance lately; are you missing your medicine?

zh: 现病史需按时间顺序写清起病、演变与处理经过。
en: The history of present illness should follow onset, course, and treatment in order.

zh: 麻烦您把现病史讲一遍，从最开始不舒服说起。
en: Please tell me the history of present illness from when it first started.

zh: 发病过程记录完整，包括每次发作的时间与表现。
en: The course of illness was recorded fully, with timing and features of each episode.

zh: 您把发病过程慢慢说，我听清楚了再记。
en: Tell me the course of illness slowly; I will write it down after.

zh: 症状定位在右下腹，需结合查体进一步确认。
en: Symptom localization is the right lower abdomen, to be confirmed on examination.

zh: 您指一下最疼的地方，我们做症状定位。
en: Point to where it hurts most so we can do symptom localization.

zh: 疼痛放射至左肩及左臂内侧，需警惕心脏来源。
en: Pain radiation to the left shoulder and arm warrants concern about a cardiac cause.

zh: 这个疼会不会往别处跑，有没有疼痛放射。
en: Does the pain travel anywhere, any pain radiation?

zh: 症状昼夜变化明显，夜间加重影响睡眠。
en: Diurnal variation is marked, with worsening at night affecting sleep.

zh: 您这症状昼夜变化大吗，晚上是不是更厉害。
en: Does your condition show much diurnal variation, worse at night?

zh: 入院后病情加重，出现呼吸费力与意识改变。
en: There was deterioration after admission, with labored breathing and altered awareness.

zh: 这两天病情加重了，走两步就喘得厉害。
en: There has been deterioration these two days; I gasp after a few steps.

zh: 治疗后病情好转，可平卧休息。
en: Clinical improvement followed treatment, and the patient can lie flat.

zh: 用药以后病情好转，晚上能睡整觉了。
en: There is clinical improvement after the medicine; I sleep all night.

zh: 诊疗经过写明在外院输液一次，症状短暂缓解。
en: Prior treatment included one infusion elsewhere, with brief relief.

zh: 来之前有没有在别处看过，把诊疗经过说一下。
en: Did you seek care elsewhere? Tell me the prior treatment.

zh: 停药三天后症状复发，程度较前加重。
en: Symptom recurrence occurred three days after stopping the drug, worse than before.

zh: 好了没多久症状复发，是不是又把药停了。
en: Symptom recurrence came soon after improvement; did you stop the drug again?

zh: 阴性症状包括无发热、无呕吐、无意识丧失。
en: Negative symptoms include no fever, no vomiting, and no loss of consciousness.

zh: 我问问有没有这些情况，阴性症状也要记下来。
en: Let me ask about these; negative symptoms must be recorded too.

zh: 症状描述过于笼统，需引导患者具体化。
en: The symptom description was too vague and needs guiding toward specifics.

zh: 您的症状描述再具体点，是胀还是针扎一样。
en: Give a clearer symptom description: is it bloating or stabbing?

zh: 症状频率为每周两到三次，多在夜间发作。
en: Symptom frequency is two to three times weekly, mostly at night.

zh: 这症状频率高不高，一天大概几回。
