en: Wear this ambulatory blood pressure device and keep it on for twenty-four hours.

zh: 血压计袖带漏气，测值偏低，已更换。
en: The sphygmomanometer cuff leaked and gave low readings, so it was replaced.

zh: 这个血压计准不准，跟另一台对一下。
en: Is this sphygmomanometer accurate, compare it with the other one.

zh: 血压袖带过窄会使测值偏高，需按臂围选择。
en: A blood pressure cuff that is too narrow raises readings, so it must match arm circumference.

zh: 血压袖带绑太松了，重新绑一下。
en: The blood pressure cuff is too loose, wrap it again.

zh: 袖带尺寸不合适是测压误差的常见原因。
en: An unsuitable cuff size is a common cause of measurement error.

zh: 袖带尺寸不对，换大一号的。
en: The cuff size is wrong, get one size larger.

zh: 先测血压再给降压药，避免降得过低。
en: Take a blood pressure before giving antihypertensives to avoid overshoot.

zh: 我现在给您测血压，胳膊放松。
en: I am going to take your blood pressure now, keep your arm relaxed.

zh: 补液后血压下降仍未纠正，加用血管活性药。
en: The blood pressure drop persisted after fluids, so a vasoactive drug was added.

zh: 他血压下降了二十毫米汞柱，可能还在渗血。
en: His blood pressure has dropped twenty mmHg, he may still be oozing.

zh: 血压波动大，镇静深度与容量状态都要复查。
en: Blood pressure variability was large, so sedation depth and volume status were reviewed.

zh: 他血压波动太大，报警限调宽一点。
en: His blood pressure is fluctuating too much, widen the alarm limits.

zh: 卧位血压 132 比 78，站立三分钟后 98 比 62，符合体位性低血压。
en: Lying blood pressure was 132 over 78 and 98 over 62 after three minutes standing, meeting orthostatic hypotension criteria.

zh: 您先躺着量，再站起来量，看是不是体位性低血压。
en: Let us measure lying down and then standing, to see whether it is orthostatic hypotension.

zh: 双侧血压相差 26 毫米汞柱，需排查主动脉夹层。
en: Blood pressure in both arms differed by 26 mmHg, so aortic dissection had to be excluded.

zh: 双侧血压都要量，两边差得多要报告医生。
en: Measure blood pressure in both arms, and report to the doctor if the difference is large.

zh: 目标血压定为收缩压 90 至 110 毫米汞柱，避免过高加重渗血。
en: The target blood pressure was set at a systolic of 90 to 110 mmHg to avoid worsening bleeding.

zh: 目标血压是多少，我们按这个调升压药。
en: What is the target blood pressure, we will titrate the vasopressor to it.

zh: 血压读数 148 比 92，复测 142 比 88，记录两次结果。
en: The blood pressure reading was 148 over 92 and 142 over 88 on recheck, both recorded.

zh: 这个血压读数不对劲，袖带是不是绑反了。
en: This blood pressure reading looks wrong, is the cuff on backwards.

zh: 血压波形随呼吸起伏增大，提示容量反应性良好。
en: The blood pressure waveform showed increased respiratory variation, suggesting good fluid responsiveness.

zh: 血压波形变平了，冲一下管路看看。
en: The blood pressure waveform has flattened, flush the line and check.

zh: 术后血压不稳，收缩压在 70 至 160 之间跳动。
en: Blood pressure was labile after surgery, with systolic jumping between 70 and 160.

zh: 他血压不稳，先把有创动脉压建上。
en: His blood pressure is labile, place an arterial line first.

zh: 血氧饱和度 88 百分比，吸氧后升至 95 百分比。
en: Oxygen saturation was 88 percent and rose to 95 percent with oxygen.

zh: 给您夹个指头测血氧饱和度，不疼的。
en: I will clip this on your finger to check your oxygen saturation, it does not hurt.

zh: 动脉血氧饱和度 93 百分比，氧分压 68 毫米汞柱，属轻度低氧。
en: Arterial oxygen saturation was 93 percent with a partial pressure of 68 mmHg, indicating mild hypoxaemia.

zh: 血气里的动脉血氧饱和度比指夹的准。
en: The arterial oxygen saturation from blood gas is more accurate than the finger clip.

zh: 脉搏血氧饱和度持续在 90 百分比以下，需复查血气。
en: Pulse oxygen saturation stayed below 90 percent, so blood gas was repeated.

zh: 脉搏血氧饱和度掉到八十八了，先调大氧流量。
en: Pulse oxygen saturation has dropped to eighty-eight, turn the oxygen up first.

zh: 术后血氧监测每小时一次，低于 92 百分比报告医生。
en: Oxygen saturation monitoring was hourly after surgery, with anything below 92 percent reported.

zh: 血氧监测别关，他夜里容易掉。
en: Do not switch off oxygen saturation monitoring, his levels drop at night.

zh: 指脉氧 94 百分比，呼吸 22 次每分，暂不需吸氧。
en: Finger pulse oximetry was 94 percent with a respiratory rate of 22, so oxygen was not needed yet.

zh: 先测个指脉氧，低于九十四再考虑吸氧。
en: Check finger pulse oximetry first, and consider oxygen if it is below ninety-four.

zh: 血氧探头位置偏移，读数不稳，重新固定。
en: The pulse oximeter probe had shifted and the reading was unstable, so it was repositioned.

zh: 血氧探头夹反了，红灯要对着指甲。
en: The pulse oximeter probe is on the wrong way, the red light should face the nail.

zh: 翻身时出现氧饱和度下降至 85 百分比，暂停操作并给氧。
en: Oxygen desaturation to 85 percent during repositioning led to pausing and giving oxygen.

zh: 他一活动就氧饱和度下降，说明储备很差。
en: His oxygen saturation drops whenever he moves, which means very little reserve.

zh: 血氧仪电池电量不足，读数频繁中断。
en: The pulse oximeter battery was low and readings kept dropping out.

zh: 拿个血氧仪过来，给他夹上看看。
en: Bring a pulse oximeter and clip it on him.

zh: 血氧波形低平，提示末梢灌注差，读数不可靠。
en: The plethysmographic waveform was flat, indicating poor peripheral perfusion and unreliable readings.

zh: 血氧波形这么小，读数肯定不准。
en: The plethysmographic waveform is so small that the reading cannot be accurate.

zh: 慢阻肺患者目标血氧饱和度 88 至 92 百分比，不宜过高。
en: For the COPD patient the target oxygen saturation was 88 to 92 percent, not higher.

zh: 目标血氧饱和度写在医嘱上，按这个调流量。
en: The target oxygen saturation is written in the order, adjust the flow to it.

zh: 氧合改善，氧合指数由 180 升至 260。
en: Oxygenation improved, with the oxygenation index rising from 180 to 260.

zh: 先看氧合怎么样，再决定要不要加呼气末正压。
en: Check the oxygenation first, then decide about adding positive end-expiratory pressure.

zh: 氧合指数 150，符合中度急性呼吸窘迫综合征。
en: The oxygenation index was 150, consistent with moderate acute respiratory distress syndrome.

zh: 氧合指数不到两百，可能要上呼吸机。
en: The oxygenation index is under two hundred, he may need a ventilator.

zh: 组织氧合不足时乳酸升高，即使血氧饱和度正常。
en: Tissue oxygenation was inadequate with rising lactate even though oxygen saturation was normal.

zh: 血氧数字好看不代表组织氧合好，还要看乳酸。
en: Good saturation numbers do not mean good tissue oxygenation, check the lactate too.

zh: 中心静脉血氧饱和度 58 百分比，提示氧输送不足。
en: Central venous oxygen saturation was 58 percent, suggesting inadequate oxygen delivery.

zh: 中心静脉血氧饱和度低了，说明组织在拼命摄取氧。
en: Central venous oxygen saturation is low, meaning the tissues are extracting hard.

zh: 混合静脉血氧饱和度需经肺动脉导管采血测定。
en: Mixed venous oxygen saturation had to be measured through a pulmonary artery catheter.

zh: 混合静脉血氧饱和度比中心静脉的更全面，但取样麻烦。
en: Mixed venous oxygen saturation is more representative than central venous, but sampling is harder.

zh: 缺氧时间超过四分钟即可造成不可逆脑损伤。
en: Hypoxia lasting more than four minutes can cause irreversible brain injury.

zh: 他缺氧很明显，口唇都发紫了。
en: He is clearly hypoxic, his lips have turned blue.

zh: 吸痰后血氧波动明显，操作前应先提高吸氧浓度。
en: Oxygen saturation fluctuated markedly after suctioning, so the inspired oxygen should be raised beforehand.

zh: 他血氧波动大，报警声一直响。
en: His oxygen saturation keeps fluctuating and the alarm never stops.

zh: 血氧读数 96 百分比，波形良好，结果可信。
en: The oxygen saturation reading was 96 percent with a good waveform, so it was reliable.

zh: 这个血氧读数别急着报，等我换根手指再测。
en: Do not report this oxygen saturation reading yet, let me try another finger.

zh: 血氧报警下限设为 90 百分比，夜间调为 92。
en: The oxygen saturation alarm lower limit was set at 90 percent and raised to 92 at night.

zh: 血氧报警响了，先看病人再看机器。
en: The oxygen saturation alarm is sounding, check the patient before the machine.

zh: 血氧趋势显示夜间多次下降，考虑睡眠呼吸事件。
en: The oxygen saturation trend showed repeated nocturnal dips, suggesting sleep-related breathing events.

zh: 看血氧趋势，比单次数字有用得多。
en: Look at the oxygen saturation trend, it is far more useful than a single number.

zh: 血氧正常范围是 95 到 98 百分比，低于 94 需评估。
en: The normal oxygen saturation range is 95 to 98 percent, and below 94 requires assessment.

zh: 您的血氧正常范围是九十五到九十八，这个结果没事。
en: Your oxygen saturation is within the normal range, so do not worry too much.

zh: 低氧饱和度伴呼吸急促，立即高流量吸氧。
en: Low oxygen saturation with tachypnea prompted immediate high-flow oxygen.

zh: 他低氧饱和度，先给氧再找原因。
en: He has a low oxygen saturation, give oxygen first and then find the cause.

zh: 氧解离曲线右移时，同样氧分压下血氧饱和度偏低。
en: When the oxygen dissociation curve shifts right, saturation is lower for the same partial pressure.

zh: 酸中毒会让氧解离曲线右移，组织更容易拿到氧。
en: Acidosis shifts the oxygen dissociation curve right, so tissues release oxygen more readily.

zh: 脉搏血氧监测适合长时间连续观察，但不能代替血气。
en: Pulse oximetry monitoring suits long continuous observation but cannot replace blood gas.

zh: 脉搏血氧监测的探头要每隔几小时换手指。
en: With pulse oximetry monitoring the probe should be moved to another finger every few hours.

zh: 吸空气血氧 91 百分比，符合低氧血症标准。
en: Oxygen saturation on room air was 91 percent, meeting the criteria for hypoxaemia.

zh: 先停氧十分钟，测个吸空气血氧再决定出院。
en: Stop the oxygen for ten minutes and check the oxygen saturation on room air before discharge.

zh: 意识清楚，对答切题，四肢活动自如。
en: Consciousness was clear, answers were appropriate and all limbs moved freely.

zh: 叫他的名字看看意识怎么样。
en: Call his name and see what his consciousness is like.

zh: 意识水平进行性下降，需紧急复查头颅 CT。
en: The level of consciousness was deteriorating, so an urgent repeat head CT was needed.

zh: 意识水平比刚才差了，叫醒后又睡过去。
en: His level of consciousness is worse than before, he wakes and then drifts off again.

zh: 意识障碍伴一侧瞳孔散大，考虑脑疝。
en: Disorder of consciousness with a dilated pupil on one side suggested herniation.

zh: 他突然意识障碍了，之前还在说话。
en: He suddenly developed a disorder of consciousness, he was talking earlier.

zh: 意识模糊，答非所问，血糖 2.1 毫摩尔每升。
en: He was confused and answered irrelevantly, with a glucose of 2.1 millimoles per litre.

zh: 老人今天意识模糊，家里人说他昨天还好好的。
en: The old man is confused today, his family says he was fine yesterday.

zh: 嗜睡，呼唤能睁眼，回答问题后再次入睡。
en: He was somnolent, opened his eyes when called and fell asleep after answering.

zh: 他大部分时间在嗜睡，叫一下能醒。
en: He is somnolent most of the time and wakes when called.

zh: 昏睡状态，压眶上神经才睁眼，不能对答。
en: He was in stupor, opening his eyes only to supraorbital pressure and unable to answer.

zh: 他已经昏睡了，得用力压才能醒。
en: He is in stupor, you must press hard to wake him.

zh: 昏迷，格拉斯哥评分 6 分，气管插管后收入监护室。
en: He was in coma with a Glasgow score of 6 and was intubated and admitted to intensive care.

zh: 他一直昏迷，家属说摔倒后就没醒过。
en: He has been in a coma and the family says he never woke after the fall.

zh: 浅昏迷，疼痛刺激能定位，角膜反射存在。
en: In light coma he could localise pain and the corneal reflex was present.

zh: 现在是浅昏迷，掐他还能躲一下。
en: He is in light coma now, he still pulls away when pinched.

zh: 深昏迷，瞳孔散大固定，脑干反射消失。
en: In deep coma the pupils were dilated and fixed with absent brainstem reflexes.

zh: 他已经深昏迷了，什么刺激都没反应。
en: He is in deep coma and does not respond to any stimulus.

zh: 格拉斯哥昏迷评分 11 分，其中运动反应 5 分。
en: The Glasgow Coma Scale score was 11, with a motor response of 5.

zh: 格拉斯哥昏迷评分算一下，看要不要叫神经外科。
en: Work out the Glasgow Coma Scale score and see whether neurosurgery is needed.

zh: 睁眼反应 2 分，仅疼痛刺激时睁眼。
en: Eye opening scored 2, with opening only to painful stimulation.

zh: 睁眼反应打几分，他是叫才睁还是自己睁。
en: What score for eye opening, does he open when called or spontaneously.

zh: 语言反应 3 分，只能说出不恰当的词语。
en: Verbal response scored 3, with only inappropriate words produced.

zh: 语言反应这块他答非所问，给 3 分。
en: For verbal response he answers irrelevantly, so score 3.

zh: 运动反应 4 分，疼痛刺激可躲避。
en: Motor response scored 4, with withdrawal from painful stimuli.

zh: 先看运动反应，能按指令抬手吗。
en: Check the motor response first, can he lift his hand on command.

zh: 格拉斯哥评分分数由 13 分降至 8 分，立即报告医生。
en: The Glasgow Coma Scale score fell from 13 to 8 and was reported to the doctor at once.

zh: 格拉斯哥评分分数低于八分通常要考虑插管。
en: A Glasgow Coma Scale score below eight usually means intubation should be considered.

zh: 每两小时做一次意识评估，记录格拉斯哥评分。
en: Consciousness assessment was done every two hours with the Glasgow score recorded.

zh: 意识评估要写清刺激方式和反应，不能只写清楚。
en: Consciousness assessment must state the stimulus and response, not just clear.

zh: 定向力完整，能说出现在的时间和所在医院。
en: Orientation was intact, as he could state the time and the hospital he was in.

zh: 问他今天几号，看定向力好不好。
en: Ask him the date to check his orientation.

zh: 定向力障碍，把病房当成自己家，夜间加重。
en: He was disoriented and took the ward for his home, worse at night.

zh: 他有定向力障碍，一直问这是哪里。
en: He has disorientation and keeps asking where he is.

zh: 意识内容异常而觉醒度保留，符合谵妄特点。
en: Abnormal content of consciousness with preserved wakefulness fitted delirium.

zh: 他醒着，但意识内容是乱的。
en: He is awake, but the content of consciousness is disordered.

zh: 轻拍双肩并大声呼唤，观察能否唤醒。
en: The shoulders were tapped with a loud call to see whether he could be aroused.

zh: 先试着唤醒他，别一上来就掐人中。
en: Try to arouse him first, do not go straight for the philtrum.

zh: 给予疼痛刺激后出现去皮质强直姿势。
en: Painful stimulus produced a decorticate posturing response.

zh: 给个疼痛刺激，看他手往哪边动。
en: Give a painful stimulus and see which way his hand moves.

zh: 最佳运动反应为疼痛定位，计 5 分。
en: The best motor response was localising to pain, scored as 5.

zh: 按最佳运动反应算，取最好的那一侧。
en: Score the best motor response, take the better side.

zh: 血糖纠正后意识恢复，能正确说出姓名。
en: Consciousness recovered after glucose correction and he could state his name correctly.

zh: 他意识恢复了，先别急着拔管，观察半天。
en: His consciousness has recovered, do not extubate in a hurry, observe for half a day.

zh: 意识丧失约两分钟，醒后不能回忆经过。
en: There was loss of consciousness for about two minutes with no memory of the event.

zh: 他刚才意识丧失了，现在醒了但很迷糊。
en: He lost consciousness just now, and although awake he is very groggy.

zh: 术后六小时出现意识水平下降，需排除颅内出血。
en: A decreased level of consciousness six hours after surgery required exclusion of intracranial bleeding.

zh: 他意识水平下降了，昨天还能自己吃饭。
en: His level of consciousness has decreased, yesterday he could still eat by himself.

zh: 昏迷程度加深，脑干反射由存在转为消失。
en: The depth of coma increased as brainstem reflexes disappeared.

zh: 昏迷程度在加深，赶紧联系重症监护室。
en: The depth of coma is increasing, contact intensive care now.

zh: 患者处于休克状态，立即建立两条静脉通路并快速补液。
en: The patient was in shock, so two intravenous lines were placed and fluids given rapidly.

zh: 他现在是休克，先补液再找原因。
en: He is in shock now, give fluids first and then look for the cause.

zh: 心率 120，收缩压 100，休克指数 1.2，提示休克。
en: Heart rate 120 over systolic 100 gave a shock index of 1.2, indicating shock.

zh: 算一下休克指数，超过一就要当心。
en: Work out the shock index, anything above one is concerning.

zh: 休克代偿期血压正常，但脉压变窄、末梢发凉。
en: In compensated shock the blood pressure was normal but the pulse pressure was narrow and the extremities cool.

zh: 别看他血压正常，这可能是休克代偿期。
en: Do not be reassured by his normal blood pressure, this may be compensated shock.

zh: 进入休克失代偿期，乳酸升至 6.8 毫摩尔每升。
en: He progressed to decompensated shock with lactate rising to 6.8 millimoles per litre.

zh: 已经到休克失代偿期了，血压撑不住了。
en: He has reached decompensated shock and the blood pressure is giving way.

zh: 冷休克表现为四肢湿冷、脉细、尿量减少。
en: Cold shock presented with cold clammy limbs, a thready pulse and reduced urine output.

zh: 他手脚冰凉，是冷休克的表现。
en: His hands and feet are ice cold, which points to cold shock.

zh: 暖休克皮肤温暖，但血压低、乳酸高。
en: In warm shock the skin was warm but blood pressure was low and lactate high.

zh: 他身上是热的，别以为不是休克，这是暖休克。
en: He feels warm, but do not assume he is not in shock, this is warm shock.

zh: 隐匿性休克患者乳酸升高而血压正常，容易延误。
en: In occult shock lactate is raised while blood pressure is normal, which delays recognition.

zh: 血压正常也可能有隐匿性休克，查个乳酸。
en: Normal blood pressure can still hide occult shock, check the lactate.

zh: 难治性休克，去甲肾上腺素已用至极限剂量。
en: Refractory shock persisted with noradrenaline at maximal dose.

zh: 这已经是难治性休克，要考虑机械循环支持。
en: This is already refractory shock, mechanical circulatory support should be considered.

zh: 取休克体位，抬高双下肢三十度。
en: The patient was placed in the shock position with both legs raised thirty degrees.

zh: 先摆休克体位，把床尾摇高。
en: Put him in the shock position first, raise the foot of the bed.

zh: 休克早期表现为烦躁、心率增快与脉压变窄。
en: Early shock presented with restlessness, tachycardia and a narrowed pulse pressure.

zh: 现在还是休克早期，赶紧补液还来得及。
en: It is still early shock, there is time to reverse it with fluids.

zh: 休克晚期出现弥散性血管内凝血与少尿。
en: Late shock was complicated by disseminated intravascular coagulation and oliguria.

zh: 到了休克晚期，能做的很有限了。
en: Once late shock is reached there is little left to offer.

zh: 组织灌注不足的证据包括乳酸升高与毛细血管再充盈延迟。
en: Evidence of inadequate tissue perfusion included rising lactate and delayed capillary refill.

zh: 他组织灌注不足，末梢都是凉的。
en: He has inadequate tissue perfusion, his extremities are cold.

zh: 微循环障碍导致皮肤花斑与乳酸清除延迟。
en: Microcirculatory disturbance caused mottled skin and delayed lactate clearance.

zh: 微循环障碍不是看血压能看出来的。
en: Microcirculatory disturbance cannot be judged from blood pressure alone.

zh: 末梢湿冷，毛细血管再充盈时间四秒，提示灌注不足。
en: Cold clammy extremities with a four-second capillary refill indicated poor perfusion.

zh: 他末梢湿冷，摸上去一手汗。
en: His extremities are cold and clammy, my hand comes away wet.

zh: 膝部出现花斑样皮肤，提示休克加重。
en: Mottled skin appeared over the knees, suggesting worsening shock.

zh: 他腿上花斑样皮肤都出来了，赶紧加升压药。
en: Mottled skin has appeared on his legs, start the vasopressor now.

zh: 毛细血管再充盈时间 4 秒，结合乳酸判断为休克。
en: Capillary refill time was four seconds and, with the lactate, indicated shock.

zh: 按压指甲松开，数毛细血管再充盈时间。
en: Press the nail and release, then count the capillary refill time.

zh: 脉压变窄至 20 毫米汞柱，提示心输出量下降。
en: The pulse pressure narrowed to 20 mmHg, suggesting reduced cardiac output.

zh: 他脉压变窄了，先按休克处理。
en: His pulse pressure has narrowed, treat him as shock for now.

zh: 休克识别依赖乳酸、毛细血管再充盈时间与意识状态。
en: Shock recognition relies on lactate, capillary refill time and mental status.

zh: 休克识别要往前移，别等血压掉下来。
en: Shock recognition must move earlier, do not wait for the pressure to fall.

zh: 休克评估包括容量状态、心功能与外周阻力三方面。
en: Shock assessment covers volume status, cardiac function and peripheral resistance.

zh: 每半小时做一次休克评估，看灌注有没有改善。
en: Do a shock assessment every half hour to see whether perfusion is improving.

zh: 休克复苏首选晶体液，同时控制出血源。
en: Shock resuscitation started with crystalloid while the bleeding source was controlled.

zh: 休克复苏别只顾着补液，病因不解决没用。
en: In shock resuscitation do not only give fluids, the cause must be dealt with.

zh: 血流动力学不稳定，暂缓转运做检查。
en: He was haemodynamically unstable, so transport for imaging was deferred.

zh: 他现在血流动力学不稳定，先别翻动。
en: He is haemodynamically unstable now, do not move him yet.

zh: 血流动力学监测显示心输出量偏低、外周阻力升高。
en: Hemodynamic monitoring showed low cardiac output with high peripheral resistance.

zh: 上了血流动力学监测，补液就有依据了。
en: With hemodynamic monitoring in place we have a basis for giving fluids.

zh: 循环衰竭合并无尿，启动血液净化治疗。
en: Circulatory failure with anuria prompted renal replacement therapy.

zh: 他已经循环衰竭了，升压药加到最大。
en: He has circulatory failure and the vasopressor is at maximum.

zh: 周围循环灌注差，四肢温度明显低于躯干。
en: Peripheral perfusion was poor, with limb temperature clearly below the trunk.

zh: 看周围循环灌注，摸手脚比看血压快。
en: Assess peripheral perfusion; feeling the limbs is quicker than the blood pressure.

zh: 低血容量性休克，估计失血超过一千毫升。
en: In hypovolemic shock the estimated blood loss exceeded one thousand millilitres.

zh: 这是低血容量性休克，先快速补液再加止血。
en: This is hypovolemic shock, give rapid fluids first and then control the bleeding.

zh: 液体复苏首选等渗晶体液，前半小时可给 1000 毫升。
en: Fluid resuscitation started with isotonic crystalloid, up to 1000 millilitres in the first half hour.

zh: 先做液体复苏，同时抽血备血。
en: Start fluid resuscitation and send blood for crossmatch at the same time.

zh: 静脉液体已加温至 37 摄氏度后输入。
en: The intravenous fluids were warmed to 37 degrees Celsius before infusion.

zh: 静脉液体挂上了，注意看滴速。
en: The intravenous fluids are running, watch the drip rate.

zh: 晶体液扩容快但维持时间短，需注意总量。
en: Crystalloid expands volume quickly but briefly, so the total volume matters.

zh: 先给晶体液，胶体留着后面用。
en: Give crystalloid first and keep the colloid for later.

zh: 胶体液扩容效率高，但价格贵且不改善预后。
en: Colloid expands volume efficiently but is costly and does not improve outcome.

zh: 胶体液不是万能的，别一上来就用。
en: Colloid is not a cure-all, do not reach for it first.

zh: 等渗晶体液包括生理盐水与乳酸林格液。
en: Isotonic crystalloids include normal saline and lactated Ringer's solution.

zh: 等渗晶体液先来一袋，快一点。
en: Give a bag of isotonic crystalloid, and quickly.

zh: 平衡盐溶液大量输注时高氯性酸中毒风险较低。
en: Balanced salt solutions carry a lower risk of hyperchloremic acidosis in large volumes.

zh: 有平衡盐溶液就用它，比生理盐水温和。
en: Use a balanced salt solution if available, it is gentler than saline.

zh: 生理盐水 500 毫升快速静滴，十分钟内完成。
en: Normal saline 500 millilitres was infused rapidly within ten minutes.

zh: 先开两袋生理盐水，通路要粗。
en: Order two bags of normal saline and use a wide-bore line.

zh: 乳酸林格液 1000 毫升快速输入，监测血钙。
en: Lactated Ringer's solution 1000 millilitres was given rapidly with calcium monitoring.

zh: 创伤病人用乳酸林格液，别用生理盐水。
en: Use lactated Ringer's solution for the trauma patient, not normal saline.

zh: 液体负荷试验给 250 毫升晶体液，观察每搏量变化。
en: A fluid challenge of 250 millilitres of crystalloid was given while stroke volume was watched.

zh: 做个液体负荷试验，看他是真缺还是已经够了。
en: Do a fluid challenge to see whether he truly needs volume or has enough.

zh: 被动抬腿试验提示液体反应性良好，可继续补液。
en: The passive leg raise suggested good fluid responsiveness, so further fluids were appropriate.

zh: 有液体反应性才补液，不然只是加重水肿。
en: Only give fluids if there is fluid responsiveness, otherwise you just worsen oedema.

zh: 被动抬腿试验后心输出量增加 12 百分比，提示有反应。
en: After the passive leg raise cardiac output rose 12 percent, indicating responsiveness.

zh: 做个被动抬腿试验，比盲目补液靠谱。
en: Do a passive leg raise, it is more reliable than giving fluid blindly.

zh: 首日补液量控制在 3000 毫升以内，避免肺水肿。
en: Fluid volume was kept under 3000 millilitres on the first day to avoid pulmonary oedema.

zh: 补液量记清楚，出入量要平衡。
en: Record the fluid volume accurately and keep intake and output balanced.

zh: 补液速度先调到每小时 500 毫升，观察血压反应。
en: The infusion rate was set at 500 millilitres per hour initially with blood pressure monitored.

zh: 补液速度太快了，老人心脏受不了。
en: The infusion rate is too fast, the elderly heart cannot cope.

zh: 快速补液 500 毫升后收缩压回升至 96 毫米汞柱。
en: After a rapid fluid bolus of 500 millilitres the systolic pressure rose to 96 mmHg.

zh: 先快速补液一袋，血压回来再放慢。
en: Give a rapid fluid bolus first, then slow down once the pressure returns.

zh: 采用限制性补液策略，前四十八小时入量控制在负平衡。
en: A restrictive fluid strategy was used, keeping the first forty-eight hours in negative balance.

zh: 这个病人按限制性补液来，别一袋接一袋。
en: Use a restrictive fluid strategy for this patient, not one bag after another.

zh: 开放性补液组患者早期血压恢复更快，但水肿更明显。
en: Patients on a liberal fluid strategy recovered blood pressure sooner but had more oedema.

zh: 创伤早期可以开放性补液，但要盯着肺。
en: Early trauma allows a liberal fluid strategy, but watch the lungs.

zh: 复苏目标为平均动脉压 65 毫米汞柱、尿量每小时 0.5 毫升每公斤。
en: The resuscitation target was a mean arterial pressure of 65 mmHg and urine output of 0.5 millilitres per kilogram per hour.

zh: 复苏目标定了没有，我们按指标来调。
en: Have the resuscitation targets been set, we will titrate to them.

zh: 复苏终点包括乳酸下降超过 20 百分比与毛细血管再充盈恢复正常。
en: Endpoints of resuscitation included a lactate fall of more than 20 percent and normal capillary refill.

zh: 到复苏终点了就收手，补多了反而不好。
en: Once the endpoint of resuscitation is reached stop, more fluid does harm.

zh: 每日液体平衡记录，连续三天为正平衡，需考虑利尿。
en: Daily fluid balance was positive for three days, so diuresis was considered.

zh: 液体平衡算一下，我怀疑他进得太多出得太少。
en: Work out the fluid balance, I suspect he takes in too much and puts out too little.

zh: 扩容后血压回升至 100 比 62 毫米汞柱。
en: After volume expansion the blood pressure recovered to 100 over 62 mmHg.

zh: 先扩容，血压稳了再看要不要升压药。
en: Expand the volume first and see whether a vasopressor is still needed.

zh: 动脉血气分析提示二氧化碳分压 68 毫米汞柱，考虑通气不足。
en: Arterial blood gas analysis showed a carbon dioxide pressure of 68 mmHg, suggesting hypoventilation.

zh: 先抽个动脉血气分析，看氧分压和酸碱。
en: Take an arterial blood gas analysis to look at the oxygen pressure and acid-base status.

zh: 氧疗指征明确，血氧 89 百分比，立即给氧。
en: The indication for oxygen therapy was clear with saturation at 89 percent, so oxygen was started at once.

zh: 他有氧疗指征，别等了先上氧。
en: He meets the indication for oxygen therapy, do not wait, give oxygen now.

zh: 十二导联心电图示下壁 ST 段抬高，启动导管室。
en: The twelve-lead ECG showed inferior ST elevation and the catheter laboratory was activated.

zh: 先做十二导联心电图，监护上那几条不够看。
en: Do a twelve-lead ECG first, the monitor leads are not enough.

zh: 低体温患者采用加温输液，液体温度维持 38 至 40 摄氏度。
en: Warmed intravenous fluid at 38 to 40 degrees Celsius was used in the hypothermic patient.

zh: 加温输液接上了吗，这么冷的天不能直接输。
en: Is the warmed intravenous fluid connected, we cannot infuse cold fluid in this weather.

zh: 目标导向液体治疗使补液更精准，减少术后并发症。
en: Goal-directed fluid therapy made fluid administration more precise and reduced postoperative complications.

zh: 我们现在按目标导向液体治疗来做，看每搏量。
en: We are using goal-directed fluid therapy now, watching the stroke volume.

zh: 入室即予心电监护，观察心律与 ST 段变化。
en: Electrocardiographic monitoring was started on arrival to watch rhythm and ST segments.

zh: 心电监护开着，别把导联扯掉。
en: Electrocardiographic monitoring is running, do not pull the leads off.

zh: 心电监护仪屏幕显示室性早搏，立即打印条图。
en: The cardiac monitor showed premature ventricular beats, so a rhythm strip was printed at once.

zh: 心电监护仪黑屏了，看看电源线。
en: The cardiac monitor has gone black, check the power cable.

zh: 心电波形出现明显基线漂移，重新粘贴电极。
en: The ECG waveform showed marked baseline drift, so the electrodes were reapplied.

zh: 心电波形太小了，把增益调一下。
en: The ECG waveform is too small, adjust the gain.

zh: 监护导联选择 II 导联，便于观察 P 波。
en: Monitoring lead II was chosen to make the P waves visible.

zh: 监护导联位置不对，P 波看不清。
en: The monitoring lead is in the wrong place and the P waves are unclear.

zh: 三导联监护用于常规观察，疑缺血时加做十二导联。
en: Three-lead monitoring was used for routine observation, with a twelve-lead ECG added when ischaemia was suspected.

zh: 先上三导联监护，等会儿再做十二导联。
en: Start three-lead monitoring first, the twelve-lead can wait.

zh: 心率 136 次每分，律齐，考虑窦性心动过速。
en: The heart rate was 136 per minute and regular, consistent with sinus tachycardia.

zh: 心率一百三十多，先看有没有发热。
en: His heart rate is over one hundred and thirty, check for fever first.

zh: 心律为心房颤动，心室率 110 次每分。
en: The cardiac rhythm was atrial fibrillation with a ventricular rate of 110.

zh: 心律看着不齐，打张条图给医生看。
en: The cardiac rhythm looks irregular, print a strip for the doctor.

zh: 心电图为窦性心律，心率 78 次每分。
en: The ECG showed sinus rhythm at 78 beats per minute.

zh: 心电图是窦性心律，不用担心。
en: It is sinus rhythm, nothing to worry about.

zh: 突发心动过速，心率 180 次每分，血压下降。
en: Sudden tachycardia at 180 per minute was accompanied by a fall in blood pressure.

zh: 他心动过速了，先看是宽还是窄。
en: He is tachycardic, first check whether the complexes are wide or narrow.

zh: 心动过缓至 38 次每分，伴头晕与黑蒙。
en: Bradycardia down to 38 per minute was accompanied by dizziness and visual greying.

zh: 他心动过缓，先把阿托品备好。
en: He is bradycardic, have atropine ready.

zh: 心律失常反复发作，需查电解质与甲状腺功能。
en: Recurrent arrhythmia prompted checks of electrolytes and thyroid function.

zh: 他有心律失常，搬动的时候小心点。
en: He has an arrhythmia, be careful when moving him.

zh: 频发室性期前收缩，每分钟超过五次，需复查电解质。
en: Frequent ventricular premature beats exceeding five per minute required electrolyte review.

zh: 监护上有个期前收缩，病人没感觉。
en: There is a premature beat on the monitor but the patient feels nothing.

zh: 心房颤动，心室率 138 次每分，予控制心率治疗。
en: Atrial fibrillation with a ventricular rate of 138 was treated with rate control.

zh: 心室率太快了，先降下来再谈复律。
en: The ventricular rate is too fast, slow it down before discussing cardioversion.

zh: PR 间期延长至 0.26 秒，提示一度房室传导阻滞。
en: The PR interval was prolonged to 0.26 seconds, indicating first-degree atrioventricular block.

zh: PR 间期有点长，数一下格子。
en: The PR interval looks long, count the small squares.

zh: QRS 波群增宽至 0.14 秒，考虑室内传导阻滞。
en: The QRS complex widened to 0.14 seconds, suggesting intraventricular block.

zh: QRS 波群宽，按室性心律处理。
en: The QRS complex is wide, treat it as a ventricular rhythm.

zh: ST 段抬高 2 毫米，启动胸痛绿色通道。
en: ST segment elevation of 2 millimetres triggered the chest pain fast-track pathway.

zh: ST 段压低了，叫医生过来看。
en: The ST segment is depressed, ask the doctor to look.

zh: T 波高尖，结合血钾 6.9 毫摩尔每升考虑高钾。
en: Peaked T waves with a potassium of 6.9 millimoles per litre suggested hyperkalaemia.

zh: T 波倒置了，之前那张是平的。
en: The T wave is now inverted, it was flat on the earlier tracing.

zh: 心电报警频繁触发，先检查电极接触再调整参数。
en: ECG alarms triggered often, so electrode contact was checked before adjusting settings.

zh: 心电报警一直响，是不是阈值设太窄。
en: The ECG alarm keeps sounding, maybe the threshold is set too tight.

zh: 导联脱落报警，重新粘贴电极后波形恢复。
en: A lead disconnection alarm was resolved by reapplying the electrode.

zh: 左边导联脱落了，怪不得波形没了。
en: The left lead has come off, that is why the waveform vanished.

zh: 心率变异性降低，提示交感张力持续升高。
en: Reduced heart rate variability suggested sustained sympathetic activation.

zh: 心率变异性这些指标看看就行，别过度解读。
en: Heart rate variability is worth a look but do not overinterpret it.

zh: 心率监测每小时一次，超过 120 次报告医生。
en: Heart rate monitoring was hourly, with rates above 120 reported to the doctor.

zh: 心率监测不能只看监护仪，要对着病人。
en: Heart rate monitoring is not just the monitor, look at the patient too.

zh: 目标心率控制在 60 至 80 次每分，逐步加量。
en: The target heart rate was 60 to 80 per minute, with gradual dose increases.

zh: 目标心率是八十以下，现在还没到。
en: The target heart rate is under eighty, we are not there yet.

zh: 电极片每二十四小时更换，出汗多时提前更换。
en: Electrode pads were changed every twenty-four hours, sooner if sweating heavily.

zh: 电极片不粘了，换新的再贴。
en: The electrode pad has lost adhesion, put a new one on.

zh: 监护报警设置按医嘱调整，避免关闭报警。
en: Alarm settings were adjusted according to orders, and alarms were never switched off.

zh: 监护报警设置别全关，静音可以但别屏蔽。
en: Do not switch all alarm settings off, silencing is fine but never disable them.

zh: 心律监测发现阵发性室上性心动过速，已记录发作时间。
en: Rhythm monitoring detected paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, and the onset time was recorded.

zh: 心律监测的重点是看有没有新出现的异常。
en: The point of rhythm monitoring is to catch anything new.

zh: 血钾 7.2 毫摩尔每升，属危急值，已电话通知医生。
en: A potassium of 7.2 millimoles per litre was a critical value and the doctor was notified by phone.

zh: 这个结果是危急值，必须马上报。
en: This result is a critical value, it must be reported immediately.

zh: 危急值报告需记录报告人、接听人与时间。
en: Critical value reporting must record the caller, the receiver and the time.

zh: 危急值报告流程贴在墙上，按步骤走。
en: The critical value reporting procedure is on the wall, follow the steps.

zh: 危急值登记本上补齐接听时间与处理措施。
en: The critical value log was completed with the receiving time and the action taken.

zh: 危急值登记别忘了签名，不然算漏项。
en: Do not forget to sign the critical value log, or it counts as missing.

zh: 危急值通知要求接听者复述结果，确认无误。
en: Critical value notification requires the receiver to read the result back for confirmation.

zh: 危急值通知到了吗，医生知道没有。
en: Has the critical value notification gone through, does the doctor know.

zh: 危急值预警弹出后三分钟内完成通知。
en: The critical value alert was followed by notification within three minutes.

zh: 危急值预警又响了，看看是哪个项目。
en: The critical value alert has gone off again, check which test it is.

zh: 危急值闭环管理要求每一步都留痕可查。
en: Closed-loop critical value management requires a traceable record at every step.

zh: 现在危急值闭环管理了，系统会自动催办。
en: With closed-loop critical value management the system chases you automatically.

zh: 不同医院危急值范围略有差异，以本院规定为准。
en: Critical value ranges vary slightly between hospitals, so local rules apply.

zh: 危急值范围在院内网上能查到。
en: The critical value range can be found on the hospital intranet.

zh: 危急值报告制度明确十小时内完成通知与记录。
en: The critical value reporting policy requires notification and documentation within the set time.

zh: 危急值报告制度是硬规定，不能口头说说就算。
en: The critical value reporting policy is mandatory, a verbal mention does not count.

zh: 报告时限为十五分钟，超时系统会标记。
en: The reporting time limit was fifteen minutes, and overruns were flagged by the system.

zh: 报告时限快到了，先打电话再补记录。
en: The reporting time limit is nearly up, phone first and document after.

zh: 血糖危急值 1.9 毫摩尔每升，立即静推葡萄糖。
en: A critical blood glucose of 1.9 millimoles per litre was treated with immediate intravenous glucose.

zh: 血糖危急值报过来了，先把葡萄糖抽好。
en: The critical blood glucose has been reported, draw up the glucose now.

zh: 血钾危急值 6.8 毫摩尔每升，立即做心电图并降钾。
en: A critical serum potassium of 6.8 millimoles per litre prompted an immediate ECG and potassium lowering.

zh: 血钾危急值，先看心电图有没有高尖 T 波。
en: Critical serum potassium, check the ECG for peaked T waves first.

zh: 血钠危急值 112 毫摩尔每升，纠正速度不超过每小时 8 毫摩尔。
en: A critical serum sodium of 112 millimoles per litre was corrected at no more than 8 millimoles per hour.

zh: 血钠危急值，补钠一定要慢。
en: Critical serum sodium, correct it slowly.

zh: 血红蛋白危急值 48 克每升，立即备血并通知医生。
en: A critical haemoglobin of 48 grams per litre prompted urgent crossmatch and doctor notification.

zh: 血红蛋白危急值，先看有没有在出血。
en: Critical haemoglobin, first check whether he is bleeding.

zh: 血小板危急值 12 乘十的九次方每升，避免肌注与深静脉穿刺。
en: A critical platelet count of 12 times ten to the ninth per litre contraindicated intramuscular injection and deep venous puncture.

zh: 血小板危急值，抽血后多压一会儿。
en: Critical platelet count, press longer after taking blood.

zh: 国际标准化比值 5.6，停用华法林并予维生素 K。
en: The international normalized ratio was 5.6, so warfarin was stopped and vitamin K given.

zh: 国际标准化比值超过五了，先别再用抗凝药。
en: The international normalized ratio is over five, hold the anticoagulant.

zh: 动脉氧分压 48 毫米汞柱，属危急值，立即给氧并准备插管。
en: An arterial oxygen partial pressure of 48 mmHg was critical, so oxygen was given and intubation prepared.

zh: 动脉氧分压这么低，血氧饱和度可能还正常。
en: The arterial oxygen partial pressure is this low even though saturation may look normal.

zh: 动脉二氧化碳分压 78 毫米汞柱，提示通气不足，需无创通气。
en: An arterial carbon dioxide partial pressure of 78 mmHg indicated hypoventilation requiring non-invasive ventilation.

zh: 动脉二氧化碳分压太高了，他二氧化碳在蓄积。
en: The arterial carbon dioxide partial pressure is too high, he is retaining carbon dioxide.

zh: 乳酸 7.4 毫摩尔每升，提示严重组织低灌注。
en: Lactate was 7.4 millimoles per litre, indicating severe tissue hypoperfusion.

zh: 乳酸抽了吗，两小时后再复查一次。
en: Have you sent the lactate, repeat it in two hours.

zh: 高乳酸血症持续不降，需重新评估容量与心功能。
en: Persistent hyperlactatemia required reassessment of volume status and cardiac function.

zh: 他有高乳酸血症，补液的同时要查肝功能。
en: He has hyperlactatemia, check liver function while giving fluids.

zh: 肌钙蛋白危急值 2.8 纳克每毫升，立即复查心电图。
en: A critical troponin level of 2.8 nanograms per millilitre prompted an immediate repeat ECG.

zh: 肌钙蛋白危急值，先让他绝对卧床。
en: Critical troponin, keep him strictly on bed rest first.

zh: 凝血危急值，凝血酶原时间 38 秒，暂停侵入操作。
en: The critical coagulation value with a prothrombin time of 38 seconds led to pausing invasive procedures.

zh: 凝血危急值，穿刺前先补血浆。
en: Critical coagulation, give plasma before puncturing.

zh: 血培养阳性报警，革兰染色为阳性球菌，立即通知医生。
en: A positive blood culture alert with Gram-positive cocci was reported to the doctor at once.

zh: 血培养阳性报警了，先把抗生素用上。
en: The blood culture alert is positive, start antibiotics now.

zh: 复测结果与原结果一致，按危急值上报。
en: Repeat testing matched the original result, so it was reported as a critical value.

zh: 先复测一下，可能是标本溶血。
en: Repeat the test first, the sample may be haemolysed.

zh: 危急值记录须包含结果、通知时间与处理措施。
en: Critical value documentation must include the result, notification time and action taken.

zh: 危急值记录补完整，别只写一句已处理。
en: Complete the critical value documentation, do not just write handled.

zh: 发现一例危急值漏报，已启动根因分析。
en: A missed critical value was identified and a root cause analysis was started.

zh: 这次危急值漏报要上报，不能内部消化。
en: This missed critical value must be reported, it cannot be settled internally.

zh: 予氧疗，目标血氧饱和度 94 至 98 百分比。
en: Oxygen therapy was started with a target saturation of 94 to 98 percent.

zh: 先上氧疗，别等到血氧掉下去。
en: Start oxygen therapy now, do not wait for the saturation to drop.

zh: 吸氧后呼吸困难减轻，血氧升至 96 百分比。
en: After oxygen inhalation the breathlessness eased and saturation rose to 96 percent.

zh: 先吸氧，流量开到每分钟三升。
en: Start oxygen inhalation at three litres per minute.

zh: 氧流量调至每分钟 5 升，十分钟后复测血氧。
en: The oxygen flow rate was set to 5 litres per minute with saturation rechecked after ten minutes.

zh: 氧流量别开太大，慢阻肺病人会二氧化碳蓄积。
en: Do not set the oxygen flow rate too high, COPD patients retain carbon dioxide.

zh: 吸氧浓度降至 40 百分比，血氧仍维持在 95。
en: The fraction of inspired oxygen was reduced to 40 percent while saturation stayed at 95.

zh: 吸氧浓度先给六十，稳定后往下调。
en: Start the fraction of inspired oxygen at sixty percent and wean down once stable.

zh: 鼻导管吸氧每分钟 2 升，患者耐受良好。
en: Nasal cannula oxygen at 2 litres per minute was well tolerated.

zh: 先鼻导管吸氧，不够再换面罩。
en: Start with nasal cannula oxygen and switch to a mask if it is not enough.

zh: 面罩吸氧每分钟 8 升，血氧升至 97 百分比。
en: Oxygen therapy via face mask at 8 litres per minute raised saturation to 97 percent.

zh: 改成面罩吸氧吧，鼻导管不够用。
en: Switch to oxygen therapy via face mask, the nasal cannula is not enough.

zh: 高流量鼻导管氧疗流量 50 升每分，氧浓度 60 百分比。
en: High-flow nasal cannula therapy was set at 50 litres per minute with 60 percent oxygen.

zh: 上高流量鼻导管氧疗，他呼吸做功太大了。
en: Start high-flow nasal cannula therapy, his work of breathing is too high.

zh: 起搏心律，每个 QRS 波前可见起搏信号。
en: The rhythm was paced, with a pacing spike before every QRS complex.

zh: 这是起搏心律，不是他自己的心跳。
en: This is a paced rhythm, not his own heartbeat.

zh: 有创机械通气后氧合改善，潮气量设为 6 毫升每公斤。
en: Oxygenation improved on invasive mechanical ventilation with tidal volume set at 6 millilitres per kilogram.

zh: 有创机械通气要镇静，不然人机对抗。
en: Invasive mechanical ventilation needs sedation, otherwise the patient fights the ventilator.

zh: 呼吸机参数按肺保护策略设定，平台压不超过 30 厘米水柱。
en: Ventilator settings followed a lung-protective strategy with plateau pressure below 30 centimetres of water.

zh: 呼吸机参数谁调的，先记下来再改。
en: Who changed the ventilator settings, record them before adjusting.

zh: 潮气量 6 毫升每公斤，平台压 26 厘米水柱。
en: Tidal volume was 6 millilitres per kilogram with a plateau pressure of 26 centimetres of water.

zh: 潮气量给太大容易伤肺，按体重算。
en: Too large a tidal volume injures the lungs, calculate it by body weight.

zh: 呼吸频率设置 14 次每分，患者有自主触发。
en: The set respiratory rate was 14 per minute with patient-triggered breaths.

zh: 呼吸频率设置调低一点，让他自己多呼吸。
en: Lower the set respiratory rate a little so he breathes more himself.

zh: 气道峰压升至 42 厘米水柱，检查是否有痰栓。
en: Peak airway pressure rose to 42 centimetres of water, so the airway was checked for a mucus plug.

zh: 气道峰压高了，先吸痰再看看。
en: Peak airway pressure is high, suction first and then reassess.

zh: 平台压 32 厘米水柱，需降低潮气量。
en: The plateau pressure was 32 centimetres of water, so tidal volume was reduced.

zh: 量一下平台压，这个比峰压更能说明问题。
en: Measure the plateau pressure, it tells you more than the peak.

zh: 呼气末正压调至 10 厘米水柱，氧合明显改善。
en: Positive end-expiratory pressure was raised to 10 centimetres of water with clear improvement in oxygenation.

zh: 呼气末正压太高会影响回心血量，注意血压。
en: Too much positive end-expiratory pressure reduces venous return, watch the blood pressure.

zh: 压力支持 12 厘米水柱，潮气量约 450 毫升。
en: Pressure support of 12 centimetres of water gave a tidal volume of about 450 millilitres.

zh: 压力支持往下调，看他能不能自己撑住。
en: Wean the pressure support down and see whether he can cope.

zh: 氧合目标为血氧饱和度 92 至 96 百分比，避免过度给氧。
en: The oxygenation target was 92 to 96 percent saturation to avoid hyperoxia.

zh: 氧合目标写在床头卡上，接班先看。
en: The oxygenation target is on the bed card, read it at handover.

zh: 氧输送不足是休克时乳酸升高的重要原因。
en: Inadequate oxygen delivery is an important cause of rising lactate in shock.

zh: 氧输送上不去，光调吸氧浓度没用。
en: If oxygen delivery does not improve, raising the inspired oxygen alone is useless.

zh: 气道阻力升高，考虑支气管痉挛，予解痉治疗。
en: Raised airway resistance suggested bronchospasm and bronchodilator treatment was given.

zh: 气道阻力这么高，是不是管路打折了。
en: Airway resistance is this high, is the circuit kinked.

zh: 肺顺应性下降至 25 毫升每厘米水柱，提示肺水肿。
en: Lung compliance fell to 25 millilitres per centimetre of water, suggesting pulmonary oedema.

zh: 肺顺应性差了，同样的压力进不去气。
en: Lung compliance has fallen, the same pressure no longer delivers the volume.

zh: 每搏量指数 32 毫升每平方米，低于正常范围。
en: The stroke volume index was 32 millilitres per square metre, below the normal range.

zh: 看每搏量指数，比单看血压能更早发现容量不足。
en: The stroke volume index picks up low volume earlier than blood pressure alone.

zh: 撤机参数达标，浅快呼吸指数 68，准备拔管。
en: Weaning parameters were met with a rapid shallow breathing index of 68, so extubation was planned.

zh: 撤机参数还差一点，再脱机训练一天。
en: The weaning parameters are not quite there, do another day of trials.

zh: 吸氧浓度持续 80 百分比超过二十四小时，警惕氧中毒。
en: An inspired oxygen of 80 percent for over twenty-four hours raised concern about oxygen toxicity.

zh: 氧中毒也是病，不是氧给得越多越好。
en: Oxygen toxicity is real, more oxygen is not always better.

zh: 呼吸支持升级为无创通气，仍不能维持氧合。
en: Respiratory support was escalated to non-invasive ventilation but oxygenation was still inadequate.

zh: 他现在需要呼吸支持，先别转普通病房。
en: He needs respiratory support now, do not move him to a general ward yet.

zh: 急性生理与慢性健康评分 28 分，预计病死率明显升高。
en: The Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation score was 28, predicting a clearly increased mortality.

zh: 算一下急性生理与慢性健康评分，家属谈话要用。
en: Work out the Acute Physiology and Chronic Health Evaluation score, we need it for the family talk.

zh: 序贯器官衰竭评分由 4 分升至 9 分，提示病情恶化。
en: The Sequential Organ Failure Assessment score rose from 4 to 9, indicating deterioration.

zh: 序贯器官衰竭评分每天算一次，看趋势比看单次重要。
en: The Sequential Organ Failure Assessment score is calculated daily, the trend matters more than one value.

zh: 快速序贯器官衰竭评分 2 项阳性，按脓毒症流程处理。
en: Two criteria of the quick Sequential Organ Failure Assessment were positive, so the sepsis pathway was activated.

zh: 快速序贯器官衰竭评分阳性，先抽血培养再上抗生素。
en: The quick Sequential Organ Failure Assessment is positive, take cultures then start antibiotics.

zh: 国家早期预警评分为 7 分，属高危，立即通知医生。
en: A National Early Warning Score of 7 was high risk, so the doctor was called at once.

zh: 国家早期预警评分超过五就要提高监护级别。
en: A National Early Warning Score above five means the monitoring level must increase.

zh: 改良早期预警评分 5 分，建议转入监护病房。
en: A Modified Early Warning Score of 5 suggested transfer to a monitored bed.

zh: 改良早期预警评分算出来多少，够不够叫快速反应团队。
en: What is the Modified Early Warning Score, is it enough to call the rapid response team.

zh: 早期预警评分每小时复评，评分上升立即上报。
en: The early warning score was recalculated hourly and any rise was reported immediately.

zh: 早期预警评分不是算完就完了，要触发行动。
en: An early warning score is not the end point, it must trigger action.

zh: 危重症评分越高，需要的监护资源越多。
en: The higher the critical illness score, the more monitoring resources are needed.

zh: 危重症评分只是参考，不能代替床旁判断。
en: A critical illness score is only a reference, it cannot replace bedside judgement.

zh: 简化急性生理评分 45 分，预计病死率约 35 百分比。
en: A Simplified Acute Physiology Score of 45 predicted a mortality of about 35 percent.

zh: 简化急性生理评分算完记得核对年龄分。
en: Remember to check the age points after calculating the Simplified Acute Physiology Score.

zh: 器官衰竭评分四项系统受累，病死率明显升高。
en: The organ failure score showed four systems involved, with markedly higher mortality.

zh: 器官衰竭评分每天都看，别只看入院那次。
en: Review the organ failure score daily, not just on admission.

zh: 出院时格拉斯哥预后评分 3 分，属重度残疾。
en: The Glasgow Outcome Scale score at discharge was 3, indicating severe disability.

zh: 格拉斯哥预后评分要等病情稳定后再评。
en: The Glasgow Outcome Scale should be scored once the condition is stable.

zh: 镇静评分目标为 -2 分，每小时评估一次。
en: The sedation score target was minus two, assessed hourly.

zh: 镇静评分太低他会躁动，调一下泵速。
en: A low sedation score will make him restless, adjust the pump rate.

zh: 镇静躁动评分 -3 分，呼唤有反应但不能保持清醒。
en: The Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale score was minus three, responding to voice but not staying awake.

zh: 镇静躁动评分目标负二到零，别镇静太深。
en: The Richmond Agitation-Sedation Scale target is minus two to zero, do not sedate too deeply.

zh: 谵妄评估阳性，注意力和思维两方面均异常。
en: Delirium assessment was positive with abnormality in both attention and thinking.

zh: 谵妄评估每天做，镇静药停了再做一次。
en: Do the delirium assessment daily, and again after holding sedation.

zh: 肌力评分 36 分，提示明显肌力下降，需早期康复。
en: A muscle strength score of 36 indicated marked weakness requiring early rehabilitation.

zh: 肌力评分比上周低，赶紧安排康复。
en: The muscle strength score is lower than last week, arrange rehabilitation.

zh: 误吸风险评估为高危，床头抬高 30 度并暂缓经口进食。
en: Aspiration risk assessment was high, so the head of the bed was raised and oral intake withheld.

zh: 误吸风险评估做完再决定能不能喝水。
en: Finish the aspiration risk assessment before deciding whether he can drink.

zh: 营养风险筛查 4 分，需请营养科会诊。
en: The nutritional risk screening score was 4, so a dietitian consultation was requested.

zh: 营养风险筛查没做，别急着开肠内营养。
en: The nutritional risk screening is not done, do not start enteral feeding yet.

zh: 静脉血栓风险评估为高危，予低分子肝素预防。
en: Venous thromboembolism risk assessment was high, so low molecular weight heparin was started.

zh: 静脉血栓风险评估重新做一遍，他刚做完手术。
en: Redo the venous thromboembolism risk assessment, he has just had surgery.

zh: 死亡风险预测 62 百分比，已与家属沟通病情。
en: The predicted mortality risk was 62 percent and the family was informed.

zh: 死亡风险预测只是概率，不能对一个病人下定论。
en: A mortality risk prediction is only a probability, it does not decide one patient's fate.

zh: 预后评分结合病情与功能状态，不能只看单项。
en: Prognostic scores combine condition and function and should not be read in isolation.

zh: 预后评分低不代表没希望，康复还长着呢。
en: A poor prognostic score does not mean there is no hope, rehabilitation takes time.

zh: 评分量表使用前须核对条目与分值定义。
en: The scoring scale items and point definitions must be checked before use.

zh: 评分量表别自己改，标准是统一的。
en: Do not change the scoring scale yourself, the standard is fixed.

zh: 评分阈值设为 5 分，达到即通知医生。
en: A score threshold of five was set, with the doctor notified when reached.

zh: 评分阈值没到也不能掉以轻心，要看趋势。
en: Not reaching the score threshold is no reason for complacency, watch the trend.

zh: 重复评分每四小时一次，变化超过两分需报告。
en: Repeated scoring was done every four hours, with a change over two reported.

zh: 重复评分是为了看动态，不是走形式。
en: Repeated scoring is about the trend, not a formality.

zh: 危重程度分级为一级，直接进入抢救区。
en: Severity grading was grade one, so he went straight to the resuscitation area.

zh: 危重程度分级不一样，安排的床位也不一样。
en: Severity grading differs and so does the bed each patient gets.

zh: 急性生理评分主要看入室二十四小时内的最差值。
en: The acute physiology score uses the worst values within the first twenty-four hours.

zh: 急性生理评分这部分最费时间，慢慢核对。
en: The acute physiology score takes the longest, check it carefully.

zh: 慢性健康评分因长期透析计 5 分。
en: The chronic health evaluation scored five points for long-term dialysis.

zh: 慢性健康评分别漏了，他一直在用激素。
en: Do not miss the chronic health evaluation, he has been on steroids.

zh: 肺超声见双侧 B 线增多，提示肺水肿。
en: Lung ultrasound showed increased B lines bilaterally, suggesting pulmonary oedema.

zh: 做个肺超声，看看肺里水多不多。
en: Do a lung ultrasound to see how much water is in the lungs.

zh: 转运监护仪电量不足，转运前必须充满。
en: The transport monitor battery was low and had to be fully charged before transfer.

zh: 把转运监护仪挂到担架旁边，方便看。
en: Hang the transport monitor on the side of the stretcher so it is visible.

zh: 转运途中监测记录心率、血压与血氧各三次。
en: Monitoring during transport recorded heart rate, blood pressure and saturation three times each.

zh: 转运途中监测别只看监护仪，脸色也要看。
en: During transport monitoring do not only watch the monitor, look at his colour too.

zh: 转运前评估未通过，暂缓外出检查。
en: The pre-transport assessment was not passed, so the imaging trip was deferred.

zh: 转运前评估做一遍，缺什么补什么。
en: Do a pre-transport assessment and fix whatever is missing.

zh: 转运风险评估为高风险，需医生陪同。
en: The transport risk assessment was high, so a doctor accompanied the patient.

zh: 转运风险评估高的话，家属要签知情同意。
en: If the transport risk assessment is high the family must sign consent.

zh: 存在转运禁忌证，改为床旁超声检查。
en: There was a contraindication to transport, so bedside ultrasound was arranged instead.

zh: 这是转运禁忌证，不能推出去做 CT。
en: This is a contraindication to transport, he cannot go to CT.

zh: 便携式监护仪固定在担架支架上，防止跌落。
en: The portable monitor was fixed to the stretcher bracket to prevent it falling.

zh: 便携式监护仪屏幕小，报警声要开大。
en: The portable monitor screen is small, turn the alarm volume up.

zh: 尿渗透压 620 毫渗摩尔每千克，提示容量不足。
en: A urine osmolality of 620 milliosmoles per kilogram suggested volume depletion.

zh: 尿渗透压高，说明他身体在拼命保水。
en: The urine osmolality is high, his body is holding on to water.

zh: 转运氧气瓶压力不足，出发前更换满瓶。
en: The portable oxygen cylinder pressure was low, so a full one was fitted before departure.

zh: 转运氧气瓶能撑多久，算一下够不够来回。
en: How long will the portable oxygen cylinder last, work out whether it covers the round trip.

zh: 转运中生命体征平稳，到达后复测一次。
en: Vital signs during transport were stable and were rechecked on arrival.

zh: 转运中生命体征有变化就停下来处理。
en: If vital signs during transport change, stop and deal with it.

zh: 转运报警提示血氧下降，立即检查探头与管路。
en: The transport alarm indicated falling saturation, so the probe and circuit were checked.

zh: 转运报警一直响，先看病人再看机器。
en: The transport alarm keeps sounding, check the patient before the machine.

zh: 转运供氧改为面罩每分钟 10 升，估算可维持四十分钟。
en: Oxygen supply during transport was changed to a mask at 10 litres per minute, estimated to last forty minutes.

zh: 转运供氧别断，路上血氧掉得很快。
en: Do not interrupt oxygen supply during transport, saturation drops fast on the way.

zh: 转运监测参数包括心电、血氧与呼气末二氧化碳。
en: Monitored parameters during transport included ECG, saturation and end-tidal carbon dioxide.

zh: 转运监测参数不用全上，挑最关键的。
en: Do not use every monitored parameter during transport, pick the essential ones.

zh: 六小时血乳酸清除率 32 百分比，提示复苏有效。
en: A six-hour lactate clearance of 32 percent indicated effective resuscitation.

zh: 血乳酸清除率上来了，说明补液起作用了。
en: Lactate clearance has improved, so the fluids are working.

zh: 转运团队由一名医生、两名护士与一名工人组成。
en: The transport team consisted of one doctor, two nurses and one porter.

zh: 转运团队分工说清楚，谁管气道谁管泵。
en: Make the transport team roles clear, who manages the airway and who manages the pumps.

zh: 转运设备检查清单逐项打钩，缺项不得出发。
en: The equipment check before transport was ticked item by item and departure was blocked if anything was missing.

zh: 转运设备检查做完了吗，吸引器带没带。
en: Is the equipment check before transport done, is the suction unit packed.

zh: 发生转运不良事件，管路脱出，已现场重新固定。
en: A transport adverse event with tube dislodgement was managed by immediate re-fixation on scene.

zh: 转运不良事件都要上报，别自己压着。
en: Transport adverse events must be reported, do not keep them quiet.

zh: 转运记录写明出发与到达时间及途中的血压变化。
en: The transport record stated departure and arrival times and the blood pressure changes en route.

zh: 转运记录回来了补，别忘了签名。
en: Fill in the transport record when you are back, and do not forget to sign.

zh: 转运安全第一位，担架护栏必须拉起。
en: Transport safety comes first, the stretcher rails must be up.

zh: 转运安全不是口号，担架要固定好。
en: Transport safety is not a slogan, secure the stretcher.

zh: 转运后交接用统一表单，双方签名确认。
en: Post-transport handover used a standard form signed by both sides.

zh: 转运后交接别漏了泵速和过敏史。
en: Do not miss the pump rates and allergy history at post-transport handover.

zh: 转运中输液使用电池驱动的输液泵，防止速度失控。
en: Infusion during transport used a battery-powered pump to prevent rate errors.

zh: 转运中输液留意管路，转弯别拽掉了。
en: Watch the line during transport, do not pull it out on the corners.

zh: 转运中心率监测显示一过性心动过速，到达后恢复。
en: Heart rate monitoring during transport showed transient tachycardia that resolved on arrival.

zh: 转运中心率监测别只看数字，节律也要看。
en: In heart rate monitoring during transport watch the rhythm, not just the number.

zh: 转运中血氧监测下降至 88 百分比，途中调高了氧流量。
en: Oxygen saturation monitoring during transport fell to 88 percent, so the flow was raised en route.

zh: 转运中血氧监测要一直开着，进电梯最容易掉。
en: Keep oxygen saturation monitoring during transport running, it drops most in the lift.

zh: 转运中血压监测每五分钟一次，收缩压维持在 100 以上。
en: Blood pressure monitoring during transport was every five minutes, with systolic kept above 100.

zh: 转运中血压监测不方便，能摸脉就先摸脉。
en: Blood pressure monitoring during transport is awkward, feel the pulse if you cannot measure.

zh: 转运设备电池续航两小时，足够完成检查。
en: The battery for transport equipment lasted two hours, enough for the investigation.

zh: 转运设备电池还剩多少，别半路没电。
en: How much is left in the battery for transport equipment, do not run out halfway.

zh: 容量评估结合中心静脉压、下腔静脉与乳酸综合判断。
en: Volume assessment combined central venous pressure, inferior vena cava and lactate.

zh: 容量评估先做，别一上来就补液。
en: Do the volume assessment first, do not start fluids straight away.

zh: 容量状态评估为不足，皮肤弹性差、尿量少。
en: Volume status was assessed as depleted, with poor skin turgor and low urine output.

zh: 他的容量状态现在偏向过负荷，先利尿。
en: His volume status is now towards overload, give a diuretic.

zh: 容量负荷已明显增加，中心静脉压升至 14 厘米水柱。
en: The volume load had clearly increased with central venous pressure rising to 14 centimetres of water.

zh: 容量负荷够了，再补就进肺里了。
en: The volume load is enough, more fluid will just go into the lungs.

zh: 容量过负荷表现为体重三日增加 4 公斤、颈静脉充盈。
en: Fluid overload showed as a 4 kilogram weight gain over three days with raised jugular venous pressure.

zh: 容量过负荷了，先停补液再考虑超滤。
en: He is fluid overloaded, stop the fluids and consider ultrafiltration.

zh: 容量不足，眼窝凹陷、口唇干燥、尿比重升高。
en: Volume depletion was evident from sunken eyes, dry lips and a raised urine specific gravity.

zh: 他容量不足，先补晶体液。
en: He is volume depleted, give crystalloid first.

zh: 中心静脉压 4 厘米水柱，结合尿量判断容量不足。
en: Central venous pressure was 4 centimetres of water and, with the urine output, indicated volume depletion.

zh: 中心静脉压单看不准，要结合动态变化。
en: Central venous pressure alone is unreliable, use the trend.

zh: 中心静脉压监测每小时一次，同时记录补液量。
en: Central venous pressure monitoring was hourly with the fluid volume recorded alongside.

zh: 中心静脉压监测的零点要校准，不然没意义。
en: The zero point of central venous pressure monitoring must be calibrated or it means nothing.

zh: 每搏量变异度 16 百分比，提示补液可能有效。
en: Stroke volume variation was 16 percent, suggesting fluid would be effective.

zh: 每搏量变异度要在窦性心律和完全机械通气下才准。
en: Stroke volume variation is only reliable in sinus rhythm with full mechanical ventilation.

zh: 脉压变异度 18 百分比，支持下腔静脉塌陷之外的另一证据。
en: Pulse pressure variation was 18 percent, adding evidence alongside inferior vena cava collapse.

zh: 脉压变异度这么高，补点液看看。
en: Pulse pressure variation is this high, give some fluid and see.

zh: 下腔静脉变异度超过 50 百分比，提示容量不足。
en: Inferior vena cava variability above 50 percent suggested volume depletion.

zh: 下腔静脉变异度大，说明他还有补液空间。
en: Inferior vena cava variability is large, meaning there is room for more fluid.

zh: 下腔静脉直径 1.2 厘米，吸气塌陷明显。
en: The inferior vena cava diameter was 1.2 centimetres with clear inspiratory collapse.

zh: 量一下下腔静脉直径，看看容量够不够。
en: Measure the inferior vena cava diameter to see whether volume is adequate.

zh: 每搏输出量由 45 毫升升至 62 毫升，补液有效。
en: Stroke volume rose from 45 to 62 millilitres, confirming that fluid was effective.

zh: 每搏输出量上来了，说明补液没白补。
en: Stroke volume has risen, so the fluid was worth giving.

zh: 心输出量 3.2 升每分，低于正常，考虑心源性因素。
en: Cardiac output was 3.2 litres per minute, below normal, suggesting a cardiac cause.

zh: 心输出量测出来多少，够不够全身用。
en: What is the cardiac output, is it enough for the whole body.

zh: 心指数 2.0 升每分每平方米，提示低灌注状态。
en: The cardiac index was 2.0 litres per minute per square metre, indicating hypoperfusion.

zh: 心指数比心输出量更公平，按体表面积算的。
en: The cardiac index is fairer than cardiac output because it is indexed to body surface area.

zh: 床旁超声显示下腔静脉充盈、左室收缩良好。
en: Point-of-care ultrasound showed a plethoric inferior vena cava and good left ventricular contraction.

zh: 做个床旁超声，看看容量和心脏。
en: Do point-of-care ultrasound to look at volume and the heart.

zh: 液体潴留明显，双下肢凹陷性水肿至膝部。
en: Fluid retention was marked with pitting oedema of both legs up to the knees.

zh: 他有液体潴留，补液要算着来。
en: He has fluid retention, so fluids must be calculated carefully.

zh: 大量液体丢失至第三间隙，血压难以维持。
en: Large volumes were lost to the third space and blood pressure was hard to maintain.

zh: 第三间隙丢的液看不见，但确实缺。
en: Fluid lost to the third space is invisible, but the deficit is real.

zh: 组织水肿加重，眼睑与双手均肿胀。
en: Tissue oedema worsened, with swelling of the eyelids and both hands.

zh: 他组织水肿了，补液要收一收了。
en: He has tissue oedema, we should ease off the fluids.

zh: 出入量每班小结一次，二十四小时总结一次。
en: Intake and output were subtotalled each shift and totalled over twenty-four hours.

zh: 出入量记得准一点，引流液也要算。
en: Record intake and output accurately, include the drainage.

zh: 每日体重增加 1.5 公斤，提示液体潴留。
en: Daily weight increased by 1.5 kilograms, suggesting fluid retention.

zh: 每日体重同一时间称，衣服尽量一样。
en: Weigh for daily weight at the same time and with similar clothing.

zh: 容量管理目标是出入平衡并维持平均动脉压 65 以上。
en: The fluid management goal was even balance with a mean arterial pressure above 65.

zh: 容量管理这事要天天看，不能只看一天。
en: Fluid management needs daily review, not just a single day.

zh: 容量目标为每日负平衡 500 毫升。
en: The volume target was a negative balance of 500 millilitres per day.

zh: 容量目标定了吗，是正平衡还是负平衡。
en: Has the volume target been set, positive or negative balance.

zh: 利尿反应良好，四小时尿量 800 毫升。
en: The diuretic response was good with 800 millilitres of urine in four hours.

zh: 利尿反应差，考虑加量或换药。
en: The diuretic response is poor, consider a higher dose or a different drug.

zh: 毛细血管渗漏导致大量液体进入组织，血压难以维持。
en: Capillary leak shifted large volumes into the tissues and blood pressure was difficult to sustain.

zh: 毛细血管渗漏期补液容易水肿，要算着补。
en: During capillary leak, fluids easily cause oedema, so calculate carefully.

zh: 血管外肺水指数 14 毫升每公斤，提示肺水肿。
en: An extravascular lung water index of 14 millilitres per kilogram indicated pulmonary oedema.

zh: 血管外肺水高说明肺里进水了，补液要停。
en: High extravascular lung water means the lungs are wet, stop the fluids.

zh: 尿量每小时 20 毫升，偏少，需加快补液。
en: Urine output was 20 millilitres per hour, low, so fluids were increased.

zh: 尿量记一下，一小时多少毫升。
en: Record the urine output, how many millilitres per hour.

zh: 尿量监测每小时一次，连续两小时低于 0.5 立即报告。
en: Urine output monitoring was hourly, with two consecutive hours below 0.5 reported at once.

zh: 尿量监测别只看总量，要看每小时。
en: Urine output monitoring is not just the total, watch the hourly figure.

zh: 少尿持续六小时，肌酐上升，考虑急性肾损伤。
en: Oliguria lasting six hours with rising creatinine suggested acute kidney injury.

zh: 他少尿了，先补液再说要不要用利尿剂。
en: He is oliguric, give fluids first and then decide about diuretics.

zh: 无尿伴血钾 6.5，紧急联系血液净化。
en: Anuria with a potassium of 6.5 prompted urgent renal replacement therapy.

zh: 他无尿了，先冲一下尿管看通不通。
en: He is anuric, flush the catheter first to check patency.

zh: 多尿每日约 4000 毫升，查血糖与尿比重。
en: Polyuria of about 4000 millilitres daily prompted glucose and urine specific gravity testing.

zh: 他多尿，注意补液和电解质。
en: He is polyuric, watch fluids and electrolytes.

zh: 每小时尿量 35 毫升，较前两小时明显增多。
en: Hourly urine output was 35 millilitres, clearly more than the previous two hours.

zh: 每小时尿量都写在这里，接班对一下。
en: The hourly urine output is written here, check it at handover.

zh: 尿量记录与出入量单一致，无漏项。
en: The urine output record matched the fluid balance chart with no gaps.

zh: 尿量记录补上时间点，不然没法判断趋势。
en: Add the times to the urine output record, otherwise the trend cannot be judged.

zh: 导尿管留置第三天，评估是否可拔除。
en: On the third day of the indwelling urinary catheter, removal was assessed.

zh: 导尿管固定好，翻身别拽。
en: Secure the urinary catheter so it is not pulled when turning.

zh: 尿袋液面超过三分之二会影响计量，及时排空。
en: A urine collection bag more than two thirds full distorts measurement, so it was emptied promptly.

zh: 尿袋挂低一点，别让尿液倒流。
en: Hang the urine collection bag lower to prevent backflow.

zh: 尿比重 1.030，提示容量不足。
en: A urine specific gravity of 1.030 suggested volume depletion.

zh: 尿比重偏高，说明他缺水，先补点液。
en: The urine specific gravity is high, meaning he is short of fluid.

zh: 尿色深黄，考虑浓缩，嘱多饮水。
en: Urine colour was deep yellow, suggesting concentration, so more oral fluids were advised.

zh: 尿色像浓茶，得查一下胆红素。
en: The urine colour is like strong tea, check bilirubin.

zh: 尿量目标为每小时每公斤 0.5 毫升。
en: The target urine output was 0.5 millilitres per kilogram per hour.

zh: 尿量目标写清楚，护士才知道什么时候报。
en: Write the target urine output clearly so the nurse knows when to report.

zh: 少尿期持续五天，需限制入量并监测血钾。
en: The oliguric phase lasted five days, requiring fluid restriction and potassium monitoring.

zh: 少尿期补液要严格，多给一点就水肿。
en: Fluids must be strict in the oliguric phase, a little extra causes oedema.

zh: 多尿期每日尿量达 5000 毫升，注意补钾补液。
en: In the polyuric phase daily urine reached 5000 millilitres, so fluids and potassium were replaced.

zh: 进入多尿期了，别以为尿多就是好了。
en: He has entered the polyuric phase, do not assume lots of urine means recovery.

zh: 24 小时尿量 850 毫升，较前一日减少。
en: The 24-hour urine output was 850 millilitres, less than the previous day.

zh: 24 小时尿量从早上八点开始算，别漏了。
en: The 24-hour urine output is counted from eight in the morning, do not miss it.

zh: 尿量趋势连续三小时下降，提示灌注恶化。
en: The urine output trend fell over three consecutive hours, suggesting worsening perfusion.

zh: 看尿量趋势就知道补液够不够。
en: The urine output trend tells you whether the fluids are enough.

zh: 每公斤体重尿量 0.3 毫升每小时，低于目标值。
en: Urine output per kilogram was 0.3 millilitres per hour, below target.

zh: 按每公斤体重尿量算，不然胖瘦没法比。
en: Calculate urine output per kilogram, otherwise body size makes comparison impossible.

zh: 尿管堵塞，膀胱区膨隆，予冲洗后恢复引流。
en: Catheter blockage with a distended bladder resolved after irrigation.

zh: 尿管堵塞了，先看看是不是打折了。
en: The catheter is blocked, first check whether it is kinked.

zh: 尿管脱出，患者诉下腹胀痛，需重新置管。
en: Catheter dislodgement with lower abdominal pain required reinsertion.

zh: 尿管脱出了，先别硬塞回去。
en: The catheter has come out, do not force it back in.

zh: 尿液引流采用密闭系统，减少感染机会。
en: Urinary drainage used a closed system to reduce infection.

zh: 尿液引流袋要低于膀胱，防止倒流。
en: Keep the urinary drainage bag below the bladder to prevent backflow.

zh: 尿量计每小时读数一次，记录后复位。
en: The urine meter was read hourly and reset after recording.

zh: 尿量计读数看不清，换个新的。
en: The urine meter reading is unclear, change it for a new one.

zh: 补液后尿量恢复至每小时 60 毫升，灌注改善。
en: After fluids the urine output recovered to 60 millilitres per hour, showing better perfusion.

zh: 他尿量恢复了，说明补液方向对。
en: His urine output has recovered, so the fluid strategy was right.

zh: 尿量下降伴血压降低，首先考虑容量不足。
en: Declining urine output with falling blood pressure pointed first to volume depletion.

zh: 尿量下降了，先查尿管再查容量。
en: Urine output is declining, check the catheter then the volume status.

zh: 尿量异常持续两天，复查肾功能与电解质。
en: Abnormal urine output persisted for two days, so renal function and electrolytes were rechecked.

zh: 尿量异常要早报，别等到肌酐升上来。
en: Report abnormal urine output early, do not wait for the creatinine to rise.

zh: 尿量记录单每小时填写，交班时核对签名。
en: The urine output chart was completed hourly and countersigned at handover.

zh: 尿量记录单放床尾，谁量的谁填。
en: Keep the urine output chart at the foot of the bed and let whoever measures fill it in.

zh: 患者突发心搏骤停，抢救团队立即开始胸外按压。
en: He went into cardiac arrest, and the team started chest compressions at once.

zh: 他刚才心搏骤停了，快推抢救车过来！
en: He just had a cardiac arrest — get the crash cart here now!

zh: 本次分析纳入院外心搏骤停且接受旁观者复苏的病例。
en: This analysis included out-of-hospital cardiac arrest cases that received bystander resuscitation.

zh: 这例是院外心搏骤停，救护车到的时候已经有人在做按压了。
en: This is an out-of-hospital cardiac arrest; someone was already doing compressions when we arrived.

zh: 院内心搏骤停的抢救记录须在六小时内完成。
en: The record of an in-hospital cardiac arrest must be completed within six hours.

zh: 三楼病房院内心搏骤停，快叫急救小组！
en: In-hospital cardiac arrest on the third floor — call the resuscitation team now!

zh: 尸检未发现心源性猝死以外的其他死因。
en: Autopsy found no cause of death other than sudden cardiac death.

zh: 医生说是心源性猝死，家里人一点准备都没有。
en: The doctor said it was sudden cardiac death, and the family was completely unprepared.

zh: 心电监护显示心室颤动，即刻行电除颤。
en: The monitor showed ventricular fibrillation, so defibrillation was performed immediately.

zh: 现在是心室颤动，赶紧除颤，别耽误！
en: It is ventricular fibrillation now — defibrillate, do not waste a second!

zh: 患者心电图呈无脉性室速，立即按心搏骤停流程处置。
en: The electrocardiogram showed pulseless ventricular tachycardia, so the arrest protocol was started.

zh: 无脉性室速，马上电击，准备除颤器！
en: Pulseless ventricular tachycardia — shock now and get the defibrillator ready!

zh: 抢救记录记载无脉性电活动，予肾上腺素并查找可逆病因。
en: The record noted pulseless electrical activity, so epinephrine was given while reversible causes were sought.

zh: 监护上有波形但摸不到脉，这就是无脉性电活动。
en: There is a waveform but no pulse — that is pulseless electrical activity.

zh: 心电图提示心脏停搏，继续按压并给予肾上腺素。
en: The tracing showed asystole, so compressions continued and epinephrine was given.

zh: 心脏停搏了，接着按压，不要停！
en: It is asystole — keep compressing, do not stop!

zh: 患者仅有濒死呼吸，未触及颈动脉搏动，立即开始复苏。
en: The patient showed only agonal breathing with no carotid pulse, so resuscitation began at once.

zh: 他那种喘气是濒死呼吸，不是真的在呼吸，得马上按压。
en: That gasping is agonal breathing, not real breathing — start compressions now.

zh: 首次心律分析为可除颤心律，予单次电击后继续按压。
en: The first rhythm check showed a shockable rhythm, so one shock was given and compressions resumed.

zh: 是可除颤心律，除颤器充好电就放。
en: It is a shockable rhythm — shock as soon as the defibrillator is charged.

zh: 心律为不可除颤心律，未予电击，仅持续胸外按压。
en: It was a non-shockable rhythm, so no shock was given and chest compressions continued.

zh: 这个是不可除颤心律，别电了，继续按压给药。
en: This is a non-shockable rhythm — stop shocking and keep compressing while we give drugs.

zh: 缩短呼救到除颤的时间是改善生存链的关键。
en: Shortening the interval from the emergency call to defibrillation is key to strengthening the chain of survival.

zh: 生存链每一环都不能断，尤其别漏了早期除颤。
en: Every link in the chain of survival matters, especially early defibrillation.

zh: 抢救中同步排查可逆病因，并针对低氧予气道支持。
en: Reversible causes were checked during resuscitation, with airway support given for hypoxia.

zh: 先别放弃，找找可逆病因，说不定还能救回来。
en: Do not give up yet — look for a reversible cause, we may still get him back.

zh: 患者处于骤停前状态，已通知抢救团队床旁待命。
en: The patient was in a peri-arrest state, so the resuscitation team was called to the bedside.

zh: 这个病人是骤停前状态，咱们别离开床旁。
en: This patient is in a peri-arrest state, so nobody leaves the bedside.

zh: 记录停搏时间与自主循环恢复时间，用于评估预后。
en: Arrest downtime and the time of return of spontaneous circulation were recorded to estimate prognosis.

zh: 停搏时间太长，脑损伤的风险很高。
en: The arrest downtime was too long, so the risk of brain injury is high.

zh: 该患者复苏后出现骤停后综合征，转入重症监护室继续治疗。
en: The patient developed post-cardiac arrest syndrome and was transferred to intensive care.

zh: 醒过来不等于没事，骤停后综合征还要盯好几天。
en: Waking up is not the end of it — post-cardiac arrest syndrome needs days of watching.

zh: 心电图由终末期心律逐渐转为直线，家属已在场。
en: The tracing drifted from a terminal rhythm to a flat line, with the family present.

zh: 这个波形是终末期心律，大家都知道意味着什么。
en: That waveform is a terminal rhythm, and everyone knows what it means.

zh: 患者呼吸骤停，予球囊面罩通气并准备气管插管。
en: The patient was in respiratory arrest, so bag-mask ventilation was started and intubation prepared.

zh: 呼吸骤停，先给通气，别等到心跳也停了。
en: Respiratory arrest — ventilate first, before the heart stops too.

zh: 骤停事件记录须逐项填写并双人核对。
en: The cardiac arrest record must be completed item by item and checked by two staff.

zh: 你在旁边把骤停事件记录写好，时间都要准确。
en: Write up the cardiac arrest record beside me, and get every time right.

zh: 本院院内心搏骤停存活率较去年提高。
en: The hospital's in-hospital cardiac arrest survival rate improved compared with last year.

zh: 现在骤停存活率比以前高了，因为按压质量抓得紧。
en: The cardiac arrest survival rate is higher now because compression quality is tightly monitored.

zh: 所有院内骤停病例均纳入骤停登记。
en: All in-hospital arrest cases are entered into the cardiac arrest registry.

zh: 这个病例记得上报骤停登记，后面要复查数据。
en: Remember to report this case to the cardiac arrest registry — the data will be reviewed later.

zh: 按骤停风险评分评估，该患者需转入监护病房。
en: On the arrest risk score, this patient needs transfer to a monitored bed.

zh: 他的骤停风险评分很高，夜班多看着点。
en: His arrest risk score is high, so keep a close eye on him at night.

zh: 经团队评估后决定终止复苏，并向家属告知。
en: After team review, termination of resuscitation was decided and the family was informed.

zh: 按压三十分钟没有反应，按规范可以终止复苏了。
en: Thirty minutes with no response — under our protocol we can proceed to termination of resuscitation.

zh: 复苏十二分钟后出现自主循环恢复，转入进一步治疗。
en: Return of spontaneous circulation occurred after twelve minutes and further treatment followed.

zh: 摸到脉了，自主循环恢复，大家先别动导管。
en: I have a pulse — return of spontaneous circulation, so leave the lines alone for now.

zh: 病例随访记录骤停转归及出院时神经功能分级。
en: Follow-up recorded the arrest outcome and the neurological grade at discharge.

zh: 这个病人的骤停转归不太好，家属要有心理准备。
en: His arrest outcome is not looking good, so the family should be prepared.

zh: 立即启动心肺复苏，同时呼叫抢救团队。
en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation was started immediately while the resuscitation team was called.

zh: 快做心肺复苏，按压别停！
en: Start cardiopulmonary resuscitation now — do not stop compressing!

zh: 胸外按压过程中尽量减少中断，保证按压质量。
en: Chest compressions were interrupted as little as possible to keep quality high.

zh: 胸外按压要快要有力，压下去让胸廓完全回弹。
en: Chest compressions must be fast and hard, and let the chest come all the way back up.

zh: 按压深度不足会显著降低复苏成功率。
en: Inadequate compression depth markedly lowers the success rate of resuscitation.

zh: 你的按压深度不够，再用力一点，压到五厘米。
en: Your compression depth is too shallow — push harder, down to five centimetres.

zh: 按压频率维持在每分钟一百至一百二十次。
en: The compression rate was kept at one hundred to one hundred twenty per minute.

zh: 按压频率太快了，跟着节拍器，一百一十下左右。
en: The compression rate is too fast — follow the metronome, about a hundred and ten a minute.

zh: 按压部位取胸骨下半部，避免压到剑突。
en: Compression position is the lower half of the sternum, avoiding the xiphoid process.

zh: 按压部位在胸骨下半段，你的手再往上挪一点。
en: Compression position is the lower sternum — move your hand up a little.

zh: 每轮按压都须保证胸廓回弹完全。
en: Every cycle of compressions must allow full chest recoil.

zh: 手别一直压着，让胸廓回弹，不然血回不来。
en: Do not lean on the chest — allow full chest recoil, otherwise blood cannot come back.

zh: 控制按压中断时间在十秒以内。
en: Compression interruption was kept under ten seconds.

zh: 按压中断别超过十秒，动作快点！
en: Keep the compression interruption under ten seconds — move faster!

zh: 培训重点是高质量心肺复苏的各项指标。
en: Training focuses on the measurable components of high-quality CPR.

zh: 咱们要做高质量心肺复苏，深度频率都得达标。
en: We need high-quality CPR here — depth and rate both have to hit target.

zh: 对目击成人心搏骤停可先行单纯胸外按压。
en: Compression-only CPR may be started first in a witnessed adult cardiac arrest.

zh: 你不会吹气就做单纯胸外按压，一直压就行。
en: If you cannot give breaths, just do compression-only CPR and keep pushing.

zh: 旁观者心肺复苏能显著缩短首次按压的延迟时间。
en: Bystander CPR substantially shortens the delay to the first chest compression.

zh: 幸好有人做了旁观者心肺复苏，不然等我们到就晚了。
en: Thankfully someone gave bystander CPR, or we would have arrived too late.

zh: 双人施救时按压者每两分钟轮换一次。
en: In two-rescuer CPR the compressor is changed every two minutes.

zh: 咱俩双人施救，你按压我通气，两分钟换一次。
en: Let us do two-rescuer CPR — you compress, I ventilate, and we swap every two minutes.

zh: 成人心肺复苏采用三十比二的按压通气比。
en: Adult CPR uses a compression-to-ventilation ratio of thirty to two.

zh: 按压通气比是三十比二，压三十下给两口气。
en: The compression-to-ventilation ratio is thirty to two — thirty pushes then two breaths.

zh: 清除口腔异物后给予人工呼吸。
en: Rescue breathing was given after clearing debris from the mouth.

zh: 来，配合我，我开始人工呼吸，你继续按压。
en: Work with me — I am starting rescue breathing while you keep compressing.

zh: 无防护设备时可实施口对口人工呼吸。
en: Mouth-to-mouth ventilation may be used when no barrier device is available.

zh: 有面罩就用面罩，没条件才做口对口人工呼吸。
en: Use a mask if we have one — only do mouth-to-mouth ventilation as a last resort.

zh: 所有急诊护士须每年通过基础生命支持考核。
en: All emergency nurses must pass a basic life support assessment each year.

zh: 先按基础生命支持做，按压加除颤，高级处理随后到。
en: Start with basic life support — compressions and defibrillation — and advanced care will follow.

zh: 高级生命支持阶段给予肾上腺素并建立高级气道。
en: During advanced life support, epinephrine was given and an advanced airway was placed.

zh: 等高级生命支持到了就给药、插管，现在就先把按压做好。
en: Once advanced life support arrives we will give drugs and intubate, but for now focus on compressions.

zh: 本流程依据最新复苏指南修订。
en: This protocol was revised according to the latest resuscitation guideline.

zh: 咱们按复苏指南来，别自己改顺序。
en: Follow the resuscitation guideline — do not change the sequence on your own.

zh: 本季度复苏成功率与按压质量培训同步改善。
en: The resuscitation success rate improved alongside compression quality training this quarter.

zh: 这个月复苏成功率上去了，说明流程改对了。
en: The resuscitation success rate went up this month, so the process change worked.

zh: 复苏记录须与医嘱、护理记录保持一致。
en: The resuscitation record must be consistent with the orders and nursing notes.

zh: 复苏记录你来写，每次给药时间都要写清楚。
en: You write the resuscitation record, and note the time of every drug dose clearly.

zh: 缩短复苏延迟是提高生存率的核心措施。
en: Reducing resuscitation delay is a core measure for improving survival.

zh: 复苏延迟一分钟，存活率就掉一大截。
en: Every minute of resuscitation delay drops the survival rate sharply.

zh: 转运途中使用心肺复苏机维持按压。
en: A mechanical CPR device maintained compressions during transport.

zh: 上心肺复苏机吧，人手不够，还得腾人出来。
en: Put the mechanical CPR device on — we are short of hands and need someone free.

zh: 复苏反馈装置显示按压深度合格率明显提升。
en: The CPR feedback device showed a clear rise in the proportion of adequate compression depth.

zh: 把复苏反馈装置贴上，看看你压得够不够深。
en: Stick the CPR feedback device on and see whether you are deep enough.

zh: 每两分钟安排一次按压者轮换并记录时间。
en: Compressor rotation was scheduled every two minutes with the time recorded.

zh: 两分钟了，按压者轮换，换人上！
en: Two minutes are up — compressor rotation, next person in!

zh: 出现复苏有效指征后继续按压并复评心律。
en: After signs of effective resuscitation appeared, compressions continued and the rhythm was rechecked.

zh: 看到复苏有效指征了，别停，接着压。
en: We are seeing signs of effective resuscitation — do not stop, keep compressing.

zh: 心前区叩击仅限目击骤停且监护在场时尝试。
en: A precordial thump is attempted only in witnessed arrest with the monitor attached.

zh: 别浪费时间做心前区叩击了，直接按压除颤。
en: Do not waste time on a precordial thump — go straight to compressions and defibrillation.

zh: 科室每半年组织一次复苏培训与考核。
en: The department runs CPR training and assessment every six months.

zh: 下周有复苏培训，新来的都要参加。
en: There is CPR training next week and all the new staff must attend.

zh: 确诊心室颤动后立即行电除颤。
en: Defibrillation was performed as soon as ventricular fibrillation was confirmed.

zh: 电除颤准备，所有人离开床！
en: Preparing for defibrillation — everybody off the bed!

zh: 大厅与候诊区均配置自动体外除颤器。
en: Automated external defibrillators are installed in the lobby and the waiting area.

zh: 快拿自动体外除颤器来，它自己会判断要不要电。
en: Get the automated external defibrillator — it decides by itself whether to shock.

zh: 抢救室配备手动除颤器与除颤电极片。
en: The resuscitation room is equipped with a manual defibrillator and defibrillation pads.

zh: 用手动除颤器，我来选能量，你们离床。
en: Use the manual defibrillator — I will pick the energy, you all step back.

zh: 除颤电极片贴于右锁骨下与左腋中线。
en: Defibrillation pads were placed below the right clavicle and at the left mid-axillary line.

zh: 除颤电极片贴好了吗？贴好我就充电。
en: Are the defibrillation pads on? If so I will charge.

zh: 使用除颤手柄时需涂导电糊并施加一定压力。
en: With defibrillator paddles, conductive gel must be applied and firm pressure used.

zh: 除颤手柄拿稳，涂点导电糊，别留空隙。
en: Hold the defibrillator paddles firmly, add gel and leave no gap.

zh: 双相波首次除颤能量选择一百二十至二百焦耳。
en: The first defibrillation energy for a biphasic device is one hundred twenty to two hundred joules.

zh: 除颤能量调到两百焦耳，快！
en: Set the defibrillation energy to two hundred joules, quickly!

zh: 老旧设备仍采用单相波除颤，能量选择三百六十焦耳。
en: Older devices still use monophasic defibrillation at three hundred sixty joules.

zh: 这台机器是单相波除颤，能量要往上调。
en: This machine does monophasic defibrillation, so the energy has to go up.

zh: 双相波除颤已取代单相波成为首选方式。
en: Biphasic defibrillation has replaced monophasic as the preferred approach.

zh: 现在都是双相波除颤，能量小一点效果一样。
en: We use biphasic defibrillation now, so lower energy works just as well.

zh: 房颤伴快速心室率时行同步电复律。
en: Synchronized cardioversion was performed for atrial fibrillation with a rapid ventricular rate.

zh: 这个不是室颤，要同步电复律，记得按同步键。
en: This is not ventricular fibrillation — we need synchronized cardioversion, so press the sync key.

zh: 心律分析确认除颤指征后方可放电。
en: A shock is delivered only after rhythm analysis confirms an indication for defibrillation.

zh: 先确认除颤指征，别看到乱就电。
en: Confirm the indication for defibrillation first — do not shock just because the trace looks messy.

zh: 一次电击后立即恢复胸外按压，不做即刻复查。
en: After a single shock, chest compressions resumed at once without an immediate recheck.

zh: 一次电击就够，电完马上按压，别站着看。
en: A single shock is enough — compress right after it, do not just stand and watch.

zh: 充电完成后再次确认无人接触患者。
en: After you charge the defibrillator, confirm again that nobody is touching the patient.

zh: 我在充电，大家手都拿开！
en: I need to charge now — everyone take your hands off!

zh: 放电前须确认心电图仍为可除颤心律。
en: Before shock delivery, confirm the tracing is still a shockable rhythm.

zh: 放电！大家都离开床了没有？
en: Shock delivery now! Is everyone clear of the bed?

zh: 心律分析时间不宜超过十秒。
en: Rhythm analysis should not take longer than ten seconds.

zh: 停一下做心律分析，看完马上接着压。
en: Pause for rhythm analysis, then get straight back on the chest.

zh: 除颤时机应尽可能提前至发现可除颤心律时。
en: Defibrillation timing should be as early as possible once a shockable rhythm is found.

zh: 除颤时机特别关键，每早一分钟都不一样。
en: Defibrillation timing is critical — every minute earlier makes a difference.

zh: 电极板位置须避开起搏器与敷料。
en: Paddle placement must avoid the pacemaker and any dressings.

zh: 电极板位置一个放右上胸一个放左腋下，别贴反。
en: Paddle placement is one on the upper right chest and one at the left axilla — do not mix them up.

zh: 转运前将患者接至除颤监护仪持续监护。
en: Before transport the patient was connected to a defibrillator monitor for continuous observation.

zh: 把除颤监护仪推到床旁，导联先贴上。
en: Bring the defibrillator monitor to the bedside and put the leads on first.

zh: 放电前口头清场并目视确认。
en: Before the shock, the team is verbally cleared and visually checked.

zh: 清场！氧气拿开，谁都别碰床！
en: Clear! Move the oxygen away and nobody touch the bed!

zh: 症状性心动过缓药物无效时改用经皮起搏。
en: Transcutaneous pacing is used when drugs fail in symptomatic bradycardia.

zh: 经皮起搏开起来，频率设七十，看看能不能夺获。
en: Start transcutaneous pacing at seventy a minute and see whether we get capture.

zh: 除颤阈值升高时需检查电极位置与接触。
en: When the defibrillation threshold rises, electrode position and contact should be checked.

zh: 除颤阈值高，可能电极没贴好。
en: The defibrillation threshold is high — the pads may not be making good contact.

zh: 两分钟后复查心律，仍为室颤者行再次除颤。
en: The rhythm was rechecked two minutes later and repeat defibrillation was given for persisting ventricular fibrillation.

zh: 还是室颤，准备再次除颤，能量不变。
en: Still ventricular fibrillation — prepare for repeat defibrillation at the same energy.

zh: 自动心律分析提示可电击，操作者确认后放电。
en: Automated rhythm analysis advised a shock, which the operator delivered after confirming.

zh: 等它自动心律分析完，听语音提示再按。
en: Wait for automated rhythm analysis to finish and follow the voice prompt before pressing.

zh: 记录除颤后心律并立即继续胸外按压。
en: The post-shock rhythm was recorded and chest compressions resumed at once.

zh: 看看除颤后心律转过来没有？转了就接着按压。
en: Check the post-shock rhythm — did it convert? If so, keep compressing.

zh: 电复律镇静首选短效静脉麻醉药并全程监护。
en: Sedation for cardioversion usually uses a short-acting intravenous agent with continuous monitoring.

zh: 做电复律镇静前先备好球囊面罩，镇静要浅。
en: Have bag-mask equipment ready before sedation for cardioversion, and keep it light.

zh: 除颤器检查记录须每班签字确认。
en: The defibrillator check record must be signed every shift.

zh: 交班前记得做除颤器检查，电池要满格。
en: Do the defibrillator check before handover and make sure the battery is full.

zh: 气道管理是抢救室交接班必须交代的内容。
en: Airway management is a mandatory item in resuscitation room handover.

zh: 这个病人气道管理要加强，随时可能堵。
en: This patient needs closer airway management — the airway could obstruct at any time.

zh: 先以手法开放气道，再评估通气效果。
en: A manual airway maneuver was performed first, then ventilation was assessed.

zh: 先做手法开放气道，看看能不能吹进去气。
en: Do a manual airway maneuver first and see whether air goes in.

zh: 无颈椎损伤疑虑时首选仰头抬颏法。
en: Head tilt-chin lift is preferred when cervical injury is not suspected.

zh: 仰头抬颏法，手放这儿，往上抬，气就通了。
en: Head tilt-chin lift — put your hand here and lift, and the airway opens.

zh: 怀疑颈椎损伤时改用推举下颌法开放气道。
en: A jaw thrust was used to open the airway when cervical injury was suspected.

zh: 别抬头，用推举下颌法，他脖子可能伤了。
en: Do not tilt the head — use a jaw thrust, his neck may be injured.

zh: 昏迷患者出现舌后坠时需放置口咽通气管。
en: When glossoptosis occurs in an unconscious patient, an oropharyngeal airway is inserted.

zh: 打呼噜那种声音是舌后坠，把头仰起来就好点。
en: That snoring sound is glossoptosis — tilting the head back helps.

zh: 置入口咽通气管后通气明显改善。
en: Ventilation improved noticeably after an oropharyngeal airway was inserted.

zh: 拿个口咽通气管来，三号的，给他放上。
en: Get an oropharyngeal airway, size three, and put it in.

zh: 牙关紧闭者可选用鼻咽通气管。
en: A nasopharyngeal airway may be chosen when the jaw is clenched.

zh: 鼻咽通气管涂点润滑剂再插，别硬顶。
en: Lubricate the nasopharyngeal airway before inserting — do not force it.

zh: 气道吸引前后应给予充分氧合。
en: Adequate oxygenation is given before and after airway suctioning.

zh: 先做气道吸引，把血吸干净再看声门。
en: Do airway suctioning first, clear the blood, then look for the glottis.

zh: 选择合适型号的吸痰管，避免损伤气道黏膜。
en: Choose an appropriately sized suction catheter to avoid injuring the airway mucosa.

zh: 吸痰管太粗了，换根细的，别伤着黏膜。
en: That suction catheter is too thick — use a finer one so we do not damage the mucosa.
