zh: 负压吸引装置应处于备用状态并每日检查。
en: Negative pressure suction equipment must be ready for use and checked daily.

zh: 负压吸引开小一点，压力太大会伤气道。
en: Turn the negative pressure suction down — too much pressure injures the airway.

zh: 体位引流前应评估患者耐受性与氧合情况。
en: Tolerance and oxygenation are assessed before postural drainage.

zh: 给他摆个体位引流，痰在肺底那边。
en: Set him up for postural drainage — the secretions are at the lung bases.

zh: 开放气道的同时须做好颈椎保护。
en: Cervical spine protection is maintained while the airway is opened.

zh: 颈椎保护要做好，我固定头你开放气道。
en: Keep up cervical spine protection — I will hold the head while you open the airway.

zh: 插管前完成气道评估并记录困难气道征象。
en: Airway assessment was completed before intubation and difficult-airway signs were recorded.

zh: 先做气道评估，看他张嘴大不大。
en: Do an airway assessment first and see how wide he can open his mouth.

zh: 评估为困难气道者应准备备用方案与设备。
en: For a predicted difficult airway, backup plans and equipment must be prepared.

zh: 这个人是困难气道，把视频喉镜也推过来。
en: This one is a difficult airway — bring the video laryngoscope too.

zh: 马氏气道分级三级以上提示插管困难风险增高。
en: A Mallampati classification of three or above suggests a higher risk of difficult intubation.

zh: 马氏气道分级是三级，插管可能不好插。
en: The Mallampati classification is three, so intubation may be tricky.

zh: 张口度小于三厘米提示可能存在困难气道。
en: A mouth opening under three centimetres suggests a possible difficult airway.

zh: 张口度不够，喉镜放不进去。
en: The mouth opening is too small — the laryngoscope will not go in.

zh: 甲颏距小于六厘米时须备好困难气道方案。
en: If thyromental distance is under six centimetres, a difficult-airway plan is required.

zh: 量一下甲颏距，看着偏短。
en: Measure the thyromental distance — it looks short.

zh: 气道异物完全阻塞时患者无法发声与咳嗽。
en: With a complete airway foreign body obstruction the patient cannot speak or cough.

zh: 气道异物，快做海姆立克手法！
en: Airway foreign body — do the Heimlich maneuver now!

zh: 成人气道异物梗阻首选海姆立克手法。
en: A Heimlich maneuver is the first choice for an adult with an obstructed airway.

zh: 别拍背了，海姆立克手法，我来。
en: Stop the back slaps — I will do the Heimlich maneuver.

zh: 摆好嗅物位可明显改善声门视野。
en: A good sniffing position clearly improves the view of the glottis.

zh: 把头垫高一点，摆成嗅物位，好插。
en: Raise the head a little into a sniffing position — it will be easier to intubate.

zh: 头后仰配合抬颏可缓解轻度气道梗阻。
en: Head extension with chin lift relieves mild airway obstruction.

zh: 头后仰一点，气道就打开了。
en: Give it a bit of head extension and the airway opens.

zh: 深度镇静会抑制气道保护反射。
en: Deep sedation suppresses the airway protective reflex.

zh: 他还有气道保护反射，说明镇静没那么深。
en: His airway protective reflex is still there, so he is not that deeply sedated.

zh: 气道梗阻分为部分性与完全性两类。
en: Airway obstruction is classified as partial or complete.

zh: 听这声音是气道梗阻，快处理！
en: That sound means airway obstruction — deal with it now!

zh: 呕吐患者取侧卧位并清理口腔。
en: A vomiting patient is placed in the lateral position and the mouth is cleared.

zh: 把他翻成侧卧位，别让呕吐物呛进去。
en: Turn him into the lateral position so the vomit does not go down.

zh: 气道异物梗阻时先予背部拍击五次。
en: Five back blows are given first when the airway is obstructed.

zh: 先做背部拍击，拍五下看看能不能咳出来。
en: Start with back blows — five of them — and see whether he can cough it out.

zh: 患者血氧持续下降，决定行气管插管。
en: Oxygen saturation kept falling, so endotracheal intubation was decided.

zh: 准备气管插管，镇静药和喉镜都备好！
en: Get ready for endotracheal intubation — prepare sedation and the laryngoscope!

zh: 选择内径七点五毫米的气管导管经口置入。
en: An endotracheal tube with an internal diameter of seven point five millimetres was inserted orally.

zh: 气管导管型号合适吗？男的先用八号。
en: Is the endotracheal tube the right size? Start with a size eight for a man.

zh: 记录导管型号与置入深度。
en: Record the tube size and the insertion depth.

zh: 导管型号别选太大，容易伤声带。
en: Do not pick too large a tube size — it damages the vocal cords.

zh: 检查导管气囊是否漏气后再置入。
en: Check the tube cuff for leaks before insertion.

zh: 导管气囊充气后要测压力，别超过三十厘米水柱。
en: Measure the pressure after inflating the tube cuff, and keep it under thirty centimetres of water.

zh: 气囊充气后听诊确认无漏气。
en: After cuff inflation, auscultation confirmed there was no leak.

zh: 气囊充气了没有？没充会漏气。
en: Have you done cuff inflation? Without it the circuit will leak.

zh: 插管深度按门齿刻度记录为二十三厘米。
en: The insertion depth was recorded as twenty-three centimetres at the incisors.

zh: 插管深度太深了，往外拔一厘米。
en: The insertion depth is too deep — pull the tube back one centimetre.

zh: 喉镜光源不足会影响声门暴露。
en: A dim laryngoscope light impairs glottic exposure.

zh: 喉镜递给我，换个大号镜片看看。
en: Pass me the laryngoscope and change to a larger blade.

zh: 根据患者体型选择合适长度的喉镜片。
en: Choose a laryngoscope blade of suitable length for the patient's build.

zh: 喉镜片装上去了吗？装反了用不了。
en: Is the laryngoscope blade fitted? It will not work if it is the wrong way round.

zh: 成人气管插管多选用弯型镜片。
en: A curved blade is usually chosen for intubation in adults.

zh: 换弯型镜片，直的在成人不好用。
en: Switch to a curved blade — the straight one is awkward in adults.

zh: 儿童插管宜选用直型镜片。
en: A straight blade is preferred for intubation in children.

zh: 直型镜片给我，这孩子会厌软。
en: Give me a straight blade — this child has a floppy epiglottis.

zh: 采用快速诱导插管，给药后三十秒内完成置管。
en: Rapid sequence intubation was used, with the tube placed within thirty seconds of induction.

zh: 按快速诱导插管来，镇静肌松一起给。
en: Go with rapid sequence intubation — give sedation and the muscle relaxant together.

zh: 插管确认以持续二氧化碳波形最为可靠。
en: Tube confirmation is most reliable with a continuous carbon dioxide waveform.

zh: 插管确认了吗？先看二氧化碳波形。
en: Is tube confirmation done? Check the carbon dioxide waveform first.

zh: 呼气末二氧化碳骤升提示导管位置正确。
en: A sharp rise in end-tidal carbon dioxide indicates the tube is correctly placed.

zh: 呼气末二氧化碳有了，管子在气管里。
en: We have end-tidal carbon dioxide, so the tube is in the trachea.

zh: 全程二氧化碳图监测可早期发现导管移位。
en: Continuous capnography detects tube displacement early.

zh: 接上二氧化碳图，波形没了就是管子出来了。
en: Connect capnography — if the waveform disappears the tube has come out.

zh: 发生插管失败后立即改用声门上气道。
en: After a failed intubation, a supraglottic airway was used immediately.

zh: 两次都插不进去，这就是插管失败，换方案。
en: Two attempts and no tube — that is a failed intubation, change the plan.

zh: 按压环状软骨后声门暴露明显改善。
en: Glottic exposure improved markedly after cricoid pressure was applied.

zh: 声门暴露不好，帮我压一下环状软骨。
en: Glottic exposure is poor — help me press on the cricoid.

zh: 快速诱导时配合环状软骨压迫。
en: Cricoid pressure is applied during rapid sequence intubation.

zh: 环状软骨压迫轻一点，压太狠看不见声门。
en: Ease off the cricoid pressure — too much and I cannot see the glottis.

zh: 导管固定后复测深度并记录。
en: After tube securement the depth was rechecked and recorded.

zh: 导管固定牢一点，转运的时候别拽出来。
en: Make the tube securement firm so it is not pulled out during transfer.

zh: 翻身拍背后出现导管移位，立即检查并调整。
en: After turning the patient, tube displacement was found and corrected at once.

zh: 导管移位了，二氧化碳波形没了！
en: The capnography trace is gone — that means tube displacement!

zh: 未闻及双肺呼吸音时应警惕导管误入食管。
en: Absent breath sounds should raise suspicion of esophageal intubation.

zh: 没听到呼吸音，别是导管误入食管了！
en: No breath sounds — could it be esophageal intubation?

zh: 预计困难气道时首选视频喉镜。
en: A video laryngoscope is first choice in a difficult airway.

zh: 视频喉镜推过来，屏幕调亮一点。
en: Bring the video laryngoscope over and brighten the screen.

zh: 张口受限者可行纤支镜插管。
en: Fiberoptic intubation can be used when mouth opening is limited.

zh: 上纤支镜插管，这个病人脖子不能动。
en: Go for fiberoptic intubation — this patient's neck cannot be moved.

zh: 拔管前评估意识、咳嗽力量与氧合。
en: Before extubation, consciousness, cough strength and oxygenation were assessed.

zh: 准备拔管，吸痰、给氧、备好重新插管的东西。
en: Prepare for extubation — suction, oxygenate and have re-intubation equipment ready.

zh: 无法插管且无法通气时行环甲膜切开。
en: Cricothyrotomy is performed when the patient can be neither intubated nor ventilated.

zh: 不行就环甲膜切开，别犹豫！
en: If this fails, do a cricothyrotomy — do not hesitate!

zh: 外科气道是困难气道流程的最后一步。
en: A surgical airway is the final step in the difficult airway algorithm.

zh: 准备外科气道，把切开包打开。
en: Prepare for a surgical airway and open the cricothyrotomy kit.

zh: 环甲膜穿刺可临时改善氧合，为切开争取时间。
en: Needle cricothyrotomy can improve oxygenation briefly while preparing for incision.

zh: 先做环甲膜穿刺通气，撑到外科医生来。
en: Do a needle cricothyrotomy for now and hold on until the surgeon arrives.

zh: 插管次数超过三次应改用其他气道方案。
en: After three intubation attempts, another airway strategy should be used.

zh: 插管次数已经两次了，第三次让上级来。
en: That is two intubation attempts already — let the senior doctor do the third.

zh: 声门上气道可在不显露声门的情况下完成通气。
en: A supraglottic airway allows ventilation without exposing the glottis.

zh: 插不进去就先用声门上气道顶着。
en: If intubation fails, use a supraglottic airway to keep going.

zh: 置入喉罩后通气阻力明显下降。
en: After the laryngeal mask airway was inserted, ventilation resistance fell clearly.

zh: 拿个喉罩过来，要四号的。
en: Bring a laryngeal mask airway, size four.

zh: 喉罩置入后充气并确认胸廓起伏。
en: After laryngeal mask insertion, the cuff was inflated and chest movement confirmed.

zh: 喉罩置入要贴着上腭往下送，别卷边。
en: During laryngeal mask insertion keep it against the palate so the cuff does not fold.

zh: 按体重对照表选择喉罩型号。
en: Laryngeal mask size is chosen from the weight-based table.

zh: 喉罩型号选四号，他六十多公斤。
en: Take laryngeal mask size four — he is over sixty kilos.

zh: 喉罩拔除前须确认意识与吞咽反射恢复。
en: Before laryngeal mask removal, consciousness and swallowing must be confirmed.

zh: 等他能睁眼再做喉罩拔除，别太早。
en: Wait until he can open his eyes before laryngeal mask removal.

zh: 插管型喉罩用于预计插管困难的患者。
en: An intubating laryngeal mask is used when intubation is expected to be difficult.

zh: 用插管型喉罩，管子从里面穿过去。
en: Use an intubating laryngeal mask and pass the tube through it.

zh: 二代喉罩可经引流通道置入胃管。
en: A second-generation laryngeal mask allows a gastric tube through its drainage channel.

zh: 二代喉罩好，能下胃管还能测漏气压。
en: The second-generation laryngeal mask is better — it takes a gastric tube and lets us measure leak pressure.

zh: 食管气管联合导管可用于院前紧急通气。
en: The esophageal tracheal Combitube can be used for emergency prehospital ventilation.

zh: 车上只有食管气管联合导管，先插这个。
en: The ambulance only carries an esophageal tracheal Combitube, so use that first.

zh: 口咽漏气压低于二十厘米水柱提示密封不良。
en: An oropharyngeal leak pressure below twenty centimetres of water suggests a poor seal.

zh: 测一下口咽漏气压，太低就得换大一号。
en: Measure the oropharyngeal leak pressure — if it is low, go up a size.

zh: 听诊颈部有漏气声提示喉罩漏气。
en: A hissing sound over the neck suggests mask leak.

zh: 喉罩漏气，听着脖子那边嘶嘶响。
en: There is a mask leak — I can hear hissing at the neck.

zh: 盲探置入操作简便，适合院前使用。
en: Blind insertion is quick and suits prehospital use.

zh: 盲探置入就行，不用等喉镜。
en: Blind insertion is fine — no need to wait for a laryngoscope.

zh: 声门上气道失败应立即改为气管插管。
en: Supraglottic airway failure calls for immediate tracheal intubation.

zh: 这是声门上气道失败，别硬撑，改插管。
en: This is supraglottic airway failure — stop forcing it and intubate.

zh: 心肺复苏期间声门上气道指征明确。
en: During resuscitation the indication for supraglottic airway use is clear.

zh: 按声门上气道指征，这个病人可以先放喉罩。
en: On the indication for supraglottic airway, we can place a mask first in this patient.

zh: 饱胃属于声门上气道禁忌，应改为插管。
en: A full stomach is a contraindication to supraglottic airway use, so intubation is preferred.

zh: 张口只有一指，这是声门上气道禁忌。
en: He opens his mouth one finger wide — that is a contraindication to supraglottic airway use.

zh: 气道密封良好时通气压力保持稳定。
en: With a good airway seal the ventilation pressure stays stable.

zh: 气道密封不行，气都从嘴边跑了。
en: The airway seal is poor — gas is escaping around the mouth.

zh: 喉罩罩体应覆盖喉部入口。
en: The mask should sit over the laryngeal inlet.

zh: 罩体没对准喉部入口，位置偏了。
en: The mask is not over the laryngeal inlet — it is sitting off to one side.

zh: 抢救车应常备基本气道辅助装置。
en: The crash cart should stock basic airway adjuncts.

zh: 气道辅助装置带上，口咽鼻咽各两个。
en: Bring the airway adjuncts — two oral and two nasal.

zh: 喉罩通气期间监测漏气压与胸廓起伏。
en: During laryngeal mask ventilation, leak pressure and chest movement are monitored.

zh: 先喉罩通气，血氧上来再说。
en: Start laryngeal mask ventilation and wait for saturation to come up.

zh: 喉罩引导插管可作为困难气道的过渡方案。
en: Laryngeal mask guided intubation can serve as a bridge in the difficult airway.

zh: 做喉罩引导插管，导丝先放进去。
en: Do laryngeal mask guided intubation and pass the bougie first.

zh: 浅麻醉下拔管易诱发喉痉挛。
en: Extubation under light anaesthesia easily triggers laryngospasm.

zh: 喉痉挛了，正压通气，别硬拔管。
en: He has laryngospasm — give positive pressure and do not force the tube out.

zh: 多次尝试置管会加重气道损伤。
en: Repeated placement attempts worsen airway trauma.

zh: 动作轻点，别弄出气道损伤。
en: Be gentler — we do not want airway trauma.

zh: 声门上气道更换需在氧合稳定时进行。
en: Supraglottic airway exchange is done only when oxygenation is stable.

zh: 等血氧稳了再做声门上气道更换。
en: Wait until saturation is stable before supraglottic airway exchange.

zh: 漏气增加与通气阻力升高提示喉罩位置不良。
en: Rising leak and resistance suggest malposition of the laryngeal mask.

zh: 喉罩位置不良，往里再送一点。
en: That is malposition of the laryngeal mask — push it in a little further.

zh: 球囊面罩通气是建立高级气道前的标准通气手段。
en: Bag-mask ventilation is the standard method before an advanced airway is placed.

zh: 先球囊面罩通气，血氧撑住再说。
en: Start bag-mask ventilation and keep the saturation up first.

zh: 简易呼吸器应连接储氧袋使用。
en: The self-inflating bag should be used with an oxygen reservoir.

zh: 简易呼吸器拿来，接上氧气。
en: Bring the self-inflating bag and connect the oxygen.

zh: 面罩通气困难时应尽早建立高级气道。
en: When mask ventilation is difficult, an advanced airway should be placed early.

zh: 面罩通气效果不好，看看是不是漏气。
en: Mask ventilation is not working well — check whether it is leaking.

zh: 双手托颌可改善面罩密闭。
en: Two-handed jaw support improves the mask seal.

zh: 面罩密闭不好，气全从旁边漏了。
en: The mask seal is poor — all the gas is leaking out the side.

zh: 双人面罩通气可显著改善送气量。
en: Two-person mask ventilation clearly improves the delivered volume.

zh: 一个人按不住，改双人面罩通气。
en: One person cannot hold it — switch to two-person mask ventilation.

zh: 根据脸型选择合适的面罩型号。
en: Choose a face mask size that fits the shape of the face.

zh: 面罩型号不对，太大漏气，换小的。
en: The face mask size is wrong — too big and leaking, so use a smaller one.

zh: 氧气储袋充盈提示氧流量充足。
en: A filled oxygen reservoir bag indicates adequate oxygen flow.

zh: 氧气储袋瘪了，把流量开大点。
en: The oxygen reservoir bag has collapsed — turn the flow up.

zh: 单向阀粘连会导致通气阻力增大。
en: A stuck one-way valve increases ventilation resistance.

zh: 单向阀卡住了，这个球囊不能用。
en: The one-way valve is stuck, so this bag is unusable.

zh: 压力安全阀可减少气压伤风险。
en: The pressure relief valve reduces the risk of barotrauma.

zh: 压力安全阀没关，难怪气打不进去。
en: The pressure relief valve is open — no wonder the gas will not go in.

zh: 心肺复苏过程中应避免过度通气。
en: Hyperventilation should be avoided during resuscitation.

zh: 别挤那么快，过度通气会让二氧化碳掉太低。
en: Do not squeeze so fast — hyperventilation drops the carbon dioxide too low.

zh: 镇痛过深可引起通气不足。
en: Excessive analgesia can cause hypoventilation.

zh: 通气不足，二氧化碳都上来了。
en: There is hypoventilation — the carbon dioxide has climbed.

zh: 送气过快易造成胃胀气并增加反流风险。
en: Fast insufflation causes gastric insufflation and raises the risk of regurgitation.

zh: 压的时候慢一点，不然胃胀气更麻烦。
en: Squeeze more slowly, or gastric insufflation will cause trouble.

zh: 复苏时通气频率保持每分钟十次。
en: During resuscitation the ventilation rate is kept at ten per minute.

zh: 通气频率太快了，十次就够。
en: The ventilation rate is too fast — ten a minute is enough.

zh: 保留自主呼吸者可采用辅助通气。
en: Assisted ventilation can be used when spontaneous breathing is preserved.

zh: 先辅助通气看看，别急着完全控制。
en: Try assisted ventilation first — do not take over completely yet.

zh: 面罩通气困难者应及早准备插管。
en: Difficult mask ventilation should prompt early preparation for intubation.

zh: 这个人是面罩通气困难，快准备插管。
en: This is difficult mask ventilation — get ready to intubate.

zh: 转运期间保持手控通气并观察胸廓起伏。
en: Manual ventilation was maintained during transfer with chest movement observed.

zh: 先手控通气，我盯着血氧。
en: Go with manual ventilation for now and I will watch the saturation.

zh: 插管后连接呼吸机行机械通气。
en: After intubation the patient was connected for mechanical ventilation.

zh: 上机械通气，参数按公斤体重算。
en: Start mechanical ventilation and set the parameters by kilogram of body weight.

zh: 无创通气适用于清醒且能配合的患者。
en: Noninvasive ventilation suits patients who are alert and cooperative.

zh: 先试无创通气，人不清醒就不行。
en: Try noninvasive ventilation first — it will not work if he is not alert.

zh: 无创通气失败后改为有创通气。
en: After noninvasive support failed, invasive ventilation was started.

zh: 别再拖了，赶紧改有创通气吧。
en: Stop delaying and switch to invasive ventilation.

zh: 呼吸机使用前须完成自检。
en: The ventilator must pass its self-test before use.

zh: 呼吸机推到床旁，先自检。
en: Bring the ventilator to the bedside and run the self-test first.

zh: 根据病情与血气结果选择通气模式。
en: The ventilation mode is chosen according to the condition.

zh: 通气模式选哪个？先给个辅助控制。
en: Which ventilation mode? Start with assist-control.

zh: 气道压力突然升高需检查管路与气道。
en: A sudden rise in airway pressure calls for checking the circuit and the airway.

zh: 气道压力报警了，看看是不是痰堵了。
en: The airway pressure alarm is going — check whether secretions are blocking it.

zh: 人机对抗时需调整触发灵敏度或加深镇静。
en: Patient-ventilator asynchrony is managed by adjusting trigger sensitivity or deepening sedation.

zh: 他明显人机对抗，先加点镇静。
en: There is obvious patient-ventilator asynchrony — give a little more sedation.

zh: 脱机前评估自主呼吸试验结果。
en: The spontaneous breathing trial is reviewed before weaning from mechanical ventilation.

zh: 今天试着脱机，你看看他呼吸功。
en: We will try weaning from mechanical ventilation today — watch his work of breathing.

zh: 呼吸机报警须在三十秒内响应。
en: A ventilator alarm must be answered within thirty seconds.

zh: 呼吸机报警了，快去看看！
en: The ventilator alarm is sounding — go and check it now!

zh: 球囊挤压应持续一秒以上，避免气流过冲。
en: Each bag squeeze should last more than one second to avoid an abrupt surge.

zh: 球囊挤压慢一点，一秒送一口。
en: Slow the bag squeeze down — one second per breath.

zh: 低流量氧疗时首选鼻导管给氧。
en: A nasal cannula is first choice for low-flow oxygen therapy.

zh: 给他上个鼻导管，两升每分钟。
en: Put a nasal cannula on him at two litres a minute.

zh: 简易面罩给氧流量应不低于五升每分钟。
en: A simple face mask needs an oxygen flow of at least five litres per minute.

zh: 换简易面罩，流量开到八升。
en: Switch to a simple face mask and set the flow to eight litres.

zh: 危重低氧患者首选非重复呼吸面罩。
en: A non-rebreather mask is first choice for the critically hypoxaemic patient.

zh: 上非重复呼吸面罩，开十五升。
en: Put on a non-rebreather mask and run it at fifteen litres.

zh: 需控制氧浓度时选用文丘里面罩。
en: A Venturi mask is used when the oxygen concentration must be controlled precisely.

zh: 用文丘里面罩，浓度调到百分之二十八。
en: Use a Venturi mask and set the concentration to twenty-eight per cent.

zh: 高流量鼻导管可减少呼吸功。
en: A high-flow nasal cannula reduces the work of breathing.

zh: 上高流量鼻导管，流量四十升。
en: Start a high-flow nasal cannula at forty litres.

zh: 氧气瓶须固定放置并标注余量。
en: Oxygen cylinders must be secured and their remaining volume labelled.

zh: 氧气瓶还剩多少？够不够转运用。
en: How much is left in the oxygen cylinder? Is it enough for the transfer?

zh: 中心供氧故障时立即启用备用氧气瓶。
en: When the central oxygen supply fails, the backup cylinder is used at once.

zh: 中心供氧接口松了，插紧一点。
en: The central oxygen supply connector is loose — push it in firmly.

zh: 长期吸氧应接湿化瓶以减轻黏膜干燥。
en: For prolonged oxygen therapy a humidifier bottle is used to reduce mucosal dryness.

zh: 湿化瓶没水了，加一点蒸馏水。
en: The humidifier bottle is empty — top it up with distilled water.

zh: 氧气管路打折会导致实际氧流量下降。
en: A kinked oxygen tubing reduces the actual flow delivered.

zh: 氧气管路缠住了，理顺一点。
en: The oxygen tubing is tangled — straighten it out.

zh: 高流量给氧时氧气湿化不可省略。
en: Oxygen humidification cannot be omitted during high-flow oxygen delivery.

zh: 氧气湿化做了没有？他说嗓子干。
en: Have you set up oxygen humidification? He says his throat is dry.

zh: 氧疗医嘱须写明装置类型与流量。
en: The oxygen therapy order must state the device type and the flow.

zh: 氧疗医嘱开了吗？没开没法调流量。
en: Is the oxygen therapy order written? Without it we cannot change the flow.

zh: 出院前为患者安排家庭氧疗并培训家属。
en: Home oxygen therapy was arranged before discharge and the family was trained.

zh: 他出院后要做家庭氧疗，家里得备制氧机。
en: He needs home oxygen therapy after discharge, so the family must get a concentrator.

zh: 氧气压力表读数低于警戒值须立即更换气瓶。
en: If the oxygen pressure gauge reads below the warning level, change the cylinder at once.

zh: 看一眼氧气压力表，别半路没气了。
en: Check the oxygen pressure gauge — we do not want it running out midway.

zh: 随访记录患者家庭氧疗依从性。
en: Follow-up recorded the patient's home oxygen therapy compliance.

zh: 老人氧疗依从性差，一天只吸两个小时。
en: His oxygen therapy compliance is poor — only two hours a day.

zh: 根据所需氧浓度选择吸氧装置。
en: The oxygen delivery device is chosen according to the concentration needed.

zh: 吸氧装置选哪个？先给个储氧面罩。
en: Which oxygen delivery device? Start with a reservoir mask.

zh: 氧流量调节后三十分钟复查血氧。
en: Saturation is rechecked thirty minutes after oxygen flow adjustment.

zh: 氧流量调节别太频繁，稳定了再看。
en: Do not keep changing the oxygen flow adjustment — wait until it settles.

zh: 氧气瓶更换时先关阀再卸表。
en: During oxygen cylinder exchange, close the valve before removing the regulator.

zh: 氧气瓶更换我来，你扶着面罩。
en: I will do the oxygen cylinder exchange — you hold the mask.

zh: 供氧中断时应立即改用备用氧气瓶。
en: When oxygen supply interruption occurs, the backup cylinder is used immediately.

zh: 供氧中断了，快接备用瓶！
en: The oxygen supply interruption is here — connect the backup cylinder now!

zh: 氧气流量表浮标读数应看中间位置。
en: Read the oxygen flowmeter at the middle of the floating ball.

zh: 氧气流量表读数不对，可能漏气了。
en: The oxygen flowmeter reading is wrong — there may be a leak.

zh: 制氧机须定期更换过滤网。
en: The filters of an oxygen concentrator must be replaced regularly.

zh: 制氧机的滤网该换了，出氧不浓。
en: The oxygen concentrator needs a new filter — the output is weak.

zh: 抢救开始后五分钟内建立静脉通路。
en: Venous access was established within five minutes of starting resuscitation.

zh: 静脉通路建好了吗？药要赶紧推。
en: Is venous access ready? The drug needs to go in now.

zh: 首选外周静脉通路用于急救给药。
en: Peripheral venous access is the first choice for emergency drugs.

zh: 外周静脉通路先打上，中心静脉慢慢来。
en: Get peripheral venous access first and take your time with the central line.

zh: 静脉留置针置入后记录置管日期与部位。
en: After peripheral intravenous catheter insertion, record the date and site.

zh: 静脉留置针打手背，粗一点的。
en: Put the peripheral intravenous catheter in the back of the hand, a large one.

zh: 需要泵入血管活性药时建立中心静脉通路。
en: Central venous access is obtained when vasoactive drugs must be infused.

zh: 中心静脉通路赶紧建，去甲肾上腺素走外周容易坏死。
en: Get central venous access now — norepinephrine through a peripheral line can cause necrosis.

zh: 中心静脉导管尖端应位于上腔静脉下段。
en: The tip of the central venous catheter should sit in the lower superior vena cava.

zh: 中心静脉导管缝好了吗？别让它滑出来。
en: Is the central venous catheter sutured? Do not let it slip out.

zh: 静脉穿刺一次成功可减少患者痛苦。
en: A successful venipuncture at the first attempt reduces patient discomfort.

zh: 静脉穿刺没中，换只手再来。
en: The venipuncture missed — try the other hand.

zh: 心肺复苏期间可选股静脉穿刺置管。
en: Femoral vein puncture may be used for access during cardiopulmonary resuscitation.

zh: 股静脉穿刺快，按压的时候也能做。
en: Femoral vein puncture is quick and can be done while compressions continue.

zh: 颈内静脉穿刺在超声引导下完成。
en: Internal jugular vein puncture was performed under ultrasound guidance.

zh: 颈内静脉穿刺你来做，我负责超声。
en: You do the internal jugular vein puncture and I will run the ultrasound.

zh: 锁骨下静脉穿刺气胸风险相对较高。
en: Subclavian vein puncture carries a relatively higher risk of pneumothorax.

zh: 锁骨下静脉穿刺出血不好压，要小心。
en: Bleeding after subclavian vein puncture is hard to compress, so be careful.

zh: 超声引导穿刺显著提高了首次成功率。
en: Ultrasound-guided cannulation clearly improved first-attempt success.

zh: 用超声引导穿刺，别盲打。
en: Use ultrasound-guided cannulation — do not poke blindly.

zh: 评估为静脉穿刺困难者应尽早改用其他通路。
en: When difficult intravenous access is predicted, another route should be used early.

zh: 这人是静脉穿刺困难，直接叫超声来。
en: This is difficult intravenous access — call for the ultrasound straight away.

zh: 穿刺点消毒后覆盖无菌敷料。
en: The puncture site was disinfected and covered with a sterile dressing.

zh: 穿刺点有点渗血，再压一会儿。
en: The puncture site is oozing a little — press a bit longer.

zh: 输液管应每日更换并标注时间。
en: Infusion tubing should be changed daily and labelled with the time.

zh: 输液管里有空气，快排一下。
en: There is air in the infusion tubing — prime it quickly.

zh: 血管活性药物须经输液泵恒速输入。
en: Vasoactive drugs must be given at a constant rate through an infusion pump.

zh: 用输液泵，手调太不准了。
en: Use an infusion pump — hand control is far too imprecise.

zh: 发现液体外渗应立即停止输注并处理。
en: When extravasation is found, the infusion is stopped at once and managed.

zh: 手背肿了，是液体外渗，快停！
en: The back of the hand is swollen — that is extravasation, stop the drip!

zh: 置管部位出现红肿提示静脉炎。
en: Redness and swelling at the cannula site suggest phlebitis.

zh: 这条血管红了，可能是静脉炎。
en: That vein is red — it could be phlebitis.

zh: 每次给药前后均须行导管冲洗。
en: Catheter flushing is performed before and after every drug dose.

zh: 导管冲洗一下，接口别堵了。
en: Flush the line — catheter flushing keeps the hub from blocking.

zh: 导管封管采用正压手法以减少回血。
en: Catheter locking uses positive pressure to reduce blood reflux.

zh: 导管封管做了再走，别留回血。
en: Do the catheter locking before you leave and do not leave blood in the line.

zh: 静脉采血与置管可一次完成。
en: Venous blood sampling and cannulation can be done in one attempt.

zh: 静脉采血顺便把血气也抽了。
en: While you do the venous blood sampling, take the blood gas too.

zh: 快速静脉输液用于纠正低血容量。
en: Rapid intravenous infusion is used to correct hypovolaemia.

zh: 先静脉输液五百，看看血压反应。
en: Give five hundred by intravenous infusion first and watch the blood pressure.

zh: 肾上腺素采用静脉注射给药。
en: Epinephrine was given by intravenous injection.

zh: 静脉注射慢慢推，别一下打太快。
en: Give the intravenous injection slowly — do not push it all at once.

zh: 三通阀连接输液管与压力监测。
en: A three-way stopcock connects the infusion tubing to the pressure line.

zh: 接个三通阀，方便同时推药。
en: Add a three-way stopcock so we can push drugs at the same time.

zh: 留置针固定应使用透明敷料便于观察。
en: Cannula securement uses a transparent dressing so the site can be seen.

zh: 留置针固定好，病人一动就掉了。
en: Check the cannula securement — it falls out as soon as the patient moves.

zh: 见到静脉回血即可确认针尖在血管内。
en: Flashback of blood confirms the needle tip is inside the vessel.

zh: 有静脉回血了，可以送管。
en: There is flashback — you can advance the cannula now.

zh: 出现输液反应应立即停止输液并报告。
en: When an infusion reaction occurs, stop the infusion at once and report it.

zh: 他输液反应了，先停下来。
en: He is having an infusion reaction — stop the drip first.

zh: 留置针拔除后按压穿刺点三分钟。
en: After peripheral catheter removal, press the puncture site for three minutes.

zh: 留置针拔除我来，你按着点。
en: I will do the peripheral catheter removal — you hold pressure.

zh: 外周静脉两次失败后立即建立骨内通路。
en: Intraosseous access was established at once after two failed peripheral attempts.

zh: 打不上静脉就上骨内通路，别耽误。
en: If the vein will not come, go for intraosseous access and do not waste time.

zh: 骨内输液在加压后速度可接近静脉输液。
en: Pressurised intraosseous infusion approaches the speed of intravenous infusion.

zh: 骨内输液加压，速度才上得来。
en: Pressurise the intraosseous infusion, otherwise the rate will not come up.

zh: 骨内穿刺部位首选胫骨近端。
en: The preferred site for intraosseous needle placement is the proximal tibia.

zh: 骨内穿刺我来，你准备冲洗。
en: I will do the intraosseous needle placement — you get the flush ready.

zh: 骨内针置入后须妥善固定。
en: Once the intraosseous needle is in place it must be secured properly.

zh: 骨内针固定好，别一碰就歪。
en: Fix the intraosseous needle well so it does not tilt at a touch.

zh: 胫骨近端穿刺是成人最常用的骨内通路部位。
en: Proximal tibia insertion is the most common site for adult intraosseous access.

zh: 做胫骨近端穿刺，位置在膝盖下面一点。
en: Do a proximal tibia insertion — the spot just below the knee.

zh: 静脉通路失败时可选肱骨头穿刺。
en: Proximal humerus insertion is an option when venous access fails.

zh: 肱骨头穿刺不好进，还是先试胫骨。
en: Proximal humerus insertion is awkward — try the tibia first.

zh: 药物注入骨髓腔后可迅速进入中心循环。
en: Drugs given into the marrow cavity reach the central circulation quickly.

zh: 骨髓腔就是骨内通路的落点，回抽有骨髓。
en: The marrow cavity is where the intraosseous route ends up — aspiration gives marrow.

zh: 出现落空感提示针尖已进入骨髓腔。
en: A loss of resistance indicates the needle tip has entered the marrow cavity.

zh: 有落空感了，针尖已经到位了。
en: There is a loss of resistance — the needle is in.

zh: 骨内针固定不牢易导致液体外渗。
en: Poor needle stabilization easily leads to fluid extravasation.

zh: 骨内针固定好，转运途中容易松。
en: Make the needle stabilization firm — it loosens easily in transit.

zh: 心搏骤停且静脉穿刺失败是骨内通路指征。
en: Cardiac arrest with failed venous access is an indication for intraosseous access.

zh: 这属于骨内通路指征了，两次静脉都没中。
en: This now meets an indication for intraosseous access — two venous attempts failed.

zh: 穿刺部位骨折属于骨内通路禁忌。
en: A fracture at the puncture site is a contraindication to intraosseous access.

zh: 同侧骨折，这是骨内通路禁忌，换另一边。
en: There is a fracture on that side — a contraindication to intraosseous access, so use the other limb.

zh: 骨内通路并发症包括渗漏、骨折与感染。
en: Extravasation and fracture are a known complication of intraosseous access.

zh: 骨内通路并发症要盯着，尤其是渗漏。
en: Watch for a complication of intraosseous access, especially extravasation.

zh: 骨内针拔除须在静脉通路建立之后。
en: Intraosseous needle removal waits until venous access is secured.

zh: 静脉通了就骨内针拔除，别留太久。
en: Once the vein is in, do the intraosseous needle removal — do not leave it long.

zh: 骨内通路冲洗时患者可能感到疼痛。
en: The patient may feel pain during intraosseous flushing.

zh: 先骨内通路冲洗，通了再推药。
en: Do intraosseous flushing first, then push the drug once it runs freely.

zh: 骨内电钻可显著缩短置针时间。
en: An intraosseous drill shortens needle placement time markedly.

zh: 骨内电钻的电池装上了吗？
en: Is the battery in the intraosseous drill?

zh: 无电钻时可使用手动骨内针。
en: A manual intraosseous needle is used when no drill is available.

zh: 没电了，用手动骨内针压进去。
en: The battery is dead — use a manual intraosseous needle and press it in.

zh: 骨内给药与静脉给药的起效时间相近。
en: Intraosseous drug delivery works about as fast as the intravenous route.

zh: 骨内给药也行，肾上腺素直接推。
en: Intraosseous drug delivery is fine — push the epinephrine straight in.

zh: 穿刺部位红肿热痛应警惕骨髓炎。
en: Redness, swelling, heat and pain at the puncture site raise concern for osteomyelitis.

zh: 骨内针留太久，小心骨髓炎。
en: Leaving the intraosseous needle too long risks osteomyelitis.

zh: 骨内通路定位以胫骨粗隆为参考。
en: Intraosseous landmark identification uses the tibial tuberosity as the reference.

zh: 骨内通路定位先摸胫骨粗隆。
en: For intraosseous landmark identification, feel the tibial tuberosity first.

zh: 首次骨内通路成功率在九成以上。
en: The first-attempt intraosseous access success rate is above ninety per cent.

zh: 骨内通路成功率比静脉高，别怕做。
en: The intraosseous access success rate beats venous access, so do not hesitate.

zh: 可除颤心律每三到五分钟给予肾上腺素。
en: Epinephrine is given every three to five minutes in a shockable rhythm.

zh: 肾上腺素一毫克，静推，快！
en: Epinephrine one milligram, push it, quickly!

zh: 第三次电击后仍为室颤时给予胺碘酮。
en: Amiodarone is given when ventricular fibrillation persists after the third shock.

zh: 胺碘酮三百毫克，推完接着按压。
en: Amiodarone three hundred milligrams, then straight back on the chest.

zh: 无胺碘酮时可用利多卡因替代。
en: Lidocaine can replace amiodarone when it is unavailable.

zh: 利多卡因一百毫克，静脉推注。
en: Lidocaine one hundred milligrams, intravenous push.

zh: 心动过缓伴低血压时给予阿托品。
en: Atropine is given for bradycardia with hypotension.

zh: 阿托品零点五毫克，静推！
en: Atropine zero point five milligrams, push it!

zh: 多巴胺经微量泵持续输入。
en: Dopamine is given continuously through a syringe pump.

zh: 多巴胺走泵，别用手去调。
en: Run the dopamine on a pump — do not adjust it by hand.

zh: 去甲肾上腺素经中心静脉泵入维持血压。
en: Norepinephrine is infused through a central line to maintain the blood pressure.

zh: 去甲肾上腺素上调一点，血压还是低。
en: Turn the norepinephrine up a little — the pressure is still low.

zh: 可考虑以血管加压素替代首剂肾上腺素。
en: Vasopressin may be considered in place of the first epinephrine dose.

zh: 血管加压素四十单位，替代肾上腺素。
en: Vasopressin forty units, replacing epinephrine.

zh: 仅在明确严重酸中毒时使用碳酸氢钠。
en: Sodium bicarbonate is used only when severe acidosis is confirmed.

zh: 碳酸氢钠先别急着给，看看血气。
en: Hold the sodium bicarbonate until we see the blood gas.

zh: 尖端扭转型室速首选硫酸镁。
en: Magnesium sulfate is first choice for torsades de pointes.

zh: 硫酸镁两克，稀释后慢推。
en: Magnesium sulfate two grams, dilute it and push slowly.

zh: 高钾血症伴心电图改变时给予氯化钙。
en: Calcium chloride is given for hyperkalaemia with electrocardiographic changes.

zh: 氯化钙十毫升，慢一点推。
en: Calcium chloride ten millilitres, push it slowly.

zh: 阿片类过量呼吸抑制时给予纳洛酮。
en: Naloxone is given for respiratory depression after opioid overdose.

zh: 纳洛酮零点四毫克，看他能不能醒。
en: Naloxone zero point four milligrams — let us see whether he wakes up.

zh: 低血糖昏迷时静脉给予葡萄糖。
en: Dextrose is given intravenously for hypoglycaemic coma.

zh: 血糖两点多，赶紧给葡萄糖！
en: The glucose is two point something — give dextrose now!

zh: 严重过敏反应予地塞米松辅助治疗。
en: Dexamethasone is given as adjunct treatment in severe anaphylaxis.

zh: 地塞米松十毫克，静脉推注。
en: Dexamethasone ten milligrams, intravenous push.

zh: 颅内压升高时可谨慎使用高渗盐水。
en: Hypertonic saline may be used cautiously when intracranial pressure is raised.

zh: 高渗盐水慢点推，会有点烧灼感。
en: Push the hypertonic saline slowly — it stings a little.

zh: 操作前给予咪达唑仑镇静。
en: Midazolam was given for sedation before the procedure.

zh: 咪达唑仑两毫克，慢慢给。
en: Midazolam two milligrams, give it slowly.

zh: 血流动力学不稳定者可选用氯胺酮诱导。
en: Ketamine may be chosen for induction when haemodynamics are unstable.

zh: 氯胺酮一百毫克，他血压低。
en: Ketamine one hundred milligrams — his blood pressure is low.

zh: 依托咪酯适用于血流动力学不稳定的诱导。
en: Etomidate suits induction in haemodynamically unstable patients.

zh: 依托咪酯推完就插，动作快。
en: Push the etomidate and intubate at once — move fast.

zh: 琥珀胆碱禁用于高钾血症患者。
en: Succinylcholine is contraindicated in patients with hyperkalaemia.

zh: 琥珀胆碱一百毫克，起效了就插。
en: Succinylcholine one hundred milligrams — intubate as soon as it takes effect.

zh: 罗库溴铵起效稍慢但禁忌证较少。
en: Rocuronium acts a little more slowly but has fewer contraindications.

zh: 用罗库溴铵，高钾病人不能用琥珀胆碱。
en: Use rocuronium — a hyperkalaemic patient cannot have succinylcholine.

zh: 疼痛剧烈时给予芬太尼镇痛。
en: Fentanyl was given for severe pain.

zh: 芬太尼五十微克，慢慢推。
en: Fentanyl fifty micrograms, push it slowly.

zh: 丙泊酚可引起血压下降，须缓慢推注。
en: Propofol can lower the blood pressure and must be injected slowly.

zh: 丙泊酚少给点，他血压不高。
en: Give less propofol — his blood pressure is not high.

zh: 血管活性药物须经中心静脉或大静脉输注。
en: Vasoactive agents should be infused through a central or large vein.

zh: 血管活性药物上泵，随时调。
en: Put the vasoactive agent on a pump so we can titrate it.

zh: 复苏中可选用的抗心律失常药有限。
en: Only a few antiarrhythmic agents are used during resuscitation.

zh: 抗心律失常药先给胺碘酮，别乱加。
en: Give amiodarone as the antiarrhythmic agent and do not add others at random.

zh: 液体复苏无效时加用血管加压药。
en: A vasopressor is added when fluid resuscitation fails.

zh: 血管加压药再加一个，血压还不行。
en: Add another vasopressor — the pressure is still not there.

zh: 心功能不全时加用正性肌力药。
en: An inotropic agent is added when cardiac function is poor.

zh: 正性肌力药上不来，心排量太低。
en: The inotropic agent is not lifting the output enough — cardiac output is too low.

zh: 复苏药物按流程时间点逐项记录。
en: Resuscitation medications are recorded item by item with their timing.

zh: 复苏药物就那几种，别一次全给。
en: There are only a few resuscitation medications — do not give them all at once.

zh: 抢救时优先选择静脉给药途径。
en: The intravenous route of administration is preferred in resuscitation.

zh: 给药途径改成静脉，口服太慢。
en: Change the route of administration to intravenous — oral is too slow.

zh: 静脉给药起效最快，适用于急救。
en: Intravenous administration works fastest and suits emergency care.

zh: 静脉给药，直接推，别耽误。
en: Intravenous administration — push it straight in and do not delay.

zh: 无静脉通路时肾上腺素可肌内注射。
en: Epinephrine can be given by intramuscular injection when there is no venous access.

zh: 肌内注射打大腿外侧，快。
en: Intramuscular injection goes into the outer thigh — quickly.

zh: 低分子肝素采用皮下注射。
en: Low molecular weight heparin is given by subcutaneous injection.

zh: 皮下注射打在肚子上，好吸收。
en: Subcutaneous injection in the abdomen absorbs well.

zh: 清醒且能吞咽者可考虑口服给药。
en: Oral administration may be considered in patients who are alert and can swallow.

zh: 口服给药先别，他可能马上要插管。
en: Hold the oral administration — he may need intubation soon.

zh: 舌下含服药物吸收快，适合急救。
en: Sublingual administration absorbs quickly and suits emergency use.

zh: 舌下含服，别咽下去，让它自己化。
en: Sublingual administration — do not swallow it.

zh: 吸入给药起效快，适用于气道痉挛。
en: Inhaled administration works quickly in airway spasm.

zh: 用吸入给药，就那个雾化装置。
en: Use inhaled administration with that nebuliser device.

zh: 滴鼻给药可使部分急救药物快速起效。
en: Intranasal administration lets some emergency drugs act quickly.

zh: 滴鼻给药简单，不用打针。
en: Intranasal administration is simple and needs no needle.

zh: 抽搐发作而静脉不通时可采用直肠给药。
en: Rectal administration can be used during a seizure when venous access fails.

zh: 小孩抽起来了，先直肠给药。
en: The child is seizing — start rectal administration.

zh: 无静脉通路时部分急救药可气管内给药。
en: Some emergency drugs can be given by endotracheal drug administration without venous access.

zh: 静脉进不去，改气管内给药。
en: The vein will not come — switch to endotracheal drug administration.

zh: 雾化吸入可缓解气道痉挛与呼吸困难。
en: Nebulized inhalation relieves airway spasm and breathlessness.

zh: 做个雾化吸入，把药加进去。
en: Set up nebulized inhalation and add the drug.

zh: 升压药经微量注射泵恒速输入。
en: Vasopressors are infused at a constant rate by syringe pump.

zh: 微量注射泵设好流速，别用手推。
en: Set the rate on the syringe pump — do not push by hand.

zh: 抗生素采用静脉滴注给药。
en: The antibiotic was given by intravenous drip.

zh: 静脉滴注慢慢来，别开太快。
en: Keep the intravenous drip slow — do not run it fast.

zh: 肾上腺素予静脉推注，随后冲管。
en: Epinephrine was given as an intravenous bolus and the line was flushed.

zh: 静脉推注，推完冲一下管。
en: Give it as an intravenous bolus and flush afterwards.

zh: 抗心律失常药先给负荷剂量。
en: The antiarrhythmic was started with a loading dose.

zh: 先给负荷剂量，再上维持。
en: Give the loading dose first, then start maintenance.

zh: 负荷剂量之后改为维持剂量持续给药。
en: After the loading dose, a maintenance dose was given continuously.

zh: 维持剂量按体重算，别照抄。
en: Work out the maintenance dose by weight — do not just copy it.

zh: 记录每次单次剂量与给药时间。
en: The single dose and the time given were recorded each time.

zh: 单次剂量别超过说明书上的上限。
en: Do not exceed the upper limit for a single dose.

zh: 给药前核对最大剂量与累积用量。
en: Check the maximum dose against the cumulative amount before giving more.

zh: 最大剂量到了，不能再加。
en: We have reached the maximum dose — nothing more can be added.

zh: 肾功能不全者需行剂量调整。
en: Patients with renal impairment need dose adjustment.

zh: 剂量调整一下，他体重太轻。
en: Make a dose adjustment — he weighs very little.

zh: 配制后标注药物浓度与配制时间。
en: The drug concentration and preparation time are labelled after mixing.

zh: 药物浓度太高，得再稀释。
en: The drug concentration is too high — it needs further dilution.

zh: 药物稀释后缓慢静脉推注。
en: After drug dilution the solution was injected slowly into the vein.

zh: 药物稀释一下再推，刺激性太强。
en: Dilute the drug first — drug dilution reduces the irritation.

zh: 给药前须先查配伍禁忌表。
en: The drug incompatibility table is checked before drugs are given.

zh: 这两个药有配伍禁忌，别走同一路。
en: These two have a drug incompatibility — do not run them through the same line.

zh: 按给药间隔记录下次用药时间。
en: The next dose time was recorded according to the dosing interval.

zh: 给药间隔还没到，再等十分钟。
en: The dosing interval is not up yet — wait ten more minutes.

zh: 儿童用药须重新做剂量计算。
en: Dose calculation must be redone for paediatric patients.

zh: 剂量计算你再核一遍，别算错。
en: Redo the dose calculation — we cannot afford an error.

zh: 疑为药物不良反应须上报并记录。
en: A suspected adverse drug reaction must be reported and documented.

zh: 这是药物不良反应，先停药观察。
en: This is an adverse drug reaction — stop the drug and observe.

zh: 复苏团队在三分钟内到位。
en: The resuscitation team arrived within three minutes.

zh: 复苏团队到齐没有？人还不够。
en: Is the resuscitation team all here? We are still short of people.

zh: 抢救组长负责决策与任务分配。
en: The team leader is responsible for decisions and task allocation.

zh: 抢救组长说了算，别各自下命令。
en: The team leader decides — stop giving separate orders.

zh: 按压者每两分钟更换一次。
en: The compressor is changed every two minutes.

zh: 按压者准备好，我说开始就压。
en: Compressor ready — start pushing when I say.

zh: 球囊操作者与按压者保持三十比二的节律。
en: The bag-mask operator keeps to a thirty-to-two rhythm with the compressor.

zh: 球囊操作者就位，听按压的节拍给气。
en: Bag-mask operator in place — give a breath on the compression beat.

zh: 气道管理者由经验丰富的医师担任。
en: The airway manager is an experienced physician.

zh: 气道管理者来了，插管交给他。
en: The airway manager is here — hand over the intubation.

zh: 给药护士复述医嘱后方可推药。
en: The medication nurse repeats the order before giving the drug.

zh: 给药护士，肾上腺素一毫克准备。
en: Medication nurse, prepare epinephrine one milligram.

zh: 记录者须实时记录每次给药时间。
en: The recorder must log the time of every drug dose in real time.

zh: 记录者记一下，现在是十点零五分。
en: Recorder, note the time — it is ten oh five now.

zh: 计时员每两分钟提示按压轮换。
en: The timekeeper calls the compressor change every two minutes.

zh: 计时员报时，两分钟到了。
en: Timekeeper, call it — two minutes are up.

zh: 除颤操作者确认清场后放电。
en: The defibrillator operator confirms the team is clear before shocking.

zh: 除颤操作者准备，我说电就电。
en: Defibrillator operator standby — shock when I say.

zh: 抢救开始前完成角色分工并点名确认。
en: Role assignment was completed and confirmed by name before resuscitation started.

zh: 先做角色分工，谁按压谁给药说清楚。
en: Do the role assignment first — say who compresses and who gives drugs.

zh: 闭环沟通可减少抢救中的遗漏与重复。
en: Closed-loop communication reduces omissions and duplication during resuscitation.

zh: 用闭环沟通，我下指令你要重复一遍。
en: Use closed-loop communication — repeat every order I give.

zh: 复苏复盘在抢救结束后二十四小时内完成。
en: Resuscitation debriefing is completed within twenty-four hours of the event.

zh: 一会儿做个复苏复盘，把问题说清楚。
en: We will do a resuscitation debriefing shortly and go through the problems.

zh: 团队站位应保证按压与给药互不干扰。
en: Team positioning should let compressions and drug preparation proceed without interference.

zh: 团队站位挪一下，你挡着静脉通路了。
en: Adjust the team positioning — you are blocking the IV line.

zh: 发现骤停后立即呼叫支援。
en: A call for help is made as soon as the arrest is recognised.

zh: 快呼叫支援，两个人不够！
en: Make the call for help — two people are not enough!

zh: 给药前由两人交叉核对药名与剂量。
en: Two staff cross-check the drug name and dose before administration.

zh: 交叉核对一下，别拿错药。
en: Do a cross-check — we must not take the wrong drug.

zh: 高质量团队协作与复苏成功率正相关。
en: Good teamwork correlates with a higher resuscitation success rate.

zh: 团队协作要跟上，别各干各的。
en: Teamwork has to improve — stop working in your own corners.

zh: 院内急救小组接到呼叫后五分钟内到达。
en: The rapid response team arrived within five minutes of the call.

zh: 院内急救小组已经在路上了。
en: The rapid response team is already on its way.

zh: 口头医嘱须在抢救结束后补记。
en: Verbal orders must be written up after resuscitation ends.

zh: 口头医嘱我复述一遍，你确认。
en: I will repeat the verbal order back — confirm it.

zh: 高危药物给药前必须复述确认。
en: Read-back is mandatory before a high-alert drug is given.

zh: 复述确认一下药名和剂量。
en: Do a read-back of the drug name and dose.

zh: 科室开展团队资源管理培训。
en: The department runs team resource management training.

zh: 团队资源管理这块还得练，沟通太乱。
en: Team resource management needs work — communication is chaotic.

zh: 复苏团队启动后记录响应时间。
en: The response time is recorded after team activation.

zh: 复苏团队启动了吗？怎么还没人来。
en: Has team activation happened? Why is nobody here yet?

zh: 重症患者抢救常需多学科协作。
en: Resuscitation of critically ill patients often needs a multidisciplinary team.

zh: 多学科协作叫上心内科，一起定方案。
en: Call cardiology for the multidisciplinary team and set the plan together.

zh: 每季度组织一次复苏演练。
en: A resuscitation drill is held every quarter.

zh: 明天下午复苏演练，全员参加。
en: There is a resuscitation drill tomorrow afternoon — everyone attends.

zh: 上级医师到场后重新评估复苏方案。
en: After senior physician arrival the resuscitation plan was reassessed.

zh: 上级医师到场了，方案听他的。
en: Senior physician arrival confirmed — follow their plan now.

zh: 复苏后处理直接影响神经功能结局。
en: Post-resuscitation care directly affects the neurological outcome.

zh: 人救回来了，复苏后处理才刚开始。
en: We got him back, but post-resuscitation care has only just begun.

zh: 复苏后监护至少持续二十四小时。
en: Post-resuscitation monitoring continues for at least twenty-four hours.

zh: 复苏后监护别松，随时可能再停。
en: Do not relax post-resuscitation monitoring — the heart could stop again.

zh: 昏迷患者复苏后启动目标温度管理。
en: Targeted temperature management was started after resuscitation in the comatose patient.

zh: 目标温度管理上起来，体温别超三十六。
en: Start targeted temperature management and keep the temperature under thirty-six.

zh: 治疗性低温需连续监测核心体温。
en: Therapeutic hypothermia requires continuous core temperature monitoring.

zh: 治疗性低温要用冰毯，先铺上。
en: Therapeutic hypothermia needs the cooling blanket — put it on first.

zh: 复温速度控制在每小时零点二五度。
en: The rewarming rate was kept at zero point two five degrees per hour.

zh: 复温别太快，慢慢来就行。
en: Rewarming should not be too fast — take it slowly.

zh: 出现寒战需加深镇静或加用肌松药。
en: Shivering is managed by deepening sedation or adding a muscle relaxant.

zh: 他在寒战，体温压不下来。
en: He is shivering, so the temperature will not come down.

zh: 神经预后评估应在降温结束后至少七十二小时进行。
en: Neurological prognostication should wait at least seventy-two hours after cooling ends.

zh: 神经预后评估别太早做，容易误判。
en: Do not do neurological prognostication too early — it is easy to misjudge.

zh: 复苏后低血压首选液体与升压药处理。
en: Post-arrest hypotension is treated first with fluids and vasopressors.

zh: 复苏后低血压，先把血压撑到六十五以上。
en: Post-arrest hypotension — push the pressure above sixty-five first.

zh: 复苏后心电图提示急性心肌缺血。
en: The post-resuscitation electrocardiogram suggested acute myocardial ischaemia.

zh: 复苏后心电图做了吗？看看有没有缺血。
en: Has the post-resuscitation electrocardiogram been done? Check for ischaemia.

zh: 复苏后血糖控制目标为七点八至十毫摩尔。
en: The target for glucose control after resuscitation is seven point eight to ten millimoles.

zh: 复苏后血糖控制要盯，别让它飙。
en: Watch the glucose control after resuscitation — do not let it spike.

zh: 出现复苏后癫痫发作须立即止惊并监测脑电。
en: A post-arrest seizure requires immediate treatment and EEG monitoring.

zh: 他刚才抽了，是复苏后癫痫发作。
en: He seized a moment ago — that is a post-arrest seizure.

zh: 反复肌阵挛与不良神经结局相关。
en: Repeated myoclonus is associated with a poor neurological outcome.

zh: 他手脚老在跳，那是肌阵挛。
en: His limbs keep jerking — that is myoclonus.

zh: 脑电图可发现非惊厥性癫痫发作。
en: An electroencephalogram can reveal non-convulsive seizures.

zh: 脑电图约上了吗？要排除隐匿抽搐。
en: Is the electroencephalogram booked? We need to rule out hidden seizures.

zh: 双侧体感诱发电位消失提示预后极差。
en: Absent bilateral somatosensory evoked potentials suggest a very poor prognosis.

zh: 体感诱发电位做了再说，别急着下结论。
en: Wait for the somatosensory evoked potential results before drawing conclusions.

zh: 出院时评估神经功能结局并记录。
en: The neurological outcome was assessed and recorded at discharge.

zh: 神经功能结局好不好，一个月后才看得出来。
en: A good neurological outcome only becomes clear after about a month.

zh: 复苏后采用肺保护性通气策略。
en: Lung-protective ventilation was used after resuscitation.

zh: 肺保护性通气，潮气量按六毫升每公斤算。
en: Use lung-protective ventilation — six millilitres per kilogram.

zh: 复苏后镇静以能耐受治疗为度。
en: Post-arrest sedation is titrated to the level needed to tolerate treatment.

zh: 复苏后镇静浅一点，好评估意识。
en: Keep post-arrest sedation light so we can assess consciousness.

zh: 复苏后发热应积极降温并查找感染灶。
en: Post-arrest fever calls for active cooling and a search for infection.

zh: 复苏后发热到三十八度五了，赶紧处理。
en: Post-arrest fever has reached thirty-eight point five — treat it now.

zh: 复苏后护理记录须逐项落实。
en: Post-resuscitation nursing must be documented item by item.

zh: 复苏后护理交接清楚，别漏管路。
en: Hand over the post-resuscitation nursing clearly — do not miss any line.

zh: 复苏后随访在出院后一个月开始。
en: Post-arrest follow-up begins one month after discharge.

zh: 复苏后随访记得约，家属要带他来复查。
en: Book the post-arrest follow-up — the family must bring him back.

zh: 复苏后康复应在病情稳定后尽早介入。
en: Post-arrest rehabilitation should start as early as possible.

zh: 复苏后康复早点做，效果更好。
en: Start post-arrest rehabilitation early — the results are better.

zh: 复苏后生活质量采用量表评估。
en: Quality of life after cardiac arrest was assessed with a standard scale.

zh: 复苏后生活质量是他最关心的事。
en: Quality of life after cardiac arrest is what worries him most.

zh: 复苏后营养支持优先选择肠内途径。
en: Post-arrest nutrition support uses the enteral route first.

zh: 复苏后营养支持先上肠内，别急着静脉。
en: Start post-arrest nutrition support enterally — no rush for the intravenous route.

zh: 复苏后呼吸支持根据血气调整参数。
en: Post-arrest respiratory support parameters are adjusted by blood gas results.

zh: 复苏后呼吸支持参数调一下，二氧化碳偏高。
en: Adjust the post-arrest respiratory support — the carbon dioxide is high.

zh: 院前急救质量影响后续院内救治。
en: The quality of prehospital emergency care affects later in-hospital treatment.

zh: 院前急救做得好，到院就好办。
en: Good prehospital emergency care makes things much easier on arrival.

zh: 院前转运途中持续监测生命体征。
en: Vital signs are monitored continuously during prehospital transport.

zh: 院前转运半小时，路上一直盯着。
en: Prehospital transport took half an hour and we watched him the whole way.

zh: 救护车到达现场用时八分钟。
en: The ambulance reached the scene in eight minutes.

zh: 救护车到楼下了，准备接人。
en: The ambulance is downstairs — get ready to receive the patient.

zh: 急救员完成现场评估后立即转运。
en: The emergency medical technician completed the scene assessment and transported at once.

zh: 急救员说现场血压测不到。
en: The emergency medical technician says no blood pressure could be measured at the scene.

zh: 院前急救团队与院内提前通报病情。
en: The prehospital team notified the hospital of the condition in advance.

zh: 院前急救团队几个人？够不够搬抬。
en: How many are in the prehospital team? Enough to carry him?

zh: 急救调度根据分级派出相应车辆。
en: Emergency dispatch sends the appropriate vehicle according to the priority.

zh: 急救调度说十分钟到，先做按压。
en: Emergency dispatch says ten minutes — keep compressing until then.

zh: 现场评估包括环境安全与伤员数量。
en: The scene assessment covers environmental safety and the number of casualties.

zh: 先做现场评估，别贸然进去。
en: Do the scene assessment first — do not rush in.

zh: 现场安全未确认前不得展开救援。
en: Rescue does not begin until scene safety is confirmed.

zh: 现场安全吗？有漏气先撤。
en: How is scene safety? If there is a gas leak, pull back first.

zh: 担架转运时保持头部与躯干同轴。
en: During stretcher transport the head and trunk are kept in line.

zh: 担架转运，一二三一起抬。
en: Stretcher transport — lift together on three.

zh: 疑似脊柱损伤者使用铲式担架。
en: A scoop stretcher is used when spinal injury is suspected.

zh: 拿铲式担架来，别让他翻身。
en: Bring the scoop stretcher — we are not turning him.

zh: 转运监护设备须固定牢靠。
en: Transport monitoring equipment must be firmly secured.

zh: 转运监护接上，血氧掉了我好知道。
en: Connect transport monitoring so I know if the saturation drops.

zh: 转运前检查转运呼吸机电池与氧源。
en: Check the transport ventilator battery and oxygen supply before transfer.

zh: 转运呼吸机的氧气够不够用？
en: Is there enough oxygen for the transport ventilator?

zh: 院前通知须包含意识、气道与预计到院时间。
en: Prehospital notification must include consciousness, airway and estimated arrival time.

zh: 院前通知打了吗？让他们备好抢救室。
en: Has prehospital notification been made? Tell them to ready the resuscitation room.

zh: 院前交接采用结构化格式并双方签名。
en: Prehospital handover uses a structured format signed by both sides.

zh: 院前交接快点，重点说意识变化。
en: Keep the prehospital handover short — focus on the change in consciousness.

zh: 交接报告内容包括发病经过与用药。
en: The handover report covers the onset and the drugs given.

zh: 交接报告先说气道和循环。
en: In the handover report, start with airway and circulation.

zh: 转运前评估转运风险并记录。
en: Transport risk is assessed and documented before moving the patient.

zh: 转运风险不小，路上得多带个人。
en: There is real transport risk — take an extra person on the road.

zh: 途中病情变化须立即停车处置。
en: Deterioration during transport requires stopping the vehicle and treating at once.

zh: 途中病情变化了，先靠边停。
en: We have deterioration during transport — pull over first.

zh: 转运时间超过三十分钟需重新评估风险。
en: If transport time exceeds thirty minutes, the risk must be reassessed.

zh: 转运时间别太长，尽量就近。
en: Keep transport time short — go to the nearest place.

zh: 缩短院前延迟可提高救治效果。
en: Shortening prehospital delay improves the outcome of emergency treatment.

zh: 院前延迟太久，路上就耽误了二十分钟。
en: The prehospital delay was too long — twenty minutes lost on the road.

zh: 直升机转运适用于偏远地区重症患者。
en: Helicopter transport suits critically ill patients in remote areas.

zh: 直升机转运快，但得看天气。
en: Helicopter transport is fast, but it depends on the weather.

zh: 转运决策由现场负责人作出。
en: The transport decision is made by the person in charge at the scene.

zh: 转运决策定了吗？送哪家医院。
en: Is the transport decision made? Which hospital are we going to?

zh: 按就近送医原则选择接收医院。
en: The receiving hospital is chosen on the principle of transport to nearest hospital.

zh: 先就近送医，别绕远去大医院。
en: Do transport to nearest hospital first — do not bypass to a big centre.

zh: 转院前须完成病情告知与交接准备。
en: Before interhospital transfer, the condition must be explained and handover prepared.

zh: 这家医院做不了，得转院。
en: This hospital cannot do it — we need an interhospital transfer.

zh: 接收医院须提前确认床位与专科能力。
en: The receiving hospital must confirm bed availability and specialist capacity in advance.

zh: 接收医院联系好了吗？别到了不收。
en: Has the receiving hospital been contacted? We cannot arrive and be refused.

zh: 院前记录随患者一并移交接收医院。
en: The prehospital record is handed over to the receiving hospital with the patient.

zh: 院前记录给我一份，留档要用。
en: Give me a copy of the prehospital record for the file.

zh: 创伤患者到院后立即开始初级评估，先查气道和呼吸。
en: The primary survey starts immediately on arrival, beginning with the airway and breathing.

zh: 我们现在做初级评估，您别动，我先看看气道通不通。
en: We are doing the primary survey now; please keep still while I check your airway.

zh: 患者情况不稳，已按创伤团队启动流程呼叫上级医师。
en: The patient became unstable, so the trauma team activation process was triggered to call the senior doctors.

zh: 这个伤情够重，马上创伤团队启动，让麻醉和外科都下来。
en: The injury is severe enough, so activate the trauma team and get anesthesia and surgery down here now.

zh: 根据创伤机制判断，该患者可能合并颈椎损伤。
en: Based on the mechanism of injury, this patient may also have a cervical spine injury.

zh: 创伤机制是什么？是车祸还是从高处摔下来的？
en: What was the mechanism of injury, a car crash or a fall from height?

zh: 高能量损伤患者应按多发伤流程完成全身评估。
en: Patients with high-energy injury should receive a full-body workup following the polytrauma pathway.

zh: 他这是高能量损伤，别只看腿，肚子和头也得查。
en: This is a high-energy injury, so do not just look at the leg; check the abdomen and head as well.

zh: 多发伤患者优先处理致命性损伤，再处理肢体骨折。
en: In polytrauma, life-threatening injuries are treated first and limb fractures later.

zh: 这是多发伤，先救命，骨折的事等稳定了再说。
en: This is polytrauma, so save his life first and deal with the fractures once he is stable.

zh: 损伤严重度评分为三十四分，属于严重创伤。
en: The injury severity score was thirty-four, indicating severe trauma.

zh: 损伤严重度评分这么高，得直接进抢救室。
en: The injury severity score is so high that he needs to go straight to the resuscitation room.

zh: 入院创伤评分偏低，提示需要立即复苏。
en: The admission trauma score was low, indicating the need for immediate resuscitation.

zh: 先算个创伤评分，看看要不要送创伤中心。
en: Let us calculate a trauma score first to see whether he needs a trauma center.

zh: 把握黄金一小时，患者到院后三十分钟内完成止血。
en: We aim to use the golden hour and achieve hemorrhage control within thirty minutes of arrival.

zh: 黄金一小时别耽误，直接推手术室。
en: Do not waste the golden hour, take him straight to the operating room.

zh: 患者已出现致命三联征，需立即启动损伤控制复苏。
en: The patient has developed the lethal triad, so damage control resuscitation must start at once.

zh: 注意致命三联征，保温、纠酸、输血一起上。
en: Watch for the lethal triad and start warming, correcting acidosis and transfusing together.

zh: 按损伤控制复苏原则，先输血浆和红细胞，少给晶体液。
en: Following damage control resuscitation, plasma and red cells are given first and crystalloid is limited.

zh: 别猛灌盐水，走损伤控制复苏，血制品先上。
en: Do not pour in saline; use damage control resuscitation and start blood products first.

zh: 患者凝血功能差，决定行损伤控制手术，暂时关腹。
en: Because coagulation was poor, damage control surgery was chosen and the abdomen was left temporarily closed.

zh: 这台按损伤控制手术做，先止血，关腹的事以后再说。
en: Do this as damage control surgery, stop the bleeding first and close the abdomen later.

zh: 该患者符合转送创伤中心的标准，已联系急救车。
en: The patient meets the criteria for transfer to a trauma center, and the ambulance has been arranged.

zh: 我们这儿做不了，得送创伤中心。
en: We cannot manage this here; he needs a trauma center.

zh: 院前创伤评估记录显示患者意识清楚、右大腿畸形。
en: The prehospital trauma assessment noted a conscious patient with a deformed right thigh.

zh: 院前创伤评估说摸不到脉搏，准备输血。
en: The prehospital trauma assessment reported no palpable pulse, so get blood ready.

zh: 气道通畅性评估发现口咽部有血凝块，立即清除。
en: The airway patency assessment found a blood clot in the oropharynx, which was cleared at once.

zh: 先做气道通畅性评估，能说话说明气道还通。
en: Start with an airway patency assessment; if he can speak, the airway is still open.

zh: 接到创伤预警后，抢救室提前备好输血与手术人员。
en: After the trauma alert, blood products and surgical staff were prepared in the resuscitation room.

zh: 创伤预警已经发了，人五分钟到。
en: The trauma alert has gone out and the patient arrives in five minutes.

zh: 严格按创伤救治流程执行，避免遗漏致命性损伤。
en: Follow the trauma protocol strictly so that life-threatening injuries are not missed.

zh: 咱们按创伤救治流程走，一步一步来。
en: Let us follow the trauma protocol and take it step by step.

zh: 骨盆骨折评估提示骨盆环不稳定，需先行固定。
en: The pelvic fracture assessment suggested an unstable pelvic ring that needed stabilization first.

zh: 骨盆骨折评估先做，别急着让人站起来。
en: Do the pelvic fracture assessment first; do not let him stand up yet.

zh: 暴露与保温同时进行，避免患者出现低体温。
en: Exposure and warming were carried out together to prevent hypothermia.

zh: 先把衣服剪开做暴露与保温，别让他在风里冻着。
en: Cut the clothes off for exposure and warming; do not let him freeze in the wind.

zh: 出血源控制比单纯输血更能改善预后。
en: Source control of bleeding improves outcome more than transfusion alone.

zh: 出血源控制没做好，输再多血也白搭。
en: If source control of bleeding is not achieved, transfusing more blood is useless.

zh: 创伤超声评估未见心包积液，腹腔也未见游离液体。
en: The focused assessment with sonography for trauma showed no pericardial or abdominal free fluid.

zh: 先做个创伤超声评估，两分钟就知道肚子里有没有血。
en: Do a focused assessment with sonography for trauma first; in two minutes we will know if there is blood in the belly.

zh: 骨盆挤压试验阳性，禁止重复检查以免加重出血。
en: The pelvic compression test was positive, and repeat testing was avoided to prevent further bleeding.

zh: 别反复做骨盆挤压试验，查一次阳性就够了。
en: Do not repeat the pelvic compression test; one positive result is enough.

zh: 快速评估在九十秒内完成，重点看气道、呼吸和出血。
en: The rapid assessment was completed in ninety seconds, focusing on airway, breathing and bleeding.

zh: 先做个快速评估，别的检查等稳定了再说。
en: Do a rapid assessment first and leave other tests until he is stable.

zh: 现场安全评估未通过，救援人员暂不进入坍塌区域。
en: The scene safety assessment was not passed, so rescuers stayed out of the collapsed area.

zh: 先做现场安全评估，别为了救人把自己搭进去。
en: Do the scene safety assessment first; do not get yourself hurt trying to rescue others.

zh: 病例讨论认为这是一例可预防性死亡，需改进院前止血。
en: The case review concluded this was a preventable death and that prehospital bleeding control must improve.

zh: 很多可预防性死亡的病例，问题都出在止血太晚。
en: In many preventable death cases the problem is that bleeding control came too late.

zh: 完善创伤救治体系后，严重创伤的死亡率明显下降。
en: After the trauma system was improved, mortality from severe trauma fell markedly.

zh: 创伤救治体系建好了，病人才能救得及时。
en: Once the trauma system is in place, patients can be treated in time.

zh: 初步稳定后开始次级评估，逐项检查全身各部位。
en: Once stabilized, the secondary survey began with each body region examined in turn.

zh: 他稳住了，我们现在做次级评估，从头查到脚。
en: He is stable now, so we are doing the secondary survey from head to toe.

zh: 接诊医师完成从头到脚查体并记录阳性发现。
en: The receiving doctor completed a head-to-toe examination and recorded the positive findings.

zh: 麻烦您配合一下，我们做个从头到脚查体。
en: Please cooperate while we do a head-to-toe examination.

zh: 创伤病史采集重点询问受伤时间、外力方向和现场情况。
en: The trauma history focused on the time of injury, the direction of force and the scene.

zh: 我先问几句创伤病史，您以前有什么病、吃什么药？
en: Let me take a brief trauma history: what illnesses do you have and what medicines do you take?

zh: 受伤时间距入院约两小时，仍在清创时限内。
en: The time of injury was about two hours before arrival, still within the debridement window.

zh: 受伤时间大概是几点？这对后面处理很重要。
en: About what time were you injured? It matters for the treatment later.

zh: 受伤部位为右前胸，局部可见淤斑。
en: The injury site was the right anterior chest, where bruising was visible.

zh: 您指一下受伤部位，是这儿疼吗？
en: Point to the injury site; is this where it hurts?

zh: 伤口检查见右小腿外侧三厘米裂口，边缘整齐。
en: Wound inspection showed a three-centimetre laceration on the outer right calf with clean edges.

zh: 先做个伤口检查，看看里面有没有异物。
en: Let us inspect the wound first to see whether anything is inside.

zh: 骨盆稳定性检查阴性，暂不考虑骨盆环断裂。
en: The pelvic stability examination was negative, so a pelvic ring fracture was thought unlikely.

zh: 别反复做骨盆稳定性检查，怀疑骨折就先上固定带。
en: Do not repeat the pelvic stability examination; if fracture is suspected, apply the binder first.

zh: 神经血管检查提示右足背动脉搏动减弱。
en: The neurovascular examination showed a weakened right dorsalis pedis pulse.

zh: 打石膏前后都要做神经血管检查，脚趾能动吗？
en: We check neurovascular status before and after plastering; can you move your toes?

zh: 伤口有活动性出血，先行加压包扎并准备清创。
en: There was active bleeding from the wound, so a pressure dressing was applied and debridement prepared.

zh: 这里有活动性出血，快拿纱布压住。
en: There is active bleeding here; grab some gauze and press on it now.

zh: 腹部钝性伤后出现隐性出血，血红蛋白进行性下降。
en: Occult bleeding developed after blunt abdominal trauma, with a falling hemoglobin level.

zh: 外面看不出血，可人是隐性出血，肚子越来越胀。
en: No blood is visible outside, but there is occult bleeding and the abdomen is distending.

zh: 骨盆骨折合并腹膜后出血，需紧急输血。
en: Pelvic fracture with retroperitoneal hemorrhage required urgent transfusion.

zh: 骨盆骨折最容易伴腹膜后出血，别只盯着片子。
en: Pelvic fracture is often accompanied by retroperitoneal hemorrhage, so do not just stare at the films.

zh: 诊断性腹腔灌洗回抽液呈血性，提示腹腔积血。
en: The diagnostic peritoneal lavage returned bloody fluid, suggesting hemoperitoneum.

zh: 超声看不清，就做诊断性腹腔灌洗。
en: If ultrasound is unclear, go ahead with diagnostic peritoneal lavage.

zh: 创伤系列X线未见明显气胸与骨盆骨折。
en: The trauma radiograph series showed no obvious pneumothorax or pelvic fracture.

zh: 先拍个创伤系列X线，胸片和骨盆一起。
en: Take the trauma radiograph series first, chest and pelvis together.

zh: 全身CT扫描发现脾周积液与右侧肋骨骨折。
en: Whole-body computed tomography found perisplenic fluid and right rib fractures.

zh: 人还算稳，直接推去做全身CT扫描。
en: He is reasonably stable, so take him straight for whole-body computed tomography.

zh: 每小时重复评估一次，记录意识与出血情况。
en: Reassessment was repeated every hour, recording consciousness and bleeding.

zh: 转运前再重复评估一遍，别把人送走了才发现不对。
en: Do another reassessment before transfer; do not discover a problem after he has left.

zh: 复查发现漏诊的右踝骨折，已补行固定。
en: Follow-up revealed a missed injury of the right ankle, which was then immobilized.

zh: 多发伤最怕漏诊，查完一遍还要回头再看。
en: Missed injury is the big fear in polytrauma, so go back and check again after the first pass.

zh: 患者出现创伤性凝血病，需补充血浆和血小板。
en: The patient developed trauma-induced coagulopathy and needed plasma and platelets.

zh: 血一直止不住，怕是创伤性凝血病，快查凝血。
en: The bleeding will not stop; I suspect trauma-induced coagulopathy, so check coagulation now.

zh: 出血量估计约一千五百毫升，已启动大量输血方案。
en: Estimated blood loss was about one and a half liters, and the massive transfusion protocol was started.

zh: 出血量估计不准，宁可按重的算。
en: If the estimated blood loss is uncertain, err on the higher side.

zh: 双侧长骨骨折需临时固定后再搬运。
en: Bilateral long bone fractures needed temporary splinting before moving the patient.

zh: 长骨骨折出血多，一根股骨就能丢一升血。
en: Long bone fractures bleed a lot; one femur can lose a liter of blood.

zh: 开放性创伤需尽早清创并预防破伤风。
en: Open trauma requires early debridement and tetanus prophylaxis.

zh: 这是开放性创伤，先冲再缝，别直接盖上。
en: This is open trauma, so irrigate before suturing and do not just cover it.

zh: 闭合性创伤外表看不出伤，仍需排查内脏损伤。
en: Closed trauma may look minor but still requires screening for internal organ injury.

zh: 闭合性创伤也可能大出血，别被皮肤骗了。
en: Closed trauma can bleed heavily too, so do not be fooled by intact skin.

zh: 左胸穿透伤，需排除心脏与大血管损伤。
en: A penetrating trauma to the left chest required exclusion of cardiac and great vessel injury.

zh: 这是穿透伤，伤口小但里面可能很深。
en: This is penetrating trauma; the wound is small but may be deep inside.

zh: 双下肢挤压伤，需监测尿量与肌酸激酶。
en: With crush injury to both legs, urine output and creatine kinase were monitored.

zh: 他被墙压了半小时，挤压伤，先补液。
en: He was pinned by a wall for half an hour with crush injury, so start fluids first.

zh: 头皮撕脱伤需保留撕脱组织，随患者一同送手术室。
en: With an avulsion injury of the scalp, the avulsed tissue was kept and sent to operating room with the patient.

zh: 这块皮撕脱伤了，得连皮一起带到手术室。
en: This skin has an avulsion injury, so bring the tissue with us to the operating room.

zh: 现场止血以直接压迫为主，无效时改用止血带。
en: Field hemostasis relied mainly on direct pressure, with a tourniquet if that failed.

zh: 先止血，其他事等血止住再说。
en: Control the bleeding first; hemostasis comes before everything else.

zh: 对伤口行直接压迫十分钟后出血明显减少。
en: After ten minutes of direct pressure the bleeding from the wound decreased markedly.

zh: 别松手，直接压迫至少十分钟。
en: Do not let go; keep direct pressure on for at least ten minutes.

zh: 前臂出血先行指压止血，再改用加压包扎。
en: Digital pressure hemostasis was used for the forearm bleeding before a pressure dressing was applied.

zh: 手边没绷带，先用指压止血顶着。
en: No bandage at hand, so use digital pressure hemostasis for now.

zh: 四肢大出血经压迫无效时，应在伤口近端使用止血带。
en: When pressure fails in major limb bleeding, a tourniquet is applied proximal to the wound.

zh: 把止血带拿出来，绑在大腿根上。
en: Get the tourniquet out and put it high on the thigh.

zh: 止血带时间已超过一小时，转运途中需标记清楚。
en: The tourniquet time had passed one hour and was clearly marked during transfer.

zh: 止血带时间要写在他额头上，不然后面忘了。
en: Write the tourniquet time on his forehead so nobody forgets later.

zh: 到手术室后再行止血带松解，现场不得随意放松。
en: Tourniquet release was deferred until the operating room, and was not done in the field.

zh: 止血带松解要等外科到场，别自己松。
en: Tourniquet release waits for the surgeon, so do not loosen it yourself.

zh: 腹股沟伤口行填塞止血，纱布末端留于体表计数。
en: The groin wound was managed with wound packing, with the gauze ends left outside and counted.

zh: 这个伤口深，先填塞止血，纱布别忘拿出来。
en: This wound is deep, so pack it to stop the bleeding and remember to take the gauze out.

zh: 使用止血敷料后加压五分钟，出血基本停止。
en: After a hemostatic dressing and five minutes of pressure, the bleeding had almost stopped.

zh: 包里有止血敷料，赶紧拆开用上。
en: There is a hemostatic dressing in the bag, so open it and use it now.

zh: 术中细小出血点以电凝止血处理，无需缝扎。
en: Small bleeding points during surgery were managed with electrocautery rather than sutures.

zh: 这里渗血，电凝止血一下就好。
en: It is oozing here; a touch of electrocautery will do.

zh: 脾动脉活动性出血，行血管结扎后出血停止。
en: Active bleeding from the splenic artery stopped after vessel ligation.

zh: 这条血管结扎掉，不然一会儿又出血。
en: Ligate this vessel or it will bleed again shortly.

zh: 仔细寻找出血点，避免盲目钳夹造成神经损伤。
en: Look carefully for the bleeding point and avoid blind clamping that could injure a nerve.

zh: 出血点在这儿，你压准一点。
en: The bleeding point is here, so press exactly on it.

zh: 伤口见喷射性出血，考虑肱动脉损伤，立即加压。
en: Spurting bleeding from the wound suggested brachial artery injury, and pressure was applied at once.

zh: 血是喷出来的，喷射性出血，肯定是动脉。
en: The blood is spurting; that is spurting bleeding, so it must be arterial.

zh: 创面持续渗血，给予明胶海绵压迫。
en: The wound kept oozing, so a gelatin sponge and pressure were applied.

zh: 不严重，就是渗血，压一会儿就好。
en: It is not serious, just oozing; a few minutes of pressure will settle it.

zh: 颈部静脉出血，需警惕空气栓塞。
en: Venous bleeding in the neck raised concern about air embolism.

zh: 血色发暗，是静脉出血，还是得压住。
en: The blood is dark, so it is venous bleeding, but it still needs pressure.

zh: 股动脉出血量大，立即加压并通知外科。
en: Arterial bleeding from the femoral artery was heavy, so pressure was applied and surgery alerted.

zh: 动脉出血，按不住就上止血带。
en: For arterial bleeding, use a tourniquet if pressure will not hold.

zh: 创面毛细血管出血，局部压迫后已停止。
en: Capillary bleeding from the wound stopped after local pressure.

zh: 毛细血管出血不用紧张，纱布压一下就好。
en: Do not worry about capillary bleeding; a little gauze pressure will do.

zh: 右大腿血肿进行性增大，需排除活动性出血。
en: The right thigh hematoma was enlarging and active bleeding had to be excluded.

zh: 这里鼓了个血肿，摸着有点硬。
en: A hematoma has formed here and feels a little hard.

zh: 骨盆骨折合并大出血，立即启动大量输血方案。
en: Pelvic fracture with major hemorrhage triggered the massive transfusion protocol immediately.

zh: 这是大出血，别慢慢来，快叫人帮忙。
en: This is major hemorrhage, so do not go slowly; call for help now.

zh: 以止血钳夹住出血点，准备结扎。
en: The bleeding point was grasped with hemostatic forceps and prepared for ligation.

zh: 把止血钳递给我，先夹住再说。
en: Pass me the hemostatic forceps and clamp it first.

zh: 骨创面渗血处放置止血海绵后压迫。
en: A hemostatic sponge was placed on the oozing bone surface and pressed.

zh: 这个位置放块止血海绵，压一压。
en: Put a hemostatic sponge here and press it.

zh: 明胶海绵填塞后创面无明显继续渗血。
en: After gelatin sponge packing the wound showed no further significant oozing.

zh: 用明胶海绵压一下，比干纱布管用。
en: Press with a gelatin sponge; it works better than dry gauze.

zh: 创伤后三小时内给予氨甲环酸，可降低出血死亡风险。
en: Tranexamic acid given within three hours of trauma reduces the risk of death from bleeding.

zh: 氨甲环酸给了没有？伤后一小时最有效。
en: Has tranexamic acid been given? It works best within an hour of injury.

zh: 外院止血失败，转入时伤口仍在渗血。
en: Hemostasis failure at the referring hospital meant the wound was still oozing on arrival.

zh: 这边止血失败，赶紧叫外科上台。
en: Hemostasis has failed here, so call the surgeons in now.

zh: 术后六小时出现再出血，再次送手术室探查。
en: Rebleeding six hours after surgery led to another trip to the operating room.

zh: 血压一上来容易再出血，盯紧引流管。
en: Rebleeding is likely once pressure rises, so watch the drain closely.

zh: 创伤性出血是院前可预防死亡的首要原因。
en: Traumatic hemorrhage is the leading cause of preventable prehospital death.

zh: 创伤性出血止不住，人很快就没了，抓紧。
en: Traumatic hemorrhage that will not stop kills quickly, so move fast.

zh: 伤口加压包扎后出血停止，远端循环良好。
en: After the pressure dressing the bleeding stopped and distal circulation was good.

zh: 先加压包扎，包紧一点，但别把手指勒紫。
en: Apply a pressure dressing, firm but not so tight that the fingers turn blue.

zh: 伤口包扎完毕，敷料干燥无渗血。
en: Bandaging was completed and the dressing was dry with no oozing.

zh: 包扎好了，回家记得别沾水。
en: The bandaging is done; keep it dry when you get home.

zh: 以弹性绷带自远心端向近心端缠绕。
en: An elastic bandage was wrapped from distal to proximal.

zh: 再拿一卷绷带，这个不够长。
en: Bring another bandage; this one is not long enough.

zh: 踝关节扭伤后以弹性绷带加压包扎。
en: An elastic bandage was applied for compression after the ankle sprain.

zh: 用弹性绷带缠上，别缠太紧。
en: Wrap it with an elastic bandage, but not too tightly.

zh: 术后以加压绷带包扎，观察足趾颜色。
en: A compression bandage was applied after surgery and the toe color monitored.

zh: 加压绷带缠两层，松紧能塞进一根手指。
en: Wrap two layers of compression bandage, loose enough to slip one finger under.

zh: 以无菌纱布覆盖创面，外覆棉垫。
en: Sterile gauze was placed over the wound and covered with cotton padding.

zh: 给我几块纱布，这里还在渗。
en: Give me some gauze; it is still oozing here.

zh: 深部伤口以纱布卷填塞，末端留于体表计数。
en: The deep wound was packed with a gauze roll whose end was left outside and counted.

zh: 拿纱布卷来，这个洞得塞满。
en: Bring a gauze roll; this hole needs packing full.

zh: 清创后以无菌敷料覆盖，明日换药。
en: After debridement a sterile dressing was applied and a dressing change planned for tomorrow.

zh: 用无菌敷料盖，别拿纸巾碰伤口。
en: Use a sterile dressing; do not touch the wound with tissue paper.

zh: 胸部吸吮性伤口以封闭敷料覆盖三面固定。
en: The sucking chest wound was covered with an occlusive dressing taped on three sides.

zh: 这个伤口要用封闭敷料，普通纱布不行。
en: This wound needs an occlusive dressing; ordinary gauze will not do.

zh: 渗液较多的创面选用吸收敷料，每日更换。
en: An absorbent dressing was chosen for the heavily exuding wound and changed daily.

zh: 这个伤口水多，换吸收敷料吧。
en: This wound is very wet, so switch to an absorbent dressing.

zh: 术后第二天行敷料更换，创面干燥。
en: A dressing change was done on the second day after surgery and the wound was dry.

zh: 今天敷料更换，可能有点凉，忍一下。
en: It is time for the dressing change; it may feel cold for a moment.

zh: 敷料固定牢靠，边缘无卷起。
en: The dressing fixation was secure with no rolled edges.

zh: 敷料固定好一点，别一翻身就掉。
en: Fix the dressing properly so it does not fall off when he turns.

zh: 敷料浸透需立即更换并评估出血量。
en: A soaked dressing must be changed at once and blood loss assessed.

zh: 敷料浸透了，快看看是不是又出血。
en: The dressing is soaked, so check whether it is bleeding again.

zh: 腕部伤口以环形包扎固定敷料。
en: A circular bandage secured the dressing on the wrist wound.

zh: 先环形包扎两圈固定，再往上缠。
en: Start with two turns of circular bandage to anchor it, then wrap upwards.

zh: 前臂伤口采用螺旋包扎，松紧适宜。
en: A spiral bandage was used on the forearm wound with appropriate tension.

zh: 这种长伤口用螺旋包扎，一圈圈往上走。
en: For a long wound like this use a spiral bandage, working upward turn by turn.

zh: 踝部损伤以八字包扎固定，限制内翻。
en: A figure-of-eight bandage stabilized the ankle injury and limited inversion.

zh: 关节这里打八字包扎，活动能小一点。
en: Use a figure-of-eight bandage at the joint to limit movement.

zh: 以三角巾折叠成宽带包扎头部伤口。
en: A triangular bandage folded into a broad strip was used on the scalp wound.

zh: 把三角巾折一下，托住他的胳膊。
en: Fold the triangular bandage and support his arm with it.

zh: 锁骨骨折以三角巾悬吊患肢，减少活动。
en: A triangular sling supported the arm in the clavicle fracture and limited movement.

zh: 胳膊用三角巾悬吊起来，别乱动。
en: Put the arm in a triangular sling and keep it still.

zh: 指尖小裂口以创可贴保护即可。
en: A small fingertip laceration was simply covered with an adhesive bandage.

zh: 这点小口子贴个创可贴就行。
en: A small cut like this just needs an adhesive bandage.

zh: 以医用胶带将敷料边缘固定于皮肤。
en: The edges of the dressing were secured to the skin with medical tape.

zh: 用医用胶带贴一下，别让敷料滑下来。
en: Put some medical tape on so the dressing does not slip.

zh: 腹部术后使用腹带，咳嗽时用手按压伤口。
en: An abdominal binder was used after surgery, with hand pressure on the wound when coughing.

zh: 咳嗽的时候用腹带兜着，会舒服点。
en: Wearing the abdominal binder when you cough should make it more comfortable.

zh: 伤口渗液量少、色淡黄，无明显异味。
en: The wound exudate was scanty and pale yellow with no offensive odor.

zh: 伤口渗液有点多，敷料一天就湿了。
en: There is a fair amount of wound exudate; the dressing is soaked within a day.

zh: 伤口覆盖前需确认创面无活动性出血。
en: Before wound coverage, active bleeding must be excluded.

zh: 伤口覆盖先别做，等医生看完再说。
en: Hold off on wound coverage until the doctor has looked at it.

zh: 伤口敷料干燥，没有渗血也没有渗液。
en: The dressing was dry with no oozing or exudate.

zh: 敷料脏了就换，别一直贴着。
en: Change the dressing once it is dirty; do not leave it on.

zh: 骨折固定前先评估远端血运与感觉。
en: Distal perfusion and sensation were assessed before fracture immobilization.

zh: 先做骨折固定，别让骨头来回晃。
en: Do the fracture immobilization first; do not let the bone move about.

zh: 以夹板固定小腿，长度需超过骨折上下关节。
en: The lower leg was held with a splint long enough to cross the joints above and below the fracture.

zh: 找块夹板来，先把他小腿固定住。
en: Find a splint and immobilize his lower leg first.

zh: 石膏固定后六小时内有肿胀加重风险。
en: There is a risk of increasing swelling in the six hours after a cast is applied.

zh: 石膏刚打上，先别用这条腿踩地。
en: The cast has just been applied, so do not put weight on it.

zh: 桡骨远端骨折行石膏固定，患肢抬高。
en: The distal radius fracture had plaster immobilization and the limb was elevated.

zh: 这个位置石膏固定四周，下周来复查。
en: This needs plaster immobilization for four weeks, so come back next week for review.

zh: 腕部以石膏托固定，绷带松松缠绕。
en: A plaster splint was applied to the wrist and wrapped loosely with a bandage.

zh: 先用石膏托，肿消了再换正式的。
en: Use a plaster splint for now and change to a proper cast when the swelling settles.

zh: 股骨骨折行皮牵引，重量五公斤。
en: Skin traction was applied for the femoral fracture with a five-kilogram weight.

zh: 给上牵引，把腿拉直一点。
en: Put traction on and straighten the leg a little.

zh: 胫骨结节骨牵引后疼痛明显缓解。
en: Pain eased markedly after skeletal traction through the tibial tuberosity.

zh: 骨牵引要打钢针，先跟家属说清楚。
en: Skeletal traction needs a metal pin, so explain it to the family first.

zh: 皮肤牵引不超过两周，需检查皮肤有无水疱。
en: Skin traction is limited to two weeks and the skin must be checked for blisters.

zh: 皮肤牵引舒服些，但拉不了太重。
en: Skin traction is more comfortable but cannot pull much weight.

zh: 骨盆固定带置于大转子水平，勿压在腹部。
en: The pelvic binder was placed at the level of the greater trochanters, not over the abdomen.

zh: 骨盆固定带绑上，位置到大转子。
en: Put the pelvic binder on, down to the greater trochanters.

zh: 前臂吊带固定后手指活动良好。
en: With the arm sling in place, finger movement was normal.

zh: 胳膊挂前臂吊带，别拎东西。
en: Keep the arm in an arm sling and do not carry anything.

zh: 托马斯夹板固定后患肢疼痛减轻。
en: Pain in the injured limb lessened after application of the Thomas splint.

zh: 上托马斯夹板，把大腿拉直。
en: Apply the Thomas splint and straighten the thigh.

zh: 真空夹板适用于多发伤患者的快速固定。
en: The vacuum splint is useful for rapid immobilization in polytrauma.

zh: 真空夹板抽一下气就硬了，很快。
en: The vacuum splint hardens as soon as the air is drawn out, which is quick.

zh: 充气夹板压力不宜过高，以免影响血运。
en: Air splint pressure should not be too high, or perfusion may be impaired.

zh: 充气夹板别打太满，摸不到脉搏就糟了。
en: Do not overinflate the air splint; losing the pulse would be serious.

zh: 石膏固定后每小时行末梢循环观察。
en: A distal circulation check was performed hourly after the cast was applied.

zh: 末梢循环观察要勤，手指发紫就喊我。
en: Do distal circulation checks often and call me if the fingers turn blue.

zh: 小腿肿胀剧痛，警惕骨筋膜室综合征。
en: Marked swelling and severe pain in the lower leg raised concern about compartment syndrome.

zh: 他说疼得受不了，别是骨筋膜室综合征。
en: He says the pain is unbearable; it could be compartment syndrome.

zh: 开放性骨折需尽早清创、固定并预防感染。
en: An open fracture requires early debridement, stabilization and infection prevention.

zh: 这是开放性骨折，先冲伤口再固定。
en: This is an open fracture, so irrigate the wound before immobilizing it.

zh: 闭合性骨折先行手法复位与石膏固定。
en: A closed fracture is first managed with closed reduction and plaster immobilization.

zh: 闭合性骨折也别大意，里面照样出血。
en: Do not underestimate a closed fracture; it can still bleed inside.

zh: 粉碎性骨折需手术内固定恢复关节面。
en: A comminuted fracture requires surgical internal fixation to restore the joint surface.

zh: 片子看是粉碎性骨折，碎了好几块。
en: The film shows a comminuted fracture broken into several pieces.

zh: 螺旋形骨折常见于滑雪时下肢扭转受伤。
en: A spiral fracture is often seen when a ski injury twists the lower limb.

zh: 这条骨折线是螺旋形骨折，转着断的。
en: The fracture line is a spiral fracture, as if twisted apart.

zh: 病理性骨折需同时处理原发骨病变。
en: A pathologic fracture requires treatment of the underlying bone disease as well.

zh: 轻轻一摔就断，要考虑病理性骨折。
en: Breaking from a trivial fall should raise suspicion of a pathologic fracture.

zh: 长跑后足部疼痛，磁共振确认应力性骨折。
en: Foot pain after long-distance running was confirmed on MRI as a stress fracture.

zh: 这是应力性骨折，得停跑一段时间。
en: This is a stress fracture, so you must stop running for a while.

zh: 骨折复位后以石膏固定并复查X线。
en: After fracture reduction a cast was applied and radiographs repeated.

zh: 骨折复位有点疼，先打局麻。
en: Fracture reduction is painful, so give local anesthesia first.

zh: 胫骨骨折行内固定，术后早期活动。
en: The tibial fracture had internal fixation and early postoperative mobilization.

zh: 这个得做内固定，打钢板。
en: This needs internal fixation with a plate.

zh: 开放性骨折行外固定，便于观察伤口。
en: External fixation was used for the open fracture so the wound could be observed.

zh: 先做外固定，等伤口好了再换内固定。
en: Use external fixation first and switch to internal fixation once the wound heals.

zh: 复查显示骨折愈合良好，可拆除石膏。
en: Review showed good fracture healing, so the cast could be removed.

zh: 骨折愈合要两三个月，别急着干活。
en: Fracture healing takes two to three months, so do not rush back to work.

zh: 右肩脱位，方肩畸形明显。
en: The right shoulder dislocation produced an obvious squared-off shoulder.

zh: 这是脱位，不是骨折，关节对不上了。
en: This is a dislocation, not a fracture; the joint surfaces no longer line up.

zh: 关节脱位需在麻醉下尽早复位。
en: A joint dislocation should be reduced early, with anesthesia if needed.

zh: 关节脱位了，赶紧复位，拖久了更难。
en: The joint is dislocated, so reduce it soon; delay makes it harder.

zh: 颈椎半脱位需颈托制动并复查影像。
en: A cervical subluxation needs collar immobilization and repeat imaging.

zh: 这是半脱位，比全脱位轻一点。
en: This is a subluxation, milder than a full dislocation.

zh: 脱位复位后需复查X线确认位置。
en: Radiographs were repeated after dislocation reduction to confirm position.

zh: 脱位复位做完了，先别动，拍片看看。
en: The dislocation reduction is done; keep still and let us take a film.

zh: 肩关节前脱位行手法复位，一次成功。
en: The anterior shoulder dislocation was treated with manual reduction at the first attempt.

zh: 这个能手法复位，不用开刀。
en: This can be managed with manual reduction, no operation needed.

zh: 关节内骨折需切开复位以恢复关节面平整。
en: Intra-articular fractures need open reduction to restore a smooth joint surface.

zh: 复位不成功的话，就改做切开复位。
en: If reduction fails, proceed to open reduction.

zh: 肩关节脱位复位后需悬吊三周。
en: After reduction of the shoulder dislocation a sling is worn for three weeks.

zh: 肩关节脱位了，胳膊抬不起来。
en: The shoulder is dislocated and he cannot lift the arm.

zh: 肘关节脱位复位后检查桡动脉搏动。
en: After reducing the elbow dislocation the radial pulse was checked.

zh: 肘关节脱位，先看看手指能不能动。
en: Elbow dislocation; first check whether he can move the fingers.

zh: 髋关节脱位需在六小时内复位以保护股骨头。
en: A hip dislocation should be reduced within six hours to protect the femoral head.

zh: 髋关节脱位了，腿都短了一截。
en: The hip is dislocated and the leg looks shorter.

zh: 膝关节脱位需立即评估腘动脉搏动。
en: Knee dislocation requires immediate assessment of the popliteal pulse.

zh: 膝关节脱位很危险，先查脚背脉搏。
en: Knee dislocation is dangerous; check the foot pulses first.

zh: 颞下颌关节脱位行口内手法复位。
