en: The temporomandibular joint dislocation was reduced manually from inside the mouth.

zh: 下巴掉了，颞下颌关节脱位，我给您复位。
en: Your jaw is out, a temporomandibular joint dislocation, and I will put it back.

zh: 桡骨小头半脱位多见于五岁以下儿童。
en: Radial head subluxation is most common in children under five.

zh: 孩子是桡骨小头半脱位，拉了一下胳膊就哭了。
en: The child has a radial head subluxation and cried after the arm was pulled.

zh: 复位前评估确认远端感觉运动正常。
en: The pre-reduction assessment confirmed normal distal sensation and movement.

zh: 复位前评估先做，不然复位完说不清。
en: Do the pre-reduction assessment first, or we cannot tell what changed afterwards.

zh: 复位后评估显示足背动脉搏动恢复。
en: The post-reduction assessment showed the dorsalis pedis pulse had returned.

zh: 复位后评估一下，看看手指还麻不麻。
en: Do a post-reduction assessment and see whether the fingers are still numb.

zh: 复位后影像提示关节间隙恢复正常。
en: The post-reduction radiograph showed a normal joint space.

zh: 去拍个复位后影像，确认对好了。
en: Go for a post-reduction radiograph to confirm the joint is aligned.

zh: 关节畸形明显，触诊有空虚感。
en: The joint deformity was obvious and palpation revealed an empty joint.

zh: 关节畸形这么明显，肯定是脱位。
en: With such an obvious joint deformity it must be a dislocation.

zh: 脱位合并神经血管损伤需急诊手术探查。
en: Dislocation with neurovascular injury required emergency surgical exploration.

zh: 别漏了神经血管损伤，手指麻不麻？
en: Do not miss neurovascular injury; are the fingers numb?

zh: 关节穿刺抽出积血，送检排除感染。
en: Joint aspiration removed blood, which was sent to exclude infection.

zh: 关节肿得厉害，做个关节穿刺。
en: The joint is very swollen, so do a joint aspiration.

zh: 膝关节腔积血，浮髌试验阳性。
en: There was hemarthrosis of the knee with a positive patellar tap test.

zh: 关节腔积血了，抽出来会舒服些。
en: There is hemarthrosis in the joint; draining it should ease the discomfort.

zh: 肩关节习惯性脱位可考虑手术稳定。
en: Recurrent shoulder dislocation may be treated with surgical stabilization.

zh: 他这个习惯性脱位，抬个手都能掉。
en: With this recurrent dislocation even lifting an arm can pop it out.

zh: 复位禁忌证明确时直接安排手术。
en: When a contraindication to reduction was clear, surgery was arranged directly.

zh: 有复位禁忌证就先别硬拉。
en: If there is a contraindication to reduction, do not force it.

zh: 患儿在镇静下复位，过程顺利。
en: The child had reduction under sedation and the procedure went smoothly.

zh: 这个得镇静下复位，不然疼得配合不了。
en: This needs reduction under sedation, or the pain will make it impossible to cooperate.

zh: 踝部骨折脱位需急诊复位并手术固定。
en: An ankle fracture-dislocation needed emergency reduction and surgical fixation.

zh: 这是骨折脱位，两样都有，得手术。
en: This is a fracture-dislocation, both at once, so surgery is needed.

zh: 复位后关节制动两周，避免负重。
en: After reduction, joint immobilization is kept for two weeks with no weight bearing.

zh: 关节制动别太久，不然会僵。
en: Do not keep the joint immobilized too long or it will become stiff.

zh: 怀疑脊柱损伤时先行脊柱制动再搬运。
en: When spinal injury is suspected, spinal immobilization comes before moving the patient.

zh: 先做脊柱制动，别随便翻他。
en: Do the spinal immobilization first and do not roll him casually.

zh: 颈椎固定期间禁止坐起与转头。
en: During cervical spine immobilization the patient must not sit up or turn the head.

zh: 颈椎固定做好，头别让他转。
en: The cervical spine immobilization is done, so do not let him turn his head.

zh: 颈托型号合适，边缘不压迫皮肤。
en: The cervical collar was the right size and its edges did not press on the skin.

zh: 把颈托给他戴上，大小调好。
en: Put the cervical collar on him and adjust the size.

zh: 转运时使用硬质颈托，避免软颈托。
en: A rigid cervical collar was used for transport instead of a soft one.

zh: 软颈托不行，必须用硬质颈托。
en: The soft one will not do; we need a rigid cervical collar.

zh: 患者整体翻上脊柱板后固定头部。
en: The patient was log-rolled onto the spine board and the head secured.

zh: 抬到脊柱板上，头两边垫好。
en: Lift him onto the spine board and pad both sides of the head.

zh: 真空担架比脊柱板更舒适，压力性损伤少。
en: The vacuum mattress is more comfortable than a spine board and causes fewer pressure injuries.

zh: 用真空担架吧，比板子舒服。
en: Use the vacuum mattress; it is more comfortable than the board.

zh: 轴向翻身需四人配合，一人固定头颈。
en: A log roll needs four people, with one holding the head and neck.

zh: 轴向翻身，听我口令一起翻。
en: Log roll on my count, everyone turn together.

zh: 气道操作时持续头颈固定，防止颈部移动。
en: Manual in-line stabilization was maintained during airway procedures to prevent neck movement.

zh: 你做操作，我来头颈固定。
en: You do the procedure and I will provide manual in-line stabilization.

zh: 颈椎损伤患者转运时保持头部中立。
en: Patients with cervical spine injury are transported with the head in a neutral position.

zh: 怀疑颈椎损伤，先别让他抬头。
en: Cervical spine injury is suspected, so do not let him lift his head.

zh: 胸腰椎损伤需卧床并评估神经功能。
en: Thoracolumbar injury requires bed rest and neurological assessment.

zh: 胸腰椎损伤，翻身要整体翻。
en: With thoracolumbar injury, turn him as a whole unit.

zh: 脊髓损伤平面以下感觉运动消失。
en: Below the level of the spinal cord injury, sensation and movement were absent.

zh: 脊髓损伤的话，恢复要看损伤程度。
en: With spinal cord injury, recovery depends on how severe the damage is.

zh: 截瘫患者需预防压疮与深静脉血栓。
en: Patients with paraplegia need prevention of pressure sores and deep vein thrombosis.

zh: 他下半身没感觉，是截瘫。
en: He has no feeling in the lower half of his body; it is paraplegia.

zh: 颈髓损伤致四肢瘫，需呼吸功能监测。
en: Cervical cord injury caused tetraplegia, requiring respiratory monitoring.

zh: 四肢瘫的病人，翻身和拍背都要人帮。
en: A patient with tetraplegia needs help with turning and chest physiotherapy.

zh: 脊髓休克期不能凭反射判断损伤程度。
en: During spinal shock, reflexes cannot be used to judge the extent of injury.

zh: 现在是脊髓休克期，反射还看不出来。
en: This is the spinal shock phase, so reflexes are not yet informative.

zh: 感觉平面在胸八，双下肢感觉消失。
en: The sensory level was at T8 with no sensation in either leg.

zh: 感觉平面到这儿，往下他就不知道了。
en: The sensory level is here; below this he feels nothing.

zh: 运动平面为颈六，腕背伸可完成。
en: The motor level was C6 and wrist extension was preserved.

zh: 运动平面在颈六，手还能抬一点。
en: The motor level is C6, so he can still lift the hand a little.

zh: 脊柱排查完成后方可解除颈托。
en: The cervical collar was removed only after spine clearance was complete.

zh: 脊柱排查没做完，颈托先别摘。
en: Spine clearance is not finished, so leave the collar on for now.

zh: 颈托解除前需完成影像与临床评估。
en: Cervical collar removal required both imaging and clinical assessment first.

zh: 颈托解除要两个人配合，扶着点头。
en: Cervical collar removal takes two people and support of the head.

zh: 脊柱X线检查未见椎体滑脱。
en: The spine radiograph showed no vertebral slip.

zh: 先拍脊柱X线，看看骨头有没有事。
en: Take a spine radiograph first to see whether the bones are injured.

zh: 颈椎过伸伤可无骨折但出现脊髓症状。
en: Hyperextension injury of the neck may cause cord symptoms without fracture.

zh: 追尾最容易颈椎过伸伤，别只看骨头。
en: Rear-end crashes commonly cause hyperextension injury, so do not look only at the bones.

zh: 脊髓压迫需尽早手术减压。
en: Spinal cord compression requires early surgical decompression.

zh: 有脊髓压迫，得赶快减压。
en: There is spinal cord compression, so decompression is urgent.

zh: 脊柱骨折稳定型可保守治疗。
en: A stable spinal fracture can be managed conservatively.

zh: 脊柱骨折了，搬运要特别小心。
en: He has a spinal fracture, so moving him needs great care.

zh: 椎体骨折压缩超过一半需手术。
en: A vertebral fracture with more than half the height lost needs surgery.

zh: 椎体骨折了，得躺硬板床。
en: There is a vertebral fracture, so he must lie on a firm bed.

zh: 影像提示脊髓横断，预后极差。
en: Imaging suggested spinal cord transection with a very poor prognosis.

zh: 脊髓横断的话，后半辈子可能站不起来。
en: With spinal cord transection he may never stand again.

zh: 马尾综合征需急诊手术减压。
en: Cauda equina syndrome requires emergency surgical decompression.

zh: 鞍区麻木、解不出尿，小心马尾综合征。
en: Saddle numbness and inability to pass urine should raise concern for cauda equina syndrome.

zh: 颅脑损伤患者需动态评估意识与瞳孔。
en: Patients with traumatic brain injury need repeated assessment of consciousness and pupils.

zh: 颅脑损伤最怕后面出血，得盯着。
en: With traumatic brain injury the fear is delayed bleeding, so watch him closely.

zh: 头部外伤后呕吐两次，需行头颅CT。
en: Two episodes of vomiting after head injury prompted a head CT.

zh: 头部外伤别不当回事，观察二十四小时。
en: Do not dismiss a head injury; observe for twenty-four hours.

zh: 脑震荡患者留观六小时，交代复诊指征。
en: Concussion patients are observed for six hours and given return precautions.

zh: 脑震荡不用太担心，但这两天别剧烈活动。
en: A concussion is not too worrying, but avoid strenuous activity for a couple of days.

zh: 脑挫裂伤周围水肿明显，需降颅压治疗。
en: Cerebral contusion and laceration showed marked surrounding edema requiring pressure control.

zh: 脑子里有脑挫裂伤，水肿还会加重。
en: There is cerebral contusion and laceration, and the swelling will worsen.

zh: 硬膜外血肿量约四十毫升，急诊开颅。
en: The epidural hematoma measured about forty milliliters and emergency craniotomy was arranged.

zh: 硬膜外血肿会中间清醒再昏迷，别放松。
en: An epidural hematoma can cause a lucid interval before coma, so stay alert.

zh: 双侧硬膜下血肿，中线移位五毫米。
en: Bilateral subdural hematoma caused five millimeters of midline shift.

zh: 老人摔了一跤，查出来硬膜下血肿。
en: The older patient fell and was found to have a subdural hematoma.

zh: 外伤性蛛网膜下腔出血，予尼莫地平。
en: Traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage was treated with nimodipine.

zh: 蛛网膜下腔出血，头疼得很厉害。
en: Subarachnoid hemorrhage causes severe headache.

zh: 额叶脑内血肿伴周围水肿。
en: The frontal intracerebral hematoma was surrounded by edema.

zh: 脑内血肿不大，先保守观察。
en: The intracerebral hematoma is small, so observe conservatively first.

zh: 凹陷性颅骨骨折需手术复位。
en: A depressed skull fracture requires surgical elevation.

zh: 摸到头骨有个坑，颅骨骨折了。
en: There is a dip in the skull, so it is a skull fracture.

zh: 颅底骨折禁止填塞耳道与鼻腔。
en: Packing the ear canal or nose is contraindicated in basilar skull fracture.

zh: 耳朵流血水，可能是颅底骨折。
en: Bloody fluid from the ear may indicate a basilar skull fracture.

zh: 开放性颅脑损伤需清创并修补硬脑膜。
en: Open traumatic brain injury requires debridement and dural repair.

zh: 开放性颅脑损伤，先清创再谈别的。
en: This is open traumatic brain injury, so debride first and discuss the rest later.

zh: 一侧瞳孔散大，提示脑疝形成。
en: A dilated pupil on one side suggested brain herniation.

zh: 瞳孔一大一小，脑疝了，快叫神外。
en: The pupils are unequal, this is brain herniation, call neurosurgery now.

zh: 颅内压增高时避免颈部屈曲与躁动。
en: With increased intracranial pressure, avoid neck flexion and agitation.

zh: 颅内压增高，床头抬高三十度。
en: Increased intracranial pressure: raise the head of the bed thirty degrees.

zh: 脑水肿高峰期在伤后三到五天。
en: Cerebral edema peaks three to five days after injury.

zh: 脑水肿还会加重，脱水药先备着。
en: Cerebral edema will worsen, so have the dehydrating agents ready.

zh: 开颅手术清除血肿并止血。
en: Craniotomy was performed to evacuate the hematoma and secure hemostasis.

zh: 得做开颅手术，家属签个字。
en: A craniotomy is needed, so ask the family to sign.

zh: 药物无效的颅内压增高行去骨瓣减压。
en: Decompressive craniectomy was performed for raised intracranial pressure that did not respond to drugs.

zh: 肿得太厉害，得去骨瓣减压，把骨头先拿掉。
en: The swelling is severe, so decompressive craniectomy is needed to take off part of the skull.

zh: 颅内血肿清除后瞳孔恢复等大。
en: After hematoma evacuation the pupils became equal again.

zh: 先做颅内血肿清除，压迫不解除不行。
en: Hematoma evacuation comes first; the pressure has to be relieved.

zh: 头颅CT示左额硬膜下血肿。
en: Head computed tomography showed a left frontal subdural hematoma.

zh: 马上推去拍头颅CT，别等。
en: Take him for head computed tomography now, do not wait.

zh: 脑脊液漏患者禁止擤鼻与填塞。
en: Patients with a cerebrospinal fluid leak must not blow the nose or pack it.

zh: 鼻子里流清水，可能是脑脊液漏。
en: Clear fluid from the nose may be a cerebrospinal fluid leak.

zh: 外伤后癫痫发作予抗癫痫药物并保护气道。
en: A post-traumatic seizure was treated with antiepileptic drugs and airway protection.

zh: 他抽起来了，是外伤后癫痫，快处理。
en: He is fitting, it is a post-traumatic seizure, treat him now.

zh: 迟发性颅内出血多在伤后二十四小时内发生。
en: Delayed intracranial hemorrhage usually appears within twenty-four hours of injury.

zh: 现在CT干净不代表没事，小心迟发性颅内出血。
en: A clean CT now does not mean all is well; watch for delayed intracranial hemorrhage.

zh: 头皮血肿较大者需排除帽状腱膜下出血。
en: A large scalp hematoma requires exclusion of subgaleal bleeding.

zh: 头上这个包是头皮血肿，先冷敷。
en: This lump is a scalp hematoma, so apply cold packs first.

zh: 头皮裂伤清创后全层缝合。
en: The scalp laceration was cleaned and closed in full thickness.

zh: 头皮裂伤出血多，先压迫再缝。
en: Scalp lacerations bleed a lot, so press first and then suture.

zh: 维持脑灌注压在六十毫米汞柱以上。
en: Cerebral perfusion pressure was kept above sixty millimeters of mercury.

zh: 脑灌注压不够，血压得往上提一点。
en: Cerebral perfusion pressure is too low, so bring the blood pressure up a little.

zh: 脑干损伤患者出现呼吸节律不齐。
en: The patient with brainstem injury developed irregular breathing.

zh: 脑干损伤最凶险，随时可能不行。
en: Brainstem injury is the most dangerous of all and can deteriorate at any moment.

zh: 胸部创伤患者先评估呼吸与循环。
en: Patients with chest trauma are assessed first for breathing and circulation.

zh: 胸部创伤别只看肋骨，里面才要命。
en: With chest trauma do not just look at the ribs; the inside is what kills.

zh: 多根肋骨骨折需镇痛并鼓励咳嗽。
en: Multiple rib fractures need analgesia and encouragement to cough.

zh: 肋骨骨折疼得不敢喘气，得给镇痛。
en: The rib fracture hurts so much he dares not breathe, so give analgesia.

zh: 连枷胸患者出现反常呼吸，需机械通气。
en: The patient with flail chest had paradoxical breathing and needed mechanical ventilation.

zh: 胸壁一吸气就塌下去，是连枷胸。
en: The chest wall caves in on inspiration, which is flail chest.

zh: 右侧气胸压缩百分之三十。
en: The right pneumothorax compressed the lung by thirty percent.

zh: 气胸了，肺被压瘪一部分。
en: There is a pneumothorax and part of the lung is collapsed.

zh: 张力性气胸需立即针刺减压。
en: A tension pneumothorax needs immediate needle decompression.

zh: 张力性气胸，先扎针放气再拍片。
en: This is a tension pneumothorax, so needle it before taking films.

zh: 开放性气胸以封闭敷料覆盖后固定。
en: An open pneumothorax was covered with an occlusive dressing and secured.

zh: 开放性气胸，先把伤口封住。
en: It is an open pneumothorax, so seal the wound first.

zh: 大量血胸需胸腔闭式引流并输血。
en: A large hemothorax required tube thoracostomy and transfusion.

zh: 是血胸了，胸管赶紧放进去。
en: There is a hemothorax, so get the chest tube in.

zh: 血气胸行胸腔闭式引流后呼吸改善。
en: Breathing improved after tube thoracostomy for the hemopneumothorax.

zh: 既是血胸又是气胸，叫血气胸。
en: Blood and air together is called a hemopneumothorax.

zh: 胸腔闭式引流后引流出八百毫升血性液体。
en: Eight hundred milliliters of bloody fluid drained after tube thoracostomy.

zh: 做胸腔闭式引流，管子固定牢一点。
en: Do the tube thoracostomy and secure the tube firmly.

zh: 针刺减压后呼吸窘迫明显缓解。
en: Respiratory distress eased markedly after needle decompression.

zh: 针刺减压先做，别等床旁超声。
en: Do the needle decompression first; do not wait for bedside ultrasound.

zh: 心包填塞表现为颈静脉怒张与血压下降。
en: Cardiac tamponade presented with distended neck veins and falling blood pressure.

zh: 心包填塞，血压一直往下掉。
en: It is cardiac tamponade and the blood pressure keeps dropping.

zh: 超声引导下行心包穿刺，抽出四十毫升积血。
en: Pericardiocentesis under ultrasound guidance removed forty milliliters of blood.

zh: 心包穿刺我来做，你盯着监护。
en: I will do the pericardiocentesis while you watch the monitor.

zh: 心脏挫伤患者需连续心电监护。
en: Patients with cardiac contusion need continuous ECG monitoring.

zh: 撞到胸口，小心心脏挫伤引起心律乱。
en: After a blow to the chest, watch for cardiac contusion causing arrhythmia.

zh: 肺挫伤范围扩大，氧合进行性下降。
en: The pulmonary contusion enlarged and oxygenation worsened progressively.

zh: 肺挫伤后面还会加重，别急着拔管。
en: Pulmonary contusion worsens later, so do not extubate too soon.

zh: 肺撕裂伤伴少量气胸，予观察。
en: Pulmonary laceration with a small pneumothorax was managed with observation.

zh: 肺撕裂伤了，先别做正压通气太高。
en: There is a pulmonary laceration, so avoid high positive pressure for now.

zh: 气管支气管损伤需支气管镜确诊。
en: Tracheobronchial injury was confirmed by bronchoscopy.

zh: 怀疑气管支气管损伤，别盲目插管。
en: Tracheobronchial injury is suspected, so do not intubate blindly.

zh: 主动脉损伤需控制血压并急诊手术。
en: Aortic injury required blood pressure control and emergency surgery.

zh: 高速车祸要想到主动脉损伤。
en: In high-speed crashes, think of aortic injury.

zh: 左侧膈肌破裂，胃泡影进入胸腔。
en: Left diaphragmatic rupture allowed the gastric bubble into the chest.

zh: 膈肌破裂了，胃都跑到胸腔里。
en: There is a diaphragmatic rupture and the stomach has moved into the chest.

zh: 胸骨骨折需排除心脏挫伤与主动脉损伤。
en: Sternal fracture requires exclusion of cardiac contusion and aortic injury.

zh: 胸骨骨折，心电图得查一下。
en: With a sternal fracture, an ECG should be done.

zh: 观察胸壁反常运动判断连枷胸范围。
en: Paradoxical chest wall movement was observed to judge the extent of flail chest.

zh: 你看这里胸壁反常运动，吸气往里凹。
en: Look at this paradoxical chest wall movement, it sinks in on inspiration.

zh: 胸腔引流管通畅，水柱随呼吸波动。
en: The chest drain was patent and the water column swung with breathing.

zh: 胸腔引流管别压住，保持通畅。
en: Do not kink the chest drain; keep it patent.

zh: 胸部X线示右侧肋膈角变钝。
en: The chest radiograph showed blunting of the right costophrenic angle.

zh: 先拍胸部X线，看看有没有气胸。
en: Take a chest radiograph first to look for pneumothorax.

zh: 胸部CT示双肺多发挫伤。
en: Chest computed tomography showed multiple bilateral pulmonary contusions.

zh: 胸部CT更清楚，能看见X线看不到的。
en: Chest computed tomography is clearer and shows what plain films cannot.

zh: 穿透性胸部创伤需急诊开胸探查。
en: Penetrating chest trauma required emergency thoracotomy.

zh: 穿透性胸部创伤，伤口小也可能要开胸。
en: With penetrating chest trauma even a small wound may need a thoracotomy.

zh: 急诊开胸后心脏恢复自主搏动。
en: Spontaneous cardiac activity returned after emergency thoracotomy.

zh: 人快不行了，准备急诊开胸。
en: He is nearly arrested, so prepare for emergency thoracotomy.

zh: 腹部创伤患者需动态观察腹部体征。
en: Patients with abdominal trauma need repeated abdominal examination.

zh: 腹部创伤别只看表面，里面可能出血。
en: With abdominal trauma do not look only at the surface; there may be internal bleeding.

zh: 腹部钝性伤首选床旁超声评估。
en: Blunt abdominal trauma is first assessed with bedside ultrasound.

zh: 腹部钝性伤里面，最怕的就是脾破裂。
en: With blunt abdominal trauma the great fear is splenic rupture.

zh: 腹部穿透伤伴腹膜刺激征，急诊剖腹探查。
en: Penetrating abdominal trauma with peritoneal signs required emergency laparotomy.

zh: 腹部穿透伤，别等了，直接手术。
en: Penetrating abdominal trauma, do not wait, go straight to surgery.

zh: 肝破裂行手术止血并修补。
en: The liver laceration was managed with surgical hemostasis and repair.

zh: 肝破裂了，肚子里全是血。
en: The liver is lacerated and the abdomen is full of blood.

zh: 脾破裂伴活动性出血，行脾切除。
en: Splenic rupture with active bleeding was treated by splenectomy.

zh: 脾破裂出血快，赶紧叫人。
en: A splenic rupture bleeds fast, so call for help now.

zh: 肠破裂需要急诊手术修补。
en: Bowel perforation required emergency surgical repair.

zh: 肠破裂了，拖久了就是腹膜炎。
en: The bowel is perforated; delay means peritonitis.

zh: 肠系膜损伤可致迟发性肠坏死。
en: Mesenteric injury can cause delayed bowel necrosis.

zh: 肠系膜损伤一开始不明显，得复查。
en: Mesenteric injury is subtle at first and needs reassessment.

zh: 胰腺损伤需测血淀粉酶并复查CT。
en: Pancreatic injury required serum amylase testing and repeat CT.

zh: 胰腺损伤不好发现，淀粉酶要查。
en: Pancreatic injury is easy to miss, so check amylase.

zh: 肾损伤患者观察尿色与尿量。
en: Patients with renal injury are monitored for urine color and volume.

zh: 肾损伤要看尿里有没有血。
en: With renal injury, check whether there is blood in the urine.

zh: 腹腔积血穿刺抽出不凝血。
en: Paracentesis for hemoperitoneum withdrew non-clotting blood.

zh: 腹腔积血，肚子都鼓起来了。
en: There is hemoperitoneum and the abdomen is distended.

zh: 腹腔穿刺抽出不凝血，提示活动性出血。
en: Abdominal paracentesis yielded non-clotting blood, suggesting active bleeding.

zh: 腹腔穿刺抽一下，有血就得手术。
en: Do an abdominal paracentesis; if there is blood, he needs surgery.

zh: 剖腹探查见小肠系膜撕裂。
en: Exploratory laparotomy revealed a torn small bowel mesentery.

zh: 剖腹探查进去看看，不能光靠CT。
en: Go in with exploratory laparotomy; CT alone is not enough.

zh: 腹腔间隙综合征需测膀胱压并减压。
en: Abdominal compartment syndrome requires bladder pressure measurement and decompression.

zh: 肚子硬得像板，小心腹腔间隙综合征。
en: The abdomen is rigid as a board; watch for abdominal compartment syndrome.

zh: 腹壁裂伤清创后探查有无腹膜穿透。
en: After cleaning the abdominal wall laceration, peritoneal penetration was checked.

zh: 腹壁裂伤不深，但得看看有没有进肚子。
en: The abdominal wall laceration is shallow, but check whether it entered the abdomen.

zh: 安全带征阳性者需警惕肠破裂。
en: A positive seat belt sign warrants vigilance for bowel perforation.

zh: 肚子上这条印是安全带征，不能大意。
en: This mark across the abdomen is the seat belt sign and must not be ignored.

zh: 脾切除后需接种肺炎球菌疫苗。
en: Pneumococcal vaccination is needed after splenectomy.

zh: 脾切除了，以后要注意防感染。
en: After the splenectomy, guard against infection in future.

zh: 肝破裂修补后留置腹腔引流。
en: An abdominal drain was left after liver laceration repair.

zh: 肝破裂修补能保住就先保住。
en: If liver laceration repair can save the organ, do that first.

zh: 肠切除吻合后观察有无吻合口漏。
en: After bowel resection and anastomosis, the patient was watched for anastomotic leak.

zh: 肠子坏死了，得肠切除吻合。
en: The bowel is necrotic, so bowel resection and anastomosis is needed.

zh: 腹部CT示脾周积液与肝裂伤。
en: Abdominal computed tomography showed perisplenic fluid and a liver laceration.

zh: 腹部CT能看清哪个脏器破了。
en: Abdominal computed tomography can show which organ is injured.

zh: 腹膜炎体征明显，需急诊手术。
en: Clear signs of peritonitis called for emergency surgery.

zh: 肚子一压就疼，是腹膜炎的表现。
en: Pain on pressing the abdomen is a sign of peritonitis.

zh: 胃肠减压引出咖啡色液体。
en: Nasogastric decompression drained coffee-ground fluid.

zh: 先胃肠减压，肚子胀得厉害。
en: Start nasogastric decompression; the abdomen is very distended.

zh: 肠管外露以湿盐水纱布覆盖，勿还纳。
en: Bowel evisceration was covered with saline-soaked gauze and not pushed back.

zh: 肠管外露别往回塞，用湿纱布盖上。
en: Do not push the eviscerated bowel back; cover it with wet gauze.

zh: 膀胱破裂需留置导尿并手术修补。
en: Bladder rupture required catheterization and surgical repair.

zh: 骨盆骨折要想到膀胱破裂。
en: With a pelvic fracture, think of bladder rupture.

zh: 尿道损伤忌反复试插导尿管。
en: Repeated attempts to insert a urinary catheter are avoided in urethral injury.

zh: 尿道损伤先别插尿管，叫泌尿科。
en: Do not catheterize a urethral injury; call urology.

zh: 腹腔引流液呈淡血性，量逐渐减少。
en: The abdominal drainage was lightly bloodstained and decreased gradually.

zh: 腹腔引流要记量，颜色变鲜就喊我。
en: Record the abdominal drainage and call me if it turns bright red.

zh: 烧伤评估需记录面积、深度与吸入性损伤。
en: Burn assessment records extent, depth and any inhalation injury.

zh: 先做烧伤评估，面积和深度都要记。
en: Do the burn assessment first and record both area and depth.

zh: 烧伤创面需保湿并预防感染。
en: Burn wounds need moisture and infection prevention.

zh: 烧伤面积不小，先建立静脉通路补液。
en: The burn area is considerable, so start fluids first.

zh: 热烧伤先用冷水冲洗降温。
en: Thermal burns are cooled with running cold water.

zh: 热烧伤先冲凉水，别抹牙膏。
en: For a thermal burn, cool it with water, do not apply toothpaste.

zh: 化学烧伤需大量清水冲洗至少二十分钟。
en: Chemical burns need copious water irrigation for at least twenty minutes.

zh: 化学烧伤先冲水，别中和。
en: For a chemical burn, irrigate with water rather than neutralizing.

zh: 电击伤需持续心电监护并查心肌酶。
en: Electrical injury requires continuous ECG monitoring and cardiac enzymes.

zh: 电击伤出口小，里面烧得很深。
en: An electrical injury may have a small exit wound but deep internal burns.

zh: 火焰烧伤伴面部焦痂，警惕气道水肿。
en: Flame burn with facial eschar raised concern about airway edema.

zh: 火焰烧伤最怕吸入热气，气道会肿。
en: With flame burns the airway can swell from inhaled hot gas.

zh: 小儿烫伤面积约百分之十。
en: The child's scald covered about ten percent of the body surface.

zh: 开水烫伤，先用凉水冲十五分钟。
en: A scald from boiling water: run cool water over it first.

zh: 吸入性损伤需尽早气管插管。
en: Inhalation injury requires early intubation.

zh: 声音嘶哑、咳黑痰，是吸入性损伤。
en: Hoarseness and black sputum indicate inhalation injury.

zh: 烧伤面积按九分法估算为百分之三十五。
en: The burn surface area was estimated at thirty-five percent by the rule of nines.

zh: 烧伤面积估多少？补液按这个算。
en: What is the burn surface area? Fluids are calculated from it.

zh: 成人九分法估算烧伤面积简便快速。
en: The rule of nines is a quick and simple way to estimate burn area in adults.

zh: 用九分法估一下，一条腿算十八。
en: Estimate with the rule of nines; one whole leg counts as eighteen.

zh: 散在小面积烧伤可用手掌法估算。
en: Scattered small burns can be estimated with the palm method.

zh: 面积小用手掌法，一个手掌百分之一。
en: Use the palm method for small areas; one palm is one percent.

zh: 烧伤深度判断需观察色泽、水疱与痛觉。
en: Burn depth is judged by color, blistering and sensation.

zh: 烧伤深度看着像深二度，可能要植皮。
en: The burn depth looks like deep partial thickness, so grafting may be needed.

zh: 一度烧伤一般三到五天愈合。
en: A first-degree burn usually heals in three to five days.

zh: 这是一度烧伤，像晒伤一样。
en: This is a first-degree burn, like sunburn.

zh: 二度烧伤水疱完整者保留疱皮。
en: In second-degree burns with intact blisters the blister roof is kept.

zh: 二度烧伤起水疱，别自己挑破。
en: Second-degree burns blister, so do not pop them yourself.

zh: 三度烧伤需手术切痂植皮。
en: Third-degree burns require excision of eschar and skin grafting.

zh: 三度烧伤都烧白了，他反而不疼。
en: A third-degree burn looks white and is paradoxically painless.

zh: 浅二度烧伤两周内可自行愈合。
en: A superficial partial-thickness burn usually heals within two weeks.

zh: 浅二度烧伤愈合快，留疤轻。
en: A superficial partial-thickness burn heals quickly with little scarring.

zh: 深二度烧伤常需削痂植皮。
en: A deep partial-thickness burn often needs tangential excision and grafting.

zh: 深二度烧伤自己好得慢，得植皮。
en: A deep partial-thickness burn heals slowly on its own and may need grafting.

zh: 全层烧伤需要早期切痂并植皮。
en: A full-thickness burn needs early excision of the eschar.

zh: 全层烧伤没有痛觉，看着吓人但不疼。
en: A full-thickness burn has no sensation, so it looks awful but does not hurt.

zh: 环形焦痂影响远端血运需切开。
en: A circumferential eschar impairing distal perfusion needs incision.

zh: 这层焦痂摸起来硬得像皮革。
en: This eschar is hard as leather.

zh: 胸部环形焦痂行焦痂切开减压后通气改善。
en: Ventilation improved after escharotomy for the circumferential chest eschar.

zh: 胸廓被焦痂勒住，得做焦痂切开减压。
en: The eschar is constricting the chest, so escharotomy is needed.

zh: 骨筋膜室综合征行筋膜切开减压。
en: Compartment syndrome was treated with fasciotomy.

zh: 压力太高就筋膜切开减压，别等坏死了。
en: If the pressure is too high, do a fasciotomy before necrosis sets in.

zh: 轻度烧伤在门诊换药就可以。
en: A mild burn can be managed with outpatient dressing changes.

zh: 轻度烧伤回家自己换药就行。
en: For a mild burn, dressing changes at home are enough.

zh: 重度烧伤需建立静脉通路并计算补液量。
en: Severe burns require intravenous access and calculated fluid resuscitation.

zh: 这是重度烧伤，必须住院治疗。
en: This is a severe burn and he needs admission.

zh: 按烧伤严重程度分级收治相应病房。
en: Patients are admitted to the appropriate unit according to the burn severity classification.

zh: 烧伤严重程度分级决定送哪儿。
en: The burn severity classification decides where the patient goes.

zh: 烧伤创面每日换药观察渗出。
en: The burn wound was dressed daily and exudate monitored.

zh: 烧伤创面别沾水，按时换药。
en: Keep the burn wound dry and change the dressing on time.

zh: 动物咬伤需冲洗伤口并评估狂犬病风险。
en: Animal bites require wound irrigation and rabies risk assessment.

zh: 动物咬伤先冲十五分钟，别急着缝。
en: For an animal bite, irrigate for fifteen minutes and do not rush to suture.

zh: 犬咬伤需彻底冲洗并清创。
en: A dog bite needs thorough irrigation and debridement.

zh: 犬咬伤最怕感染，冲干净最重要。
en: Infection is the main worry with a dog bite, so irrigation matters most.

zh: 猫咬伤易并发腱鞘炎与脓肿。
en: Cat bites often lead to tenosynovitis and abscess formation.

zh: 猫咬伤伤口小，但容易化脓。
en: A cat bite wound is small but tends to suppurate.

zh: 人咬伤需预防性使用抗生素。
en: Human bites require prophylactic antibiotics.

zh: 人咬伤看着轻，感染起来很凶。
en: A human bite looks mild but can become severely infected.

zh: 蛇咬伤需制动患肢并记录牙痕间距。
en: Snake bites require immobilizing the limb and recording fang mark spacing.

zh: 蛇咬伤别乱跑，患肢放低。
en: With a snake bite, do not run about; keep the limb low.

zh: 毒蛇咬伤需尽早使用抗蛇毒血清。
en: Venomous snake bites need antivenom as early as possible.

zh: 毒蛇咬伤，越早打血清越好。
en: For a venomous snake bite, the sooner the antivenom the better.

zh: 鼠咬伤需冲洗并评估出血热风险。
en: Rodent bites require irrigation and assessment for hemorrhagic fever risk.

zh: 鼠咬伤要打疫苗，别不当回事。
en: A rodent bite needs vaccination, so do not dismiss it.

zh: 蝙蝠咬伤即使伤口小也需按狂犬病暴露处理。
en: A bat bite requires rabies post-exposure management even if the wound is small.

zh: 蝙蝠咬伤最容易被忽略，其实很危险。
en: Bat bites are easily overlooked but are in fact dangerous.

zh: 咬伤伤口不立即缝合，先冲洗引流。
en: Bite wounds are not closed immediately; they are irrigated and drained first.

zh: 咬伤伤口先别缝，敞开引流。
en: Do not suture a bite wound yet; leave it open to drain.

zh: 咬伤冲洗至少十五分钟，再考虑缝合。
en: Bite wound irrigation is continued for at least fifteen minutes before suturing is considered.

zh: 护士正在做咬伤冲洗，您忍一下，水有点凉。
en: The nurse is doing the bite wound irrigation; it feels cold but bear with it.

zh: 狂犬病一旦发病，病死率接近百分之百。
en: Once rabies develops, mortality approaches one hundred percent.

zh: 狂犬病没法治，所以暴露后一定要打疫苗。
en: Rabies cannot be cured, so vaccination after exposure is essential.

zh: 狂犬病暴露后需立即冲洗伤口并接种疫苗。
en: After rabies exposure the wound is irrigated at once and vaccination started.

zh: 医生问您是不是狂犬病暴露，主要是要不要打针。
en: The doctor asks about rabies exposure because it decides whether you need shots.

zh: 狂犬病暴露分级为三级，需疫苗加免疫球蛋白。
en: Rabies exposure category three requires both vaccine and immunoglobulin.

zh: 按狂犬病暴露分级，您这个算二级。
en: By the rabies exposure category, yours counts as level two.

zh: 狂犬病疫苗按第零、三、七、十四、二十八天接种。
en: The rabies vaccine is given on days zero, three, seven, fourteen and twenty-eight.

zh: 狂犬病疫苗要按时打，不能漏针。
en: The rabies vaccine must be given on schedule, with no missed doses.

zh: 三级暴露需在伤口周围注射狂犬病免疫球蛋白。
en: Category three exposure requires rabies immunoglobulin infiltrated around the wound.

zh: 狂犬病免疫球蛋白比较贵，但三级暴露必须打。
en: Rabies immunoglobulin is expensive, but it is mandatory for category three exposure.

zh: 狂犬病预防的关键是尽早冲洗与接种。
en: The key to rabies prevention is early irrigation and vaccination.

zh: 狂犬病预防要做好，别等发病才后悔。
en: Rabies prevention must be done properly; do not wait for symptoms.

zh: 狂犬病暴露后预防包括冲洗、疫苗与免疫球蛋白。
en: Rabies post-exposure prophylaxis includes irrigation, vaccine and immunoglobulin.

zh: 暴露后预防越早开始越好，别拖到明天。
en: Post-exposure prophylaxis should start as early as possible, not tomorrow.

zh: 猫抓病表现为抓伤后腋窝淋巴结肿大。
en: Cat scratch disease presents with enlarged axillary nodes after a scratch.

zh: 猫抓病一般能自愈，但淋巴结会肿好几周。
en: Cat scratch disease usually resolves by itself, but the nodes stay swollen for weeks.

zh: 蛇毒入血后可出现牙龈出血与呼吸困难。
en: Once snake venom enters the blood, gum bleeding and breathing difficulty may follow.

zh: 别用嘴吸毒，蛇毒从口腔也能吸收。
en: Do not suck out snake venom; it can be absorbed through the mouth.

zh: 抗蛇毒血清需在监测下缓慢静脉滴注。
en: Antivenom is given by slow intravenous infusion under monitoring.

zh: 抗蛇毒血清越早用越好，但要注意过敏。
en: Antivenom works best early, but watch for allergy.

zh: 咬伤感染多在伤后二十四到四十八小时出现。
en: Bite infection usually appears twenty-four to forty-eight hours after injury.

zh: 咬伤感染了，得换抗生素。
en: The bite is infected, so change the antibiotic.

zh: 巴斯德菌感染常在数小时内红肿明显。
en: Pasteurella infection often causes marked redness within hours.

zh: 猫咬伤后肿得快，是巴斯德菌感染。
en: Rapid swelling after a cat bite suggests Pasteurella infection.

zh: 动物抓伤虽浅，仍需冲洗并评估疫苗。
en: An animal scratch, though shallow, still needs irrigation and vaccine assessment.

zh: 孩子被猫抓伤，动物抓伤也得打疫苗。
en: The child was scratched by a cat, and an animal scratch also needs vaccination.

zh: 蜱虫叮咬后需完整取出蜱体并观察红斑。
en: After a tick bite the tick is removed intact and redness observed.

zh: 蜱虫叮咬别硬拽，头断在里面更麻烦。
en: Do not yank a tick bite; a retained head is worse.

zh: 蜂蜇伤后出现全身荨麻疹需立即处理。
en: A bee sting with generalized hives requires immediate treatment.

zh: 蜂蜇伤先把毒刺刮掉，别用手挤。
en: For a bee sting, scrape out the stinger instead of squeezing.

zh: 清创需在麻醉下彻底清除坏死组织。
en: Debridement under anesthesia removes all necrotic tissue.

zh: 伤口得先清创，不然缝了也感染。
en: The wound needs debridement, or it will get infected even if sutured.

zh: 清创缝合在伤后六到八小时内完成最佳。
en: Debridement and suturing are best completed within six to eight hours of injury.

zh: 这个口子要做清创缝合，先打局麻。
en: This wound needs debridement and suturing, so give local anesthesia first.

zh: 伤口清洗用生理盐水反复冲洗。
en: The wound irrigation was done with repeated saline washing.

zh: 伤口清洗要彻底，别怕疼。
en: The wound irrigation must be thorough, even if it stings.

zh: 伤口探查发现肌腱部分断裂。
en: Wound exploration revealed a partial tendon tear.

zh: 伤口探查一下，看看有没有伤到筋。
en: Explore the wound to see whether a tendon is injured.

zh: 缝合时需对齐皮缘，避免张力过大。
en: During suturing the skin edges are aligned without excessive tension.

zh: 缝合前再冲一遍，别把脏东西缝进去。
en: Irrigate once more before suturing so nothing dirty is closed in.

zh: 单纯缝合适用于边缘整齐的浅表伤口。
en: Simple suture is suitable for shallow wounds with clean edges.

zh: 这个伤口单纯缝合就行，不用分层。
en: A simple suture will do for this wound, no layered closure needed.

zh: 间断缝合便于引流并可单针拆除。
en: Interrupted suture allows drainage and single stitches can be removed.

zh: 面部用间断缝合，线细一点。
en: Use interrupted suture on the face with a fine thread.

zh: 连续缝合速度快，但一处断开可全部松脱。
en: Continuous suture is fast but one break can loosen the whole line.

zh: 长伤口用连续缝合，快一些。
en: Use continuous suture for a long wound, it is faster.

zh: 褥式缝合常用于张力较大的伤口。
en: Mattress suture is often used for wounds under greater tension.

zh: 关张力大的口子用褥式缝合。
en: Close a high-tension wound with a mattress suture.

zh: 面部裂伤行皮内缝合，减少瘢痕。
en: Facial lacerations were closed with subcuticular suture to reduce scarring.

zh: 皮内缝合不用拆线，线会自己吸收。
en: Subcuticular suture needs no removal when an absorbable thread is used.

zh: 可吸收缝线常用于口腔黏膜与深层组织。
en: Absorbable suture is often used for oral mucosa and deep layers.

zh: 里面用可吸收缝线，不用再拆。
en: Use absorbable suture inside so it does not need removing.

zh: 皮肤缝合多用不可吸收缝线，按期拆线。
en: Skin closure usually uses non-absorbable suture removed on schedule.

zh: 皮肤这层用不可吸收缝线，七天拆。
en: Use non-absorbable suture for the skin and remove it in seven days.

zh: 面部伤口五天拆线，四肢伤口十天拆线。
en: Sutures are removed at five days on the face and ten days on the limbs.

zh: 今天可以拆线了，可能有点拉扯感。
en: The sutures can come out today; you may feel a little tugging.

zh: 清创缝合前给予局部麻醉，减轻疼痛。
en: Local anesthesia was given before debridement and suturing to reduce pain.

zh: 先打局部麻醉，等麻了再清创。
en: Give local anesthesia first and debride once it has taken effect.

zh: 浸润麻醉沿伤口边缘分层注射。
en: Infiltration anesthesia was injected in layers along the wound edges.

zh: 浸润麻醉打一圈，伤口就不疼了。
en: Infiltrate all around with infiltration anesthesia and the wound will stop hurting.

zh: 伤口感染需拆开部分缝线引流并抗感染。
en: Wound infection required opening part of the suture line for drainage and antibiotics.

zh: 伤口感染了，得把线拆开一点引流。
en: The wound infection means opening the stitches a little to drain it.

zh: 伤口裂开需重新清创并延期缝合。
en: Wound dehiscence requires repeat debridement and delayed closure.

zh: 伤口裂开了，先别急着重缝。
en: The wound dehiscence means do not rush to close it again.

zh: 伤口愈合不良需排查感染与营养状况。
en: Poor wound healing requires checking for infection and nutrition.

zh: 伤口愈合要忌口吗？正常吃饭就行。
en: Does wound healing need dietary restrictions? Eating normally is fine.

zh: 一期缝合适用于污染轻、伤后时间短的伤口。
en: Primary closure suits wounds with little contamination and a short delay.

zh: 这个伤口干净，可以做一期缝合。
en: This wound is clean, so primary closure can be done.

zh: 污染重的伤口行延期缝合更安全。
en: Delayed primary closure is safer for heavily contaminated wounds.

zh: 先敞开引流，过几天再做延期缝合。
en: Leave it open to drain and do a delayed primary closure in a few days.

zh: 伤口引流条放置二十四到四十八小时。
en: The wound drainage strip is left in place for twenty-four to forty-eight hours.

zh: 伤口引流放一根，明天看情况拔。
en: Put in a wound drain and decide about removal tomorrow.

zh: 引流条需记录数量，拔除时核对完整。
en: Drainage strips are counted and checked intact on removal.

zh: 引流条别塞太紧，不然引流不畅。
en: Do not pack the drainage strip too tightly or it will not drain.

zh: 污染伤口需彻底清创并延期缝合。
en: A contaminated wound needs thorough debridement and delayed closure.

zh: 这是污染伤口，不能马上缝。
en: This is a contaminated wound and cannot be closed immediately.

zh: 撕裂伤需修整皮缘后缝合。
en: A laceration is closed after the skin edges are trimmed.

zh: 撕裂伤边缘不齐，得修剪一下再缝。
en: The laceration edges are irregular and need trimming before suturing.

zh: 缝线粗细根据部位与张力选择。
en: Suture size is chosen according to site and tension.

zh: 缝线打结要牢固，别让它松开。
en: Tie the suture securely so it does not loosen.

zh: 缝合针持针时需与持针器垂直。
en: The suture needle is held at right angles in the needle holder.

zh: 缝合针别乱放，容易扎到人。
en: Do not leave the suture needle lying about; it can prick someone.

zh: 持针器夹住缝合针中后三分之一处。
en: The needle holder grips the suture needle at its middle to posterior third.

zh: 把持针器给我，我来缝这一针。
en: Pass me the needle holder and I will place this stitch.

zh: 破伤风可表现为牙关紧闭与角弓反张。
en: Tetanus may present with trismus and opisthotonos.

zh: 伤口脏就要想到破伤风，疫苗打了没有？
en: A dirty wound raises the question of tetanus; has he been vaccinated?

zh: 破伤风梭菌芽孢可在土壤中存活多年。
en: Spores of Clostridium tetani can survive in soil for years.

zh: 破伤风梭菌在缺氧的深伤口里容易繁殖。
en: Clostridium tetani multiplies readily in deep oxygen-poor wounds.

zh: 破伤风抗毒素注射前需做皮试。
en: A skin test is required before tetanus antitoxin is given.

zh: 破伤风抗毒素要先皮试，别直接打。
en: Tetanus antitoxin needs a skin test first; do not give it directly.

zh: 伤口污染重者优选破伤风免疫球蛋白。
en: Tetanus immunoglobulin is preferred for heavily contaminated wounds.

zh: 破伤风免疫球蛋白不用皮试，直接打。
en: Tetanus immunoglobulin needs no skin test and is given directly.

zh: 破伤风类毒素是百白破疫苗的组成成分。
en: Tetanus toxoid is a component of the DTP vaccine.

zh: 小时候打的针里有破伤风类毒素，能管很多年。
en: The shots you had as a child contained tetanus toxoid and protect for years.

zh: 破伤风疫苗接种后局部可有红肿疼痛。
en: Tetanus vaccine may cause local redness and pain after injection.

zh: 破伤风疫苗十年加强一次。
en: Tetanus vaccine is boosted every ten years.

zh: 破伤风预防需结合伤口类型与接种史。
en: Tetanus prophylaxis depends on wound type and vaccination history.

zh: 破伤风预防不是每个伤口都要打针，看情况。
en: Tetanus prophylaxis is not needed for every wound; it depends on the case.

zh: 主动免疫保护时间长，需数周才起效。
en: Active immunization gives long-lasting protection but takes weeks to work.

zh: 打疫苗属于主动免疫，管得久。
en: Vaccination is active immunization and protects for a long time.

zh: 被动免疫起效快，但保护只维持数周。
en: Passive immunization acts quickly but lasts only a few weeks.

zh: 打免疫球蛋白是被动免疫，马上有用。
en: Immunoglobulin gives passive immunization that works immediately.

zh: 儿童期完成基础免疫，成年后定期加强。
en: Primary immunization is completed in childhood with periodic boosters later.

zh: 基础免疫没打全，受伤后要补。
en: If primary immunization was incomplete, it must be completed after injury.

zh: 破伤风每十年加强免疫一次。
en: Booster immunization for tetanus is given every ten years.

zh: 加强免疫这一针别忘了，十年一次。
en: Do not forget the booster immunization, once every ten years.

zh: 疫苗接种史不详者按未完成接种处理。
en: When the vaccination history is unknown, the patient is treated as incompletely vaccinated.

zh: 您记得疫苗接种史吗？小时候打过几针？
en: Do you remember your vaccination history, how many shots as a child?

zh: 免疫接种记录需与患者自述核对。
en: The immunization record is checked against what the patient reports.

zh: 免疫接种记录带来没有？手机里也行。
en: Do you have the immunization record? A phone copy is fine.

zh: 伤口污染程度重者需延期缝合并加强抗感染。
en: Heavily contaminated wounds need delayed closure and stronger antibiotic cover.

zh: 先看伤口污染程度，再决定缝不缝。
en: Assess the wound contamination level first, then decide about closure.

zh: 清洁伤口可立即缝合，无需预防性抗生素。
en: A clean wound can be sutured at once without prophylactic antibiotics.

zh: 这是清洁伤口，缝完就能回家。
en: This is a clean wound, so you can go home after suturing.

zh: 破伤风皮试观察二十分钟看有无红肿。
en: The tetanus skin test is read after twenty minutes for redness and swelling.

zh: 破伤风皮试阴性才能打全量。
en: Only after a negative tetanus skin test can the full dose be given.

zh: 牙关紧闭是破伤风最常见的早期表现。
en: Trismus is the most common early sign of tetanus.

zh: 他牙关紧闭，嘴都张不开。
en: He has trismus and cannot open his mouth.

zh: 角弓反张提示破伤风已进入发作期。
en: Opisthotonos indicates that tetanus has entered the spasmodic phase.

zh: 看到角弓反张，基本就是破伤风了。
en: Opisthotonos like this is almost certainly tetanus.

zh: 苦笑面容与牙关紧闭常同时出现。
en: Risus sardonicus often accompanies trismus.

zh: 他脸上那个苦笑面容，是破伤风的典型表现。
en: That risus sardonicus is typical of tetanus.

zh: 肌肉强直从咀嚼肌开始逐渐波及全身。
en: Muscle rigidity starts in the jaw muscles and spreads over the body.

zh: 全身肌肉强直，碰一下就抽。
en: There is whole-body muscle rigidity and any touch triggers spasms.

zh: 轻微刺激即可诱发肌痉挛，需安静避光。
en: Even slight stimuli can trigger muscle spasm, so a quiet dark room is needed.

zh: 别大声说话，会诱发肌痉挛。
en: Do not speak loudly; it may trigger muscle spasm.

zh: 接种禁忌证排除后再补种疫苗。
en: Vaccination is given once contraindications to vaccination are excluded.

zh: 有接种禁忌证就先不打，等好了再说。
en: If there is a contraindication to vaccination, wait until it resolves.

zh: 免疫状态评估后决定是否需补种疫苗。
en: Immune status assessment determines whether extra vaccine doses are needed.

zh: 先做免疫状态评估，别盲目加打。
en: Do an immune status assessment first; do not just add shots.

zh: 破伤风发作后需进监护室并保持环境安静。
en: After tetanus onset the patient needs intensive care in a quiet environment.

zh: 破伤风发作起来很痛苦，得镇静。
en: Tetanus onset is very distressing, so sedation is needed.

zh: 破伤风抗体水平低者需加强接种。
en: Those with low tetanus antibody levels need a booster.

zh: 查一下破伤风抗体，看看还要不要打。
en: Check the tetanus antibody to see whether another dose is needed.

zh: 手术知情同意需由患者本人签署。
en: Informed consent for surgery should be signed by the patient in person.

zh: 手术知情同意我给您讲清楚，您再决定签不签。
en: I will explain the informed consent for surgery, then you decide whether to sign.

zh: 手术同意书需写明术式与主要并发症。
en: The surgical consent form states the procedure and main complications.

zh: 手术同意书您先看一遍，有不懂的问我。
en: Read the surgical consent form and ask me about anything unclear.

zh: 术前谈话记录需双方签字归档。
en: The preoperative discussion is recorded and signed by both parties.

zh: 术前谈话大概二十分钟，家属最好都来。
en: The preoperative discussion takes about twenty minutes; it is best if the family all come.

zh: 手术风险告知需包括出血、感染与麻醉风险。
en: Disclosure of surgical risks covers bleeding, infection and anesthesia risks.

zh: 手术风险告知不是吓您，是让您有准备。
en: Disclosure of surgical risks is not meant to frighten you but to prepare you.

zh: 该患者有明确的手术指征，应尽早安排。
en: The patient has a clear surgical indication and should be scheduled early.

zh: 手术指征明确，拖下去只会更危险。
en: The surgical indication is clear and delay only adds risk.

zh: 手术禁忌证排除后方可安排择期手术。
en: Elective surgery is arranged only after contraindications to surgery are excluded.

zh: 有手术禁忌证就先保守治疗。
en: If there is a contraindication to surgery, treat conservatively first.

zh: 手术方案经全科讨论后确定。
en: The surgical plan was settled after a departmental discussion.

zh: 手术方案有两套，先讲第一套。
en: There are two surgical plans; I will explain the first.

zh: 术式选择需兼顾根治效果与功能保留。
en: The choice of surgical procedure balances cure and preservation of function.

zh: 术式选择我们倾向创伤小的那种。
en: For the choice of surgical procedure we favor the less invasive option.

zh: 麻醉方式由麻醉医师评估后决定。
en: The anesthesia type is decided by the anesthesiologist after assessment.

zh: 麻醉方式有两种，全麻或半麻，都可以。
en: There are two anesthesia types, general or regional, and both are possible.

zh: 全身麻醉需术前禁食并评估气道。
en: General anesthesia requires preoperative fasting and airway assessment.

zh: 全身麻醉就是睡一觉，醒来手术就做完了。
en: General anesthesia is like sleeping; you wake up when the operation is over.

zh: 区域麻醉患者保持清醒，但手术部位无痛。
en: With regional anesthesia the patient stays awake but feels no pain in the operative area.

zh: 区域麻醉下半身没感觉，人是清醒的。
en: With regional anesthesia the lower body is numb but you stay awake.

zh: 麻醉风险需在术前访视时充分告知。
en: Anesthesia risk is fully explained during the preoperative visit.

zh: 麻醉风险不大，但签字是必经流程。
en: The anesthesia risk is low, but signing is a required step.

zh: 术前禁食一般要求固体八小时、清饮两小时。
en: Preoperative fasting usually means eight hours for solids and two hours for clear fluids.

zh: 术前禁食别忘了，偷吃东西手术要推迟。
en: Do not forget preoperative fasting; eating would delay the operation.

zh: 术前准备包括备血与抗生素皮试。
en: Preoperative preparation includes blood crossmatching and antibiotic skin testing.

zh: 术前准备都做完了，就等手术台。
en: Preoperative preparation is complete; we are just waiting for the operating room.

zh: 术后护理需观察伤口渗血与引流液性状。
en: Postoperative care involves watching the wound for bleeding and checking drain fluid.

zh: 术后护理家属也要学，回家才知道怎么做。
en: The family should learn postoperative care to manage at home.

zh: 术后并发症以出血与感染最常见。
en: The most common postoperative complications are bleeding and infection.

zh: 术后并发症发现了要早处理，别等严重。
en: Postoperative complications must be treated early, not when severe.

zh: 手术并发症包括神经损伤与切口裂开。
en: Surgical complications include nerve injury and wound dehiscence.

zh: 手术并发症概率不高，但发生了我们会处理。
en: Surgical complications are uncommon, but we will manage them if they occur.

zh: 二次手术风险高于首次，需重新评估。
en: Reoperation carries higher risk than the first operation and needs reassessment.

zh: 如果出血止不住，可能要做二次手术。
en: If the bleeding cannot be stopped, a reoperation may be needed.

zh: 急诊手术需在最短时间内完成术前准备。
en: Emergency surgery requires preoperative preparation in the shortest possible time.

zh: 这是急诊手术，签字后马上进手术室。
en: This is emergency surgery, so sign and go to the operating room at once.

zh: 择期手术前需完善检查并控制基础病。
en: Elective surgery requires completed tests and control of underlying disease.

zh: 择期手术不急，先把血压血糖调好。
en: Elective surgery is not urgent; control the blood pressure and glucose first.

zh: 替代治疗方案包括保守观察与介入治疗。
en: Alternative treatment options include conservative observation and interventional treatment.

zh: 替代治疗方案我也讲了，您可以比较后再定。
en: I have also explained the alternative treatment options, so compare them before deciding.

zh: 手术获益与风险需权衡后决定。
en: Surgical benefit must be weighed against risk before deciding.

zh: 手术获益明显大于风险，我们建议做。
en: The surgical benefit clearly outweighs the risk, so we recommend it.

zh: 该手术成功率约百分之九十。
en: The surgical success rate for this operation is about ninety percent.

zh: 手术成功率不是保证，个体情况还有差别。
en: The surgical success rate is not a guarantee; individual cases differ.

zh: 术前评估提示患者可耐受全身麻醉。
en: The preoperative assessment indicated the patient could tolerate general anesthesia.

zh: 术前评估要两三天，结果出来才能定手术。
en: Preoperative assessment takes two or three days and the operation is scheduled after the results.

zh: 术前核查由手术、麻醉与护理三方共同完成。
en: The surgical safety checklist is completed jointly by surgery, anesthesia and nursing.

zh: 术前核查走一遍，确认是哪条腿。
en: Run through the surgical safety checklist and confirm which leg it is.

zh: 患者主诉胸痛两小时，伴大汗和恶心，立即送入抢救室。
en: The patient reports chest pain for two hours with sweating and nausea and was moved to the resuscitation room.

zh: 您这个胸痛是什么时候开始的，是一直疼还是一阵一阵地疼？
en: When did your chest pain start, and is it constant or does it come and go?

zh: 他一爬楼梯就心绞痛发作，含服硝酸甘油两分钟就缓解了。
en: His angina pectoris is triggered by climbing stairs and eases within two minutes of sublingual nitroglycerin.

zh: 医生追问他心绞痛一般持续几分钟，会不会放射到左肩。
en: The doctor asked how long each angina pectoris episode lasts and whether it radiates to the left shoulder.

zh: 心电图和肌钙蛋白都支持急性心肌梗死，马上启动导管室。
en: Both the ECG and troponin support acute myocardial infarction, so the catheterization lab was activated at once.

zh: 家属担心急性心肌梗死要不要马上开刀，医生先解释了介入方案。
en: The family worried whether acute myocardial infarction needs immediate surgery, so the doctor explained the interventional option first.

zh: 心电图提示ST段抬高型心肌梗死，十分钟内完成溶栓知情谈话。
en: The ECG showed ST-elevation myocardial infarction, and the thrombolysis consent talk was finished within ten minutes.

zh: 确诊ST段抬高型心肌梗死以后，我们直接送您去做冠脉造影。
en: Once ST-elevation myocardial infarction is confirmed, we will take you straight to coronary angiography.

zh: 肌钙蛋白升高而心电图不抬高，考虑非ST段抬高型心肌梗死，先收观察室。
en: With raised troponin and no ST elevation, non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction was considered, and the patient was kept in the observation unit.

zh: 护士提醒非ST段抬高型心肌梗死也要按急性冠脉综合征流程处理。
en: The nurse reminded the team that non-ST-elevation myocardial infarction is also managed along the acute coronary syndrome pathway.

zh: 凡疑诊急性冠脉综合征，到院十分钟内必须完成首份心电图。
en: For any suspected acute coronary syndrome, a first ECG must be completed within ten minutes of arrival.

zh: 医生跟他解释，急性冠脉综合征要抽血看肌钙蛋白才能分清类型。
en: The doctor explained that acute coronary syndrome needs blood tests for troponin before the type can be identified.

zh: 胸痛患者到院第一件事就是做心电图，不能先排队挂号。
en: The first thing a chest pain patient needs on arrival is an ECG, before any registration queue.

zh: 您别紧张，心电图不疼，几分钟就做完，结果马上给医生看。
en: Do not worry, the ECG is painless and takes a few minutes, and the result goes straight to the doctor.

zh: 抽血查肌钙蛋白需要一小时出结果，期间患者不能离院。
en: The troponin blood test takes an hour, and the patient must not leave the department meanwhile.

zh: 医生说他肌钙蛋白阴性也不能马上回家，要复查一次。
en: The doctor said a negative troponin does not mean he can go home at once and that it must be repeated.

zh: 冠状动脉造影安排在明天上午，术前需要空腹并停用部分药物。
en: Coronary angiography is scheduled for tomorrow morning, and the patient must fast and hold some medications beforehand.

zh: 家属问冠状动脉造影风险大不大，医生说明了穿刺出血和造影剂过敏的可能。
en: The family asked how risky coronary angiography is, and the doctor described bleeding at the puncture site and possible contrast allergy.

zh: 经皮冠状动脉介入治疗在发病两小时内完成，患者胸痛明显缓解。
en: Percutaneous coronary intervention was completed within two hours of onset, and the chest pain eased markedly.

zh: 医生建议先做经皮冠状动脉介入治疗，比单纯吃药开通血管更彻底。
en: The doctor recommended percutaneous coronary intervention first, which opens the vessel more reliably than drugs alone.

zh: 当地医院没有介入条件，先给溶栓治疗再转院。
en: The local hospital had no catheterization service, so thrombolytic therapy was given before transfer.

zh: 医生交代溶栓治疗最大的风险是出血，出现头痛要立刻报告。
en: The doctor warned that the main risk of thrombolytic therapy is bleeding and that headache must be reported at once.

zh: 疑诊心梗先嚼服阿司匹林三百毫克，除非有过敏或活动性出血。
en: Chewable aspirin three hundred milligrams is given first in suspected myocardial infarction unless allergy or active bleeding exists.

zh: 护士问他对阿司匹林有没有过敏，以前吃过后有没有胃出血。
en: The nurse asked whether he is allergic to aspirin and whether it ever caused stomach bleeding.

zh: 血压允许的话先舌下含服硝酸甘油，五分钟不缓解再含一片。
en: If blood pressure allows, give sublingual nitroglycerin and repeat once after five minutes without relief.

zh: 含硝酸甘油后他头晕得厉害，护士马上量了血压并让他平卧。
en: He felt very dizzy after nitroglycerin, so the nurse checked his blood pressure and laid him flat.

zh: 突发撕裂样胸背痛要警惕主动脉夹层，先做增强CT。
en: Sudden tearing chest and back pain should raise suspicion of aortic dissection, so contrast CT came first.

zh: 确诊主动脉夹层后不能再用抗凝药，要马上联系血管外科。
en: Once aortic dissection is confirmed, anticoagulants must be stopped and vascular surgery called immediately.

zh: 术后长期卧床的患者突发呼吸困难，要想到肺栓塞。
en: Sudden dyspnea in a patient bedridden after surgery should prompt suspicion of pulmonary embolism.

zh: CT肺动脉造影确诊肺栓塞后，立即开始抗凝治疗。
en: After CT pulmonary angiography confirmed pulmonary embolism, anticoagulation was started at once.

zh: 这小伙子胸痛在平卧时加重、坐起来前倾就减轻，很像心包炎。
en: This young man's chest pain worsens when lying flat and eases when he sits forward, which fits pericarditis.

zh: 心包炎复查心脏超声是为了看有没有心包积液。
en: Echocardiography is repeated in pericarditis to look for pericardial effusion.

zh: 超声发现中量心包积液，患者暂无心包填塞表现。
en: Ultrasound found a moderate pericardial effusion without signs of tamponade for now.

zh: 复查超声看心包积液有没有增多。
en: Repeat the ultrasound to see whether the pericardial effusion has increased.

zh: 急性胸痛患者一律优先做心电图。
en: Every patient with acute chest pain gets an ECG first.

zh: 您这种急性胸痛不能自己走回家，要留观。
en: With acute chest pain like this you cannot walk home alone and need observation.

zh: 他说的放射痛一直到左手臂内侧和小指。
en: He described radiating pain that reached the inner left arm and little finger.

zh: 有没有放射痛、放射到哪里，对判断胸痛原因很关键。
en: Whether there is radiating pain and where it travels is key to judging the cause of chest pain.

zh: 他说是压榨性胸痛，像有块石头压在胸口，喘不上气。
en: He described crushing chest pain, like a stone on his chest that made it hard to breathe.

zh: 典型压榨性胸痛超过二十分钟不缓解，要按心梗处理。
en: Typical crushing chest pain lasting over twenty minutes without relief should be managed as myocardial infarction.

zh: 动态心电图抓到一次心肌缺血，正好和他胸痛的时间对得上。
en: Ambulatory ECG captured one episode of myocardial ischemia that matched the timing of his chest pain.

zh: 心肌缺血不一定疼，糖尿病患者可能只表现为气短乏力。
en: Myocardial ischemia is not always painful, and diabetic patients may only report breathlessness and fatigue.

zh: 他常在后半夜出现冠状动脉痉挛，白天造影却是正常的。
en: His coronary artery spasm usually occurs after midnight, while daytime angiography looks normal.

zh: 医生加了钙通道阻滞剂来预防冠状动脉痉挛再发作。
en: The doctor added a calcium channel blocker to prevent another coronary artery spasm.

zh: 大面积心梗后出现心源性休克，需要升压药和紧急再灌注。
en: Cardiogenic shock after a large myocardial infarction requires vasopressors and urgent reperfusion.

zh: 护士发现他四肢湿冷、尿量减少，提醒医生警惕心源性休克。
en: The nurse found his limbs cold and urine output low and warned the doctor to watch for cardiogenic shock.

zh: 他这两天休息时也犯病，属于不稳定型心绞痛，不能回家。
en: His pain now comes at rest, which is unstable angina, so he cannot go home.

zh: 不稳定型心绞痛要按急性冠脉综合征处理，抽血查肌钙蛋白。
en: Unstable angina is managed as acute coronary syndrome with blood tests for troponin.

zh: 老人说不清疼，只说心前区不适，我们照样给他做了心电图。
en: The elderly man could not describe pain and only reported precordial discomfort, so we did an ECG anyway.

zh: 心前区不适伴出冷汗，即使不疼也要当心梗筛查。
en: Precordial discomfort with cold sweats still warrants myocardial infarction screening even without pain.

zh: 急诊胸痛先做危险分层，低危的才能进观察室随访。
en: Chest pain in the emergency department is first risk stratified, and only low-risk patients go to observation.

zh: 危险分层为高危的患者，我们不建议离院观察。
en: For patients whose risk stratification is high, we do not advise observation at home.

zh: 支架植入后要规范双联抗血小板治疗，不能自己停药。
en: After stent placement, dual antiplatelet therapy must be taken as prescribed and never stopped on one's own.

zh: 医生交代双联抗血小板治疗期间出现黑便要马上回来。
en: The doctor warned that black stools during dual antiplatelet therapy require an immediate return visit.

zh: 房室结折返性心动过速突发突止，心率可达一百八。
en: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia starts and stops abruptly and the rate can reach one hundred eighty.

zh: 她反复房室结折返性心动过速，建议做射频消融。
en: She has recurrent atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia, so ablation was advised.

zh: 心电图是心房颤动，心室率一百四十次，先控制心率。
en: The ECG showed atrial fibrillation with a ventricular rate of one hundred forty, so rate control came first.

zh: 心房颤动最大的危险是脑卒中，需要评估要不要长期抗凝。
en: The main danger of atrial fibrillation is stroke, so it must be assessed for long-term anticoagulation.

zh: 心房扑动的心电图有典型锯齿波，心室率常是成比例的。
en: Atrial flutter shows classic sawtooth waves, and the ventricular rate is often a fixed proportion.

zh: 医生用药物控制心房扑动没成功，改成电复律。
en: Drugs failed to control the atrial flutter, so electrical cardioversion was used instead.

zh: 监护提示室性心动过速，患者意识还在，准备同步电复律。
en: The monitor showed ventricular tachycardia with the patient still conscious, so synchronized cardioversion was prepared.

zh: 无脉性室性心动过速按心脏骤停处理，立即开始按压。
en: Pulseless ventricular tachycardia is managed as cardiac arrest with immediate chest compressions.

zh: 心电监护见尖端扭转型室速，立即静脉补镁。
en: The monitor showed torsades de pointes, so intravenous magnesium was given at once.

zh: 低钾会诱发尖端扭转型室速，先把钾补上来。
en: Low potassium can trigger torsades de pointes, so potassium was corrected first.

zh: 她突发室上性心动过速，心率一百八，先试迷走神经刺激。
en: She had sudden supraventricular tachycardia at a rate of one hundred eighty, so vagal maneuvers were tried first.

zh: 室上性心动过速多数血流动力学稳定，可以先用药物转复。
en: Most supraventricular tachycardia is hemodynamically stable and can be converted with drugs first.

zh: 他是窦性心动过缓，心率四十八次，但没有头晕就暂时观察。
en: He has sinus bradycardia at forty eight beats per minute, but without dizziness it is simply observed.

zh: 运动员的窦性心动过缓多半是生理性的，不用紧张。
en: Sinus bradycardia in athletes is mostly physiological and no cause for alarm.

zh: 窦性心动过速只是表现，要找发热、疼痛还是失血的原因。
en: Sinus tachycardia is only a sign, so look for fever, pain, or blood loss as the cause.

zh: 补液后他的窦性心动过速慢慢降下来了。
en: His sinus tachycardia gradually settled after fluid replacement.

zh: 动态心电图报告偶发室性期前收缩，一天不到一百次。
en: The ambulatory ECG reported infrequent premature ventricular contractions, fewer than one hundred a day.

zh: 频发室性期前收缩要查电解质和心脏结构。
en: Frequent premature ventricular contractions warrant checks of electrolytes and cardiac structure.

zh: 她说心慌像漏跳一下，心电图是房性期前收缩。
en: She described her palpitations as a skipped beat, and the ECG showed premature atrial contractions.

zh: 少喝浓茶和咖啡，房性期前收缩往往就少了。
en: Cutting back on strong tea and coffee usually reduces premature atrial contractions.

zh: 他是二度房室传导阻滞，心率掉到四十次时眼前发黑。
en: He has second-degree atrioventricular block and blacked out when the rate dropped to forty.

zh: 三度房室传导阻滞要尽快装临时起搏器。
en: Third-degree atrioventricular block needs a temporary pacemaker as soon as possible.

zh: 病态窦房结综合征的患者反复晕倒，最终装了永久起搏器。
en: The patient with sick sinus syndrome kept fainting and eventually received a permanent pacemaker.

zh: 动态心电图发现五秒长间歇，支持病态窦房结综合征。
en: Ambulatory ECG found a five-second pause, supporting sick sinus syndrome.

zh: 心电图看到预激波，诊断预激综合征，建议做射频消融。
en: A delta wave on the ECG led to a diagnosis of pre-excitation syndrome and a recommendation for radiofrequency ablation.

zh: 预激综合征合并房颤时不能用某些房室结药物。
en: Some atrioventricular node blockers must be avoided when pre-excitation syndrome coexists with atrial fibrillation.

zh: 房颤持续时间不长，今天安排电复律，术前要镇静。
en: The atrial fibrillation is recent, so electrical cardioversion is scheduled today with sedation.

zh: 电复律后要连续监护几小时，看心律会不会再变。
en: After electrical cardioversion the rhythm is monitored for several hours in case it changes again.

zh: 医生选了静脉抗心律失常药物，同时监测血压和心电图。
en: The doctor chose an intravenous antiarrhythmic drug while monitoring blood pressure and ECG.

zh: 抗心律失常药物本身也可能致心律失常，用药后要复查心电图。
en: Antiarhythmic drugs can themselves trigger arrhythmia, so the ECG is repeated after dosing.

zh: 动态心电图要背一天，洗澡时取下来，不舒服随时记录时间。
en: Holter monitoring lasts a full day; take it off for showers and note the time of any symptoms.

zh: 普通心电图正常但症状反复，最好做一次动态心电图。
en: If the resting ECG is normal but symptoms recur, Holter monitoring is the better test.

zh: 他的室上速反复发作，做了射频消融后半年没再犯。
en: After repeated supraventricular tachycardia he underwent radiofrequency ablation and has had no attacks for six months.

zh: 射频消融前要做电生理检查，把病灶位置定下来。
en: An electrophysiological study is done before radiofrequency ablation to localize the target.

zh: 心率只有三十几次，医生建议装人工心脏起搏器。
en: With a rate of only about thirty, the doctor advised implanting a pacemaker.

zh: 装上人工心脏起搏器后，过安检门要提前告诉工作人员。
en: After a pacemaker is fitted, tell security staff before walking through metal detectors.

zh: 他有家族猝死史，医生建议植入式心律转复除颤器预防猝死。
en: With a family history of sudden death, the doctor advised an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator.

zh: 植入式心律转复除颤器放电时患者会觉得胸口被重重一击。
en: When an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator fires, the patient feels a heavy blow to the chest.

zh: QT间期五百二十毫秒，要注意药物影响。
en: The QT interval was five hundred twenty milliseconds, so drug effects were reviewed.

zh: 用这类药要监测QT间期，别和别的延长药一起用。
en: Monitor the QT interval with these drugs and avoid combining them with other prolonging agents.

zh: 心电图呈左束支传导阻滞，要结合症状判断是不是新发的。
en: The ECG showed left bundle branch block, and symptoms help decide whether it is new.

zh: 新发左束支传导阻滞伴胸痛，按急性心梗处理。
en: New left bundle branch block with chest pain is managed as acute myocardial infarction.

zh: 他主诉心悸伴出汗，先做心电图排除快速心律失常。
en: He reported palpitations with sweating, so an ECG was done first to exclude a rapid arrhythmia.

zh: 心悸不一定是心脏病，甲亢和贫血也会引起。
en: Palpitations do not always mean heart disease, since hyperthyroidism and anemia can cause them too.

zh: 年轻女孩反复晕倒，心电图提示长QT综合征。
en: A young girl kept fainting, and the ECG suggested long QT syndrome.

zh: 长QT综合征患者要避免用延长QT间期的药物。
en: Patients with long QT syndrome must avoid drugs that prolong the QT interval.

zh: 他晕倒时面色苍白、几秒钟就醒了，符合阿斯综合征。
en: He went pale and woke within seconds after fainting, which fits Adams-Stokes syndrome.

zh: 阿斯综合征一确诊就要评估起搏器指征。
en: Once Adams-Stokes syndrome is diagnosed, pacing indications must be assessed.

zh: 心衰合并左束支阻滞，评估心脏再同步治疗指征。
en: Heart failure with left bundle branch block prompted assessment for cardiac resynchronization therapy.

zh: 装了心脏再同步治疗以后，他走路没那么喘了。
en: After cardiac resynchronization therapy he was less breathless when walking.

zh: 先教他做迷走神经刺激，屏气用力像解大便那样。
en: First teach him a vagal maneuver: hold the breath and strain as if passing stool.

zh: 迷走神经刺激无效，改用静脉药物转复心律。
en: The vagal maneuver failed, so intravenous drugs were used to restore the rhythm.

zh: 急性缺血时容易出现室性心律失常，要持续监护。
en: Ventricular arrhythmia is common during acute ischemia and requires continuous monitoring.

zh: 这类室性心律失常要考虑装除颤器，光吃药不够。
en: This kind of ventricular arrhythmia calls for a defibrillator, and drugs alone are not enough.

zh: 怀疑脑卒中要在到院十分钟内完成评估并启动卒中流程。
en: Suspected stroke must be assessed within ten minutes of arrival and the stroke pathway activated.

zh: 家属说他早上还好好的，突然就脑卒中了，说话也不清楚。
en: His family said he was fine in the morning and then suddenly had a stroke and could not speak clearly.

zh: 八成脑卒中属于缺血性脑卒中，时间窗内可以溶栓。
en: About eighty percent of strokes are ischemic stroke, which can be thrombolysed within the time window.

zh: 缺血性脑卒中患者到院要先做头颅CT排除出血。
en: Patients with ischemic stroke need a head CT first to exclude hemorrhage.

zh: 头颅CT看到高密度影，诊断出血性脑卒中，不能溶栓。
en: The head CT showed a hyperdense lesion, so hemorrhagic stroke was diagnosed and thrombolysis withheld.

zh: 出血性脑卒中首要处理是控制血压和降低颅内压。
en: Managing hemorrhagic stroke starts with blood pressure control and lowering intracranial pressure.

zh: 症状一小时就完全恢复了，医生说是短暂性脑缺血发作，仍要住院查原因。
en: The symptoms resolved within an hour, and although the doctor called it a transient ischemic attack, admission for workup was still advised.

zh: 短暂性脑缺血发作是脑卒中的警报，不能因为好了就回家。
en: A transient ischemic attack is a warning of stroke and must not be dismissed just because symptoms resolved.

zh: 基底节区脑出血三十毫升，神经外科会诊考虑是否手术。
en: There was a thirty-milliliter intracerebral hemorrhage in the basal ganglia, and neurosurgery was consulted about surgery.

zh: 脑出血患者躁动明显，先镇静并控制血压。
en: The patient with intracerebral hemorrhage was very agitated, so sedation and blood pressure control came first.

zh: 产后头痛伴视物模糊，MRV确诊脑静脉窦血栓形成。
en: Postpartum headache with blurred vision was diagnosed as cerebral venous sinus thrombosis on MRV.

zh: 脑静脉窦血栓形成要尽早抗凝，即使有少量出血。
en: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis is anticoagulated early even when there is minor hemorrhage.

zh: CT上左侧颞叶见低密度灶，符合脑梗死。
en: CT showed a low-density lesion in the left temporal lobe consistent with cerebral infarction.

zh: 脑梗死的范围越大，脑水肿和脑疝的风险越高。
en: The larger the cerebral infarction, the higher the risk of cerebral edema and herniation.

zh: 他还在溶栓时间窗内，马上抽血并联系家属签字。
en: He is still within the thrombolytic time window, so bloods were drawn and the family called for consent.

zh: 超过溶栓时间窗就只能评估取栓或保守治疗。
en: Beyond the thrombolytic time window, only thrombectomy or conservative care can be considered.

zh: 静脉溶栓前必须排除近期手术、出血和血压过高。
en: Before intravenous thrombolysis, recent surgery, bleeding, and very high blood pressure must be excluded.

zh: 静脉溶栓后每十五分钟评估一次神经功能。
en: After intravenous thrombolysis, neurological status is assessed every fifteen minutes.

zh: 大血管闭塞的患者做了机械取栓，术后肌力从零级恢复到三级。
en: The patient with large-vessel occlusion underwent mechanical thrombectomy and improved from grade zero to grade three power.

zh: 机械取栓的时间窗比静脉溶栓宽，但越早越好。
en: The window for mechanical thrombectomy is wider than for thrombolysis, but earlier is still better.

zh: 房颤患者突发偏瘫，考虑脑栓塞。
en: Sudden hemiplegia in a patient with atrial fibrillation suggested cerebral embolism.

zh: 脑栓塞的梗死灶常多发，与栓子来源一致。
en: Infarcts in cerebral embolism are often multiple and fit the embolic source.

zh: 住进卒中单元以后，康复师第二天就来评估吞咽和肢体功能。
en: After admission to the stroke unit, the therapist assessed swallowing and limb function the next day.

zh: 卒中单元里护士会定时翻身并教家属做早期康复。
en: In the stroke unit nurses reposition patients regularly and teach families early rehabilitation.

zh: 他右半边脸面瘫，眼睛闭不紧，要给眼罩保护角膜。
en: He has right facial palsy and cannot close the eye, so an eye patch protects the cornea.

zh: 脑卒中引起的面瘫常伴同侧肢体无力。
en: Facial palsy from stroke usually comes with weakness of the same-side limbs.

zh: 他左侧偏瘫，左上肢抬不起来，走路要人扶。
en: He has left hemiplegia, cannot lift the left arm, and needs help to walk.

zh: 偏瘫患者入院就要评估压疮和误吸风险。
en: Patients with hemiplegia need pressure sore and aspiration risk assessed on admission.

zh: 他听懂了但不说话，是运动性失语症，家属别以为他装聋。
en: He understands but does not speak, which is motor aphasia, so the family should not think he is pretending.

zh: 失语症患者要用简单手势配合沟通，不要大声催。
en: Communicate with aphasia patients using simple gestures and without rushing them.

zh: 他说话含糊是构音障碍，让他重复一句话就更明显。
en: His slurred speech is dysarthria and is even clearer when he repeats a sentence.

zh: 构音障碍和失语症不同，前者是说不清，后者是找不到词。
en: Dysarthria differs from aphasia: the first is unclear speech, the second is difficulty finding words.

zh: 卒中后吞咽困难要先禁食，等床旁吞咽评估通过再喝水。
en: Dysphagia after stroke means fasting until a bedside swallow assessment is passed.

zh: 吞咽困难的患者喝水最容易呛，要用增稠剂。
en: Patients with dysphagia choke most on water and need thickeners.

zh: 他形容雷击样头痛，一秒钟就疼到极点，马上安排头颅CT。
en: He described a thunderclap headache that peaked within a second, so an urgent head CT was arranged.

zh: 没有雷击样头痛的特点，可以先观察再决定要不要腰穿。
en: Without the thunderclap headache pattern, observation can come before deciding on lumbar puncture.

zh: 影像显示大片缺血半暗带，取栓后肌力明显恢复。
en: Imaging showed a large ischemic penumbra, and power improved clearly after thrombectomy.

zh: 缺血半暗带越小，溶栓获益越少。
en: The smaller the ischemic penumbra, the less there is to gain from thrombolysis.

zh: 超声发现重度颈动脉狭窄，与他这次卒中有关。
en: Ultrasound found severe carotid stenosis, which accounted for this stroke.

zh: 有症状的颈动脉狭窄要评估内膜剥脱手术。
en: Symptomatic carotid stenosis warrants assessment for endarterectomy.

zh: 卒中后癫痫发作要观察频率并决定是否用药。
en: In post-stroke epilepsy the seizure frequency is observed before deciding on treatment.

zh: 他卒中后癫痫第一次发作在病后第三天。
en: His first post-stroke epilepsy seizure came on the third day after the stroke.

zh: 体重算好剂量后，阿替普酶十分钟内静脉推注一部分。
en: After calculating the dose by weight, part of the alteplase was given as a bolus within ten minutes.

zh: 用阿替普酶后血压不能超过一百八，护士每十五分钟量一次。
en: After alteplase, blood pressure must stay below one hundred eighty, so the nurse measured it every fifteen minutes.

zh: 溶栓后头痛加重，复查CT发现出血转化，立即停用抗栓药。
en: Headache worsened after thrombolysis and repeat CT showed hemorrhagic transformation, so antithrombotic drugs were stopped.

zh: 出血转化高危的患者，溶栓前要反复核对影像。
en: Patients at high risk of hemorrhagic transformation need imaging reviewed carefully before thrombolysis.

zh: 血管内治疗对发病六到二十四小时的大血管闭塞仍可能有效。
en: Endovascular therapy can still help large-vessel occlusion presenting six to twenty four hours after onset.

zh: 家属同意做血管内治疗，签字后直接送导管室。
en: The family agreed to endovascular therapy and, after signing, the patient went straight to the catheterization lab.

zh: 缺血性卒中急性期要尽早启动抗血小板治疗。
en: Antiplatelet therapy should start early in the acute phase of ischemic stroke.

zh: 抗血小板治疗期间要注意牙龈出血和黑便。
en: During antiplatelet therapy watch for bleeding gums and black stools.

zh: 维持脑血流灌注是卒中急性期处理的核心目标之一。
en: Maintaining cerebral perfusion is a central goal in acute stroke care.

zh: 血压降得太快反而会减少脑血流灌注，加重缺血。
en: Lowering blood pressure too fast can reduce cerebral perfusion and worsen ischemia.

zh: 出院前用改良Rankin量表评了一次，评了两分。
en: Before discharge a modified Rankin Scale score was recorded and came to two.

zh: 改良Rankin量表评分超过二分，说明生活还需要别人帮忙。
en: A modified Rankin Scale score above two means the patient still needs help in daily life.

zh: 患者主诉呼吸困难，说话只能两个字一顿，立即给氧。
en: The patient reported dyspnea and could speak only two words at a time, so oxygen was started at once.

zh: 您这个呼吸困难是突然出现的还是这几天慢慢加重的？
en: Did your dyspnea come on suddenly, or has it built up over the past few days?

zh: 支气管哮喘患者接触花粉后发作，双肺满布哮鸣音。
en: The patient with bronchial asthma developed an attack after pollen exposure, with wheezing all over both lungs.

zh: 她有支气管哮喘史，每次感冒都会诱发喘息。
en: She has a history of bronchial asthma, and every cold triggers wheezing.

zh: 哮喘急性发作时先连续雾化沙丁胺醇，再评估要不要加激素。
en: In an acute asthma attack, nebulized salbutamol is given repeatedly before deciding on steroids.

zh: 孩子哮喘急性发作说不出完整句子，家长吓得一直哭。
en: The child in an acute asthma attack could not speak in full sentences, and the parents were in tears.

zh: 听诊双肺喘息明显，呼气相延长，先给支气管扩张剂。
en: Wheezing was obvious on auscultation with prolonged expiration, so a bronchodilator was given first.

zh: 老人家一活动就喘息，躺下更厉害，要查心功能。
en: The old man wheezes on any exertion and worse when lying down, so cardiac function needs checking.

zh: 他有端坐呼吸，躺平两分钟就憋得坐起来。
en: He has orthopnea and within two minutes of lying flat he sits bolt upright gasping.

zh: 出现端坐呼吸说明淤血已经很重，要马上利尿。
en: Orthopnea means congestion is already severe and diuretics are needed urgently.

zh: 他反复夜间阵发性呼吸困难，常常睡到半夜憋醒要开窗。
en: He has recurrent paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea and often wakes at midnight gasping and opens the window.

zh: 夜间阵发性呼吸困难伴双下肢水肿，基本可以考虑心衰。
en: Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea with leg edema makes heart failure the likely diagnosis.

zh: 他有慢性阻塞性肺疾病，这次痰变黄变多，是急性加重。
en: He has chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, and this time the sputum turned yellow and increased, indicating an exacerbation.

zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者不能吸高浓度氧，会加重二氧化碳潴留。
en: Patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease should not receive high-flow oxygen because it worsens carbon dioxide retention.

zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重期要给雾化扩张剂和无创通气。
en: Acute exacerbation of COPD is treated with nebulized bronchodilators and non-invasive ventilation.

zh: 这次慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重和天气变冷、痰多有关。
en: This acute exacerbation of COPD was linked to colder weather and increased sputum.

zh: 血气提示呼吸衰竭，氧分压五十，赶紧准备无创通气。
en: Blood gases showed respiratory failure with an oxygen partial pressure of fifty, so non-invasive ventilation was prepared quickly.

zh: 呼吸衰竭分一型和二型，处理方式不一样。
en: Respiratory failure is classified as type one or type two, and the management differs.

zh: 重症肺炎后出现急性呼吸窘迫综合征，氧合指数只有一百。
en: Acute respiratory distress syndrome developed after severe pneumonia, with an oxygenation index of only one hundred.

zh: 急性呼吸窘迫综合征要小潮气量通气，不能按常规潮气量给。
en: Acute respiratory distress syndrome requires low tidal volume ventilation rather than usual tidal volumes.

zh: 指脉氧只有八十五，低氧血症明显，先面罩吸氧。
en: The pulse oximeter read only eighty five, clear hypoxemia, so a face mask delivered oxygen first.

zh: 低氧血症纠正后他的烦躁明显好转。
en: His agitation eased noticeably once the hypoxemia was corrected.

zh: 血气二氧化碳分压八十，高碳酸血症已经很明显。
en: The blood gas carbon dioxide was eighty, so hypercapnia was already marked.

zh: 慢阻肺患者出现高碳酸血症时不能给太高浓度的氧。
en: In COPD patients with hypercapnia, oxygen must not be given at too high a concentration.

zh: 先雾化吸入支气管扩张剂，二十分钟后复评喘息。
en: Nebulized bronchodilators were given first and wheezing reassessed after twenty minutes.

zh: 他喷支气管扩张剂越来越频繁，说明哮喘控制不好。
en: He needs his bronchodilator more and more often, which means his asthma is poorly controlled.

zh: 沙丁胺醇雾化二十分钟一次，连做三次看效果。
en: Salbutamol nebulization was given every twenty minutes for three doses to assess response.

zh: 他自己在家喷沙丁胺醇不缓解才来的急诊。
en: He came to the emergency department because salbutamol at home brought no relief.

zh: 重症哮喘加静脉糖皮质激素，观察四小时再决定要不要住院。
en: Intravenous glucocorticoid was added for severe asthma, with reassessment after four hours to decide on admission.

zh: 长期吃糖皮质激素的患者突然停药会出现肾上腺危象。
en: Suddenly stopping long-term glucocorticoids can precipitate an adrenal crisis.

zh: 哮喘控制不佳时加吸入性糖皮质激素，规律用才有效。
en: In poor asthma control an inhaled corticosteroid is added and works only if used regularly.

zh: 吸入性糖皮质激素用完要漱口，防止口腔真菌感染。
en: Rinse the mouth after an inhaled corticosteroid to prevent oral fungal infection.

zh: 峰流速比平时下降三成，说明这次发作不轻。
en: Peak expiratory flow was thirty percent below his usual value, indicating a significant attack.

zh: 教患者每天早晚各测一次峰流速并记在本子上。
en: Teach patients to measure peak expiratory flow twice daily and record it in a diary.

zh: 抽血气分析要扎桡动脉，会比普通抽血疼一点。
en: Arterial blood gas sampling goes into the radial artery and hurts a little more than a routine blood draw.

zh: 血气分析结果回来，二氧化碳分压明显升高。
en: The arterial blood gas result came back with a clearly raised carbon dioxide partial pressure.

zh: 慢阻肺患者吸氧浓度过高会引起二氧化碳潴留。
en: Too high an oxygen concentration can cause carbon dioxide retention in COPD patients.

zh: 二氧化碳潴留加重时患者会嗜睡、胡言乱语。
en: Worsening carbon dioxide retention makes patients drowsy and confused.

zh: 孩子吸气时三凹征明显，哭声都变弱了，准备气道支持。
en: The child showed clear suprasternal retraction on inspiration and a weaker cry, so airway support was prepared.

zh: 出现三凹征说明呼吸费力已经很重，不能只看血氧。
en: Suprasternal retraction means breathing effort is already severe, and pulse oximetry alone is not enough.

zh: 急性肺水肿患者咳粉红色泡沫痰，坐位给氧并静推利尿剂。
en: The patient with acute pulmonary edema coughed pink frothy sputum, so oxygen was given sitting up with intravenous diuretics.

zh: 肺水肿好转后肺部湿啰音明显减少。
en: After the pulmonary edema improved, the lung crackles decreased markedly.

zh: 慢阻肺患者嗜睡、手扑翼样颤动，考虑肺性脑病。
en: Drowsiness with flapping tremor in the COPD patient suggested pulmonary encephalopathy.

zh: 肺性脑病改善通气后意识能明显好转。
en: Pulmonary encephalopathy improves markedly once ventilation is improved.

zh: 哮喘持续发作出现呼吸肌疲劳，是插管指征。
en: Respiratory muscle fatigue during a prolonged asthma attack is an indication for intubation.

zh: 呼吸肌疲劳的患者呼吸浅快、说话断句。
en: Patients with respiratory muscle fatigue breathe rapidly and shallowly and speak in broken phrases.

zh: 婴儿呼吸窘迫伴鼻翼扇动，需要马上评估。
en: The infant in respiratory distress with nasal flaring needed urgent assessment.

zh: 呼吸窘迫的患者说不出整句话，要优先处理。
en: Patients in respiratory distress cannot speak full sentences and must be prioritized.

zh: 支气管舒张试验阳性，支持哮喘诊断。
en: A positive bronchodilator reversibility test supports the diagnosis of asthma.

zh: 支气管舒张试验前要停用短效扩张剂六小时。
en: Short-acting bronchodilators are stopped six hours before a bronchodilator reversibility test.

zh: 患者说咯血两口，鲜红色带泡沫，先拍胸片。
en: The patient reported coughing up two mouthfuls of hemoptysis, bright red and frothy, so a chest film came first.

zh: 咯血和呕血要问清是咳出来还是吐出来的。
en: For hemoptysis versus hematemesis, ask whether the blood was coughed up or vomited.

zh: 老慢支患者长期吃茶碱，这次心慌要查血药浓度。
en: The patient with chronic bronchitis had taken theophylline long term, so a drug level was checked for his palpitations.

zh: 茶碱治疗窗窄，加量一定要慢。
en: Theophylline has a narrow therapeutic window, so any dose increase must be gradual.

zh: 患者腹痛六小时，先在右下腹，现在全腹都疼。
en: The patient had abdominal pain for six hours, starting in the right lower quadrant and now all over.

zh: 您这个腹痛是绞痛、胀痛还是烧灼样的疼？
en: Is your abdominal pain cramping, bloating, or burning?

zh: 急腹症患者先禁食、建立静脉通路，同时联系外科。
en: For acute abdomen, keep the patient fasting, secure intravenous access, and call surgery.

zh: 这例急腹症血压不稳，考虑腹腔内出血。
en: This case of acute abdomen had unstable blood pressure, suggesting intra-abdominal bleeding.

zh: 疼痛从脐周转到右下腹，超声考虑急性阑尾炎。
en: The pain migrated from the umbilicus to the right lower quadrant, and ultrasound suggested acute appendicitis.

zh: 急性阑尾炎伴发热和白细胞升高，准备急诊手术。
en: Acute appendicitis with fever and raised white cells prompted emergency surgery.

zh: 暴饮暴食后上腹剧痛，血淀粉酶升高，诊断急性胰腺炎。
en: Severe epigastric pain after a heavy meal with raised amylase led to a diagnosis of acute pancreatitis.

zh: 急性胰腺炎要禁食、补液并监测尿量。
en: Acute pancreatitis requires fasting, fluid replacement, and urine output monitoring.

zh: 右上腹痛伴发热，墨菲征阳性，考虑急性胆囊炎。
en: Right upper quadrant pain with fever and a positive Murphy sign suggested acute cholecystitis.

zh: 急性胆囊炎先抗感染和禁食，再请外科评估。
en: Acute cholecystitis was treated with antibiotics and fasting before surgical review.

zh: 体检发现胆石症多年，这次吃油腻后右上腹绞痛。
en: Cholelithiasis had been known for years, and this time fatty food brought right upper quadrant colic.

zh: 胆石症患者反复发作胆绞痛，建议择期手术。
en: Recurrent biliary colic in cholelithiasis usually leads to elective surgery.

zh: 腹部平片见多个液气平面，诊断肠梗阻，先禁食减压。
en: Abdominal films showed multiple air-fluid levels, so intestinal obstruction was diagnosed and fasting with decompression started.

zh: 肠梗阻患者呕吐后腹胀稍缓解，但仍需留置胃管。
en: After vomiting the distension eased slightly in this intestinal obstruction, but a nasogastric tube was still needed.

zh: 立位腹平片见膈下游离气体，考虑胃肠穿孔。
en: Free air under the diaphragm on an erect abdominal film pointed to gastrointestinal perforation.

zh: 胃肠穿孔需要急诊手术修补，先禁食并抗感染。
en: Gastrointestinal perforation requires emergency repair, with fasting and antibiotics first.

zh: 左下腹痛伴发热，CT诊断结肠憩室炎。
en: Left lower quadrant pain with fever was diagnosed as acute diverticulitis on CT.

zh: 结肠憩室炎多数抗感染即可，脓肿才需引流。
en: Most acute diverticulitis responds to antibiotics and only abscesses need drainage.

zh: 老人房颤病史，突发剧烈腹痛而腹部软，要想到肠系膜缺血。
en: In an elderly patient with atrial fibrillation and severe pain but a soft abdomen, mesenteric ischemia must be considered.

zh: 肠系膜缺血确诊后要尽快手术，坏死肠管必须切除。
en: Once mesenteric ischemia is confirmed, surgery should follow quickly and necrotic bowel must be resected.

zh: 他疼得满地打滚，是典型肾绞痛，先给解痉止痛。
en: He was writhing in pain with classic renal colic, so antispasmodic analgesia came first.

zh: 肾绞痛患者尿常规常见红细胞。
en: Urinalysis in renal colic commonly shows red blood cells.

zh: CT看到输尿管结石六毫米，先止痛再考虑排石。
en: CT showed a six-millimeter ureteral calculus, so analgesia came before measures to pass the stone.

zh: 输尿管结石合并感染发热要紧急引流。
en: A ureteral calculus with infection and fever needs emergency drainage.

zh: 消化性溃疡患者空腹时上腹痛明显，进食后减轻。
en: In peptic ulcer the epigastric pain is worse when hungry and eases after eating.

zh: 消化性溃疡要查幽门螺杆菌并按疗程用药。
en: Peptic ulcer requires testing for Helicobacter pylori and a full course of treatment.

zh: 他烧心反酸多年，胃食管反流病一直没规范治。
en: He had heartburn and acid regurgitation for years without proper treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease.

zh: 胃食管反流病引起的胸痛做心电图是正常的。
en: Chest pain from gastroesophageal reflux disease comes with a normal ECG.

zh: 超声提示中量腹腔积液，腹部膨隆明显。
en: Ultrasound showed moderate ascites with obvious abdominal distension.

zh: 腹腔积液患者抽液后呼吸困难缓解。
en: After fluid was drained the patient's breathing eased despite the ascites.

zh: 急诊先做腹部超声，看胆囊、胰腺和有无积液。
en: Abdominal ultrasonography came first in the emergency department to assess the gallbladder, pancreas, and any fluid.

zh: 腹部超声没看到结石，但不能完全排除。
en: Abdominal ultrasonography showed no stone, but that does not fully exclude one.

zh: 消化道出血患者先静脉抑酸治疗，等胃镜。
en: Patients with gastrointestinal bleeding receive intravenous acid suppression while awaiting endoscopy.

zh: 抑酸治疗要足量足疗程，不能疼了才吃。
en: Acid suppression must be given at full dose for the full course, not only when pain occurs.

zh: 术后频繁呕吐、上腹膨隆，考虑急性胃扩张。
en: Repeated vomiting and epigastric distension after surgery suggested acute gastric dilatation.

zh: 急性胃扩张要先禁食并留置胃管减压。
en: Acute gastric dilatation is treated by fasting and nasogastric decompression.

zh: 急性胰腺炎泵入生长抑素，同时严密观察腹痛。
en: Somatostatin was infused for acute pancreatitis while abdominal pain was closely watched.

zh: 食管静脉出血用生长抑素可以降低门脉压力。
en: Somatostatin lowers portal pressure in variceal bleeding.

zh: 质子泵抑制剂静脉给药，八小时一次。
en: The proton pump inhibitor was given intravenously every eight hours.

zh: 出院后继续口服质子泵抑制剂八周。
en: After discharge the proton pump inhibitor is continued by mouth for eight weeks.

zh: 腹痛、发热加黄疸，考虑急性胆管炎，要尽快引流。
en: Pain, fever, and jaundice pointed to acute cholangitis, so drainage was needed promptly.

zh: 胆管炎患者血压下降提示病情危重。
en: Falling blood pressure in cholangitis signals a critical condition.

zh: 急性胰腺炎六周后CT发现胰腺假性囊肿。
en: Six weeks after acute pancreatitis, CT found a pancreatic pseudocyst.

zh: 胰腺假性囊肿合并感染时需要引流。
en: An infected pancreatic pseudocyst requires drainage.

zh: 查了一圈没有器质性问题，诊断功能性消化不良。
en: After extensive testing showed no organic disease, functional dyspepsia was diagnosed.

zh: 功能性消化不良与情绪和进食习惯关系很大。
en: Functional dyspepsia is closely related to mood and eating habits.

zh: 他慢性腹痛两年，反复做检查都没找到原因。
en: He had chronic abdominal pain for two years, and repeated tests found no cause.

zh: 慢性腹痛患者要有耐心，不能每次疼都做CT。
en: Patients with chronic abdominal pain need patience, and not every episode warrants a CT.

zh: 重症监护患者出现急性胃黏膜病变，胃管引出咖啡样液体。
en: The intensive care patient developed acute gastric mucosal lesion with coffee-ground fluid from the gastric tube.

zh: 急性胃黏膜病变要停用损伤药物并抑酸。
en: In acute gastric mucosal lesion, offending drugs are stopped and acid suppression started.

zh: 呼气试验阳性，说明有幽门螺杆菌感染。
en: A positive breath test confirmed Helicobacter pylori infection.

zh: 根除幽门螺杆菌要联合用药十四天。
en: Eradicating Helicobacter pylori requires combination therapy for fourteen days.

zh: 术后第三天腹胀明显、没有排气，是麻痹性肠梗阻。
en: Marked distension and no flatus on the third postoperative day indicated paralytic ileus.

zh: 麻痹性肠梗阻以纠正电解质和胃肠减压为主，多数不用手术。
en: Paralytic ileus is mainly managed by correcting electrolytes and decompression, and usually needs no surgery.

zh: 患者消化道出血量大，先建立两条静脉通路。
en: With heavy gastrointestinal bleeding, two intravenous lines were secured first.

zh: 消化道出血要先判断是上消化道还是下消化道。
en: In gastrointestinal bleeding, first decide whether it is upper or lower tract.

zh: 上消化道出血最常见的原因是消化性溃疡。
en: The most common cause of upper gastrointestinal bleeding is peptic ulcer.

zh: 上消化道出血患者呕血两次，血压开始往下走。
en: The patient with upper gastrointestinal bleeding vomited blood twice and blood pressure began to fall.

zh: 下消化道出血以鲜血便为主，要查结肠镜。
