en: Patient responsibilities should be explained along with rights.

zh: 患者义务包括如实说用药史，这点常被忽略。
en: Patient responsibilities include reporting medication history, which is often overlooked.

zh: 申诉须在规定期限内提出。
en: An appeal must be filed within the set period.

zh: 患者对答复不满，可以走申诉程序。
en: If the patient is unhappy with the reply, they may use the appeal process.

zh: 回访记录应纳入满意度管理。
en: Follow-up records should feed into satisfaction management.

zh: 回访发现患者伤口红肿，让他马上回来。
en: The follow-up call found wound redness, so we asked the patient to return at once.

zh: 服务承诺须可考核、可追责。
en: Service commitments must be measurable and accountable.

zh: 服务承诺写了候诊不超过三十分钟，就要做到。
en: The service commitment says waiting under thirty minutes, so we must meet it.

zh: 隐私保护贯穿诊疗全过程。
en: Privacy protection runs through the whole care process.

zh: 这里人多，我们换个地方谈，保护您的隐私。
en: It is crowded here, so let us talk somewhere private to protect your privacy.

zh: 数据保护需技术与制度双管齐下。
en: Data protection needs both technical and policy measures.

zh: 数据保护检查下周来，先把台账整理好。
en: The data protection inspection is next week, so organize the records first.

zh: 医疗保密有法定例外情形。
en: Medical confidentiality has statutory exceptions.

zh: 医疗保密不等于对家属一概不说，要看患者意愿。
en: Medical confidentiality does not mean saying nothing to family; it follows the patient's wishes.

zh: 信息泄露须按规定上报并处置。
en: Information leakage must be reported and handled per regulations.

zh: 发生信息泄露，先封账号再上报。
en: When information leakage occurs, freeze the account first, then report.

zh: 匿名化后的数据不再属于个人信息。
en: Anonymized data is no longer personal information.

zh: 匿名化处理过的统计结果可以对外发布。
en: Anonymized statistical results may be published.

zh: 数据脱敏须保留必要的业务可读性。
en: Data masking must keep enough readability for the business.

zh: 演示环境的数据要脱敏，手机号只留后四位。
en: Data in the demo environment must be masked, keeping only the last four digits.

zh: 目的限制禁止超范围使用数据。
en: Purpose limitation forbids using data beyond the disclosed scope.

zh: 目的限制写清楚，就不能拿去二次营销。
en: Once purpose limitation is stated, the data cannot be reused for marketing.

zh: 部分国家的医疗数据要求本地化存储。
en: Some countries require local storage of medical data.

zh: 数据本地化要求意味着东盟节点要单独部署。
en: Data localization means a separate ASEAN node is needed.

zh: 授权访问须按岗位最小权限配置。
en: Authorized access should follow least privilege by role.

zh: 授权访问有记录，谁看过一查就知道。
en: Authorized access is logged, so any viewing can be traced.

zh: 访问日志至少保存六个月。
en: Access logs must be kept for at least six months.

zh: 访问日志显示有人半夜查了病历，要核实。
en: The access log shows a record viewed at midnight, which needs checking.

zh: 权限管理须定期复核。
en: Access control must be reviewed periodically.

zh: 权限管理收回要及时，调岗当天就改。
en: Access control must be revoked promptly, changed the day of transfer.

zh: 网络安全等级保护须定期测评。
en: Cybersecurity classified protection requires periodic assessment.

zh: 网络安全演练发现钓鱼邮件很容易中招。
en: The cybersecurity drill showed phishing emails are easily clicked.

zh: 敏感数据传输与存储须加密。
en: Sensitive data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.

zh: 这份资料要加密发送，不要用普通邮件。
en: Send this file encrypted, not by ordinary email.

zh: 数据备份须异地存放并定期恢复演练。
en: Data backups must be stored offsite and restore-tested regularly.

zh: 数据备份每天凌晨跑，别在那个时候维护。
en: Data backup runs every early morning, so avoid maintenance then.

zh: 患者授权须写明使用范围与期限。
en: Patient authorization must state the scope and duration of use.

zh: 患者授权只签了宣传用途，不能拿去做研究。
en: The patient authorization covers publicity only, not research.

zh: 信息披露豁免包括传染病报告与司法调取。
en: Disclosure exemptions include infectious disease reporting and judicial requests.

zh: 这个属于信息披露豁免，不用再要患者同意。
en: This falls under a disclosure exemption, so patient consent is not required.

zh: 法定报告须在规定时限内完成。
en: Statutory reporting must be completed within the set time limit.

zh: 法定报告二十四小时内报，晚了要说明。
en: Statutory reporting is due within twenty-four hours; delays need explanation.

zh: 影像资料使用须取得单独同意。
en: Use of images requires separate consent.

zh: 影像资料使用要打码，眼睛也不能露。
en: Use of images requires masking, including the eyes.

zh: 录音录像须告知并取得同意。
en: Audio-video recording requires disclosure and consent.

zh: 诊疗区录音录像是为了安全，不是监视患者。
en: Audio-video recording in care areas is for safety, not surveillance.

zh: 预检分诊台设体温筛查岗，对所有到院患者先测额温。
en: A temperature screening post is set at triage, and every arriving patient has a forehead temperature taken first.

zh: 请您先到这边做体温筛查，稍等一下就好。
en: Please come here for temperature screening first; it only takes a moment.

zh: 症状筛查表包括发热、咳嗽、皮疹和腹泻四项必问内容。
en: The symptom screening form covers four mandatory items: fever, cough, rash and diarrhoea.

zh: 我先给您做症状筛查，最近有没有发烧咳嗽？
en: Let me run a symptom screening first. Have you had any fever or cough recently?

zh: 产科分诊将孕三十二周合并阴道出血者直接判为一级。
en: Obstetric triage assigns a woman at 32 weeks with vaginal bleeding directly to level one.

zh: 您先去产科分诊台，护士会根据孕周和出血情况给您分级。
en: Please go to obstetric triage; the nurse will grade you by gestational age and bleeding.

zh: 创伤分诊提示高处坠落患者，立即启动创伤团队。
en: Trauma triage flagged the fall-from-height patient and activated the trauma team immediately.

zh: 这个病人按创伤分诊要马上进抢救室，你们先准备。
en: Trauma triage puts this patient straight into the resuscitation room; please get ready.

zh: 患者生命体征平稳，予急诊留观六小时后复查心肌酶。
en: Vital signs were stable, so the patient was kept for emergency observation and troponin was repeated after six hours.

zh: 您今天先不用住院，在急诊留观观察一晚上，明早复查。
en: You do not need admission today; we will keep you under emergency observation overnight and repeat the tests in the morning.

zh: 留观区现有十二张床位，其中两张为隔离观察位。
en: The observation area has twelve beds, two of which are for isolation observation.

zh: 留观区在走廊尽头右转，家属可以在外面等候。
en: The observation area is at the end of the corridor on the right; family members may wait outside.

zh: 输液区护士每小时巡视一次，记录滴速与穿刺点情况。
en: Infusion area nurses round hourly, recording drip rate and the puncture site.

zh: 您到输液区找个座位，输液过程中不舒服马上叫我们。
en: Please find a seat in the infusion area and call us at once if you feel unwell during the infusion.

zh: 夜间挂号时段调整为二十二时至次日六时，每小时放号四十个。
en: The night registration slot now runs from 22:00 to 06:00 with forty slots per hour.

zh: 您预约的挂号时段是九点半，提前十分钟来就行。
en: Your registration slot is 9:30; please come ten minutes earlier.

zh: 护照翻译件须加盖翻译机构公章并与原件一并归档。
en: The translated passport must carry the agency's seal and be filed together with the original.

zh: 麻烦您提供护照翻译件，我们要核对姓名拼写。
en: Please provide the translated passport so we can check the spelling of your name.

zh: 该院已开通国际保险直付，合作保险公司名单在收费处公示。
en: The hospital offers international direct billing, and the list of partner insurers is posted at the cashier.

zh: 您的保险支持国际保险直付吗？支持的话我们直接和保险公司结算。
en: Does your policy cover international direct billing? If so, we will settle directly with the insurer.

zh: 挂号时须选择医保类型，选择错误将影响后续结算。
en: The insurance type must be selected at registration; a wrong choice affects later settlement.

zh: 请问您的医保类型是职工医保还是居民医保？
en: Is your insurance type employee or resident coverage?

zh: 导医台提供中英双语就医指引，含楼层索引与检查须知。
en: The information desk provides bilingual medical guidance, including a floor index and test instructions.

zh: 我给您一份就医指引，照着上面的顺序走就不会漏项。
en: Here is your medical guidance; follow the order and nothing will be missed.

zh: 门诊大厅设多语种导诊屏，支持中英越泰四种语言切换。
en: The lobby has multilingual wayfinding screens supporting Chinese, English, Vietnamese and Thai.

zh: 您用英文也可以，我们有提供多语种导诊的同事。
en: English is fine; we have colleagues who provide multilingual wayfinding.

zh: 导诊单上注明先抽血再拍片，两项都在二楼完成。
en: The guidance slip states blood draw first, then imaging, both on the second floor.

zh: 这张导诊单您拿好，按上面的顺序一项项做。
en: Keep this guidance slip and follow the order listed.

zh: 满意度回访由服务台在患者离院三日内完成，记录不满意项。
en: Satisfaction follow-up is completed within three days of discharge, recording any dissatisfaction.

zh: 我们稍后会对您做一次满意度回访，麻烦您接一下电话。
en: We will do a satisfaction follow-up call later; please take the call.

zh: 陪护告知记录须写明已交代跌倒预防与用药注意事项。
en: The caregiver briefing record must state that fall prevention and medication precautions were explained.

zh: 我给您做一下陪护告知，晚上要注意他起来会不会摔倒。
en: Let me give you a caregiver briefing; watch out that he does not fall when getting up at night.

zh: 重症病房实行探视预约，每次不超过两人、不超过三十分钟。
en: The intensive care ward uses visiting appointments, with no more than two people for thirty minutes.

zh: 探视需要提前预约，您扫这个码选个时间段。
en: Visits require an appointment; scan this code and choose a time slot.

zh: 转诊对接由医务处指定专人负责，三十分钟内回复是否接收。
en: A designated officer handles referral liaison and replies within thirty minutes on acceptance.

zh: 转诊对接已经联系好了，那边留了一张床给你们。
en: The referral liaison is done; they have reserved a bed for you.

zh: 城区急救响应时间中位数为十一分钟，超过十五分钟须说明原因。
en: The median urban emergency response time is eleven minutes; any delay beyond fifteen must be explained.

zh: 我们承诺急救响应时间在十五分钟以内，请您保持电话畅通。
en: We aim for an emergency response time under fifteen minutes; please keep your phone available.

zh: 患者恢复自主呼吸后取复苏体位，持续监测血氧。
en: Once spontaneous breathing returned, the patient was placed in the recovery position with continuous oxygen saturation monitoring.

zh: 他有呼吸了，先摆成复苏体位，别让他仰面躺着吐。
en: He is breathing now; put him in the recovery position so he does not choke lying on his back.

zh: 本次复苏按压分数为百分之八十二，高于质控要求的百分之八十。
en: The chest compression fraction was 82 percent, above the 80 percent quality threshold.

zh: 按压分数还不够，换人动作要快，尽量别停。
en: Our chest compression fraction is still low; switch compressors fast and keep interruptions minimal.

zh: 每班交接须核对抢救车封条与药品效期。
en: Each shift handover checks the crash cart seal and drug expiry dates.

zh: 抢救车推到床边，把肾上腺素和插管包都拿出来。
en: Bring the crash cart to the bedside and get out epinephrine and the intubation kit.

zh: 调度员依据急救优先分级调度系统判定为最高优先级并立即派车。
en: Using the medical priority dispatch system, the dispatcher assigned the highest priority and dispatched at once.

zh: 系统按急救优先分级调度系统判定您这属于紧急情况，车已经派出。
en: Under the medical priority dispatch system this is an emergency, and the ambulance is on its way.

zh: 社区急救志愿者在救护车到达前完成初步止血与安抚。
en: Community emergency volunteers controlled bleeding and reassured the patient before the ambulance arrived.

zh: 现场有急救志愿者在帮忙，你们到了直接接手就行。
en: Emergency volunteers are helping at the scene; you can take over when you arrive.

zh: 第一响应者在四分钟内到达并开始胸外按压。
en: The first responder arrived within four minutes and began chest compressions.

zh: 第一响应者已经到场了，正在做按压，我们马上接手。
en: The first responder is on scene doing compressions; we will take over shortly.

zh: 创伤患者在院前镇痛后疼痛评分由九分降至四分。
en: After prehospital analgesia the trauma patient's pain score fell from nine to four.

zh: 他疼得厉害，我们在路上给了院前镇痛。
en: He was in severe pain, so we gave prehospital analgesia en route.

zh: 收到费用担保函后，收费处按直付流程登记，不再向患者预收押金。
en: On receipt of the letter of guarantee, the cashier registers direct billing and stops collecting a deposit.

zh: 请您让保险公司发一份费用担保函，我们收到后就不用您先垫钱。
en: Please ask your insurer to send a letter of guarantee; once we receive it you will not need to pay up front.

zh: 口译伦理要求译员不替患者作答，也不对诊疗方案发表意见。
en: Interpreting ethics require the interpreter not to answer for the patient or comment on treatment.

zh: 按口译伦理，我只能如实转述，不能替医生解释病情。
en: Under interpreting ethics I can only relay faithfully and cannot explain the condition for the doctor.

zh: 医院在患者权利告知书中写明语言权与获取口译服务的途径。
en: The patient rights statement sets out language rights and how to obtain interpreting services.

zh: 您有语言权，可以要求我们提供口译，这不额外收费。
en: You have language rights and may request an interpreter at no extra charge.

zh: 科室每年开展文化能力培训，覆盖宗教饮食与丧葬习俗。
en: The department runs annual cultural competence training covering religious diet and burial customs.

zh: 我们尽量按您的文化习惯安排，这也是文化能力的一部分。
en: We will accommodate your cultural practices as far as we can; that is part of cultural competence.

zh: 预立照护计划应在患者病情稳定时启动，并记录讨论内容。
en: Advance care planning should start when the patient is stable, with the discussion documented.

zh: 趁您现在状态好，我们可以做一次预立照护计划，把以后的想法说清楚。
en: While you are stable, we could do advance care planning and record what you would want later.

zh: 不良事件上报后由医务处组织根因分析，七日内反馈整改意见。
en: After adverse event reporting, the medical affairs office conducts root cause analysis and gives feedback within seven days.

zh: 这件事我们要走不良事件上报，不是追究谁，是为了改流程。
en: We need to file an adverse event report; it is not about blame, but about fixing the process.

zh: 产后抑郁筛查在出院前完成，评分十三分以上转心理科。
en: Postpartum depression screening is completed before discharge, with scores above thirteen referred to psychiatry.

zh: 我们给您做一次产后抑郁筛查，就是几个问题，别紧张。
en: We will do a postpartum depression screening; it is just a few questions, please do not worry.

zh: 急救包内止血敷料每季度检查一次，过期立即更换。
en: Dressings in the first aid kit are checked quarterly and replaced as soon as they expire.

zh: 急救包在后备箱，先拿止血带和纱布出来。
en: The first aid kit is in the boot; get out the tourniquet and gauze first.

zh: 口译预约须至少提前四小时提交，急诊可即时呼叫。
en: Interpreting requests must be submitted at least four hours ahead, with immediate call-out for emergencies.

zh: 您需要哪种语言？我帮您提交口译预约。
en: Which language do you need? I will submit an interpreting request for you.

zh: 患者携带输液港，穿刺时须使用专用无损伤针。
en: The patient has an implantable venous access port, which requires a dedicated non-coring needle.

zh: 他胸口有个输液港，别在普通位置扎针。
en: He has an implantable venous access port on his chest, so do not use an ordinary site.

zh: 直升机停机坪夜间启用需提前打开边界灯并清空安全区。
en: Using the helipad at night requires switching on perimeter lights and clearing the safety zone.

zh: 救护车先送直升机停机坪，直升机那边已经准备好了。
en: Take the patient to the helipad first; the helicopter crew is ready.

zh: 长期机械通气患者于入院第十二天行气管切开。
en: Tracheostomy was performed on day twelve of admission for the patient on prolonged ventilation.

zh: 这个病人上气道长期不通，后面可能要做气管切开。
en: This patient cannot maintain the upper airway long term; a tracheostomy may be needed later.

zh: 一氧化碳中毒昏迷患者接受高压氧治疗两次后意识转清。
en: The comatose carbon monoxide poisoning patient regained consciousness after two sessions of hyperbaric oxygen therapy.

zh: 建议做高压氧治疗，对缺氧和中毒恢复都有帮助。
en: Hyperbaric oxygen therapy is recommended; it helps recovery from hypoxia and poisoning.

zh: 处方开具片剂两盒，嘱患者按说明书服用。
en: Two boxes of tablets were prescribed, and the patient was told to follow the package insert.

zh: 这个片剂一天三次，饭后吃。
en: Take this tablet three times a day after meals.

zh: 胶囊剂应整粒吞服，不要打开胶囊壳。
en: Capsules should be swallowed whole; do not open the capsule shell.

zh: 这个胶囊剂有点大，可以掰开吃吗？
en: This capsule is quite large; can I open it and take the contents?

zh: 缓释片必须整片吞服，掰开会导致剂量突释。
en: Extended-release tablets must be swallowed whole; splitting them causes dose dumping.

zh: 缓释片早上吃一次就行，晚上不用再吃。
en: You only need the extended-release tablet once in the morning, not again at night.

zh: 控释片的外壳可能随粪便排出，属于正常现象。
en: The shell of a controlled-release tablet may appear in the stool, which is normal.

zh: 控释片不能掰，掰了就不控释了。
en: Do not split a controlled-release tablet; splitting it destroys the controlled release.

zh: 肠溶片应空腹整片吞服，避免与抑酸药同服。
en: Enteric-coated tablets should be swallowed whole on an empty stomach and not taken with acid suppressants.

zh: 肠溶片别掰开，掰开就在胃里化了。
en: Do not crush the enteric-coated tablet; it will dissolve in the stomach instead.

zh: 分散片可投入温水中分散后口服，也可直接吞服。
en: A dispersible tablet can be dispersed in warm water or swallowed directly.

zh: 老人吞咽困难，给他开分散片吧。
en: The older patient has trouble swallowing, so prescribe a dispersible tablet.

zh: 口崩片置于舌面待其崩解，不要整片吞咽。
en: Place the orally disintegrating tablet on the tongue and let it disintegrate; do not swallow it whole.

zh: 口崩片不用水，放在舌头上就化了。
en: You do not need water for an orally disintegrating tablet; it dissolves on the tongue.

zh: 颗粒剂用温水冲服，水温不宜超过六十度。
en: Dissolve the granules in warm water not hotter than sixty degrees.

zh: 这个颗粒剂冲开有点苦，可以加点糖吗？
en: These granules taste bitter when dissolved; can I add some sugar?

zh: 口服溶液用专用量具量取，避免用汤匙估量。
en: Measure the oral solution with the supplied measuring device rather than a spoon.

zh: 口服溶液摇匀再倒，别直接对瓶喝。
en: Shake the oral solution before pouring, and do not drink straight from the bottle.

zh: 混悬液使用前充分摇匀，以保证每次剂量准确。
en: Shake the suspension well before use so that each dose is accurate.

zh: 混悬液放久了会沉底，喝之前摇一摇。
en: The suspension settles on standing, so shake it before drinking.

zh: 注射剂使用前应检查药液是否澄清、有无异物。
en: Before use, check that the injection is clear and free of particles.

zh: 这个注射剂要避光，配好马上用。
en: This injection must be kept away from light and used immediately after preparation.

zh: 粉针剂需用生理盐水溶解后静脉滴注。
en: The powder for injection must be dissolved in normal saline before intravenous infusion.

zh: 粉针剂先化开，别直接推。
en: Dissolve the powder for injection first; do not push it directly.

zh: 雾化液按医嘱加入雾化器，避免与其他药液混合。
en: Add the nebulizer solution to the nebulizer as prescribed and avoid mixing it with other solutions.

zh: 雾化液一次一支，用不完就扔。
en: Use one vial of nebulizer solution at a time and discard any leftover.

zh: 栓剂应冷藏保存，使用前去除外包装。
en: A suppository should be kept refrigerated and the wrapper removed before use.

zh: 栓剂塞进去以后尽量躺一会儿，别马上去厕所。
en: After inserting the suppository, lie down for a while and do not go to the toilet straight away.

zh: 贴剂应贴在清洁干燥无毛的皮肤上，并每日更换部位。
en: Apply the transdermal patch to clean, dry, hairless skin and change the site daily.

zh: 贴剂撕下来以后对折粘好再扔，别让小孩碰到。
en: Fold the used transdermal patch sticky side together before disposal to keep children away from it.

zh: 滴眼液开封后四周内使用，过期须丢弃。
en: Use eye drops within four weeks of opening and discard them after expiry.

zh: 滴眼液点完请按住内眼角，防止流入鼻腔。
en: After instilling eye drops, press the inner corner of the eye to stop the drops draining into the nose.

zh: 软膏剂薄涂于患处，避免覆盖过厚影响散热。
en: Apply a thin layer of ointment to the affected area and avoid thick covering that traps heat.

zh: 软膏剂涂完不用包，晾着就行。
en: You do not need to cover the ointment after applying it; just leave it open.

zh: 处方须写明药品规格，避免发错剂量。
en: The prescription must state the drug strength to avoid dispensing the wrong dose.

zh: 这个药有十毫克和二十毫克两种药品规格，别拿错。
en: This drug comes in two drug strengths, ten and twenty milligrams, so do not pick the wrong one.

zh: 复方制剂含多种成分，须核对是否与其他药物重复。
en: A fixed-dose combination contains several ingredients, so check for duplication with other drugs.

zh: 这是复方制剂，别再另加退烧药。
en: This is a fixed-dose combination, so do not add another antipyretic on top.

zh: 剂量根据体重与肾功能计算，不得随意加倍。
en: The dose is calculated from body weight and renal function and must not be doubled at will.

zh: 这个剂量是一次两片，别一次吃四片。
en: The dose is two tablets at a time, not four.

zh: 每日一次，早餐后服用，整片吞服。
en: Once daily, after breakfast, swallowed whole.

zh: 每日一次是每天同一时间吃，不是想起来才吃。
en: Once daily means the same time every day, not whenever you remember.

zh: 每日两次，早八点与晚八点各服一次。
en: Twice daily, at eight in the morning and eight in the evening.

zh: 每日两次就是早晚各一次，间隔差不多十二小时。
en: Twice daily means one in the morning and one in the evening, about twelve hours apart.

zh: 每日三次，餐后半小时服用。
en: Three times daily, half an hour after meals.

zh: 每日三次不要挤在一起吃，尽量隔开。
en: Do not take three times daily all at once; space the doses out.

zh: 每八小时一次，夜间也要按时给药。
en: Give it every 8 hours, including through the night.

zh: 每八小时一次是看钟点，不是跟着三餐吃。
en: Every 8 hours follows the clock, not mealtimes.

zh: 必要时口服一片，二十四小时内不超过三次。
en: Take one tablet as needed, no more than three times in twenty-four hours.

zh: 必要时就是难受才吃，不难受不吃。
en: As needed means take it only when you feel unwell, and skip it when you do not.

zh: 立即一次给予地塞米松十毫克静脉注射。
en: Give a stat dose of dexamethasone ten milligrams intravenously.

zh: 这个是立即一次，现在就去推。
en: This is a stat dose, so give it now.

zh: 睡前一次口服，服后不要再起床活动。
en: Take one dose at bedtime and do not get up and move around afterwards.

zh: 睡前一次，吃完就躺着，注意防跌倒。
en: Take it once at bedtime, lie down afterwards, and be careful about falls.

zh: 日剂量分两次给予，避免一次负荷过重。
en: The daily dose is divided into two administrations to avoid an excessive single load.

zh: 日剂量是全天总量，不是每次的量。
en: The daily dose is the total for the whole day, not the amount per dose.

zh: 处方须注明剂量单位，避免毫克与微克混淆。
en: The prescription must state the dosage unit to avoid confusing milligrams with micrograms.

zh: 剂量单位看仔细，微克和毫克差一千倍。
en: Check the dosage unit carefully; micrograms and milligrams differ a thousandfold.

zh: 该药单次剂量为五十微克，不得按毫克给药。
en: The single dose of this drug is fifty micrograms and must not be given in milligrams.

zh: 这里是微克，不是毫克，看清楚再推。
en: This is in micrograms, not milligrams, so check carefully before giving it.

zh: 胰岛素按国际单位计量，须使用专用注射器。
en: Insulin is measured in international units, so a dedicated syringe must be used.

zh: 这个国际单位不是毫克，换算要查说明书。
en: This is in international units, not milligrams, so check the label for conversion.

zh: 皮内注射后观察十五分钟判断皮试结果。
en: After intradermal injection, observe for fifteen minutes to read the skin test.

zh: 这个是皮内注射，会起个小包，别抓。
en: This is an intradermal injection; a small wheal will appear, so do not scratch it.

zh: 外用局部给药后不要立即覆盖敷料。
en: Do not cover the area immediately after topical administration.

zh: 这个是外用局部给药，别吃下去。
en: This is for topical administration; do not swallow it.

zh: 鼻饲给药前后各用二十毫升温水冲管。
en: Flush the tube with twenty millilitres of warm water before and after nasogastric administration.

zh: 鼻饲给药要把药碾碎化开，别整片推。
en: For nasogastric administration crush and dissolve the tablet; do not push it whole.

zh: 经皮给药可避免首过效应，但起效较慢。
en: Transdermal administration avoids first-pass metabolism but has a slower onset.

zh: 经皮给药贴在前胸或后背，别贴伤口上。
en: Apply the transdermal administration patch to the chest or back, not on a wound.

zh: 用药前须核对用法用量，尤其是儿童剂量。
en: Check the dosage and administration before use, especially for children.

zh: 用法用量写在盒子上，照着做别自己改。
en: The dosage and administration are printed on the box; follow them and do not change them yourself.

zh: 餐前服用可提高吸收，避免与食物同服影响。
en: Before meals improves absorption and avoids interference from food.

zh: 餐前服用是饭前三十分钟，不是端起碗才吃。
en: Before meals means thirty minutes before eating, not just as you sit down to eat.

zh: 餐后服用可减轻胃肠道刺激。
en: After meals reduces gastrointestinal irritation.

zh: 这个药餐后服用，空腹吃会胃疼。
en: Take this after meals; it causes stomach pain on an empty stomach.

zh: 空腹服用吸收更完全，但可能引起胃部不适。
en: On an empty stomach gives fuller absorption but may cause stomach discomfort.

zh: 空腹服用就是早上起来先吃药再吃早饭。
en: On an empty stomach means take it in the morning before breakfast.

zh: 随餐服用可增加脂溶性药物的吸收。
en: With meals improves absorption of fat-soluble drugs.

zh: 随餐服用就是吃饭时一起吃，别忘了。
en: With meals means take it together with your meal, so do not forget.

zh: 晨服可减少夜间排尿，避免影响睡眠。
en: Take it in the morning to reduce night-time urination and sleep disturbance.

zh: 晨服就是早上吃，别拖到中午。
en: In the morning means take it in the morning, not at noon.

zh: 缓释与肠溶制剂须整片吞服。
en: You should swallow the tablet whole when it is extended-release or enteric-coated.

zh: 这个药整片吞服，别掰成两半。
en: Please swallow the tablet whole; do not break it in half.

zh: 抗酸药嚼服后效果更快，须嚼碎再咽。
en: Chewed antacids act faster; chew thoroughly before swallowing.

zh: 这个是嚼服，嚼碎了再喝水。
en: This one is to be chewed; chew it and then drink some water.

zh: 医嘱写明顿服，即一日总量一次服完。
en: The order reads take all at once, meaning the entire daily amount in one dose.

zh: 顿服就是一天的药一次吃完，不是分三次。
en: The label says take all at once, so take the whole day's amount in one go.

zh: 日剂量较大时建议分服，减轻胃肠反应。
en: When the daily dose is large, divided doses are advised to reduce gastrointestinal effects.

zh: 这个药要分服，早中晚各一次。
en: This drug is given in divided doses: morning, noon, and evening.

zh: 颗粒剂冲服时水温不宜过高，以免破坏药效。
en: Granules should be dissolved in warm water, not hot, or the drug may be destroyed.

zh: 这个冲服，用温水化开再喝。
en: For this one, dissolve it in water and drink it; do not swallow the powder dry.

zh: 抗菌药物疗程一般为五至七天，不得随意延长。
en: The usual course of treatment for antibacterials is five to seven days and should not be extended at will.

zh: 这个疗程七天，吃完要回来复查。
en: The course of treatment is seven days; come back for review when it is finished.

zh: 出现不良反应须及时上报并记录在病历中。
en: Any adverse drug reaction must be reported promptly and documented in the chart.

zh: 吃了这个药有不良反应，身上起疹子。
en: I had an adverse drug reaction to this medicine; a rash appeared.

zh: 该药常见副作用为嗜睡，服药后避免驾车。
en: A common side effect of this drug is drowsiness, so avoid driving after taking it.

zh: 这个药的副作用是犯困，白天别开车。
en: The side effect of this drug is drowsiness, so do not drive during the day.

zh: 长期大剂量使用可致毒性反应，须监测血药浓度。
en: Long-term high-dose use can cause a toxic reaction, so drug levels must be monitored.

zh: 剂量太大出毒性反应了，赶紧停药。
en: The dose was too high and caused a toxic reaction, so stop the drug now.

zh: 药疹多出现在用药后三至七天，须立即停药。
en: A drug rash usually appears three to seven days after starting the drug; stop it immediately.

zh: 身上这个药疹是吃药引起的，先停。
en: This drug rash is caused by the medicine, so stop it first.

zh: 胃肠道反应明显者改为餐后服药。
en: For marked gastrointestinal reactions, switch to taking the drug after meals.

zh: 这个药胃肠道反应大，饭后吃能好点。
en: This drug causes strong gastrointestinal reactions, so taking it after meals helps.

zh: 用药期间出现肝损伤须停药并复查肝功能。
en: If liver injury occurs during treatment, stop the drug and recheck liver function.

zh: 这个药可能引起肝损伤，要定期抽血。
en: This drug may cause liver injury, so blood tests are needed regularly.

zh: 化疗后出现骨髓抑制，须监测白细胞与血小板。
en: Bone marrow suppression after chemotherapy requires monitoring of white cells and platelets.

zh: 这药会骨髓抑制，发烧要马上来。
en: This drug causes bone marrow suppression, so come in at once if you develop a fever.

zh: 联合用药时须警惕 QT间期延长，必要时复查心电图。
en: Watch for QT prolongation when drugs are combined and repeat the ECG if needed.

zh: 这个药会 QT间期延长，心电图先做一个。
en: This drug can cause QT prolongation, so do an ECG first.

zh: 注射部位反应多在数日内消退，可局部冷敷。
en: Injection site reactions usually resolve within days and can be treated with a cold compress.

zh: 打针的地方有点肿，是注射部位反应。
en: The injection site is a bit swollen; that is an injection site reaction.

zh: 使用头孢类抗菌药物期间饮酒可致双硫仑样反应。
en: Drinking alcohol during cephalosporin treatment can cause a disulfiram-like reaction.

zh: 这个药期间不能喝酒，会双硫仑样反应。
en: You must not drink alcohol while on this drug, or you may have a disulfiram-like reaction.

zh: 长期使用糖皮质激素须逐渐减量，避免撤药反应。
en: After long-term steroids, taper the dose gradually to avoid a withdrawal reaction.

zh: 这个药不能突然停，会有撤药反应。
en: You cannot stop this drug suddenly or you will have a withdrawal reaction.

zh: 说明书明确列出禁忌证，用药前须逐项核对。
en: The label lists the contraindications, which must be checked before prescribing.

zh: 他有禁忌证，这药不能用。
en: He has a contraindication, so this drug cannot be used.

zh: 肝功能不全者慎用，须减量并监测转氨酶。
en: Use with caution in hepatic impairment, with a reduced dose and transaminase monitoring.

zh: 这个药慎用，不是不能用，但要多观察。
en: Use with caution does not mean forbidden; it means the patient needs closer observation.

zh: 对本品过敏者禁用，标注须醒目。
en: Do not use in patients allergic to this product, and the warning must be prominent.

zh: 孕妇禁用，这个药不能开。
en: It is do not use in pregnancy, so this drug cannot be prescribed.

zh: 绝对禁忌须在病历首页醒目标注，避免再次误用。
en: An absolute contraindication must be flagged prominently on the front of the chart to prevent repeat use.

zh: 这个药是绝对禁忌，不能用，没有任何例外。
en: This drug is an absolute contraindication; it cannot be used under any circumstances.

zh: 相对禁忌不是绝对不能用，须记录权衡过程。
en: A relative contraindication does not mean the drug is forbidden; the weighing process must be documented.

zh: 这是相对禁忌，风险大但救命时还可以用。
en: This is a relative contraindication: the risk is high, but it may still be used to save life.

zh: 说明书标注孕妇禁用，育龄女性须先排除妊娠。
en: The label marks it contraindicated in pregnancy, so women of childbearing age must first have pregnancy excluded.

zh: 这个药孕妇禁用，你先把月经情况说清楚。
en: This drug is contraindicated in pregnancy, so tell me first about your periods.

zh: 该药儿童禁用，不得按成人剂量减半使用。
en: This drug is contraindicated in children and must not be halved from an adult dose.

zh: 这个药儿童禁用，孩子不能吃。
en: This drug is contraindicated in children, so the child cannot take it.

zh: 哺乳期禁用药物须改为暂停哺乳或更换品种。
en: For a drug contraindicated during breastfeeding, either suspend breastfeeding or change the drug.

zh: 这个药哺乳期禁用，吃了就先别喂奶。
en: This drug is contraindicated during breastfeeding, so do not feed the baby while taking it.

zh: 该药肝肾功能不全慎用，须复查转氨酶与肌酐。
en: Use with caution in hepatic and renal impairment, and recheck transaminases and creatinine.

zh: 他肝肾功能不全慎用这个药，剂量减半。
en: In his case, caution in hepatic and renal impairment means half the dose.

zh: 青霉素过敏禁用，用药前须核对过敏史。
en: Contraindicated in case of allergy to penicillin, so check the allergy history before use.

zh: 他对这个药过敏禁用，换一种。
en: He is allergic, so it is contraindicated in case of allergy; choose another drug.

zh: 黑框警告提示严重风险，须向患者明确说明。
en: A boxed warning flags a serious risk that must be explained clearly to the patient.

zh: 这个药有黑框警告，用之前要签字知情。
en: This drug carries a boxed warning, so the patient must sign consent before use.

zh: 镇静药与酒精产生协同作用，可致呼吸抑制。
en: Sedatives and alcohol have a synergistic effect that can cause respiratory depression.

zh: 这两个药有协同作用，剂量都要减。
en: These two drugs have a synergistic effect, so both doses should be reduced.

zh: 抗菌药物与某些药物存在拮抗作用，不宜同用。
en: Some antibacterials have an antagonistic effect with certain drugs and should not be combined.

zh: 这两个药是拮抗作用，一起吃白吃。
en: These two drugs have an antagonistic effect, so taking them together wastes the treatment.

zh: 利福平酶诱导明显，可使多种药物血药浓度下降。
en: Rifampicin causes marked enzyme induction and can lower the levels of many drugs.

zh: 这个药有酶诱导，会让他吃的其他药失效。
en: This drug causes enzyme induction and may make his other medicines ineffective.

zh: 大环内酯类酶抑制可致他汀类蓄积与肌病。
en: Enzyme inhibition by macrolides can cause statin accumulation and myopathy.

zh: 这个药酶抑制强，合用要减量。
en: This drug causes strong enzyme inhibition, so the other drug needs a lower dose.

zh: 该药经肝药酶代谢，合用抑制剂须减量。
en: This drug is metabolised by hepatic drug-metabolizing enzymes, so reduce the dose with inhibitors.

zh: 肝药酶慢的人，药容易蓄积。
en: People with slow hepatic drug-metabolizing enzymes accumulate drugs more easily.

zh: 高蛋白结合率药物合用时可发生置换性相互作用。
en: Drugs with a high protein binding rate can interact by displacing each other.

zh: 这个药蛋白结合率高，低蛋白病人要小心。
en: This drug has a high protein binding rate, so be careful in patients with low protein.

zh: 万古霉素须做血药浓度监测，防止肾毒性。
en: Vancomycin requires therapeutic drug monitoring to prevent nephrotoxicity.

zh: 这个药要做血药浓度监测，明天抽血。
en: This drug needs therapeutic drug monitoring, so blood will be taken tomorrow.

zh: 西柚汁与部分药物存在食物相互作用，须避免同服。
en: Grapefruit juice has a food-drug interaction with some medicines and should not be taken together.

zh: 这个药有食物相互作用，别跟牛奶一起吃。
en: This drug has a food-drug interaction, so do not take it with milk.

zh: 头孢类与酒精相互作用可致双硫仑样反应。
en: The alcohol-drug interaction with cephalosporins can cause a disulfiram-like reaction.

zh: 这个药有酒精相互作用，停药一周内别喝。
en: This drug has an alcohol-drug interaction, so do not drink for a week after stopping it.

zh: 中西药相互作用常被忽略，问诊须问草药。
en: Herb-drug interaction is often overlooked, so ask about herbal medicines during the consultation.

zh: 他在喝中药，注意中西药相互作用。
en: He is taking herbal medicine, so watch for a herb-drug interaction.

zh: 钙剂与左甲状腺素须间隔服药，至少四小时。
en: Calcium and levothyroxine require separate dosing at least four hours apart.

zh: 这两个药间隔服药，一个早上一个晚上。
en: These two drugs need separate dosing: one in the morning and one in the evening.

zh: 开方前须完成相互作用查询并记录结果。
en: Complete an interaction check and record the result before writing the prescription.

zh: 我先做个相互作用查询，稍等。
en: Let me run an interaction check first; please wait.

zh: 合并用药越多，相互作用风险越高。
en: The more concomitant medication a patient takes, the higher the interaction risk.

zh: 把合并用药都写下来，我看看有没有冲突。
en: Write down all your concomitant medication so I can check for conflicts.

zh: 孕妇用药须选择证据充分、风险较低的品种。
en: Medication in pregnancy should use agents with good evidence and lower risk.

zh: 你这是孕妇用药，我得查一下安全性。
en: This is medication in pregnancy, so I need to check the safety data.

zh: 哺乳期用药应选择乳汁分泌量低的药物。
en: Medication during breastfeeding should use drugs that pass into milk in low amounts.

zh: 哺乳期用药要谨慎，吃完四小时再喂。
en: Medication during breastfeeding needs care, so wait four hours after a dose before feeding.

zh: 儿童用药须按体重计算，不可直接减半成人量。
en: Pediatric medication is dosed by weight and must not simply halve an adult dose.

zh: 儿童用药有专用剂型，别掰大人的药。
en: There are specific dosage forms for pediatric medication, so do not split adult tablets.

zh: 老年用药应从小剂量开始，缓慢加量。
en: Geriatric medication should start at a low dose and be increased slowly.

zh: 老年用药要简化，一天一次最好。
en: Geriatric medication should be simplified, ideally once a day.

zh: 肝功能不全者须避免经肝代谢且肝毒性大的药物。
en: In hepatic impairment, avoid drugs that are hepatically metabolised and hepatotoxic.

zh: 他肝功能不全，这个药要减量。
en: He has hepatic impairment, so this drug must be reduced.

zh: 肾功能不全须按肌酐清除率调整剂量。
en: In renal impairment, adjust the dose according to creatinine clearance.

zh: 她肾功能不全，用药间隔要拉长。
en: She has renal impairment, so the dosing interval must be lengthened.

zh: 处方前须核对妊娠安全性分级，选风险最低者。
en: Check the pregnancy safety category before prescribing and choose the lowest-risk option.

zh: 这个药妊娠安全性分级偏低，能换就换。
en: This drug has a low pregnancy safety category, so change it if possible.

zh: 哺乳风险分级低的药物优先用于哺乳期。
en: Drugs with a low lactation risk category are preferred during breastfeeding.

zh: 查一下哺乳风险分级，再决定能不能喂。
en: Check the lactation risk category before deciding whether feeding is safe.

zh: 儿童剂量按每公斤体重计算，不得超过成人量。
en: The pediatric dose is calculated per kilogram and must not exceed the adult dose.

zh: 儿童剂量是每公斤十毫克，别按成人算。
en: The pediatric dose is ten milligrams per kilogram, not the adult amount.

zh: 老年剂量调整通常从成人量的二分之一开始。
en: Dose adjustment in older adults usually starts at half the adult dose.

zh: 老年剂量调整要慢，先吃半片。
en: Dose adjustment in older adults is gradual, so start with half a tablet.

zh: 透析患者用药须注意药物是否被透析清除。
en: Medication in dialysis patients requires checking whether the drug is removed by dialysis.

zh: 他是透析患者用药，这个药透析后补。
en: For medication in dialysis patients, this drug is given after dialysis.

zh: 新生儿用药须按日龄与体重精确计算。
en: Neonatal medication must be calculated precisely from postnatal age and weight.

zh: 新生儿用药剂量很小，要用专用注射器。
en: Neonatal medication doses are tiny and need a dedicated syringe.

zh: 体重剂量按实际体重计算，肥胖者须校正。
en: Weight-based dosing uses actual body weight, with correction for obesity.

zh: 这个药是体重剂量，先称一下体重。
en: This drug uses weight-based dosing, so weigh the patient first.

zh: 化疗药物按体表面积剂量给药，须精确测量身高体重。
en: Chemotherapy is given by body surface area dosing, so height and weight must be measured accurately.

zh: 这个药是体表面积剂量，不能按体重算。
en: This drug uses body surface area dosing, not weight-based dosing.

zh: 储存条件不符合会降低药效，须每日记录温湿度。
en: Failure to meet storage conditions reduces potency, so record temperature and humidity daily.

zh: 这个药储存条件要求高，得放冰箱。
en: This drug has strict storage conditions and must go in the fridge.

zh: 避光保存的药物须用棕色瓶或避光袋。
en: Protect from light any drug that is light-sensitive, using amber bottles or bags.

zh: 这个要避光保存，别放在窗台上。
en: Please protect from light and keep it off the windowsill.

zh: 冷藏保存的药品不得贴近冰箱内壁，以免冻结。
en: Drugs requiring refrigerated storage must not touch the freezer wall or they may freeze.

zh: 这个药冷藏保存，放冰箱中间那层。
en: This drug needs refrigerated storage, so put it on the middle shelf.

zh: 冷冻保存的样本须避免反复冻融。
en: Samples kept in frozen storage must avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles.

zh: 这个要冷冻保存，不能放冷藏层。
en: This one needs frozen storage; do not just refrigerate it.

zh: 室温保存的药品应远离暖气与直射阳光。
en: Store at room temperature and keep the drug away from radiators and direct sunlight.

zh: 这个室温保存就行，不用放冰箱。
en: You can store at room temperature; no fridge is needed.

zh: 发放前须核对有效期，过期药品一律不得使用。
en: Check the expiry date before dispensing; expired drugs must never be used.

zh: 看一下有效期，别给过期的。
en: Check the expiry date and do not give out expired stock.

zh: 出现不良反应时须记录批号并上报。
en: When an adverse reaction occurs, record the batch number and report it.

zh: 把批号抄下来，这批药要召回。
en: Write down the batch number; this batch is being recalled.

zh: 滴眼液开封后有效期仅四周，须标注开瓶日期。
en: Eye drops have an in-use shelf life of only four weeks, so mark the opening date.

zh: 开封后有效期到了就别用了。
en: Once the in-use shelf life is over, stop using it.

zh: 疫苗与胰岛素须全程冷链，断链后不得使用。
en: Vaccines and insulin need an unbroken cold chain; do not use them after a break.

zh: 这个药走冷链，路上不能断冰。
en: This drug travels in the cold chain, so the ice must not run out on the way.

zh: 配好的药液药物稳定性有限，须在规定时间内输完。
en: A prepared solution has limited drug stability, so it must be infused within the stated time.

zh: 这个药药物稳定性差，配好马上用。
en: This drug has poor drug stability, so use it immediately after preparation.

zh: 用药交代须包括剂量、时间、不良反应与储存。
en: Medication counseling must cover dose, timing, adverse effects, and storage.

zh: 我给您做个用药交代，有不懂的随时问。
en: I will do your medication counseling now; ask me anything you do not understand.

zh: 服药时间应相对固定，避免血药浓度波动。
en: The dosing time should be kept fairly regular to avoid fluctuations in drug levels.

zh: 服药时间最好写下来，贴在冰箱上。
en: Write the dosing time down and stick it on the fridge.

zh: 漏服处理原则是想起即补，接近下次则跳过。
en: Missed dose management is to take it when remembered, or skip it if the next dose is near.

zh: 漏服处理我教您一遍，别再自己加量。
en: I will explain missed dose management once, and do not take extra doses yourself.

zh: 停药告知须写明不可骤停的药物与减量方案。
en: Discontinuation advice must state which drugs cannot be stopped abruptly and how to taper.

zh: 这个是停药告知，吃完就该停，别自己续。
en: This is the discontinuation advice: stop when the course ends and do not continue on your own.

zh: 不良反应告知可提高患者警觉，减少严重事件。
en: Adverse effect counseling raises patient awareness and reduces serious events.

zh: 不良反应告知我讲一下，出疹子要马上回来。
en: Let me give the adverse effect counseling; come back at once if a rash appears.

zh: 用药教育应使用图示与白话，避免专业术语堆砌。
en: Patient education on medication should use pictures and plain words rather than jargon.

zh: 用药教育资料带回去，家里人也看看。
en: Take the patient education on medication leaflet home so your family can read it too.

zh: 分药盒可减少漏服，但须避光防潮。
en: A pill organizer reduces missed doses but must be kept away from light and moisture.

zh: 用分药盒把一周的药分好，不容易忘。
en: Use a pill organizer to sort a week of medicines so you do not forget.

zh: 喂药时应抱起取半卧位，不可捏鼻强灌。
en: For administering medicine to a child, hold the child upright and never pinch the nose to force it.

zh: 喂药的时候别硬灌，容易呛到。
en: When administering medicine to a child, do not force it, or the child may choke.

zh: 鼻饲服药前后须冲管，不同药物分开给。
en: For administering via feeding tube, flush before and after and give drugs separately.

zh: 鼻饲服药要一片一片化开，别混在一起。
en: When administering via feeding tube, dissolve one tablet at a time and do not mix them.

zh: 首次用药应观察过敏反应，尤其注射剂。
en: Observe for allergic reactions after the first dose, especially with injections.

zh: 首次用药先坐半小时再走。
en: After the first dose, sit for half an hour before leaving.

zh: 用药确认须核对姓名、药名、剂量与途径。
en: Medication confirmation must check the name, drug, dose, and route.

zh: 给药前做用药确认，别叫错人。
en: Do the medication confirmation before giving it, so the wrong patient is not called.

zh: 用药指导单须与处方一致，字迹清楚。
en: The medication instruction sheet must match the prescription and be clearly written.

zh: 这张用药指导单您收好，照着吃。
en: Keep this medication instruction sheet and follow it when taking your medicine.

zh: 依从性差会导致疗效不足与耐药。
en: Poor adherence leads to inadequate efficacy and resistance.

zh: 他的依从性不错，每天都按时吃。
en: His adherence is good; he takes the medicine on time every day.

zh: 不依从常见于多重用药与老年患者。
en: Non-adherence is common with polypharmacy and in older patients.

zh: 他是不依从，自己把药减半了。
en: He is showing non-adherence and halved the dose himself.

zh: 自行停药可致病情反跳或撤药反应。
en: Self-discontinuation can cause rebound of the illness or a withdrawal reaction.

zh: 别自行停药，有副作用先打电话问。
en: Do not practice self-discontinuation; call first if you have side effects.

zh: 服药提醒可设手机闹钟或由家属协助。
en: A medication reminder can be a phone alarm or help from a family member.

zh: 设个服药提醒，到点就响。
en: Set a medication reminder so it rings at the right time.

zh: 依从性评估可通过问询与药片计数完成。
en: Adherence assessment can be done by questioning and tablet counts.

zh: 做个依从性评估，看看这几个月吃得怎么样。
en: Let us do an adherence assessment to see how the last few months went.

zh: 多重用药增加相互作用与跌倒风险。
en: Polypharmacy increases the risk of interactions and falls.

zh: 他多重用药，得做一次全面梳理。
en: He has polypharmacy, so a full medication review is needed.

zh: 用药错误须上报并分析原因，避免再犯。
en: A medication error must be reported, analysed, and prevented from recurring.

zh: 这次用药错误是剂量看错了。
en: This medication error happened because the dose was misread.

zh: 入院二十四小时内须完成药物重整。
en: Medication reconciliation must be completed within twenty-four hours of admission.

zh: 转科前先做药物重整，别漏药。
en: Do medication reconciliation before the transfer so no drug is missed.

zh: 抗菌药物须按分级管理原则开具。
en: Antibacterial agents must be prescribed according to the tiered management rules.

zh: 抗菌药物不能随便吃，要有指征。
en: Antibacterial agents should not be taken casually; there must be an indication.

zh: 非限制使用级抗菌药物由主治以下医师开具即可。
en: Non-restricted category antibacterials can be prescribed by doctors below attending level.

zh: 这个属于非限制使用级，普通医生能开。
en: This is in the non-restricted category, so any doctor can prescribe it.

zh: 限制使用级抗菌药物须经主治医师查房同意。
en: Restricted category antibacterials require the attending physician's agreement on rounds.

zh: 这是限制使用级，得请上级医生签字。
en: This is in the restricted category, so a senior doctor must sign.

zh: 特殊使用级抗菌药物须经会诊与审批后方可使用。
en: Special-use category antibacterials require consultation and approval before use.

zh: 这个是特殊使用级，得开专家会诊。
en: This one is special-use category, so an expert consultation is needed.

zh: 经验性用药须结合本地耐药谱，不能凭感觉。
en: Empirical therapy must follow local resistance patterns, not guesswork.

zh: 现在是经验性用药，等培养结果再调整。
en: For now this is empirical therapy; adjust it when the culture results come back.

zh: 培养结果回报后改为目标性用药，减少广谱使用。
en: After culture results return, switch to targeted therapy to reduce broad-spectrum use.

zh: 药敏出来了，改成目标性用药。
en: The susceptibility results are back, so switch to targeted therapy.

zh: 降阶梯治疗可减少耐药与二重感染。
en: De-escalation therapy reduces resistance and superinfection.

zh: 体温正常两天了，可以考虑降阶梯治疗。
en: The temperature has been normal for two days, so de-escalation therapy can be considered.

zh: 滥用抗菌药物会加速耐药，须严格掌握指征。
en: Misuse of antibacterials accelerates drug resistance, so indications must be strict.

zh: 这个细菌已经耐药，普通抗生素没用。
en: This bacterium already shows drug resistance, so ordinary antibiotics will not work.

zh: 使用青霉素前须做皮试，阴性方可给药。
en: A skin test is required before penicillin, and the drug may be given only if it is negative.

zh: 皮试打了要等二十分钟看结果。
en: After the skin test you must wait twenty minutes for the result.

zh: 围手术期预防用药一般在切皮前半小时给予。
en: Perioperative prophylaxis is usually given half an hour before the incision.

zh: 这个是围手术期预防用药，术后不超过二十四小时。
en: This is perioperative prophylaxis and should not continue beyond twenty-four hours after surgery.

zh: 抗菌药物分级管理须在信息系统中设置权限。
en: Tiered management of antibacterials requires permissions to be set in the information system.

zh: 按抗菌药物分级管理，这个药要上级医生开。
en: Under tiered management of antibacterials, this drug needs a senior doctor to prescribe.

zh: 联合用药须有明确指征，避免无谓叠加。
en: Combination therapy needs a clear indication to avoid unnecessary stacking of drugs.

zh: 这两种药是联合用药，要一起吃才有效。
en: These two drugs are combination therapy and must be taken together to work.

zh: 滴速每分钟四十滴，须定时巡视。
en: The drip rate is forty drops per minute, and the line must be checked regularly.

zh: 滴速太快了，请调慢一点。
en: The drip rate is too fast, so slow it down.

zh: 溶媒选择错误会导致药物沉淀或失效。
en: Choosing the wrong solvent causes precipitation or loss of drug potency.

zh: 这个药只能用葡萄糖做溶媒。
en: This drug can only use glucose as the solvent.

zh: 冲管须使用与药物相容的溶媒，避免配伍反应。
en: Flush the line with a compatible solvent to avoid an incompatibility reaction.

zh: 两种药之间要冲管，别让它们在管里混。
en: Flush the line between the two drugs so they do not mix in the tubing.

zh: 配液须在净化台上完成并注明时间。
en: Admixture preparation must be done on a clean bench and the time noted.

zh: 配液好了，两小时内输完。
en: Admixture preparation is done; infuse it within two hours.

zh: 发现渗漏须立即拔针并抬高患肢。
en: If infiltration is found, remove the needle immediately and raise the limb.

zh: 手背肿起来了，可能是渗漏。
en: The back of the hand is swollen; it may be infiltration.

zh: 高警示药品须专区存放并加标识。
en: High-alert medication must be stored in a dedicated area with a label.

zh: 这是高警示药品，必须双人核对。
en: This is a high-alert medication and must be double-checked.

zh: 听似看似药品须分开放置并加警示标识。
en: Look-alike sound-alike medicines must be stored apart and marked with a warning label.

zh: 这两个药听似看似，拿药时要多看一眼。
en: These two are look-alike sound-alike drugs, so look carefully when picking them up.

zh: 胰岛素输注前须完成独立双核对。
en: Independent double check must be completed before insulin infusion.

zh: 独立双核对就是各看各的，别念出来。
en: Independent double check means each looks separately; do not read it aloud.

zh: 肝素过量可致出血，须监测凝血功能。
en: Heparin overdose can cause bleeding, so clotting must be monitored.

zh: 肝素是抗凝药，打针后按压久一点。
en: Heparin is an anticoagulant, so press longer after the injection.

zh: 高浓度电解质须稀释后缓慢静脉滴注。
en: Concentrated electrolyte must be diluted and infused slowly.

zh: 这个高浓度电解质不能直接推。
en: This concentrated electrolyte cannot be pushed directly.

zh: 细胞毒药物配制须在生物安全柜内完成。
en: Cytotoxic drug preparation must be done in a biological safety cabinet.

zh: 细胞毒药物外溅要按流程处理。
en: If a cytotoxic drug spills, follow the spill procedure.

zh: 麻醉药品须双人双锁管理并逐支登记。
en: Narcotic drugs require double locks with two people and a record for every ampoule.

zh: 麻醉药品开处方要用专用处方。
en: A narcotic drug requires a special prescription form.

zh: 精神药品分第一类与第二类管理。
en: Psychotropic drugs are managed as class one and class two.

zh: 这个精神药品要登记，别随便放。
en: This psychotropic drug must be registered, so do not leave it lying around.

zh: 高危药品标识须为红底白字，便于识别。
en: The high-alert label should be white on red for easy recognition.

zh: 看到高危药品标识就要多核对一遍。
en: When you see the high-alert label, check again.

zh: 给药错误须立即上报并评估患者影响。
en: An administration error must be reported at once and the patient assessed.

zh: 刚才给药错误了，赶紧告诉医生。
en: There was an administration error just now; tell the doctor immediately.

zh: 对乙酰氨基酚中毒须尽早给予乙酰半胱氨酸。
en: Acetylcysteine should be given early in paracetamol poisoning.

zh: 乙酰半胱氨酸味道难闻，可以稀释后喝。
en: Acetylcysteine smells unpleasant and can be diluted before drinking.

zh: 亚甲蓝用于治疗高铁血红蛋白血症。
en: Methylene blue is used to treat methaemoglobinaemia.

zh: 亚甲蓝会让人尿变蓝，别紧张。
en: Methylene blue turns the urine blue, so do not worry.

zh: 重金属中毒须使用螯合剂，并监测肾功能。
en: Heavy metal poisoning requires a chelating agent and monitoring of renal function.

zh: 螯合剂要按疗程打，不能一直用。
en: The chelating agent is given in courses; it cannot be used continuously.

zh: 过量处理包括稳定生命体征、清除毒物与解毒。
en: Overdose management includes stabilising vital signs, removing the drug, and giving antidotes.

zh: 过量处理先看呼吸和循环。
en: In overdose management, check breathing and circulation first.

zh: 解毒治疗须与清除毒物同时进行。
en: Antidotal treatment should proceed together with removal of the poison.

zh: 解毒治疗越早越好，别等结果。
en: Antidotal treatment should start as early as possible; do not wait for results.

zh: 呋塞米静脉推注后须记录尿量与电解质。
en: After intravenous furosemide, record urine output and electrolytes.

zh: 呋塞米推了，注意他会不会低钾。
en: Furosemide has been given, so watch for low potassium.

zh: 高钾血症可静脉注射葡萄糖酸钙保护心肌。
en: In hyperkalaemia, intravenous calcium gluconate protects the myocardium.

zh: 葡萄糖酸钙推慢点，别漏到血管外。
en: Push calcium gluconate slowly and avoid extravasation.

zh: 空腹采血前请确认患者已禁食八小时。
en: Confirm the patient has fasted eight hours before fasting blood sampling.

zh: 抽血要空腹采血，早上没吃东西吧。
en: This is fasting blood sampling, so you have not eaten this morning?

zh: 血常规用抗凝管，不能与生化管混用。
en: Use an anticoagulant tube for the blood count, not the biochemistry tube.

zh: 这个是抗凝管，抽完要马上颠倒混匀。
en: This is an anticoagulant tube; invert it gently right after collection.

zh: 采血管按颜色区分添加剂，请按顺序使用。
en: Blood collection tubes are colour-coded by additive; use them in order.

zh: 采血管顺序别弄错，不然结果会受影响。
en: Do not mix up the blood collection tube order, or the results will be affected.

zh: 真空采血减少溶血，是目前门诊的主要方式。
en: Vacuum blood collection reduces haemolysis and is the main outpatient method.

zh: 我们用真空采血，一下就好，不用紧张。
en: We use vacuum blood collection; it is quick, so do not worry.

zh: 血培养必须严格无菌采集，否则易报假阳性。
en: Blood cultures require strict aseptic specimen collection to avoid false positives.

zh: 无菌采集要注意，手别碰针头。
en: Mind the aseptic specimen collection; do not touch the needle.

zh: 皮肤消毒待干后再进针，避免消毒液混入标本。
en: Let skin disinfection dry before puncture to avoid contaminating the sample.

zh: 皮肤消毒有点凉，忍一下就好。
en: The skin disinfection feels cold; bear with it for a moment.

zh: 血培养采集应在抗菌药物使用前完成。
en: Blood culture collection should be completed before antibiotics are given.

zh: 先做血培养采集，再上抗生素。
en: Do the blood culture collection first, then start the antibiotic.

zh: 清洁后留取中段尿送培养，减少污染。
en: After cleansing, collect midstream urine for culture to reduce contamination.

zh: 留中段尿，先尿一点再接杯子。
en: Collect midstream urine: urinate a little first, then use the cup.

zh: 标本溶血会使血钾假性升高，需重新采集。
en: Hemolysis of specimen falsely raises potassium, so a new sample is needed.

zh: 这个标本溶血了，麻烦重新抽一次。
en: This sample shows hemolysis of specimen; please draw another one.

zh: 标本拒收要登记原因并通知临床重采。
en: Specimen rejection must be documented with a reason and the ward informed.

zh: 标本量不够，按标本拒收处理了。
en: The volume was short, so the specimen rejection rule was applied.

zh: 采血后先贴标本条码，再送检。
en: Apply the specimen barcode after collection, then send it to the laboratory.

zh: 条码贴歪了，麻烦贴好，标本条码要扫得上。
en: The label is crooked; stick it straight so the specimen barcode scans.

zh: 采血顺序错误可致钾、钙结果失真。
en: A wrong order of draw can distort potassium and calcium results.

zh: 按采血顺序来，先培养瓶再凝血管。
en: Follow the order of draw: culture bottles first, then the coagulation tube.

zh: 动脉采血后需按压五分钟并立即送检。
en: After arterial puncture, press for five minutes and send the sample at once.

zh: 动脉采血有点疼，忍一下，按好不能揉。
en: Arterial puncture stings; hold the pressure afterwards and do not rub.

zh: 急诊入院常规查血常规，半小时出结果。
en: A complete blood count is routine on admission, with results in thirty minutes.

zh: 先抽个血常规，看看白细胞高不高。
en: We will run a complete blood count to see if the white cells are up.

zh: 白细胞计数明显升高，提示细菌感染可能。
en: A raised white blood cell count suggests a bacterial infection.

zh: 白细胞计数二十，先按感染处理。
en: The white blood cell count is twenty, so treat as infection first.

zh: 红细胞计数降低伴血红蛋白下降，提示贫血。
en: A low red blood cell count with low haemoglobin points to anaemia.

zh: 红细胞计数偏低，得查一下有没有出血。
en: The red blood cell count is low, so check for bleeding.

zh: 血红蛋白六十，属于重度贫血，需备血。
en: A low red cell count with low hemoglobin points to anaemia.

zh: 血红蛋白太低了，先输不输血要评估。
en: The hemoglobin is very low; whether to transfuse needs assessment.

zh: 血小板计数低于二十，出血风险很高。
en: A platelet count below twenty carries a high bleeding risk.

zh: 血小板计数低，穿刺后要多按一会儿。
en: The platelet count is low, so press longer after puncture.

zh: 红细胞压积与血红蛋白同步下降，支持失血判断。
en: A falling hematocrit together with haemoglobin supports blood loss.

zh: 红细胞压积掉得快，提示还在出血。
en: The hematocrit is dropping fast, suggesting ongoing bleeding.

zh: 平均红细胞体积偏小，提示缺铁可能。
en: A low mean corpuscular volume suggests possible iron deficiency.

zh: 平均红细胞体积低，先查铁蛋白。
en: The mean corpuscular volume is low; check ferritin first.

zh: 中性粒细胞比例升高，符合细菌感染表现。
en: A raised neutrophil proportion fits a bacterial infection.

zh: 中性粒细胞高，多半是细菌感染。
en: The neutrophils are high, which usually means bacterial infection.

zh: 淋巴细胞比例升高，常见于病毒感染。
en: A raised lymphocyte proportion is common in viral infection.

zh: 淋巴细胞高，考虑病毒性的。
en: The lymphocytes are high, so a viral cause is likely.

zh: 白细胞分类提示中性粒细胞为主，需复查。
en: The differential count is neutrophil-predominant and needs repeating.

zh: 白细胞分类我看一下，中性高不高。
en: Let me see the differential count: are the neutrophils high?

zh: 红细胞分布宽度增大，提示混合性贫血。
en: A raised red cell distribution width suggests a mixed anaemia.

zh: 红细胞分布宽度高，说明红细胞大小不一。
en: The red cell distribution width is high, so cell sizes vary.

zh: 网织红细胞升高提示骨髓代偿活跃。
en: A raised reticulocyte count means the marrow is compensating.

zh: 网织红细胞上来了，说明骨髓在造血。
en: The reticulocytes are rising, so the marrow is producing cells.

zh: 嗜酸性粒细胞增多，需追问过敏与寄生虫接触。
en: Eosinophilia calls for asking about allergy and parasite exposure.

zh: 嗜酸性粒细胞偏高，最近有没有过敏。
en: The eosinophils are raised; any recent allergy?

zh: 血小板压积随血小板计数同步变化。
en: Plateletcrit changes in step with the platelet count.

zh: 血小板压积也低，和血小板计数一致。
en: The plateletcrit is low too, matching the platelet count.

zh: 入院查肝功能，转氨酶明显升高。
en: Liver function tests on admission show markedly raised transaminases.

zh: 查个肝功能，看看转氨酶高不高。
en: Let us run liver function tests to check the transaminases.

zh: 肾功能异常时用药剂量需按肌酐调整。
en: When renal function is impaired, doses must be adjusted to creatinine.

zh: 肾功能不好，这个药得减量。
en: The renal function test is abnormal, so this drug needs a lower dose.

zh: 丙氨酸氨基转移酶升高三倍，需查病因。
en: Alanine aminotransferase is three times normal; the cause must be sought.

zh: 丙氨酸氨基转移酶很高，别再用伤肝的药。
en: The alanine aminotransferase is very high, so avoid hepatotoxic drugs.

zh: 天冬氨酸氨基转移酶与丙氨酸氨基转移酶同时升高。
en: Aspartate aminotransferase rises together with alanine aminotransferase.

zh: 天冬氨酸氨基转移酶也高，心肌和肝都要考虑。
en: The aspartate aminotransferase is also high, so consider heart and liver.

zh: 总胆红素升高伴巩膜黄染，提示黄疸。
en: A raised total bilirubin with scleral icterus indicates jaundice.

zh: 总胆红素高，眼睛也有点黄。
en: The total bilirubin is high and the eyes look yellow.

zh: 白蛋白偏低，提示营养差或慢性炎症。
en: A low albumin suggests poor nutrition or chronic inflammation.

zh: 白蛋白低，输液和营养都得调。
en: The albumin is low, so fluids and nutrition need adjusting.

zh: 血肌酐两天内翻倍，符合急性肾损伤。
en: Serum creatinine doubled in two days, consistent with acute kidney injury.

zh: 血肌酐涨得快，赶紧查尿量和用药。
en: The serum creatinine is rising fast; check urine output and drugs.

zh: 血尿素氮升高但肌酐正常，考虑脱水。
en: A raised blood urea nitrogen with normal creatinine suggests dehydration.

zh: 血尿素氮高，可能水不够，先补液。
en: The blood urea nitrogen is high, possibly from dehydration; give fluids.

zh: 估算肾小球滤过率低于三十，用药需调整。
en: An estimated glomerular filtration rate below thirty requires dose adjustment.

zh: 估算肾小球滤过率才三十，药得改。
en: The estimated glomerular filtration rate is only thirty, so change the drug.

zh: 急诊查电解质，血钾五点八需处理。
en: Electrolytes on arrival show potassium 5.8, which needs treatment.

zh: 先查电解质，钾高不高很关键。
en: Check the electrolytes; whether potassium is high matters.

zh: 血钾六点二，需要立即心电监护。
en: Serum potassium of 6.2 requires immediate cardiac monitoring.

zh: 血钾太高了，先降钾再谈别的。
en: The serum potassium is too high; lower it before anything else.

zh: 急诊先测血糖，低血糖要立刻纠正。
en: Check blood glucose first; hypoglycaemia must be corrected at once.

zh: 血糖三点一，先给糖再查原因。
en: The blood glucose is 3.1; give glucose first, then look for the cause.

zh: 乳酸脱氢酶明显升高，结合溶血指标判断。
en: Lactate dehydrogenase is markedly raised; interpret with haemolysis markers.

zh: 乳酸脱氢酶高，可能有组织破坏。
en: The lactate dehydrogenase is high, suggesting tissue breakdown.

zh: 术前常规查凝血功能，排除出血风险。
en: A coagulation profile is routine before surgery to exclude bleeding risk.

zh: 先查凝血功能，再决定能不能做操作。
en: Check the coagulation profile before deciding whether the procedure is safe.

zh: 凝血酶原时间延长，提示华法林作用或肝病。
en: A prolonged prothrombin time suggests warfarin effect or liver disease.

zh: 凝血酶原时间延长了，华法林吃了多少。
en: The prothrombin time is prolonged; how much warfarin have you taken?

zh: 活化部分凝血活酶时间明显延长，需查肝素用量。
en: A markedly prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time calls for checking heparin.

zh: 活化部分凝血活酶时间太长，肝素要减。
en: The activated partial thromboplastin time is too long; reduce the heparin.

zh: 纤维蛋白原降低见于消耗性凝血病。
en: A low fibrinogen is seen in consumptive coagulopathy.

zh: 纤维蛋白原低，得补冷沉淀。
en: The fibrinogen is low, so cryoprecipitate is needed.

zh: 急诊查D二聚体，阴性可辅助排除肺栓塞。
en: A negative D-dimer helps exclude pulmonary embolism in the emergency setting.

zh: D二聚体高，不能只看这一项就下结论。
en: A high D-dimer alone is not enough to make the diagnosis.

zh: 凝血酶时间延长提示纤维蛋白原异常或肝素残留。
en: A prolonged thrombin time suggests abnormal fibrinogen or residual heparin.

zh: 凝血酶时间也延长，可能还有肝素。
en: The thrombin time is prolonged too, so heparin may still be present.

zh: 纤维蛋白降解产物升高，提示纤溶亢进。
en: Raised fibrin degradation products indicate enhanced fibrinolysis.

zh: 纤维蛋白降解产物高，符合弥散性血管内凝血。
en: The fibrin degradation product is high, consistent with disseminated coagulation.

zh: 抗凝血酶降低时肝素效果会变差。
en: When antithrombin is low, heparin works less well.

zh: 抗凝血酶低，肝素效果不好，要加量或换药。
en: The antithrombin is low, so heparin works poorly; increase or switch.

zh: 血小板聚集试验异常，提示血小板功能缺陷。
en: An abnormal platelet aggregation test suggests a platelet function defect.

zh: 血小板聚集试验不好，拔牙前要评估。
en: The platelet aggregation test is abnormal, so assess before extraction.

zh: 出血时间延长而血小板计数正常，考虑功能障碍。
en: A prolonged bleeding time with a normal count suggests a function disorder.

zh: 出血时间有点长，先别做有创操作。
en: The bleeding time is a little long, so avoid invasive procedures for now.

zh: 凝血因子缺乏需补充相应制品。
en: Deficient coagulation factors must be replaced with the matching product.

zh: 凝血因子缺，得输血浆补。
en: A coagulation factor is missing, so plasma is needed.

zh: 血栓弹力图指导大出血时的成分输血。
en: Thromboelastography guides component therapy in major haemorrhage.

zh: 做个血栓弹力图，按结果补血制品。
en: Run a thromboelastography and replace blood products by the result.

zh: 抗凝治疗监测需定期查国际标准化比值。
en: Anticoagulation monitoring requires regular international normalized ratio checks.

zh: 抗凝治疗监测不能停，一周复查一次。
en: Anticoagulation monitoring must continue, with weekly checks.

zh: 动脉血氧分压五十，需立即给氧。
en: An arterial partial pressure of oxygen of fifty requires immediate oxygen.

zh: 动脉血氧分压低，氧流量调大。
en: The arterial partial pressure of oxygen is low; increase the oxygen flow.

zh: 动脉血二氧化碳分压升高提示通气不足。
en: A raised arterial partial pressure of carbon dioxide indicates hypoventilation.

zh: 动脉血二氧化碳分压高，得考虑上无创通气。
en: The arterial partial pressure of carbon dioxide is high; consider non-invasive ventilation.

zh: 酸碱度七点二，属于失代偿性酸血症。
en: A pH of 7.2 indicates uncompensated acidaemia.

zh: 酸碱度偏酸，先找原因再补碱。
en: The pH is acidotic; find the cause before giving bicarbonate.

zh: 碳酸氢根降低提示代谢性酸中毒。
en: A low bicarbonate indicates metabolic acidosis.

zh: 碳酸氢根低，是代谢性的酸中毒。
en: The bicarbonate is low, so this is metabolic acidosis.

zh: 胸痛患者先抽心肌标志物，再做心电图。
en: For chest pain, draw cardiac markers first, then do the ECG.

zh: 先查心肌标志物，别漏了心梗。
en: Check the cardiac markers so we do not miss a heart attack.

zh: 高敏肌钙蛋白阴性可辅助快速排除心梗。
en: A negative high-sensitivity troponin helps rule out infarction quickly.

zh: 高敏肌钙蛋白两次都阴性，先观察。
en: Both high-sensitivity troponin results are negative; observe for now.

zh: 肌酸激酶明显升高，需排查横纹肌溶解。
en: A markedly raised creatine kinase calls for excluding rhabdomyolysis.

zh: 肌酸激酶这么高，查一下肌红蛋白和肾功。
en: The creatine kinase is high; check myoglobin and renal function.

zh: 肌酸激酶同工酶升高支持心肌损伤。
en: A raised creatine kinase MB supports myocardial injury.

zh: 肌酸激酶同工酶高，结合肌钙蛋白看。
en: The creatine kinase MB is up; interpret it with troponin.

zh: 肌红蛋白升高早但特异性差，需结合肌钙蛋白。
en: Myoglobin rises early but is non-specific, so interpret with troponin.

zh: 肌红蛋白高得早，但还得看肌钙蛋白。
en: The myoglobin rises early, but troponin still matters.

zh: B型钠尿肽升高，提示心功能不全可能。
en: A raised B-type natriuretic peptide suggests cardiac dysfunction.

zh: B型钠尿肽高，考虑心衰，先利尿。
en: The B-type natriuretic peptide is high; consider heart failure and give a diuretic.

zh: N末端前脑钠肽显著升高，支持急性心衰诊断。
en: A markedly raised N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide supports acute heart failure.

zh: N末端前脑钠肽很高，心衰跑不了。
en: The N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide is very high, so heart failure is likely.

zh: 心型脂肪酸结合蛋白可更早提示心肌损伤。
en: Heart-type fatty acid-binding protein signals myocardial injury earlier.

zh: 心型脂肪酸结合蛋白高得早，先按心梗观察。
en: The heart-type fatty acid-binding protein rises early; observe as infarction.

zh: 心肌损伤不等于心梗，需结合临床与心电图。
en: Myocardial injury is not the same as infarction; interpret with clinical data.

zh: 有心肌损伤，但不一定是心梗。
en: There is myocardial injury, but it is not necessarily infarction.

zh: 肌钙蛋白有诊断窗口期，太早抽血可能阴性。
en: Troponin has a diagnostic window, so an early sample may be negative.

zh: 过了诊断窗口期才抽，结果要看准。
en: This sample is past the diagnostic window, so interpret the result carefully.

zh: 肌钙蛋白动态变化符合急性心梗的演变。
en: The troponin kinetics fit the evolution of acute myocardial infarction.

zh: 盯着肌钙蛋白动态变化，两小时后再抽一次。
en: Watch the troponin kinetics and repeat the sample in two hours.

zh: 心肌酶谱轻度升高，需结合肌钙蛋白判断。
en: The myocardial enzyme panel is mildly raised and must be read with troponin.

zh: 心肌酶谱一起查，别只看一项。
en: Run the myocardial enzyme panel together, not just one test.

zh: 快速肌钙蛋白检测阴性，仍需按流程复查。
en: A negative rapid troponin assay still needs repeat testing per protocol.

zh: 先做快速肌钙蛋白检测，别等中心实验室。
en: Do the rapid troponin assay first rather than waiting for the central laboratory.

zh: 感染标志物升高，需结合培养结果判断。
en: Raised infection markers must be interpreted with culture results.

zh: 感染标志物都高，先上经验性抗生素。
en: The infection markers are all high, so start empirical antibiotics.

zh: 超敏C反应蛋白轻度升高，提示慢性炎症状态。
en: A mildly raised high-sensitivity C-reactive protein suggests chronic inflammation.

zh: 超敏C反应蛋白高一点，先别急着用抗生素。
en: The high-sensitivity C-reactive protein is slightly up; do not rush to antibiotics.

zh: 红细胞沉降率增快，见于感染与风湿活动。
en: A raised erythrocyte sedimentation rate occurs in infection and active rheumatism.

zh: 红细胞沉降率快，查查有没有慢性炎症。
en: The erythrocyte sedimentation rate is fast; look for chronic inflammation.

zh: 白细胞介素6显著升高，提示炎症反应强烈。
en: A markedly raised interleukin-6 indicates a strong inflammatory response.

zh: 白细胞介素6这么高，病情不轻。
en: The interleukin-6 is so high that the illness is not mild.

zh: 血清淀粉样蛋白A升高而C反应蛋白不高，提示病毒可能。
en: A raised serum amyloid A with a low C-reactive protein suggests a viral cause.

zh: 血清淀粉样蛋白A高，可能是病毒。
en: The serum amyloid A is high, so a virus is possible.

zh: 内毒素升高，需警惕革兰阴性菌败血症。
en: Raised endotoxin calls for vigilance for Gram-negative sepsis.

zh: 内毒素高，革兰阴性菌感染要考虑。
en: The endotoxin is high, so Gram-negative infection must be considered.

zh: G试验阳性提示侵袭性真菌感染可能。
en: A positive 1,3-beta-D-glucan test suggests possible invasive fungal infection.

zh: G试验阳性，真菌感染要查到底。
en: The 1,3-beta-D-glucan test is positive, so work up a fungal infection.

zh: 半乳甘露聚糖试验阳性，支持侵袭性曲霉病。
en: A positive galactomannan test supports invasive aspergillosis.

zh: 半乳甘露聚糖试验阳性，赶紧请感染科。
en: The galactomannan test is positive; call infectious diseases now.

zh: 病毒载量下降说明抗病毒治疗有效。
en: A falling viral load shows the antiviral treatment is working.

zh: 病毒载量降下来了，药继续吃。
en: The viral load has fallen, so keep taking the medicine.

zh: 抗体滴度四倍升高有诊断意义。
en: A fourfold rise in antibody titer is diagnostically significant.

zh: 抗体滴度查两次，看有没有升高。
en: Check the antibody titer twice to see whether it rises.

zh: 血培养阳性，需按药敏调整抗生素。
en: Blood culture positive means adjusting antibiotics to the susceptibility result.

zh: 培养阳性了，看看药敏再换药。
en: The culture is positive, so check susceptibility before switching drugs.

zh: 炎症指标回落，说明治疗有效。
en: The inflammatory markers are falling, which means treatment is working.

zh: 炎症指标还高，疗程没到。
en: The inflammatory markers are still high, so the course is not finished.

zh: 急诊查尿常规，白细胞明显增多。
en: Urinalysis in the emergency department shows many white cells.

zh: 先留个尿常规，看看有没有感染。
en: Leave a urine sample for urinalysis to check for infection.

zh: 尿蛋白两个加号，需查二十四小时定量。
en: Urine protein is two plus, so a twenty-four hour quantification is needed.

zh: 尿蛋白有加号，肾要查一下。
en: There is urine protein, so the kidneys need checking.

zh: 尿潜血阳性而镜检无红细胞，需复查。
en: Occult blood in urine without red cells on microscopy should be repeated.

zh: 尿潜血阳性，先排除月经污染。
en: Occult blood in urine is positive; first exclude menstrual contamination.

zh: 尿沉渣见大量白细胞管型，提示肾盂肾炎。
en: Urine sediment shows many white cell casts, suggesting pyelonephritis.

zh: 尿沉渣有管型，提示肾脏受累。
en: The urine sediment has casts, so the kidney is involved.

zh: 尿酮体三个加号，需警惕糖尿病酮症。
en: Urine ketone is three plus, so diabetic ketosis must be excluded.

zh: 尿酮体强阳性，赶紧查血糖血气。
en: The urine ketone is strongly positive; check glucose and blood gas quickly.

zh: 尿培养出大肠埃希菌，按药敏换药。
en: Urine culture grew Escherichia coli, so switch drugs by susceptibility.

zh: 尿培养结果出来了，看看对什么药敏感。
en: The urine culture is back; check which drugs it is sensitive to.

zh: 粪便隐血阳性，需进一步查消化道。
en: A positive fecal occult blood test requires gastrointestinal work-up.

zh: 粪便隐血阳性，别只当痔疮。
en: The fecal occult blood test is positive; do not dismiss it as haemorrhoids.

zh: 粪便常规见大量白细胞，提示肠道感染。
en: Stool routine shows many white cells, suggesting intestinal infection.

zh: 留个粪便常规，看看有没有感染。
en: Send a stool routine to check for infection.

zh: 粪便培养出沙门菌，需报传染病卡。
en: Stool culture grew Salmonella, so a notifiable disease report is required.

zh: 粪便培养阳性，按传染病流程处理。
en: The stool culture is positive, so follow the infectious disease pathway.

zh: 白细胞酯酶阳性，支持尿路感染。
en: A positive leukocyte esterase supports urinary tract infection.

zh: 白细胞酯酶阳性，先按尿路感染处理。
en: The leukocyte esterase is positive, so treat as urinary infection first.

zh: 亚硝酸盐阳性提示大肠埃希菌等感染。
en: A positive nitrite suggests infection with organisms such as Escherichia coli.

zh: 亚硝酸盐阳性，尿路感染可能性大。
en: The nitrite is positive, so urinary infection is likely.

zh: 24小时尿蛋白两克，达到肾病范围。
en: A 24-hour urine protein of two grams is in the nephrotic range.

zh: 留24小时尿蛋白要记好时间。
en: For the 24-hour urine protein, record the collection times carefully.

zh: 伤口分泌物细菌培养阳性，需清创。
en: Bacterial culture of the wound discharge is positive, so debridement is needed.

zh: 先做细菌培养，再决定用哪种抗生素。
en: Do a bacterial culture before choosing the antibiotic.

zh: 药敏试验提示对万古霉素敏感。
en: The antimicrobial susceptibility test shows sensitivity to vancomycin.

zh: 等药敏试验出来再换窄谱的。
en: Wait for the antimicrobial susceptibility test before narrowing coverage.

zh: 革兰染色见革兰阳性球菌成簇排列。
en: Gram stain shows clusters of Gram-positive cocci.

zh: 先看革兰染色，初步判断用什么药。
en: Look at the Gram stain first to guide the initial drug choice.

zh: 革兰阳性菌感染常选用青霉素类。
en: Gram-positive bacterium infections are often treated with penicillins.

zh: 革兰阳性菌，先按球菌覆盖。
en: It is a Gram-positive bacterium, so cover cocci first.

zh: 革兰阴性菌败血症进展快，需尽早用药。
en: Gram-negative bacterium sepsis progresses fast and needs early antibiotics.

zh: 革兰阴性菌，用药要覆盖肠道菌。
en: It is a Gram-negative bacterium, so cover enteric organisms.

zh: 真菌培养阳性，需评估免疫状态。
en: A positive fungal culture requires assessment of immune status.

zh: 真菌培养阳性，看看有没有免疫低下。
en: The fungal culture is positive; check for immunosuppression.

zh: 深部脓肿需同时送需氧与厌氧培养。
en: Deep abscess samples need both aerobic and anaerobic culture.

zh: 这个标本要加厌氧培养，别只做普通培养。
en: Add anaerobic culture for this sample, not just the routine one.

zh: 尿培养菌落计数超过十万，有诊断意义。
en: A colony count above one hundred thousand in urine culture is significant.

zh: 菌落计数够高，说明不是污染。
en: The colony count is high enough, so it is not contamination.

zh: 最低抑菌浓度越低，药物越有效。
en: The lower the minimum inhibitory concentration, the more effective the drug.

zh: 看最低抑菌浓度，别只看敏感还是耐药。
en: Check the minimum inhibitory concentration, not just sensitive or resistant.

zh: 检出多重耐药菌株需单间隔离。
en: Detection of a multidrug-resistant strain requires single-room isolation.

zh: 有多重耐药菌株，先隔离再谈治疗。
en: There is a multidrug-resistant strain, so isolate the patient first.

zh: 痰培养检出耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌，需接触隔离。
en: Sputum culture grew methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus, so contact isolation is needed.

zh: 检出耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌，按接触隔离办。
en: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus was found; apply contact isolation.

zh: 痰培养出铜绿假单胞菌，按药敏调整。
en: Sputum culture grew Pseudomonas aeruginosa, so adjust by susceptibility.

zh: 痰培养要送合格的痰，口水不行。
en: For sputum culture send proper sputum, not saliva.

zh: 痰中检出定植菌时不必使用抗生素。
en: Antibiotics are unnecessary when sputum grows only a colonizer.

zh: 这是定植菌，不用为它上抗生素。
en: This is a colonizer, so no antibiotic is needed for it.

zh: 免疫学检查阳性，需结合临床判断。
en: The immunological test is positive and must be read with the clinical picture.

zh: 先做免疫学检查，看抗体有没有。
en: Run an immunological test to look for antibodies.

zh: 乙肝表面抗原阳性，需查病毒载量与肝功能。
en: A positive hepatitis B surface antigen requires viral load and liver tests.

zh: 乙肝表面抗原阳性，操作要按血源性防护。
en: Hepatitis B surface antigen is positive, so follow blood-borne precautions.

zh: 丙肝抗体阳性，需做核酸检测确认。
en: A positive hepatitis C antibody needs nucleic acid confirmation.

zh: 丙肝抗体阳性，先别下诊断，要查核酸。
en: A positive hepatitis C antibody is not a diagnosis until nucleic acid is checked.

zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体初筛阳性，需送确证试验。
en: A reactive human immunodeficiency virus antibody screen requires confirmatory testing.

zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体要送确证，别直接告诉患者结果。
en: The human immunodeficiency virus antibody needs confirmation; do not tell the patient yet.

zh: 梅毒螺旋体抗体阳性，需结合非特异性试验判断。
en: A positive Treponema pallidum antibody must be read with a non-treponemal test.

zh: 梅毒螺旋体抗体阳性，再查滴度。
en: The Treponema pallidum antibody is positive; check the titre too.

zh: 类风湿因子阳性不等于类风湿关节炎。
en: A positive rheumatoid factor does not equal rheumatoid arthritis.

zh: 类风湿因子高，还要看关节症状。
en: The rheumatoid factor is high, but joint symptoms still count.

zh: 抗链球菌溶血素O升高，提示近期链球菌感染。
en: A raised antistreptolysin O suggests recent streptococcal infection.

zh: 抗链球菌溶血素O高，问问他前阵子有没有咽痛。
en: The antistreptolysin O is high; ask about a recent sore throat.

zh: 补体C3降低，需考虑免疫复合物疾病。
en: A low complement C3 suggests immune complex disease.

zh: 补体C3低了，查查有没有活动性狼疮。
en: The complement C3 is low; look for active lupus.

zh: 交叉配血相合后才能发血。
en: Blood is issued only after crossmatching shows compatibility.

zh: 交叉配血过了，可以输血。
en: The crossmatching has passed, so transfusion can start.

zh: 血型鉴定为 A 型 Rh 阳性。
en: Blood typing shows group A, Rh positive.

zh: 先做血型鉴定，再谈输血。
en: Do the blood typing before discussing transfusion.

zh: 自身抗体谱阳性，需结合临床表现诊断。
en: A positive autoantibody panel needs clinical correlation before diagnosis.

zh: 自身抗体阳性，别急着下结论。
en: The autoantibody is positive; do not jump to a diagnosis.

zh: 不同实验室参考区间不同，需看本报告单。
en: Reference intervals differ between laboratories, so use the one printed on the report.

zh: 参考区间在每个报告单上，别记错。
en: The reference interval is printed on each report, so do not memorise it.

zh: 肌钙蛋白的医学决定水平通常取第九十九百分位。
en: The medical decision level for troponin is usually the ninety-ninth percentile.

zh: 超过医学决定水平就要处理，别只看正常值。
en: Above the medical decision level, act; do not rely on the normal range alone.

zh: 低于检测限的结果不能报告为零。
en: A result below the detection limit cannot be reported as zero.

zh: 低于检测限，写小于检测限，不要写零。
en: Below the detection limit, write less than the limit, not zero.

zh: 超出线性范围的结果需稀释后复测。
en: A result outside the linear range must be diluted and retested.

zh: 超线性范围了，稀释后重做。
en: It is outside the linear range; dilute and repeat.

zh: 室内质控失控时当批结果不能发出。
en: When internal quality control fails, that batch of results cannot be released.

zh: 室内质控没过，这批结果先别发。
en: Internal quality control failed, so hold this batch of results.

zh: 室间质评成绩合格才能开展该项目。
en: The laboratory must pass external quality assessment to run the test.

zh: 室间质评合格，这个项目才算靠谱。
en: External quality assessment is passed, which makes the test reliable.

zh: 结果异常时需先复核再通知临床。
en: An abnormal result should be verified before informing the clinician.

zh: 结果异常先复核一遍，别急着报。
en: For an abnormal result, verify it first before reporting.

zh: 标本污染可造成假阳性，需重复检测。
en: Specimen contamination can cause a false positive, so repeat the test.

zh: 这可能是假阳性，重新抽血复查。
en: This may be a false positive; redraw and repeat.

zh: 采样过早可导致假阴性，需复查。
en: Sampling too early can cause a false negative, so retest.

zh: 别被假阴性骗了，两小时后再抽。
en: Do not be misled by a false negative; repeat in two hours.

zh: 检验结果互认可减少重复抽血。
en: Mutual recognition of test results reduces repeat blood draws.

zh: 同级医院的检验结果互认，别重复抽。
en: Mutual recognition of test results applies here, so do not redraw.

zh: 参考方法用于校准常规检测系统。
en: A reference method is used to calibrate routine testing systems.

zh: 这个项目用参考方法做的，结果可信。
en: This test used the reference method, so the result is reliable.

zh: 检验报告需双人审核后发放。
en: The laboratory report is released after review by two staff.

zh: 检验报告出来了，我给您解释一下。
en: The laboratory report is back; let me explain it.

zh: 流感抗原阴性，不能完全排除流感。
en: A negative influenza antigen test does not fully exclude influenza.

zh: 结果是阴性，先放心一半。
en: The result is negative, so that is partly reassuring.

zh: 血培养阳性，需立即通知临床。
en: A positive blood culture must be reported to the clinician at once.

zh: 阳性了，得马上告诉医生。
en: It is positive, so tell the doctor immediately.

zh: 弱阳性结果建议两周后复查。
en: A weakly positive result should be repeated in two weeks.

zh: 弱阳性先别慌，过两周复查。
en: A weakly positive result is not alarming; repeat in two weeks.

zh: 胸片未见异常，但不能排除早期病变。
en: No abnormality detected on the chest film, but early disease is not excluded.

zh: 报告写未见异常，先按这个处理。
en: The report says no abnormality detected, so manage accordingly.

zh: 报告写待排肺栓塞，需马上做CT血管成像。
en: The report says pulmonary embolism to be excluded, so CT angiography is urgent.

zh: 写的是待排，不是确诊，别吓着患者。
en: It says to be excluded, not confirmed, so do not frighten the patient.

zh: 发热待查需完善感染与免疫筛查。
en: Fever pending investigation requires infection and immune screening.

zh: 写待查就是还没查清楚，别自己猜。
en: Pending investigation means it is not settled, so do not guess.

zh: 急诊检验报告时限为六十分钟。
en: The laboratory turnaround time for emergency reports is sixty minutes.

zh: 检验报告时限一小时，别催了。
en: The laboratory turnaround time is one hour, so no need to chase it.

zh: 报告审核通过后才能发放给临床。
en: The report is released to the clinician only after report verification.

zh: 报告审核还没过，先等通知。
en: Report verification has not passed yet, so wait for the notice.

zh: 解释性备注提示该结果需结合临床症状判断。
en: The interpretive comment notes that the result needs clinical correlation.

zh: 看解释性备注，别只看数字。
en: Read the interpretive comment, not just the numbers.

zh: 结果复核发现报告序号与标本不符。
en: Result review found the report number did not match the specimen.

zh: 结果复核过一遍，确认没问题再发。
en: Do a result review and release it once confirmed.

zh: 检验结论提示缺铁性贫血可能。
en: The laboratory impression suggests possible iron deficiency anaemia.

zh: 检验结论写得很清楚，按它处理。
en: The laboratory impression is clear, so act on it.

zh: 报告用语应避免绝对化表述，如确诊、排除。
en: Reporting wording should avoid absolutes such as confirmed or excluded.

zh: 报告用语规范点，别写得太绝对。
en: Keep the reporting wording standard and avoid absolutes.

zh: 电子报告与纸质报告具有同等效力。
en: The electronic report carries the same weight as the paper one.

zh: 电子报告在系统里能查，不用等纸的。
en: The electronic report is in the system, so no need to wait for paper.

zh: X线摄影示右下肢骨折。
en: Radiography shows a fracture of the right lower limb.

zh: 先拍个X线摄影，看看骨头。
en: Do a radiography first to check the bone.

zh: 急诊头颅计算机断层扫描未见出血。
en: Emergency computed tomography of the head shows no haemorrhage.

zh: 马上推去做计算机断层扫描，怀疑出血。
en: Take him for computed tomography now; bleeding is suspected.

zh: 先做平扫排除出血，再考虑增强。
en: Do a non-contrast scan first to exclude bleeding, then consider contrast.

zh: 先平扫，别急着打造影剂。
en: Do the non-contrast scan first; do not rush the contrast.

zh: 增强扫描示肝右叶不均匀强化。
en: The contrast-enhanced scan shows heterogeneous enhancement in the right liver lobe.

zh: 增强扫描要签同意书，先问过敏史。
en: The contrast-enhanced scan needs consent, so ask about allergy first.

zh: 肺窗见双下肺渗出影。
en: The lung window shows infiltrates in both lower lungs.

zh: 调到肺窗，看清肺里的情况。
en: Switch to the lung window to see the lungs clearly.

zh: 纵隔窗见气管旁淋巴结增大。
en: The mediastinal window shows enlarged paratracheal nodes.

zh: 纵隔窗再看一遍，淋巴结大不大。
en: Look again on the mediastinal window: are the nodes enlarged?

zh: 骨窗见颅骨线样透亮影，提示骨折。
en: The bone window shows a linear lucency in the skull, suggesting fracture.

zh: 切到骨窗，看有没有骨折线。
en: Switch to the bone window to look for a fracture line.

zh: 薄层厚扫描可发现更小的病灶。
en: Thinner slice thickness allows smaller lesions to be detected.

zh: 层厚调薄一点，小结节才看得见。
en: Reduce the slice thickness so small nodules are visible.

zh: 图像重建后矢状面显示更清楚。
en: After image reconstruction the sagittal view is clearer.

zh: 图像重建完再看冠状面。
en: Finish the image reconstruction, then review the coronal view.

zh: 腹部平片见多个液气平面，提示肠梗阻。
en: The abdominal radiograph shows multiple air-fluid levels, suggesting obstruction.

zh: 腹部平片看有没有气腹。
en: Check the abdominal radiograph for free air.

zh: 儿童检查应尽量降低辐射剂量。
en: Radiation dose should be kept as low as possible in children.

zh: 这个检查辐射剂量不低，能替代就替代。
en: This examination carries a real radiation dose, so substitute if possible.

zh: 三维重建清晰显示骨折块移位方向。
en: Three-dimensional reconstruction clearly shows the direction of fracture displacement.

zh: 做个三维重建，手术前看清楚。
en: Do a three-dimensional reconstruction to see it clearly before surgery.

zh: 磁共振成像示腰椎间盘突出。
en: Magnetic resonance imaging shows a lumbar disc herniation.

zh: 磁共振成像要预约，还不能带金属。
en: Magnetic resonance imaging needs booking and no metal is allowed.

zh: T1加权成像示出血呈高信号。
en: T1-weighted imaging shows the haemorrhage as high signal.

zh: 看T1加权成像，脂肪是亮的。
en: On T1-weighted imaging, fat appears bright.

zh: T2加权成像示脑白质高信号灶。
en: T2-weighted imaging shows high-signal foci in the white matter.

zh: T2加权成像上水肿看得清楚。
en: Oedema is clearly seen on T2-weighted imaging.

zh: 弥散加权成像高信号提示急性脑梗死。
en: High signal on diffusion-weighted imaging suggests acute infarction.

zh: 弥散加权成像亮，考虑急性梗死。
en: It is bright on diffusion-weighted imaging, so consider acute infarction.

zh: 液体衰减反转恢复序列示脑室旁高信号。
en: The fluid-attenuated inversion recovery sequence shows periventricular high signal.

zh: 看液体衰减反转恢复序列，病灶更明显。
en: Look at the fluid-attenuated inversion recovery sequence; the lesion stands out.

zh: 磁共振血管成像示右侧大脑中动脉狭窄。
en: Magnetic resonance angiography shows stenosis of the right middle cerebral artery.

zh: 先做磁共振血管成像，看血管通不通。
en: Do magnetic resonance angiography first to check vessel patency.

zh: 超声检查示胆囊壁增厚。
en: Ultrasonography shows thickening of the gallbladder wall.

zh: 做个超声检查，看胆囊。
en: Do an ultrasonography to look at the gallbladder.

zh: 彩色多普勒超声示下肢静脉血栓形成。
en: Color Doppler ultrasonography shows deep vein thrombosis of the leg.

zh: 彩色多普勒超声看血流，血栓一目了然。
en: Color Doppler ultrasonography shows the flow, so the clot is obvious.

zh: 超声心动图示左室射血分数下降。
en: Echocardiography shows a reduced left ventricular ejection fraction.

zh: 做个超声心动图，看心功能。
en: Do an echocardiography to assess cardiac function.

zh: 弹性成像提示结节质地偏硬。
en: Elastography suggests the nodule is relatively stiff.

zh: 加做弹性成像，看硬不硬。
en: Add elastography to see how stiff it is.

zh: 超声造影示病灶动脉期快速强化。
en: Contrast-enhanced ultrasound shows rapid arterial enhancement of the lesion.

zh: 超声造影能看血供，比普通超声清楚。
en: Contrast-enhanced ultrasound shows the blood supply more clearly.

zh: 体内有心脏起搏器属于磁共振禁忌证。
en: A cardiac pacemaker is a contraindication to MRI.

zh: 先问有没有磁共振禁忌证，起搏器不能进。
en: Ask about any contraindication to MRI; a pacemaker cannot go in.

zh: 造影检查示右肾动脉狭窄。
en: Contrast examination shows stenosis of the right renal artery.

zh: 造影检查前要签知情同意。
en: Consent is required before a contrast examination.

zh: 对比剂经静脉注入后即刻扫描。
en: The contrast medium is injected intravenously and scanning follows at once.

zh: 对比剂打进去会有点发热，正常。
en: The contrast medium may feel warm; that is normal.

zh: 碘对比剂使用前需评估肾功能。
en: Renal function must be checked before iodinated contrast medium is given.

zh: 碘对比剂对肾有影响，先查肌酐。
en: Iodinated contrast medium affects the kidney, so check creatinine first.

zh: 钆对比剂在严重肾功能不全时需慎用。
en: Gadolinium-based contrast agent should be used cautiously in severe renal impairment.

zh: 钆对比剂对肾要求高，先看肾功能。
en: The gadolinium-based contrast agent needs good renal function, so check it.

zh: 有对比剂过敏史者检查前需预处理。
en: Those with contrast medium allergy need premedication before scanning.

zh: 有对比剂过敏就别直接做，要先预处理。
en: With contrast medium allergy, premedicate rather than scan directly.

zh: 碘对比剂可引起过敏样反应，需备抢救药。
en: Iodinated contrast can cause an anaphylactoid reaction, so keep resuscitation drugs ready.

zh: 出现过敏样反应，先停药给氧。
en: If an anaphylactoid reaction occurs, stop the agent and give oxygen.

zh: 造影前准备包括问过敏史与查肌酐。
en: Pre-contrast preparation includes allergy history and creatinine testing.

zh: 造影前准备做完了吗，过敏史问了吗。
en: Is pre-contrast preparation complete? Was the allergy history taken?

zh: 高危患者造影前后需水化。
en: High-risk patients need hydration before and after contrast.

zh: 记得给水化，不然容易伤肾。
