en: Remember hydration, or the kidney may be damaged.

zh: 造影后观察三十分钟，无不适方可离院。
en: After thirty minutes of post-contrast observation the patient may leave if well.

zh: 造影后观察半小时再走。
en: Stay for half an hour of post-contrast observation.

zh: 对比剂肾病多在三天内肌酐升高。
en: In contrast-induced nephropathy creatinine rises within three days.

zh: 小心对比剂肾病，术后复查肌酐。
en: Watch for contrast-induced nephropathy and recheck creatinine.

zh: 血管造影示冠状动脉前降支闭塞。
en: Angiography shows occlusion of the left anterior descending artery.

zh: 血管造影能看清堵在哪儿。
en: Angiography shows exactly where the blockage is.

zh: 数字减影血管造影示动脉瘤形态。
en: Digital subtraction angiography shows the aneurysm morphology.

zh: 要做数字减影血管造影，得进导管室。
en: Digital subtraction angiography is needed, so go to the catheter laboratory.

zh: 注射速率过快可致血管外渗。
en: An excessive injection rate can cause extravasation.

zh: 注射速率调低一点，血管细。
en: Lower the injection rate; the vein is small.

zh: 影像诊断考虑右侧肺炎。
en: The imaging diagnosis is right-sided pneumonia.

zh: 影像诊断只是参考，还要看临床。
en: The imaging diagnosis is only a reference and must be read with the clinical picture.

zh: 影像表现描述病灶大小、位置与密度。
en: The imaging finding describes the size, site, and density of the lesion.

zh: 影像表现写得很细，按这个判断。
en: The imaging finding is detailed, so judge from it.

zh: 出现典型的影像征象，支持肠梗阻。
en: The typical imaging sign supports bowel obstruction.

zh: 这个影像征象很典型，基本能定。
en: This imaging sign is typical, so the diagnosis is fairly secure.

zh: 右肺上叶见占位性病变，需进一步评估。
en: A space-occupying lesion is seen in the right upper lobe and needs further assessment.

zh: 报告写占位性病变，先别告诉患者是癌。
en: The report says space-occupying lesion, so do not tell the patient it is cancer.

zh: 头颅CT见高密度影，考虑出血。
en: Head CT shows a hyperdense shadow, suggesting haemorrhage.

zh: 这儿有高密度影，可能是血。
en: There is a hyperdense shadow here, possibly blood.

zh: 左额叶见片状低密度影，提示水肿。
en: A patchy hypodense shadow in the left frontal lobe suggests oedema.

zh: 低密度影这块是水肿还是梗死，要复查。
en: Is this hypodense shadow oedema or infarction? Repeat the scan.

zh: 强化程度不均，提示坏死可能。
en: The degree of enhancement is uneven, suggesting possible necrosis.

zh: 强化程度低，血供不丰富。
en: The degree of enhancement is low, so blood supply is poor.

zh: 肿块边界清楚，良性可能性大。
en: The mass is well-defined, so a benign lesion is more likely.

zh: 报告说边界清楚，先别太担心。
en: The report says well-defined, so do not worry too much.

zh: 小结节建议三个月后随访复查。
en: For the small nodule, follow-up imaging in three months is advised.

zh: 这个要随访复查，别一年后才来。
en: This needs follow-up imaging, so do not wait a year.

zh: 报告建议进一步检查，除外肿瘤。
en: The report recommends further imaging to exclude a mass.

zh: 报告写建议进一步检查，我们加做增强。
en: The report says recommend further imaging, so add a contrast study.

zh: 影像与临床不符时需重新评估或复查。
en: When there is an imaging-clinical discrepancy, reassess or repeat the scan.

zh: 影像与临床不符，别只信片子。
en: There is an imaging-clinical discrepancy, so do not trust the film alone.

zh: 疑难病例安排会诊读片后再出报告。
en: Difficult cases go to imaging consultation before the report is issued.

zh: 这个片子安排会诊读片，别急着发报告。
en: Arrange an imaging consultation for this study; do not issue the report yet.

zh: 影像结论为急性阑尾炎可能。
en: The imaging conclusion is possible acute appendicitis.

zh: 影像结论我看懂了，就是阑尾炎可能。
en: I understand the imaging conclusion: probable appendicitis.

zh: 门诊病历须由接诊医师书写并签名。
en: The outpatient medical record must be written and signed by the treating physician.

zh: 把门诊病历给医生看，别只带化验单。
en: Show the doctor the outpatient medical record, not just the lab slips.

zh: 急诊病历须准确记录到院时间与离院时间。
en: The emergency department medical record must accurately record arrival and departure times.

zh: 急诊病历我们自己写，家属不要代签。
en: We write the emergency department medical record ourselves, so family members should not sign for it.

zh: 留观病历每日记录一次，病情变化随时记录。
en: The observation unit record is written once daily, and at any time the condition changes.

zh: 他还在留观，留观病历先别归档。
en: He is still under observation, so do not archive the observation unit record yet.

zh: 入院记录应在患者入院后二十四小时内完成。
en: The admission note should be completed within twenty-four hours of admission.

zh: 入院记录写好了吗，护士站等着收。
en: Is the admission note ready, the nursing station is waiting for it.

zh: 住院病历包括入院记录、病程记录与出院小结。
en: The inpatient medical record includes the admission note, progress notes and discharge summary.

zh: 住院病历不能带走，只能按规定复印。
en: The inpatient medical record cannot be taken away, only copied according to the rules.

zh: 病案在出院后三个工作日内归档。
en: The medical record is archived within three working days after discharge.

zh: 这份病案已经归档，调阅要走流程。
en: This medical record has already been archived, so retrieval must follow the procedure.

zh: 病案首页的诊断应按主要诊断选择原则填写。
en: Diagnoses on the medical record front sheet should follow the principal diagnosis rules.

zh: 病案首页这里填错了，主要诊断和手术要对上。
en: The medical record front sheet is filled in wrongly here, the principal diagnosis must match the operation.

zh: 系统按就诊记录自动生成费用清单。
en: The system generates the billing list automatically from the visit record.

zh: 这次就诊记录里没写过敏史，补一下。
en: This visit record does not mention allergies, please add it.

zh: 复诊记录须写明上次治疗后症状变化。
en: The follow-up visit record must state how symptoms changed after the previous treatment.

zh: 复诊记录接着上次写，别重开一份。
en: Continue the follow-up visit record from last time, do not start a new one.

zh: 门诊日志每日核对一次，不得漏登。
en: The outpatient register is checked daily and no entry may be omitted.

zh: 门诊日志上这个人没登记，先补上。
en: This patient is not in the outpatient register, add the entry first.

zh: 住院登记完成后才能生成住院号。
en: The inpatient number is generated only after inpatient registration is complete.

zh: 住院登记还没做，先办手续再上病房。
en: Inpatient registration is not done yet, finish the paperwork before going to the ward.

zh: 纸质病历与电子病历内容不一致时以原件为准。
en: When the paper medical record and the electronic record differ, the original prevails.

zh: 纸质病历还在架子上，扫描完再归档。
en: The paper medical record is still on the shelf, scan it before archiving.

zh: 病历摘要包括诊断、主要检查与治疗经过。
en: The medical record summary covers diagnoses, key investigations and the treatment course.

zh: 给他出一份病历摘要，转诊要用。
en: Issue a medical record summary for him, it is needed for the referral.

zh: 就诊前处理：自服硝酸甘油一片，症状未缓解。
en: Pre-visit management: one glyceryl trinitrate tablet self-administered without relief.

zh: 就诊前处理问清楚，吃过什么药、谁给的。
en: Clarify the pre-visit management, what was taken and who gave it.

zh: 疫区接触史：发病前两周到过登革热流行区。
en: Epidemic area contact history: visited a dengue-endemic area two weeks before onset.

zh: 疫区接触史要问，发热病人别漏了。
en: Ask the epidemic area contact history, do not miss it in febrile patients.

zh: 旅居史：近一月曾赴东南亚三国。
en: Travel and residence history: travelled to three Southeast Asian countries in the past month.

zh: 旅居史问细一点，去了哪些国家。
en: Ask the travel and residence history in detail, which countries did he visit.

zh: 浅表淋巴结未触及肿大。
en: Superficial lymph nodes were not enlarged on palpation.

zh: 浅表淋巴结摸一下，颈部有没有肿大。
en: Palpate the superficial lymph nodes, is there enlargement in the neck.

zh: 肺部听诊：右下肺可闻及湿啰音。
en: Pulmonary auscultation: crackles audible over the right lower lung.

zh: 肺部听诊两边对比着听。
en: On pulmonary auscultation, compare both sides.

zh: 脊柱四肢：脊柱无畸形，四肢活动自如。
en: Spine and limbs: no spinal deformity and free limb movement.

zh: 脊柱四肢都要看，别漏了脚上的伤。
en: Check the spine and limbs, do not miss the injury on the foot.

zh: 专科检查：右膝浮髌试验阳性。
en: Specialized examination: positive ballottement test of the right knee.

zh: 专科检查请骨科来补，我们写的太简单。
en: Ask orthopaedics to add the specialized examination, ours is too brief.

zh: 初步诊断：急性冠脉综合征待排。
en: Preliminary diagnosis: acute coronary syndrome to be excluded.

zh: 初步诊断先写上，等结果出来再改。
en: Write the preliminary diagnosis first and revise it when results come back.

zh: 入院诊断：社区获得性肺炎。
en: Admission diagnosis: community-acquired pneumonia.

zh: 入院诊断和门诊不一样，要在病程里说明理由。
en: The admission diagnosis differs from the outpatient one, so the reason must be explained in the progress note.

zh: 出院诊断：急性阑尾炎，术后恢复良好。
en: Discharge diagnosis: acute appendicitis with good postoperative recovery.

zh: 出院诊断按主要诊断排第一，别把顺序写乱。
en: The discharge diagnosis lists the principal diagnosis first, do not mix the order.

zh: 修正诊断：由肺炎修正为肺结核。
en: Revised diagnosis: changed from pneumonia to pulmonary tuberculosis.

zh: 修正诊断要写清依据，不能只改结论。
en: The revised diagnosis must state the basis, not just change the conclusion.

zh: 补充诊断：二型糖尿病。
en: Supplementary diagnosis: type 2 diabetes mellitus.

zh: 补充诊断别忘了首页也要同步。
en: Do not forget the supplementary diagnosis must be synced to the front sheet too.

zh: 鉴别诊断应考虑主动脉夹层与肺栓塞。
en: The differential diagnosis should include aortic dissection and pulmonary embolism.

zh: 鉴别诊断要写出为什么排、怎么排。
en: The differential diagnosis must state why and how each condition is excluded.

zh: 疑似诊断：急性胰腺炎。
en: Suspected diagnosis: acute pancreatitis.

zh: 疑似诊断要跟家属讲清楚，别当成确诊。
en: Explain the suspected diagnosis clearly to the family and do not present it as confirmed.

zh: 确诊需病理结果支持。
en: The confirmed diagnosis requires pathological support.

zh: 确诊了再跟病人谈，先别下结论。
en: Wait until the diagnosis is confirmed before talking to the patient, do not conclude early.

zh: 临床诊断与病理诊断不一致时须讨论。
en: A discrepancy between the clinical diagnosis and the pathological diagnosis must be discussed.

zh: 这个只是临床诊断，最后还要等病理。
en: This is only the clinical diagnosis, we still await pathology.

zh: 病理诊断：浸润性导管癌。
en: Pathological diagnosis: invasive ductal carcinoma.

zh: 病理诊断出来了，赶紧告诉主管医生。
en: The pathological diagnosis is back, tell the doctor in charge quickly.

zh: 术后并发症为肺部感染。
en: The postoperative complication was pulmonary infection.

zh: 并发症要写进出院小结，不能省。
en: The complication must be written in the discharge summary, it cannot be omitted.

zh: 误诊原因分析已写入死亡病例讨论记录。
en: The analysis of the misdiagnosis was entered in the death case discussion record.

zh: 不能轻易写误诊，要有依据。
en: Do not write misdiagnosis lightly, it needs evidence.

zh: 医嘱须由具备处方权的医师下达。
en: Medical orders must be issued by a physician with prescribing rights.

zh: 医嘱改一下，把输液速度降下来。
en: Change the medical order and lower the infusion rate.

zh: 长期医嘱包括低盐饮食与每日测血压。
en: Standing orders included a low-salt diet and daily blood pressure measurement.

zh: 长期医嘱开好没有，护理要照着执行。
en: Are the standing orders written, nursing will follow them.

zh: 临时医嘱：地西泮十毫克，睡前一次。
en: Temporary order: diazepam ten milligrams once at bedtime.

zh: 临时医嘱别忘了开，今晚就要做。
en: Do not forget the temporary order, it is needed tonight.

zh: 备用医嘱：体温超过三十八度五予退热药。
en: As-needed order: antipyretic if temperature exceeds 38.5 degrees.

zh: 备用医嘱要看条件，不是每天都给。
en: The as-needed order depends on the condition, it is not given every day.

zh: 停止医嘱后护士须及时在系统内确认。
en: After a discontinue order the nurse must confirm it in the system promptly.

zh: 这个药停止医嘱开了吗，别再输了。
en: Has the discontinue order been written for this drug, do not infuse it again.

zh: 医嘱执行后须记录执行时间与执行人。
en: After order implementation, the time and the person must be recorded.

zh: 医嘱执行了没有，签字才算完成。
en: Has the order been implemented? It counts only after signing.

zh: 医嘱核对由两名护士完成。
en: Order verification is completed by two nurses.

zh: 医嘱核对别走过场，剂量要看清楚。
en: Do not treat order verification as a formality, check the dose carefully.

zh: 医嘱转抄后须与原医嘱逐项核对。
en: After order transcription every item must be checked against the original order.

zh: 医嘱转抄容易错，转完再对一遍。
en: Order transcription is error-prone, check it again after copying.

zh: 出院医嘱须写明复诊时间与联系电话。
en: The discharge order must state the follow-up time and contact number.

zh: 出院医嘱给病人讲一遍，别只塞张纸。
en: Explain the discharge order to the patient, do not just hand over a sheet.

zh: 医嘱变更须注明原因与时间。
en: Order modification must state the reason and the time.

zh: 医嘱变更了要通知护士，不然还按老的开。
en: When an order modification is made, tell the nurse or the old one will still be followed.

zh: 医嘱审核由临床药师完成，发现问题退回医师。
en: Order review is done by a clinical pharmacist, who returns problems to the physician.

zh: 这个医嘱审核没过，剂量超了，先别发药。
en: This order review failed because the dose is too high, do not dispense yet.

zh: 医嘱补录须注明实际下达时间与补录原因。
en: Late order entry must state the actual order time and the reason for the delay.

zh: 医嘱补录不要写成现在时间，要写实际时间。
en: For late order entry do not write the current time, write the actual time.

zh: 电子医嘱须由下达医师本人完成医嘱签名。
en: Electronic orders must be signed by the ordering physician personally.

zh: 医嘱签名是你自己的工号，不能代签。
en: The order signature must be your own staff number, no signing on behalf of others.

zh: 病程记录须反映病情变化与上级医师意见。
en: The progress note must reflect changes in condition and the senior physician's opinion.

zh: 病程记录今天还没写，查完房补上。
en: The progress note is not written today, complete it after rounds.

zh: 首次病程记录须在入院后八小时内完成。
en: The initial progress note must be completed within eight hours of admission.

zh: 首次病程记录写了吗，八小时内要完成。
en: Is the initial progress note done, it is due within eight hours.

zh: 日常病程记录一般每日一次，危重患者随时记录。
en: A daily progress note is usual, with entries at any time for critically ill patients.

zh: 日常病程记录别只写病情平稳四个字。
en: Do not write only stable condition in the daily progress note.

zh: 上级医师查房记录须有上级医师签名。
en: The senior physician rounds note must be signed by that physician.

zh: 上级医师查房记录还没签，催一下。
en: The senior physician rounds note is unsigned, please chase it up.

zh: 主治医师查房记录应体现诊断依据与治疗调整。
en: The attending physician rounds note should show the diagnostic basis and treatment changes.

zh: 主治医师查房记录写在日常病程后面。
en: The attending physician rounds note goes after the daily progress entry.

zh: 主任医师查房记录须在一周内完成首次。
en: The first chief physician rounds note must be completed within one week.

zh: 主任医师查房记录要把下一步方案写清楚。
en: The chief physician rounds note must state the next plan clearly.

zh: 疑难病例讨论记录须写明参加人员与结论。
en: The difficult case discussion record must list participants and conclusions.

zh: 这个病人要不要提交疑难病例讨论记录。
en: Should this patient go to a difficult case discussion record.

zh: 术前小结由经治医师书写，上级医师审签。
en: The preoperative summary is written by the treating physician and reviewed by a senior.

zh: 术前小结写完整，麻醉科要看。
en: Complete the preoperative summary, anaesthesia will review it.

zh: 术后首次病程记录须在术后即刻完成。
en: The first postoperative progress note must be completed immediately after surgery.

zh: 术后首次病程记录别拖，回病房就写。
en: Do not delay the first postoperative progress note, write it back on the ward.

zh: 住院满一个月须写阶段小结。
en: An interval summary is required after one month of admission.

zh: 阶段小结这个月该写了，别等出院。
en: The interval summary is due this month, do not wait until discharge.

zh: 交接班记录须写明危重患者与待处理事项。
en: The handover record must list critically ill patients and pending tasks.

zh: 交接班记录写清楚，别口头说说就完了。
en: Write the handover record properly, do not just say it verbally.

zh: 病情变化记录须写明时间、表现与处理。
en: The record of condition change must state the time, findings and management.

zh: 病人刚抽搐了，病情变化记录马上写。
en: The patient just had a seizure, write the record of condition change at once.

zh: 诊疗计划须与诊断和病情相符。
en: The treatment plan must match the diagnosis and the condition.

zh: 诊疗计划写具体点，别写继续治疗。
en: Make the treatment plan specific, do not write continue treatment.

zh: 护理记录与病程记录须相互对应。
en: The nursing record and the progress note must correspond to each other.

zh: 护理记录里生命体征那栏空着，补上。
en: The vital signs column in the nursing record is blank, fill it in.

zh: 科内会诊由科室主任组织。
en: Intradepartmental consultation is organised by the department head.

zh: 科内会诊定在下午，大家把片子带上。
en: Intradepartmental consultation is this afternoon, bring the images.

zh: 科间会诊须在二十四小时内完成。
en: Interdepartmental consultation must be completed within twenty-four hours.

zh: 科间会诊单开了没，心内科到现在没来。
en: Has the interdepartmental consultation been requested, cardiology has not come yet.

zh: 院外会诊须经医务部门审批备案。
en: Outside consultation requires approval and filing by the medical affairs office.

zh: 院外会诊的手续先走，别先请人来了。
en: Complete the outside consultation formalities first, do not bring the expert in yet.

zh: 急会诊须在十分钟内到位。
en: Urgent consultation must be attended within ten minutes.

zh: 叫急会诊，病人血压掉了。
en: Call an urgent consultation, the blood pressure has dropped.

zh: 会诊申请须写明会诊目的与主要问题。
en: The consultation request must state the purpose and main questions.

zh: 会诊申请写清楚要解决什么问题。
en: Make the consultation request clear about what needs solving.

zh: 会诊意见已记录在病程中，请主管医师落实。
en: The consultation opinion has been recorded in the progress note, the treating physician should act on it.

zh: 会诊意见和我们的方案不一样，先讨论再改。
en: The consultation opinion differs from our plan, discuss before changing it.

zh: 会诊记录由会诊医师书写并签名。
en: The consultation record is written and signed by the consulting physician.

zh: 会诊记录别只写同意目前治疗。
en: Do not write only agree with current treatment in the consultation record.

zh: 多学科会诊每周三下午固定进行。
en: Multidisciplinary consultation is held every Wednesday afternoon.

zh: 这个肿瘤病人走多学科会诊更合适。
en: This cancer patient is better handled through multidisciplinary consultation.

zh: 转科记录由转出科室书写，转入科室接收。
en: The transfer note is written by the departing department and received by the incoming one.

zh: 转科记录写好了吗，那边等着接收。
en: Is the transfer note ready, they are waiting to receive.

zh: 转院手续须经科主任与医务部门同意。
en: The hospital transfer procedure requires the department head and medical affairs approval.

zh: 转院手续先办，救护车我来联系。
en: Complete the hospital transfer procedure first, I will arrange the ambulance.

zh: 接收科室须在转科记录上签字确认。
en: The receiving department must sign the transfer note to confirm.

zh: 接收科室说没床，先别推病人过去。
en: The receiving department says there is no bed, do not move the patient yet.

zh: 转科交接须双方护士与医师共同完成。
en: Transfer handover must be completed jointly by nurses and physicians of both sides.

zh: 转科交接要当面做，别只发个消息。
en: Transfer handover must be done face to face, not just by message.

zh: 手术记录须在术后二十四小时内完成。
en: The operative note must be completed within twenty-four hours after surgery.

zh: 手术记录写完给我看，别只写手术顺利。
en: Show me the operative note when done, do not just write surgery went well.

zh: 手术通知单须注明手术名称、部位与麻醉方式。
en: The surgery notification must state the procedure, site and anaesthetic method.

zh: 手术通知单今天下午三点前送到手术室。
en: Send the surgery notification to the theatre before three this afternoon.

zh: 手术部位标识须由术者在患者清醒时完成。
en: Surgical site marking must be done by the surgeon while the patient is awake.

zh: 手术部位标识做了吗，左膝还是右膝。
en: Has the surgical site marking been done, left or right knee.

zh: 手术分级与术者资质必须匹配。
en: The surgery classification must match the surgeon's credentials.

zh: 这台是四级手术，主刀要有相应资质。
en: This is a level-four operation under surgery classification, the surgeon needs the matching credentials.

zh: 麻醉记录须包含麻醉方式、用药与出入量。
en: The anesthesia record must include the technique, drugs and fluid balance.

zh: 麻醉记录单贴到病历里，别丢了。
en: File the anesthesia record in the chart, do not lose it.

zh: 麻醉术前访视记录须写明明细与 ASA 分级。
en: The pre-anesthetic visit record must state the findings and ASA class.

zh: 麻醉术前访视记录做了没，明天第一台。
en: Has the pre-anesthetic visit record been done, first case tomorrow.

zh: 麻醉复苏记录须记录离室评分与时间。
en: The post-anesthesia recovery record must note the discharge score and time.

zh: 麻醉复苏记录写完了再送回病房。
en: Finish the post-anesthesia recovery record before sending the patient back.

zh: 术后随访记录须在术后二十四小时内完成。
en: The postoperative follow-up record must be completed within twenty-four hours.

zh: 术后随访记录别忘写镇痛评分。
en: Do not forget the analgesia score in the postoperative follow-up record.

zh: 植入物登记须记录产品名称与批号。
en: Implant registration must record the product name and batch number.

zh: 植入物登记标签贴在病历上，不然后续没法追溯。
en: Stick the implant registration label in the chart, otherwise traceability fails.

zh: 手术清点记录须由巡回与器械护士共同签名。
en: The surgical count record must be signed by the circulating and scrub nurses.

zh: 手术清点记录对不上，先别关腹。
en: The surgical count record does not match, do not close yet.

zh: 手术风险评估包括心肺功能与营养状态。
en: Surgical risk assessment covers cardiorespiratory function and nutrition.

zh: 手术风险评估是高危，术前要跟家属谈清楚。
en: Surgical risk assessment is high risk, discuss it clearly with the family preoperatively.

zh: 麻醉分级为三级，属高风险患者。
en: The ASA physical status classification was three, a high-risk patient.

zh: 麻醉分级写几级，术前访视单上要填。
en: What is the ASA class, fill it in on the pre-anesthetic form.

zh: 抢救记录须在抢救结束后六小时内补记完成。
en: The rescue record must be completed within six hours after resuscitation ends.

zh: 抢救记录现在补，六小时内必须写完。
en: Complete the rescue record now, it must be done within six hours.

zh: 抢救起止时间须精确到分钟并双人核对。
en: The rescue start and end time must be to the minute and checked by two staff.

zh: 抢救起止时间记准，家属会问几点开始的。
en: Record the rescue start and end time accurately, the family will ask when it began.

zh: 抢救经过须按时间顺序写明各项措施与反应。
en: The course of rescue must state each measure and response in chronological order.

zh: 抢救经过写得细一点，几点给药几点除颤。
en: Write the course of rescue in detail, when drugs were given and when defibrillation was done.

zh: 抢救措施包括气管插管、静脉通路与升压药。
en: Rescue measures included intubation, intravenous access and vasopressors.

zh: 抢救措施逐条写，别合并成一句。
en: List the rescue measures one by one, do not merge them into one sentence.

zh: 抢救人员名单须与排班记录一致。
en: The list of rescue personnel must match the duty roster.

zh: 抢救人员都记上，进修医生也要写。
en: Record all rescue personnel, including the trainee doctors.

zh: 抢救用药须记录药名、剂量、给药途径与时间。
en: Resuscitative medication must be recorded with name, dose, route and time.

zh: 抢救用药别只写肾上腺素，剂量也要写。
en: Do not write only adrenaline for resuscitative medication, include the dose.

zh: 抢救记录补记须注明补记时间与原因。
en: Supplementary rescue documentation must state when and why it was written.

zh: 抢救记录补记要写明是事后补的，不能装作当时写的。
en: The supplementary rescue documentation must state it was written afterwards, not pretend it was contemporaneous.

zh: 病危通知书须由家属签收并注明时间。
en: The critical condition notice must be signed by the family with the time noted.

zh: 病危通知书先让家属签，抢救同时进行。
en: Have the family sign the critical condition notice while resuscitation continues.

zh: 抢救室登记本与病历信息须保持一致。
en: The resuscitation room register must be consistent with the medical record.

zh: 抢救室登记本补一下，刚才那个病人没写转归。
en: Update the resuscitation room register, the outcome for that patient is missing.

zh: 复苏后评估须记录意识、瞳孔与血氧。
en: The post-resuscitation assessment must record consciousness, pupils and oxygen saturation.

zh: 复苏后评估做了吗，瞳孔和血糖都要查。
en: Has the post-resuscitation assessment been done, check pupils and glucose too.

zh: 院前抢救记录须随患者一并移交。
en: The prehospital emergency care record must be handed over with the patient.

zh: 院前抢救记录给我看一下，路上用了什么药。
en: Show me the prehospital emergency care record; what drugs were given en route?

zh: 抢救记录审核由科主任或质控医师完成。
en: Rescue record review is done by the department head or quality control physician.

zh: 抢救记录审核没通过，时间点前后矛盾。
en: The rescue record review failed, the times contradict each other.

zh: 抢救记录签名须由参加抢救的人员本人完成。
en: The rescue record signature must be made personally by those who took part.

zh: 抢救记录签名别漏了，参加的人都要签。
en: Do not miss any rescue record signature, everyone involved must sign.

zh: 死亡记录须在患者死亡后二十四小时内完成。
en: The death record must be completed within twenty-four hours after death.

zh: 死亡记录写完了吗，家属等着办手续。
en: Is the death record finished, the family is waiting for the paperwork.

zh: 死亡时间以心电图直线并记录的时间为准。
en: The time of death is the time when asystole is documented on the ECG.

zh: 死亡时间记准，死亡证明上要用。
en: Record the time of death accurately, it goes on the death certificate.

zh: 死亡原因须与死亡证明书一致。
en: The cause of death must match the death certificate.

zh: 死亡原因先别下定论，等讨论后统一。
en: Do not settle the cause of death yet, agree it after discussion.

zh: 直接死亡原因填写为呼吸循环衰竭。
en: The immediate cause of death was recorded as cardiorespiratory failure.

zh: 直接死亡原因和根本原因要分开填。
en: Fill in the immediate cause of death separately from the underlying cause.

zh: 根本死亡原因须依据病史与病理判断。
en: The underlying cause of death is judged from the history and pathology.

zh: 根本死亡原因写错了，统计口径就不对。
en: If the underlying cause of death is wrong, the statistics are wrong.

zh: 死亡诊断应与住院期间的检查结果相符。
en: The death diagnosis should match the investigations during admission.

zh: 死亡诊断和出院诊断口径要一致。
en: The death diagnosis must be consistent with the discharge diagnosis.

zh: 死亡病例讨论记录须在一周内完成。
en: The death case discussion record must be completed within one week.

zh: 死亡病例讨论记录别写成走过场，问题要写出来。
en: Do not make the death case discussion record a formality, write the problems out.

zh: 死亡证明书须由执业医师填写并加盖专用章。
en: The death certificate must be completed by a licensed physician and stamped.

zh: 死亡证明书一共几联，家属别弄丢了。
en: How many copies does the death certificate have, the family must not lose them.

zh: 死亡通知须由两名医护人员共同完成。
en: Death notification must be carried out by two clinicians together.

zh: 死亡通知别让实习生单独去说。
en: Do not let a trainee deliver the death notification alone.

zh: 尸检须经家属同意并签署知情同意书。
en: Autopsy requires family consent and a signed consent form.

zh: 要不要建议尸检，得看家属能不能接受。
en: Should we suggest an autopsy, it depends whether the family can accept it.

zh: 尸检同意书须写明检查范围与用途。
en: The autopsy consent must state the scope and purpose of the examination.

zh: 尸检同意书签了才能做，别先动遗体。
en: The autopsy consent must be signed first, do not touch the body before that.

zh: 遗体交接记录须写明时间、双方人员与遗体状况。
en: The remains handover record must state the time, both parties and the condition of the body.

zh: 遗体交接记录签一下，太平间要留底。
en: Sign the remains handover record, the mortuary needs a copy.

zh: 死亡登记须在死亡后二十四小时内完成。
en: Death registration must be completed within twenty-four hours after death.

zh: 死亡登记漏了一个，赶紧补，报表要报。
en: One death registration is missing, add it now, the report is due.

zh: 脑死亡判定须由两名以上医师按规范程序完成。
en: Brain death determination must be performed by at least two physicians following the protocol.

zh: 脑死亡判定结果要跟家属反复解释。
en: The brain death determination result must be explained to the family repeatedly.

zh: 出院小结须包括入院情况、诊疗经过与出院医嘱。
en: The discharge summary must cover the admission, treatment course and discharge orders.

zh: 出院小结今天必须出，医保要结算。
en: The discharge summary must be issued today, insurance needs it for settlement.

zh: 入院日期与出院日期须与住院登记一致。
en: The admission date and discharge date must match the inpatient registration.

zh: 入院日期再核对一下，别和急诊日期混了。
en: Check the admission date again, do not confuse it with the emergency visit date.

zh: 出院日期以医嘱下达时间为准。
en: The discharge date is set by the time the discharge order is written.

zh: 出院日期还没定，等主任查房再说。
en: The discharge date is not set yet, wait for the chief's rounds.

zh: 住院天数按出院日期减入院日期计算。
en: Length of stay is calculated by subtracting the admission date from the discharge date.

zh: 住院天数算错了，医保会退回来。
en: The length of stay is miscalculated, insurance will reject it.

zh: 出院带药须与出院医嘱一致。
en: Discharge medication must match the discharge order.

zh: 出院带药只开一周，剩下的让他来门诊续。
en: Give only one week of discharge medication, the rest can be renewed at the clinic.

zh: 出院指导须口头讲解并有书面材料。
en: Discharge instructions must be explained verbally and provided in writing.

zh: 出院指导别只给一张纸，要问病人听懂没有。
en: Do not just hand over a sheet for discharge instructions, ask whether the patient understood.

zh: 随访计划须写明复查时间与负责科室。
en: The follow-up plan must state the review date and the responsible department.

zh: 随访计划留个电话，病人有问题能打。
en: Put a phone number in the follow-up plan so the patient can call with problems.

zh: 出院评估包括生命体征、伤口与活动能力。
en: Discharge assessment covers vital signs, wounds and mobility.

zh: 出院评估没做就别办出院，路上出事谁负责。
en: Do not discharge without a discharge assessment, who is responsible if something happens on the way.

zh: 达到出院标准后方可办理出院手续。
en: Discharge formalities may be completed only once the discharge criteria are met.

zh: 他还没达到出院标准，血象还没降下来。
en: He does not meet the discharge criteria yet, the blood count has not come down.

zh: 非计划再入院须在病历质控中分析原因。
en: Unplanned readmission must be analysed in medical record quality control.

zh: 这个非计划再入院要复盘，是不是出院太早。
en: This unplanned readmission needs review, was the discharge too early.

zh: 转归栏须填写治愈、好转、未愈或死亡。
en: The outcome field must record cured, improved, not cured or died.

zh: 转归写好转还是治愈，要看复查结果。
en: Whether the outcome is improved or cured depends on the review results.

zh: 出院转归为治愈，复查指标均正常。
en: The outcome at discharge was cured, with all review indices normal.

zh: 写治愈要有依据，别凭感觉写。
en: Writing cured needs evidence, not a feeling.

zh: 转归为好转，嘱两周后门诊复查。
en: The outcome was improved, with a clinic review in two weeks.

zh: 他算好转，回家还得继续吃药。
en: He counts as improved, but must keep taking medicine at home.

zh: 自动出院须签署知情同意与风险告知书。
en: Discharge against medical advice requires a signed acknowledgement of risk.

zh: 家属坚持要自动出院，把风险讲清楚再签字。
en: The family insists on discharge against medical advice, explain the risks before they sign.

zh: 诊断证明书须经医师签名并加盖专用章。
en: The medical certificate of diagnosis must be signed and officially stamped.

zh: 开诊断证明书要挂号，不能当场随便写。
en: A medical certificate of diagnosis requires a clinic visit, it cannot be written on the spot.

zh: 病假条须写明休息起止日期与建议天数。
en: The sick leave certificate must state the start and end dates and the recommended days.

zh: 病假条只能开一周，长了要复诊。
en: The sick leave certificate can cover only one week, longer needs a review.

zh: 病假天数应与病情严重程度相符。
en: The days of sick leave should match the severity of the condition.

zh: 病假天数别一次开太多，按规定来。
en: Do not issue too many days of sick leave at once, follow the rules.

zh: 休息建议包括避免负重与卧床时间。
en: The rest recommendation includes avoiding weight-bearing and the period of bed rest.

zh: 休息建议写具体点，别只写注意休息。
en: Make the rest recommendation specific, do not just write take a rest.

zh: 复工证明须结合复查结果开具。
en: The fitness-for-work certificate must be issued together with review results.

zh: 他要复工证明，先看复查报告再开。
en: He wants a fitness-for-work certificate, check the review report before issuing it.

zh: 出生医学证明须核对父母身份信息后签发。
en: The birth certificate is issued after checking the parents' identity details.

zh: 出生医学证明名字写错了，改起来很麻烦。
en: If the name on the birth certificate is wrong, correcting it is very troublesome.

zh: 诊断证明专用章由医务部门统一管理。
en: The official seal for medical certificates is controlled by the medical affairs office.

zh: 诊断证明专用章不能借给别的科室用。
en: The official seal for medical certificates cannot be lent to another department.

zh: 诊断意见须与病历记录一致。
en: The diagnostic opinion must be consistent with the medical record.

zh: 诊断意见和病历对不上，家属会质疑。
en: If the diagnostic opinion does not match the record, the family will question it.

zh: 住院证明须载明入院与出院日期。
en: The hospitalisation certificate must state the admission and discharge dates.

zh: 单位要住院证明，出院时一起开。
en: The employer wants a hospitalisation certificate, issue it at discharge.

zh: 伤情证明须客观描述创口大小与位置。
en: The injury certificate must describe the size and site of the wound objectively.

zh: 伤情证明别写推测，只写你看到的。
en: Do not write speculation in the injury certificate, write only what you observed.

zh: 误工证明须与病假条时间衔接。
en: The lost-work certificate must match the period on the sick leave certificate.

zh: 误工证明开的时候要写清休息多少天。
en: When issuing the lost-work certificate, state clearly how many days of rest.

zh: 保险理赔医学证明须如实填写诊疗项目。
en: The insurance medical certificate must accurately list the treatment provided.

zh: 保险理赔医学证明不能按病人要求改诊断。
en: The insurance medical certificate cannot have the diagnosis changed at the patient's request.

zh: 诊断证明书存根须保存两年以上。
en: The counterfoil of medical certificates must be kept for at least two years.

zh: 诊断证明书存根翻出来对一下，笔迹不对。
en: Check the counterfoil of the medical certificate, the handwriting does not match.

zh: 转诊理由须写明本院不具备的条件。
en: The reason for referral must state what this hospital cannot provide.

zh: 转诊理由要写实话，不能只写患者要求。
en: The reason for referral must be honest, not just patient request.

zh: 转诊回执须留存归档备查。
en: The referral receipt must be kept on file for verification.

zh: 转诊回执要回来，不然算没交接完。
en: The referral receipt must come back, otherwise the handover is incomplete.

zh: 检查申请单须写明检查部位与临床诊断。
en: The examination request form must state the site and the clinical diagnosis.

zh: 检查申请单别只写查一下，部位要填。
en: Do not just write check it on the examination request form, fill in the site.

zh: 检验申请单须注明标本类型与检验项目。
en: The laboratory request form must state the specimen type and the tests requested.

zh: 检验申请单开错了，重开一张。
en: The laboratory request form is wrong, issue a new one.

zh: 影像检查申请单须写明检查目的与既往结果。
en: The imaging request form must state the purpose and previous results.

zh: 影像检查申请单上写怀孕了吗，这很重要。
en: Does the imaging request form mention pregnancy, that matters a lot.

zh: 输血申请单须由主治及以上医师审核。
en: The blood transfusion request form must be reviewed by an attending physician or above.

zh: 输血申请单和血样一起送血库，别分开。
en: Send the blood transfusion request form with the sample to the blood bank, not separately.

zh: 病理申请单须写明标本来源与固定方式。
en: The pathology request form must state the specimen source and fixative.

zh: 病理申请单临床诊断那栏空着不行。
en: The clinical diagnosis field on the pathology request form cannot be left blank.

zh: 申请医师须签署姓名与工号。
en: The requesting physician must sign with name and staff number.

zh: 申请医师是谁，出了问题先找他。
en: Who is the requesting physician, if there is a problem we go to him first.

zh: 申请科室与执行科室须在系统中对应。
en: The requesting department and the performing department must correspond in the system.

zh: 申请科室填错了，检验科不认。
en: The requesting department is wrong, the laboratory will not accept it.

zh: 病历管理由病案管理部门统一负责。
en: Medical record management is the responsibility of the medical record department.

zh: 病历管理这块检查很严，别随便外借。
en: Medical record management is inspected strictly, do not lend records casually.

zh: 病历归档须在出院后规定时限内完成。
en: Medical record archiving must be completed within the set time after discharge.

zh: 病历归档慢了会被扣分，催一下。
en: Slow medical record archiving loses points, chase it up.

zh: 病历借阅须登记用途与归还时间。
en: Medical record access must record the purpose and the return time.

zh: 病历借阅只能在本室看，不能带走。
en: Medical record access is only allowed inside this room, records cannot be taken away.

zh: 病历复印须核验申请人身份与授权材料。
en: Medical record copying requires verification of identity and authorisation.

zh: 病历复印要带身份证，家属代办还要委托书。
en: Medical record copying needs an ID, and a family proxy also needs an authorisation letter.

zh: 病历封存须医患双方共同在场并签字。
en: Medical record sealing requires both parties present and signing.

zh: 病历封存要当着家属的面封，别自己封。
en: Medical record sealing must be done in front of the family, not alone.

zh: 病历启封须记录时间、地点与在场人员。
en: Unsealing of medical records must record the time, place and those present.

zh: 病历启封不能单方面进行，必须双方在场。
en: Unsealing of medical records cannot be unilateral, both sides must be present.

zh: 病历保存期限门诊不少于十五年。
en: The retention period of outpatient medical records is at least fifteen years.

zh: 病历保存期限没到不能销毁，这是硬规定。
en: Records cannot be destroyed before the retention period ends, that is a hard rule.

zh: 病历质控每月抽取一定比例病历。
en: Medical record quality control samples a set proportion of records each month.

zh: 病历质控抽查到我们科了，赶紧自查。
en: Medical record quality control has sampled our department, self-check quickly.

zh: 病历缺陷分为一般缺陷与重大缺陷。
en: Medical record defects are graded as minor and major.

zh: 这个病历缺陷是缺上级医师签名，补签没用。
en: This medical record defect is a missing senior signature, back-signing will not help.

zh: 病历修改须保留原记录并注明修改时间。
en: Medical record amendment must preserve the original entry and note the time.

zh: 病历修改不能涂掉原字，要划双线再改。
en: Medical record amendment must not erase the original, draw a double line and correct it.

zh: 病历真实性是医疗损害责任认定的关键。
en: The authenticity of medical records is central to determining liability.

zh: 病历真实性出了问题，后面怎么解释都没用。
en: Once the authenticity of medical records is questioned, no explanation helps.

zh: 病历完整性检查包括入院记录与知情同意书。
en: Completeness of medical records covers the admission note and consent forms.

zh: 病历完整性不够，缺了手术同意书。
en: Completeness of medical records is poor, the surgical consent form is missing.

zh: 病历查阅权限按岗位分级设置。
en: Access rights to medical records are set by role level.

zh: 病历查阅权限别乱开，护士看不到全部。
en: Do not grant access rights to medical records casually, nurses cannot see everything.

zh: 病案室须具备防火防潮与防盗条件。
en: The medical record room must be protected against fire, damp and theft.

zh: 病案室几点下班，我要调一份旧病历。
en: When does the medical record room close, I need an old record.

zh: 电子病历须符合统一的接口与数据标准。
en: Electronic medical records must follow common interface and data standards.

zh: 电子病历系统卡住了，先手写再补录。
en: The electronic medical record system is frozen, write by hand and enter it later.

zh: 电子签名与手写签名具有同等效力。
en: An electronic signature has the same effect as a handwritten one.

zh: 电子签名只能用你自己的账号，不要共用。
en: Electronic signatures must use your own account, never share it.

zh: 电子签名认证须由具备资质的机构提供。
en: Electronic signature authentication must be provided by a qualified authority.

zh: 电子签名认证过期了，登录不上系统。
en: The electronic signature authentication has expired, I cannot log in.

zh: 时间戳由系统自动生成，不得人为修改。
en: The timestamp is generated by the system and must not be altered.

zh: 时间戳显示凌晨三点，那会儿谁在改病历。
en: The timestamp shows three in the morning, who was editing the record then.

zh: 电子病历系统须具备权限管理与操作留痕功能。
en: The electronic medical record system must support access control and audit trails.

zh: 电子病历系统今晚升级，大家提前下班前保存。
en: The electronic medical record system is upgraded tonight, save everything before leaving.

zh: 结构化病历便于质控与科研数据提取。
en: A structured medical record makes quality control and research extraction easier.

zh: 结构化病历点选太多，写不清具体情况。
en: Structured medical records have too many tick boxes and cannot describe specifics.

zh: 病历模板须经科室审核后统一使用。
en: Medical record templates must be approved by the department before use.

zh: 病历模板套得太顺，容易漏掉个体差异。
en: Following the medical record template too smoothly makes it easy to miss individual differences.

zh: 修改痕迹不得删除或覆盖。
en: The audit trail must not be deleted or overwritten.

zh: 修改痕迹一查就知道谁改的，别想蒙。
en: The audit trail shows exactly who changed it, do not try to hide it.

zh: 操作日志至少保存六个月。
en: Operation logs are retained for at least six months.

zh: 操作日志显示他半夜查过这个病人。
en: The operation log shows he looked at this patient in the middle of the night.

zh: 电子病历归档后不得再修改。
en: An electronic record cannot be modified after archiving.

zh: 电子病历归档前把未签名的都签掉。
en: Sign all unsigned entries before electronic record archiving.

zh: 电子病历共享须取得患者授权。
en: Medical record sharing requires patient authorisation.

zh: 电子病历共享范围要写清楚，别全院都能看。
en: The scope of medical record sharing must be defined, not visible to the whole hospital.

zh: 病历数据安全实行分级保护与定期审计。
en: Medical record data security uses tiered protection and regular audits.

zh: 病历数据安全出了问题，全院都要通报。
en: If medical record data security fails, the whole hospital gets notified.

zh: 电子病历分级评价共分八个等级。
en: Electronic medical record grading has eight levels.

zh: 电子病历分级评价要升到五级，今年得改系统。
en: To reach level five in electronic medical record grading, the system must change this year.

zh: 数据接口须符合国家医疗数据交换标准。
en: Data interfaces must follow national health data exchange standards.

zh: 数据接口对不上，检验结果传不过来。
en: The data interface does not match, so lab results cannot be transferred.

zh: 拟行阑尾切除术，术中根据探查情况决定是否放置引流。
en: An appendectomy is planned, with a drain placed only if the findings indicate it.

zh: 你这个阑尾切除术，一般是打三个小孔，肚子上会留几个疤。
en: Your appendectomy is usually done through three small holes, so you will have a few small scars.

zh: 同意行腹腔镜阑尾切除术，如术中粘连严重则中转开腹。
en: Consent is given for laparoscopic appendectomy, converting to open surgery if dense adhesions are found.

zh: 腹腔镜阑尾切除术恢复快，两三天就能下床活动。
en: With a laparoscopic appendectomy you recover quickly and can walk in two or three days.

zh: 因胎儿窘迫拟行剖宫产术，已向孕妇及家属说明母婴风险。
en: A cesarean section is planned for fetal distress, and the maternal and fetal risks have been explained.

zh: 医生说要做剖宫产术，我有点怕，能不能再等等看。
en: The doctor says I need a cesarean section; I am nervous and wonder whether we can wait.

zh: 急诊行清创缝合术，术后需观察伤口有无感染及破伤风预防。
en: Emergency debridement and suture were performed, with the wound watched for infection and tetanus cover given.

zh: 这个口子得做清创缝合术，打点麻药，缝几针。
en: This cut needs debridement and suture; we will numb it and put in a few stitches.

zh: 拟行左胫骨骨折内固定术，术后需限制负重并定期复查X线。
en: Internal fixation of the left tibial fracture is planned, with limited weight bearing and repeat radiographs afterwards.

zh: 骨折内固定术以后钢板要不要取，得看位置和恢复情况。
en: Whether the plates come out after internal fixation depends on where they are and how the bone heals.

zh: 诊断不明时先行腹腔镜探查术，必要时中转开腹。
en: Laparoscopic exploration is performed first when the diagnosis is unclear, converting to laparotomy if needed.

zh: 先做腹腔镜探查术，创伤小，有事再转开腹。
en: We start with laparoscopic exploration because it is less invasive, and convert if we find a problem.

zh: 择期行胆囊切除术，术前禁食八小时并停用抗凝药。
en: Elective cholecystectomy is scheduled after an eight-hour fast and stopping anticoagulants.

zh: 胆囊切除术现在多是打孔做，第二天就能喝粥。
en: A cholecystectomy is usually done through keyholes now, and you can take fluids the next day.

zh: 拟行腹股沟疝修补术，可使用补片，术后避免重体力劳动三个月。
en: Inguinal hernia repair with mesh is planned, with no heavy lifting for three months.

zh: 腹股沟疝修补术做完当天就能下地，别使劲咳嗽。
en: After inguinal hernia repair you can walk the same day, but avoid hard coughing.

zh: 因胃窦部肿瘤行胃大部切除术，术后需少量多餐。
en: Subtotal gastrectomy was performed for an antral tumour, with small frequent meals afterwards.

zh: 胃大部切除术后得少吃多餐，一次吃多了会难受。
en: After a subtotal gastrectomy you eat small amounts often; a big meal will make you uncomfortable.

zh: 肠坏死行肠切除吻合术，术中注意吻合口血供。
en: Bowel resection with anastomosis was performed for ischaemic bowel, with attention to anastomotic blood supply.

zh: 肠切除吻合术后要等排气才能吃东西，别急着喂。
en: After bowel resection with anastomosis we wait for flatus before eating, so do not feed yet.

zh: 气胸行胸腔闭式引流术，术后观察水柱波动与漏气情况。
en: Closed chest drainage was placed for pneumothorax, with the water column and air leak monitored.

zh: 胸腔闭式引流术放根管子，咳嗽的时候瓶子会冒泡，别怕。
en: Closed chest drainage means a tube is left in; bubbling when you cough is expected, do not be alarmed.

zh: 糖尿病足坏疽行小腿截肢术，术前已评估残端血供与假肢条件。
en: Below-knee amputation was planned for diabetic gangrene after assessing stump perfusion and prosthetic suitability.

zh: 截肢术是最后的选择，我们先把能保的都保住了再谈。
en: Amputation is the last option; we try everything to save the limb first.

zh: 股骨颈骨折行全髋关节置换术，术后第一天开始床旁康复。
en: Total hip arthroplasty was performed for a femoral neck fracture, with bedside rehabilitation on day one.

zh: 全髋关节置换术后不能跷二郎腿，小心假体脱位。
en: After total hip arthroplasty do not cross your legs, or the prosthesis may dislocate.

zh: 三支病变行冠状动脉旁路移植术，术前停用抗血小板药并备血。
en: Coronary artery bypass grafting was planned for triple-vessel disease, with antiplatelets stopped and blood reserved.

zh: 冠状动脉旁路移植术要开胸，恢复期比放支架长得多。
en: Coronary artery bypass grafting means opening the chest, and recovery takes much longer than a stent.

zh: 局麻下行体表肿物切除术，标本送病理，七天出结果。
en: Excision of the superficial mass was done under local anaesthesia and the specimen sent for pathology, results in seven days.

zh: 体表肿物切除术门诊就能做，切下来的东西要化验。
en: Excision of the superficial mass can be done in the clinic, and the tissue will be tested.

zh: 肛周脓肿行切开引流术，术后每日换药至创面愈合。
en: Incision and drainage of the perianal abscess was performed, with daily dressing changes until healing.

zh: 脓肿切开引流术不用缝，敞开换药好得快。
en: Incision and drainage leaves the wound open, and dressing changes help it heal faster.

zh: 气管插管全身麻醉下完成手术，术毕待自主呼吸恢复后拔管。
en: Surgery was completed under endotracheal general anesthesia and the tube removed once spontaneous breathing returned.

zh: 气管插管全身麻醉醒了嗓子会疼，那是管子蹭的。
en: After endotracheal general anesthesia your throat will be sore from the tube.

zh: 全凭静脉麻醉用于术中神经电生理监测，避免吸入药干扰。
en: Total intravenous anesthesia was used to avoid interference with intraoperative neurophysiological monitoring.

zh: 全凭静脉麻醉不用面罩吸药，睡得更平稳，醒来也快。
en: With total intravenous anesthesia there is no mask agent, so you sleep smoothly and wake quickly.

zh: 小儿短小手术可选吸入全身麻醉，苏醒较快。
en: Inhalational general anesthesia may be chosen for short paediatric procedures because recovery is quick.

zh: 吸入全身麻醉是戴个面罩吸药，几口就睡着了。
en: Inhalational general anesthesia means breathing the agent through a mask and falling asleep in a few breaths.

zh: 椎管内麻醉适用于下腹部及下肢手术，术前需评估凝血与穿刺部位。
en: Neuraxial anesthesia suits lower abdominal and limb surgery, after checking coagulation and the puncture site.

zh: 椎管内麻醉人是清醒的，下半身没感觉，听到器械声别紧张。
en: With neuraxial anesthesia you stay awake but feel nothing below the waist; do not be alarmed by the sounds.

zh: 蛛网膜下腔阻滞下完成剖宫产，术中注意防治低血压。
en: Cesarean delivery was performed under spinal anesthesia, with prevention and treatment of hypotension.

zh: 蛛网膜下腔阻滞打完腿会发热发麻，那是正常起效。
en: After spinal anesthesia your legs feel warm and numb as it takes effect, which is normal.

zh: 硬膜外阻滞用于分娩镇痛，置管后按需追加药量。
en: Epidural anesthesia was used for labour analgesia, with top-ups given through the catheter as needed.

zh: 硬膜外阻滞那根管子留在背上，疼的时候能加药。
en: We keep the epidural anesthesia going through a catheter in your back.

zh: 腰硬联合麻醉用于下肢骨折手术，起效快且可延长阻滞时间。
en: Combined spinal-epidural anesthesia was used for lower limb fracture surgery, giving rapid onset and extendable block.

zh: 腰硬联合麻醉起效快，时间长了还能从管子里加药。
en: Combined spinal-epidural anesthesia works fast and can be topped up through the catheter if it runs long.

zh: 局部浸润麻醉逐层注射，注意单次总量不超过安全上限。
en: Local infiltration anesthesia was injected layer by layer, keeping the total dose below the safe limit.

zh: 局部浸润麻醉打的时候有点胀，忍一下就好。
en: Local infiltration anesthesia stings a little as it goes in, so bear with it.

zh: 超声引导下神经阻滞可减少局麻药用量并提高成功率。
en: Ultrasound-guided nerve block reduces the local anesthetic dose and improves success.

zh: 神经阻滞打完那条腿会麻几个小时，别下地走。
en: After the nerve block that leg stays numb for hours, so do not try to walk.

zh: 臂丛神经阻滞下行桡骨远端骨折复位，注意观察气胸与局麻药中毒。
en: Brachial plexus block was used for distal radius fracture reduction, watching for pneumothorax and toxicity.

zh: 臂丛神经阻滞打完手抬不起来是正常的，药效过了就好。
en: After a brachial plexus block the arm will not lift, which is normal until it wears off.

zh: 表面麻醉下行胃镜检查，嘱患者含住麻药五分钟后咽下。
en: Topical anesthesia was used for gastroscopy, asking the patient to hold the agent for five minutes before swallowing.

zh: 表面麻醉就是喉咙喷麻药，有点苦，别咽太快。
en: Topical anesthesia means spraying the throat numb; it tastes bitter, so do not swallow too fast.

zh: 监护麻醉下完成拔牙与内镜操作，术中持续监测血氧与血压。
en: Monitored anesthesia care was used for dental extraction and endoscopy, with continuous oxygen and pressure monitoring.

zh: 监护麻醉是半睡半醒，叫你能应，但不会觉得疼。
en: With monitored anesthesia care you are drowsy but can respond, and you will not feel pain.

zh: 术前给予轻度镇静，保持患者能配合指令并维持气道通畅。
en: Light sedation was given before the procedure, keeping the patient able to follow commands and protect the airway.

zh: 给你一点镇静，人放松点，不舒服就说话。
en: We will give you some sedation to relax you; tell us if you are uncomfortable.

zh: 清醒镇静用于关节复位，术中保持语言交流并监测呼吸。
en: Conscious sedation was used for joint reduction, maintaining verbal contact and monitoring breathing.

zh: 清醒镇静就是迷糊但能说话，疼了可以加药。
en: Conscious sedation means you are drowsy but can talk, and we can add more if it hurts.

zh: 麻醉诱导前再次核对禁食时间与过敏史，给药后立即准备通气。
en: Fasting time and allergies were rechecked before induction of anesthesia, with ventilation ready immediately after dosing.

zh: 麻醉诱导就是开始推药那几分钟，几秒钟就睡着了。
en: Induction of anesthesia is the few minutes when we start the drugs; you are asleep in seconds.

zh: 麻醉维持期间根据血压与心率调整吸入浓度，避免术中知晓。
en: During maintenance of anesthesia the inhaled concentration is adjusted to blood pressure and heart rate to prevent awareness.

zh: 麻醉维持这一段最平稳，你什么都不用管，我们在盯着。
en: Maintenance of anesthesia is the stable part; you do not need to do anything, we are watching.

zh: 术前访视记录麻醉方案、气道评估结果与患者疑问。
en: The preoperative visit note records the anesthetic plan, airway findings and the patient's questions.

zh: 麻醉医生晚上会来术前访视，把想问的都问清楚。
en: The anesthesiologist will come for the preoperative visit tonight, so ask everything you want to know.

zh: 麻醉前评估重点看气道条件、心肺储备与近期用药。
en: Preanesthetic assessment focuses on airway features, cardiopulmonary reserve and recent medications.

zh: 麻醉前评估发现他最近在吃抗凝药，得先停药。
en: Preanesthetic assessment found he is on an anticoagulant, so it must be stopped first.

zh: 术前检查包括血常规、凝血功能、肝肾功能与胸片。
en: The preoperative workup includes a blood count, coagulation profile, liver and kidney function and a chest radiograph.

zh: 术前检查有几项没出，手术可能要往后推一天。
en: Some preoperative workup results are back yet, so surgery may slip by a day.

zh: 心肺功能评估结合心电图、胸片与六分钟步行试验判断手术耐受性。
en: Cardiopulmonary assessment combines electrocardiography, chest imaging and a six-minute walk test to judge fitness.

zh: 心肺功能评估不太好，麻醉方式得改一改。
en: The cardiopulmonary assessment is not favourable, so the anesthetic plan needs adjusting.

zh: 术前心电图提示频发室早，请心内科会诊后再定手术。
en: The preoperative electrocardiogram showed frequent ventricular ectopy, so cardiology review was requested before scheduling.

zh: 术前心电图有点问题，得让心内科先看看。
en: There is an abnormality on the preoperative electrocardiogram, so cardiology should see him first.

zh: 肝肾功能不全者需减少经肾排泄的肌松药剂量并延长监测时间。
en: In liver or kidney impairment, renally cleared muscle relaxants are reduced and monitoring is prolonged.

zh: 肝肾功能不太好，麻药得减量，醒了也多观察一会儿。
en: With poor liver and kidney function we reduce the anesthetic dose and watch you longer after waking.

zh: 电解质检查提示低钾，术前需补钾并复查后再麻醉。
en: The electrolyte panel showed hypokalaemia, so potassium was replaced and rechecked before anesthesia.

zh: 电解质检查钾低，先补钾，不然麻醉有风险。
en: The electrolyte panel shows low potassium; we replace it first, as anesthesia would be risky otherwise.

zh: 抗凝药停用时间依药物而定，华法林需提前五天并监测凝血。
en: Anticoagulant discontinuation depends on the drug; warfarin is stopped five days ahead with coagulation monitoring.

zh: 抗凝药停用这几天要小心，刷牙都别太用力。
en: While the anticoagulant is stopped, be careful even when brushing your teeth.

zh: 术前戒烟四周以上可明显降低术后肺部感染与伤口愈合不良。
en: Preoperative smoking cessation of four weeks or more clearly reduces chest infection and poor wound healing.

zh: 术前戒烟越早越好，哪怕提前两周也有好处。
en: Preoperative smoking cessation helps the earlier the better, even two weeks makes a difference.

zh: 营养评估提示重度营养不良，术前给予肠内营养一周再手术。
en: Nutritional assessment showed severe malnutrition, so enteral nutrition was given for a week before surgery.

zh: 营养评估不过关，先吃一周营养餐再上手术台。
en: The nutritional assessment is poor, so you need a week of supplements before surgery.

zh: 功能状态良好者耐受手术能力较强，可减少不必要的术前检查。
en: Good functional capacity predicts better tolerance of surgery and reduces unnecessary preoperative testing.

zh: 他功能状态不错，每天能走五公里，手术风险小很多。
en: His functional capacity is good, walking five kilometres a day, so surgical risk is much lower.

zh: 术前讨论记录术式、麻醉方式、备用方案与抢救预案。
en: The preoperative case discussion records the procedure, anesthetic plan, backup plan and resuscitation plan.

zh: 明天早上术前讨论，你把影像和化验都准备好。
en: Preoperative case discussion is tomorrow morning, so have the imaging and results ready.

zh: 颈部活动度受限者插管宜采用视频喉镜并避免强行后仰。
en: With limited neck mobility, intubation should use a video laryngoscope and avoid forced extension.

zh: 颈部活动度差，不能后仰，插管的时候别硬掰。
en: His neck will not extend, so do not force it during intubation; use the video laryngoscope.

zh: 牙齿情况记录松动牙与烤瓷冠，插管前用牙垫保护。
en: Dentition notes loose teeth and crowns, with a bite block used to protect them during intubation.

zh: 牙齿情况我记一下，你有颗牙松，插管时别碰掉。
en: One of your teeth is loose and could be knocked during intubation; we will note it first.

zh: 全麻前取下活动义齿并记录，交家属保管。
en: The removable denture was taken out and documented before general anesthesia, then given to the family.

zh: 进手术室前把活动义齿摘了，交给你家里人。
en: Take out the removable denture before going to theatre and give it to your family.

zh: 插管困难者应限制尝试次数，三次失败即改用声门上气道。
en: In difficult intubation, attempts are limited and a supraglottic airway is used after three failures.

zh: 插管困难，最多试三次，不行就换方案。
en: This is difficult intubation; we try at most three times, then change the plan.

zh: 声门暴露分级三级以上需调整头位或改用视频喉镜。
en: A Cormack-Lehane grade of III or worse calls for repositioning or a video laryngoscope.

zh: 声门暴露分级不好，垫个肩垫再试。
en: The Cormack-Lehane grade is poor, so put a shoulder roll under and try again.

zh: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停患者术后需加强气道监测，慎用镇静药。
en: Patients with obstructive sleep apnea need closer postoperative airway monitoring and careful sedation.

zh: 他有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停，术后别给太多镇静药。
en: He has obstructive sleep apnea, so do not give much sedation after surgery.

zh: 颏下间隙小于三指提示舌根空间不足，插管可能困难。
en: A submandibular space under three fingers suggests limited tongue space and possible intubation difficulty.

zh: 颏下间隙不到三指，插管可能不好插。
en: The submandibular space is under three fingers, so intubation may be difficult.

zh: 预给氧三分钟或四次深呼吸后开始诱导，提高缺氧耐受。
en: Preoxygenation for three minutes or four deep breaths precedes induction to improve hypoxia tolerance.

zh: 先预给氧几分钟，再推药，这样憋气时间能长一点。
en: We preoxygenate for a few minutes before induction so you can hold your breath longer.

zh: 饱胃患者采用快速序贯诱导，不给面罩正压通气。
en: Rapid sequence induction was used for a full stomach, avoiding positive pressure mask ventilation.

zh: 饱胃就用快速序贯诱导，别捏球囊，直接插。
en: With a full stomach we use rapid sequence induction, no bagging, straight to the tube.

zh: 困难气道处理流程要求每次尝试后重新评估氧合与方案。
en: The difficult airway algorithm requires reassessing oxygenation and the plan after each attempt.

zh: 按困难气道处理流程走，别一直试插，先保氧合。
en: Follow the difficult airway algorithm: do not keep trying, keep oxygenation first.

zh: ASA 一级患者麻醉风险低，可按常规方案实施。
en: ASA class I patients carry low anesthetic risk and follow the routine plan.

zh: ASA 一级就是身体挺好，除了这个手术没别的毛病。
en: ASA class I means you are basically healthy apart from the condition we are operating on.

zh: 高血压控制良好的 ASA 二级患者可安全接受择期手术。
en: An ASA class II patient with well-controlled hypertension can safely undergo elective surgery.

zh: ASA 二级，就是血压有点高但吃药控制得住。
en: ASA class II means slightly high blood pressure that tablets keep under control.

zh: ASA 三级患者术前需优化合并症，麻醉后加强监护。
en: ASA class III patients need comorbidities optimised before surgery and closer monitoring afterwards.

zh: ASA 三级，麻醉风险明显升高，术后要进监护室观察。
en: ASA class III means clearly higher anesthetic risk, so you will be monitored closely after surgery.

zh: ASA 四级患者仅在救命手术时实施麻醉，需多学科共同决策。
en: ASA class IV patients are anesthetised only for life-saving surgery, with multidisciplinary decisions.

zh: ASA 四级，做手术是为了保命，风险要家属充分理解。
en: ASA class IV means surgery is to save life, and the family must fully understand the risk.

zh: ASA 五级患者手术风险极高，术前须完成家属沟通并记录。
en: ASA class V carries extremely high risk, so family discussion is completed and documented before surgery.

zh: ASA 五级，人已经在生死边上，做不做手术都得说清楚。
en: ASA class V means the patient is at the edge of life, so the decision must be discussed openly.

zh: ASA 六级仅用于脑死亡器官捐献，需符合器官移植相关规定。
en: ASA class VI applies only to brain-dead organ donors and follows organ transplant regulations.

zh: ASA 六级是脑死亡捐献的情况，和普通手术不是一回事。
en: ASA class VI is the brain-dead donor situation, not the same as ordinary surgery.

zh: 记录为 ASA 三级 E，提示急诊手术需按加急流程准备。
en: Recorded as ASA class III with the emergency modifier, indicating emergency surgery.

zh: 他是 ASA 三级 E，那个 E 就是急诊手术的意思。
en: He is ASA class III with the emergency modifier; the E means emergency surgery.

zh: 麻醉风险分级为高危者，术前谈话须由高年资医师完成。
en: For high anesthesia risk classification, the preoperative discussion is led by a senior physician.

zh: 麻醉风险分级是高危，谈话得让主任来签字确认。
en: The anesthesia risk classification is high, so the consultant must lead the consent discussion.

zh: 围术期风险与 ASA 分级、手术分级和患者功能状态相关。
en: Perioperative risk depends on the ASA class, the surgical grade and functional capacity.

zh: 医生把围术期风险算了一遍，说这次手术风险中等。
en: The doctor worked out the perioperative risk and said it is moderate for this operation.

zh: 评估手术耐受力后确定术式与麻醉方式，耐受差者选择微创方案。
en: Surgical tolerance guides the choice of procedure and anesthesia, with minimally invasive options for frail patients.

zh: 他这个手术耐受力差，咱们选小一点的手术方式。
en: His surgical tolerance is poor, so we choose a smaller operation.

zh: 按术前禁饮两小时执行，可减少口渴与脱水又不增加误吸风险。
en: A two-hour clear fluid fast reduces thirst and dehydration without raising aspiration risk.

zh: 术前禁饮是两小时，白开水、糖水都算，牛奶不算清饮料。
en: The clear fluid fast is two hours; water and sugar water count, but milk does not.

zh: 记录禁食时间时须写明食物种类，油炸食物需延长至八小时以上。
en: When recording fasting duration, note the food type; fatty meals require more than eight hours.

zh: 禁食时间够不够，得看最后一次吃的是什么。
en: Whether the fasting duration is long enough depends on what was last eaten.

zh: 术前两小时内可少量饮用清饮料，不得饮用牛奶或含渣食物。
en: Clear fluids may be taken up to two hours before anesthesia; milk and solids are not allowed.

zh: 清饮料就是白开水、糖水这类，能看见底的才行。
en: Clear fluids mean water or sugar water you can see through, nothing cloudy.

zh: 糖尿病胃轻瘫与肠梗阻患者存在胃排空延迟，应按饱胃处理。
en: Diabetic gastroparesis and bowel obstruction cause delayed gastric emptying and are managed as a full stomach.

zh: 他胃排空延迟，虽然禁食了八小时，还是按饱胃处理。
en: He has delayed gastric emptying, so even after eight hours we treat him as a full stomach.

zh: 结直肠手术前需完成胃肠道准备，口服泻药并禁食。
en: Bowel preparation for colorectal surgery uses oral laxatives plus fasting.

zh: 胃肠道准备今天下午开始喝泻药，晚上会跑几趟厕所。
en: Bowel preparation starts this afternoon with laxatives; expect several trips to the toilet tonight.

zh: 皮肤准备使用抗菌皂清洁，避免用力搓擦损伤皮肤。
en: Skin preparation uses an antiseptic wash without vigorous scrubbing that damages the skin.

zh: 皮肤准备今晚洗个澡，用我们给的抗菌皂。
en: For skin preparation, shower tonight with the antiseptic soap we gave you.

zh: 手术区备皮宜用剪刀或推剪，避免剃刀造成皮肤破损。
en: Surgical site hair removal should use clippers rather than a razor, which can nick the skin.

zh: 手术区备皮用推子，不用剃刀，免得刮破皮感染。
en: We use clippers for surgical site hair removal, not a razor, to avoid cuts and infection.

zh: 术前用药记录药名、剂量与给药时间，避免与麻醉药叠加抑制呼吸。
en: Premedication is recorded with drug, dose and time to avoid additive respiratory depression.

zh: 术前用药已经给了，病人有点困，别再给镇静药。
en: Premedication has been given and the patient is drowsy, so no more sedatives.

zh: 术前镇静选用短效药物，给药后须监测血氧与呼吸。
en: Preoperative sedation uses a short-acting agent, with oxygen saturation and breathing monitored afterwards.

zh: 老人术前镇静要减量，容易呼吸抑制。
en: For elderly patients, preoperative sedation must be reduced because of respiratory depression risk.

zh: 预防性抗生素应在切皮前三十至六十分钟内给药，超过时间需追加。
en: Prophylactic antibiotics are given thirty to sixty minutes before incision and repeated if surgery runs long.

zh: 预防性抗生素已经推了，记一下时间。
en: The prophylactic antibiotic has gone in, so note the time.

zh: 血栓高风险者停华法林期间给予抗凝桥接，术前再停短效药。
en: Patients at high thrombotic risk receive anticoagulation bridging while warfarin is stopped, holding the short-acting drug before surgery.

zh: 他在做抗凝桥接，停药时间得按表来，不能自己停。
en: He is on anticoagulation bridging, so the stop dates follow the schedule, not his own choice.

zh: 围术期血糖管理目标为七点八至十毫摩尔每升，术中每小时监测。
en: Perioperative glucose management targets seven point eight to ten millimoles per litre, checked hourly in theatre.

zh: 围术期血糖管理要盯紧，高血糖伤口长不好。
en: Perioperative glucose management matters: high glucose slows wound healing.

zh: 饱胃、肠梗阻与胃排空延迟者误吸风险高，需快速序贯诱导。
en: A full stomach, obstruction or delayed emptying raises aspiration risk, so rapid sequence induction is used.

zh: 麻醉前一定问清最后进食时间，误吸会要命。
en: Always ask when they last ate; aspiration can be fatal.

zh: 苏醒延迟需排查低血糖、低体温、电解质紊乱与残余肌松。
en: Delayed emergence prompts a search for hypoglycaemia, hypothermia, electrolyte disturbance and residual paralysis.

zh: 手术做完一个小时还没醒，这是苏醒延迟，得查原因。
en: An hour after surgery and still not awake, that is delayed emergence; find the cause.

zh: 恶性高热一旦发生立即停用诱发药、给予丹曲林并全身降温。
en: Malignant hyperthermia is managed by stopping the trigger, giving dantrolene and cooling the body.

zh: 恶性高热虽然罕见，但抢救车必须常备丹曲林。
en: Malignant hyperthermia is rare, but dantrolene must always be on the emergency trolley.

zh: 局麻药中毒早期表现为耳鸣、口周麻木，严重时抽搐与心搏骤停。
en: Local anesthetic toxicity starts with tinnitus and perioral numbness, progressing to seizures and cardiac arrest.

zh: 打完局麻他说耳朵响、嘴发麻，这是局麻药中毒，快处理。
en: After the local he reports ringing ears and numb lips, which is local anesthetic toxicity; act now.

zh: 全脊麻表现为迅速出现的低血压、呼吸困难与意识丧失，须立即气道支持。
en: Total spinal anesthesia brings rapid hypotension, breathing difficulty and loss of consciousness, requiring immediate airway support.

zh: 硬膜外打进去十分钟血压掉到六十，考虑全脊麻。
en: Ten minutes after the epidural the pressure is down to sixty, so consider total spinal anesthesia.

zh: 穿刺后头痛在坐起时加重、平卧缓解，多数经补液与卧床数日好转。
en: Post-dural puncture headache worsens on sitting and eases lying flat, usually settling with fluids and rest.

zh: 她站起来就头痛，躺下就好，是典型的穿刺后头痛。
en: Her head aches on standing and eases lying down, typical post-dural puncture headache.

zh: 麻醉后神经损伤多表现为局部麻木无力，需记录范围并随访。
en: Nerve injury after anesthesia usually shows as localized numbness or weakness and must be mapped and followed up.

zh: 麻醉后手腕抬不起来，可能是麻醉后神经损伤，请会诊。
en: The wrist will not lift after anesthesia, possibly nerve injury after anesthesia; request a consult.

zh: 支气管痉挛时气道压骤升、通气困难，需加深麻醉并给予支气管扩张药。
en: Bronchospasm brings a sudden rise in airway pressure, managed by deepening anesthesia and giving bronchodilators.

zh: 气道压一下子高了，听诊有哮鸣音，是支气管痉挛。
en: Airway pressure has shot up with wheeze on auscultation; that is bronchospasm.

zh: 术中知晓高风险手术需监测麻醉深度并避免单纯肌松。
en: Surgery at high risk of intraoperative awareness requires depth monitoring and avoiding muscle relaxants alone.

zh: 病人说手术中听见有人说话，要评估是不是术中知晓。
en: The patient says she heard talking during surgery, so assess for intraoperative awareness.

zh: 术后恶心呕吐高危者预防性给予止吐药，并避免使用一氧化二氮。
en: Patients at high risk of postoperative nausea and vomiting receive prophylactic antiemetics and avoid nitrous oxide.

zh: 她术后恶心呕吐得厉害，先给止吐药再喝水。
en: She has severe postoperative nausea and vomiting, so give an antiemetic before any water.

zh: 有麻醉药物过敏史者须更换药物类别，并在术前预防用药。
en: A history of anesthetic allergy requires switching drug classes and preoperative prophylaxis.

zh: 他说上次麻醉后全身起疹子，可能是麻醉药物过敏。
en: He says he broke out in a rash after the last anesthetic, possibly anesthetic allergy.

zh: 麻醉期间低血压持续超过十分钟与术后器官损伤相关，须及时处理。
en: Intraoperative hypotension lasting over ten minutes is linked to organ injury and must be corrected promptly.

zh: 麻醉期间低血压了，先减浅麻醉、加快补液。
en: We have intraoperative hypotension; lighten the anesthesia and give fluids faster.

zh: 麻醉后呼吸抑制需持续监测血氧与呼气末二氧化碳，必要时拮抗。
en: Respiratory depression after anesthesia requires monitoring of saturation and end-tidal carbon dioxide, with reversal if needed.

zh: 老人回病房后麻醉后呼吸抑制，血氧一直往下掉。
en: Back on the ward the elderly patient has respiratory depression after anesthesia, with falling saturation.

zh: 阻滞失败需评估原因并改行全身麻醉，不可反复追加至中毒剂量。
en: Block failure is assessed and converted to general anesthesia rather than repeated dosing to toxic levels.

zh: 阻滞失败，切皮还疼，别再加药了，改全麻。
en: The block failed and the incision still hurts, so stop topping up and convert to general anesthesia.

zh: 麻醉并发症按系统分类记录，严重者需上报并做根因分析。
en: Anesthesia complications are recorded by system, and serious ones are reported and analysed for root cause.

zh: 这份病历把麻醉并发症写清楚了，包括低血压和苏醒延迟。
en: This record documents the anesthesia complication fully, including hypotension and delayed emergence.

zh: 苏醒期躁动常见于疼痛、缺氧与膀胱充盈，须先排查诱因再约束。
en: Emergence agitation often reflects pain, hypoxia or a full bladder, so causes are excluded before restraint.

zh: 他在苏醒期躁动，先看看是不是疼或者憋尿。
en: He has emergence agitation; check whether it is pain or a full bladder first.

zh: 手术风险须逐项告知并写入知情同意书，包括出血、感染与血栓。
en: Surgical risk is explained item by item in the consent form, including bleeding, infection and thrombosis.

zh: 手术风险主要是出血、感染和血栓，我会一条条讲。
en: The surgical risk is mainly bleeding, infection and clots, and I will go through each one.

zh: 术中出血量大时需及时输血并记录出入量。
en: Heavy intraoperative bleeding requires prompt transfusion and fluid balance recording.

zh: 术中出血比预计多，已经备了四个单位红细胞。
en: Intraoperative bleeding was more than expected, and four units of red cells are ready.

zh: 术后出血表现为引流量增多、血压下降与切口渗血，须立即评估。
en: Postoperative bleeding shows as rising drain output, falling pressure and wound oozing, requiring urgent review.

zh: 引流管里血突然多了，怕是术后出血，快叫医生。
en: Blood in the drain has suddenly increased, likely postoperative bleeding; call the doctor.

zh: 手术部位感染表现为切口红肿热痛与脓性分泌物，需取标本培养。
en: Surgical site infection shows redness, heat, pain and purulent discharge, and a specimen is sent for culture.

zh: 切口有点红还有脓，考虑手术部位感染。
en: The wound is red with pus, so consider surgical site infection.

zh: 深静脉血栓预防包括早期活动、弹力袜与药物抗凝。
en: Deep vein thrombosis prevention includes early mobilisation, compression stockings and pharmacological anticoagulation.

zh: 术后第二天腿肿了，要排查深静脉血栓。
en: The leg is swollen on day two after surgery, so screen for deep vein thrombosis.

zh: 血管损伤可导致大出血或肢体缺血，需血管外科同期处理。
en: Vascular injury may cause major bleeding or limb ischaemia and requires vascular surgical repair.

zh: 手术中血管损伤了，请血管外科上台。
en: There is vascular injury during the operation; call vascular surgery to the table.

zh: 脏器损伤是腹腔手术的重要风险，二次手术率随之升高。
en: Organ injury is a major risk in abdominal surgery and raises the reoperation rate.

zh: 腹腔手术有脏器损伤的风险，我们会仔细分离。
en: Abdominal surgery carries a risk of organ injury; we dissect carefully to avoid it.

zh: 术后粘连可引起慢性腹痛与粘连性肠梗阻，需再次手术松解。
en: Postoperative adhesion can cause chronic pain and adhesive obstruction requiring surgical division.

zh: 他以前做过手术，这次肠梗阻很可能是术后粘连。
en: He has had surgery before, so this obstruction is likely postoperative adhesion.

zh: 愈合不良与糖尿病、营养不良和局部血供差相关。
en: Poor wound healing is linked to diabetes, malnutrition and poor local blood supply.

zh: 血糖控制不好，伤口愈合不良，拆线得往后拖。
en: With poor glucose control the wound heals badly, so suture removal must be delayed.

zh: 围术期死亡是最严重的风险，须在知情同意中明确告知。
en: Perioperative death is the most serious risk and must be stated clearly in the consent discussion.

zh: 围术期死亡虽然概率低，但同意书里必须写明。
en: Perioperative death is unlikely, but it must be written in the consent form.

zh: 术中大出血需启动大量输血方案并通知血库备血。
en: Massive intraoperative hemorrhage triggers the massive transfusion protocol and a blood bank call.

zh: 术中大出血，启动大量输血方案，快通知血库！
en: Massive intraoperative hemorrhage: activate the massive transfusion protocol and call the blood bank.

zh: 手术失败可能需二次手术或改行其他治疗方式。
en: Surgical failure may require a second operation or a different treatment approach.

zh: 手术失败不是谁故意的，但得跟家属说清楚是否二次手术。
en: Surgical failure is not intentional, but the family must be told whether a second operation is needed.

zh: 疾病复发与切除范围、病理类型相关，术后需定期随访。
en: Recurrence of disease depends on resection margins and pathology, so regular follow-up is required.

zh: 肿瘤切干净了，但还有疾病复发的可能，要按时复查。
en: The tumour was removed completely, but recurrence of disease is possible, so keep the follow-up appointments.

zh: 器官功能衰竭是术后严重并发症，常需转入重症监护治疗。
en: Organ failure is a serious postoperative complication, often requiring intensive care.

zh: 术后出现器官功能衰竭，得转重症监护室。
en: Organ failure has developed after surgery, so transfer to intensive care is needed.

zh: 住院时间延长会增加费用与院内感染风险，需评估原因。
en: Prolonged hospital stay raises costs and infection risk, so the cause must be reviewed.

zh: 伤口感染导致住院时间延长，费用也会增加。
en: The wound infection caused a prolonged hospital stay and higher costs.

zh: 知情同意须说明替代方案及其利弊，不能只讲手术。
en: Informed consent must describe alternative treatment options and their pros and cons, not just surgery.

zh: 除了手术，替代方案还有保守治疗和介入，你可以选。
en: Besides surgery, the alternative treatment options are conservative care and intervention; you can choose.

zh: 实施手术须取得患者知情同意，并签署书面文件。
en: Informed consent must be obtained and documented in writing before surgery.

zh: 知情同意不是签个字，我得把风险和替代方案都讲明白。
en: Informed consent is not just a signature; I must explain the risks and alternatives.

zh: 手术知情同意书须由患者本人签署，无行为能力时由法定代理人签署。
en: The surgical informed consent form is signed by the patient, or by the legal representative if the patient lacks capacity.

zh: 手术知情同意书你看一遍，有不明白的现在问。
en: Read the surgical informed consent form and ask about anything unclear now.

zh: 麻醉知情同意书须写明麻醉方式与可能出现的并发症。
en: The anesthesia informed consent form must state the technique and possible complications.

zh: 麻醉知情同意书和手术那张是分开的，两张都要签。
en: The anesthesia informed consent form is separate from the surgical one; both must be signed.

zh: 保守治疗适用于病情稳定、无急诊手术指征的患者。
en: Conservative treatment suits stable patients without an emergency surgical indication.

zh: 先保守治疗观察两天，不行再手术。
en: Let us try conservative treatment for two days and operate if it fails.

zh: 药物治疗可作为手术的替代方案，但需说明失败后仍需手术。
en: Medical therapy may replace surgery, but patients must know surgery may still be needed if it fails.

zh: 药物治疗先试一个疗程，没用再考虑手术。
en: Try medical therapy for one course first; if it does not work, consider surgery.

zh: 介入治疗可作为手术替代方案，但存在穿刺并发症与复发可能。
en: Interventional therapy may replace surgery but carries puncture complications and recurrence risk.

zh: 这个病可以介入治疗，不用开刀，但可能要再做一次。
en: This can be treated by interventional therapy without opening you up, but it may need repeating.

zh: 内镜治疗适用于部分早期病变，出血或穿孔时需中转手术。
en: Endoscopic therapy suits some early lesions, converting to surgery if bleeding or perforation occurs.

zh: 能内镜治疗就先内镜治，不行再开刀。
en: If endoscopic therapy is possible we try it first and operate if it fails.

zh: 患者有权要求第二诊疗意见，不应因此延误急诊处置。
en: Patients may seek a second opinion, which should not delay emergency care.

zh: 你想听第二诊疗意见可以，我们不会拦着。
en: You may seek a second opinion; we will not stand in the way.

zh: 拒绝手术须记录告知内容、患者状态与签字，并说明随访安排。
en: Refusal of surgery is documented with what was explained, the patient's capacity and a signature, plus follow-up.

zh: 他拒绝手术，我们得把风险讲清楚并让他签字。
en: He is refusing surgery, so we must explain the risks clearly and have him sign.

zh: 撤回同意须在切皮前确认并记录，已备血与用药需相应调整。
en: Withdrawal of consent is confirmed and documented before incision, with blood reservation and premedication adjusted.

zh: 病人进手术室前撤回同意，手术停了。
en: The patient withdrew consent before entering theatre, so the operation was cancelled.

zh: 授权委托书须写明受托人、授权范围与有效期，并随病历保存。
en: The authorization letter states the proxy, the scope and the validity period and is kept with the record.

zh: 这份授权委托书要写清楚谁替你做决定，签好交给我们。
en: The authorization letter must name who decides for you; sign it and give it to us.

zh: 无民事行为能力人手术由法定代理人签署知情同意书。
en: For a person without capacity for civil conduct, the legal representative signs the consent form.

zh: 他是无民事行为能力人，同意书得由监护人签。
en: He is a person without capacity for civil conduct, so the guardian signs the consent.

zh: 医疗损害责任以过错为要件，知情同意缺陷常成为争议焦点。
en: Medical damage liability requires fault, and deficient informed consent is often the focus of disputes.

zh: 同意书签得不规范，医疗损害责任风险会明显上升。
en: Poorly documented consent clearly raises the risk of medical damage liability.

zh: 风险告知应具体到本术式的主要并发症，不能只写套话。
en: Risk disclosure should name the main complications of this operation, not use generic wording.

zh: 风险告知我按这张单子逐条讲，你听完再签。
en: I will go through the risk disclosure item by item from this sheet, then you sign.

zh: 大手术常规备血两个单位，术中出血多时再追加。
en: Two units are routinely reserved for major surgery, with more requested if bleeding is heavy.

zh: 手术备血已经备好了，需要的时候直接取。
en: Blood reservation for surgery is done, so units can be collected when needed.

zh: 输血知情同意书须包括输血传播感染与输血反应等风险。
en: The transfusion informed consent form covers risks such as transfusion-transmitted infection and reactions.

zh: 输血知情同意书单独一张，跟手术同意书不是一回事。
en: The transfusion informed consent form is separate; it is not the same as the surgical consent.

zh: 自体输血可减少异体输血需求与免疫反应，但需提前评估采集条件。
en: Autologous transfusion reduces donor exposure and immune reactions but requires prior assessment.

zh: 她选择自体输血，术前两周先存了兩个单位血。
en: She chose autologous transfusion and banked two units two weeks before surgery.

zh: 术中血液回收禁用于恶性肿瘤与污染手术野。
en: Intraoperative cell salvage is not used in malignancy or a contaminated operative field.

zh: 这台用术中血液回收，出血能直接还回去。
en: We use intraoperative cell salvage here so the shed blood can be returned.

zh: 成分输血优于全血，可按缺乏成分精准补充。
en: Component transfusion is preferred over whole blood because the missing component is replaced precisely.

zh: 现在都是成分输血，缺什么补什么，不输全血。
en: We do component transfusion now: replace what is missing, not whole blood.

zh: 新鲜冰冻血浆用于凝血因子缺乏或大量输血后的凝血病。
en: Fresh frozen plasma is used for clotting factor deficiency or coagulopathy after massive transfusion.

zh: 凝血功能差，先输新鲜冰冻血浆，不是输红细胞。
en: The coagulation is poor, so give fresh frozen plasma first, not red cells.

zh: 红细胞悬液输注前须核对血型，一单位约提升血红蛋白五克每升。
en: Packed red blood cells are checked against the blood group; one unit raises haemoglobin by about five grams per litre.

zh: 血红蛋白七十，输两个单位红细胞悬液。
en: Haemoglobin is seventy, so transfuse two units of packed red blood cells.

zh: 血小板输注用于血小板低于二十且伴出血风险者。
en: Platelet transfusion is used when the count is below twenty with a bleeding risk.

zh: 血小板太低，先约血小板输注，别等到出血。
en: The platelets are very low, so book a platelet transfusion before bleeding starts.

zh: 出现输血反应立即停止输血、保留血袋并报告输血科。
en: For a transfusion reaction, stop the transfusion, keep the bag and notify the blood bank.

zh: 他输血十分钟就发冷发热，是输血反应，先停。
en: He had chills and fever ten minutes into the transfusion, a transfusion reaction; stop it.

zh: 输血传播感染包括乙肝、丙肝、艾滋与梅毒，输血前须筛查。
en: Transfusion-transmitted infection includes hepatitis B and C, HIV and syphilis, so screening precedes transfusion.

zh: 输血前都查过输血传播感染指标，结果正常。
en: Screening for transfusion-transmitted infection was done and the results are normal.

zh: 大量输血需按比例输注红细胞、血浆与血小板并监测凝血。
en: Massive transfusion gives red cells, plasma and platelets in fixed ratios with coagulation monitoring.

zh: 出血止不住，启动大量输血，红细胞血浆一比一。
en: The bleeding will not stop, so start massive transfusion with red cells and plasma one to one.

zh: 输血指征包括血红蛋白低于七十或血流动力学不稳定。
en: Transfusion indications include haemoglobin below seventy or haemodynamic instability.

zh: 输血指征够了，血红蛋白六十五还心慌气短。
en: The transfusion indication is met: haemoglobin sixty-five with palpitations and breathlessness.

zh: 限制性输血阈值多为血红蛋白七十，可减少输血相关并发症。
en: Restrictive transfusion usually uses a threshold of seventy and reduces transfusion-related complications.

zh: 我们按限制性输血来，血红蛋白不到七十先不输。
en: We follow restrictive transfusion: no transfusion until haemoglobin falls below seventy.

zh: 术后镇痛方案按手术类型与患者情况个体化制定。
en: Postoperative analgesia is tailored to the operation and the individual patient.

zh: 术后镇痛要跟上，疼得睡不着影响恢复。
en: Postoperative analgesia must be adequate; pain that stops sleep delays recovery.

zh: 术后疼痛评估每小时一次，评分大于四分需调整镇痛方案。
en: Postoperative pain assessment is hourly, and a score above four prompts a change in the analgesia plan.

zh: 术后疼痛评估做了吗？他说有八分疼。
en: Has the postoperative pain assessment been done? He rates it eight out of ten.

zh: 镇痛方案采用多模式联合，减少单一阿片类药物用量。
en: The analgesia plan combines several modalities to reduce reliance on a single opioid.

zh: 镇痛方案写进医嘱了，按需给药也要记录。
en: The analgesia plan is in the orders; record every as-needed dose too.

zh: 多模式镇痛联合对乙酰氨基酚、非甾体抗炎药与局部阻滞。
en: Multimodal analgesia combines paracetamol, an NSAID and a local block.

zh: 用多模式镇痛，几种药一起上，阿片类就能少用。
en: Use multimodal analgesia: several drugs together means less opioid.

zh: 患者自控镇痛须设置单次剂量与锁定时间，并向患者讲解使用方法。
en: Patient-controlled analgesia requires set bolus doses and lockout intervals, with instruction for the patient.

zh: 给你接患者自控镇痛泵，疼的时候按一下，别连着按。
en: I will connect the patient-controlled analgesia pump; press it when it hurts, not repeatedly.

zh: 硬膜外镇痛效果确切，但需监测血压、感觉平面与导管位置。
en: Epidural analgesia works well but requires monitoring of blood pressure, sensory level and catheter position.

zh: 硬膜外镇痛泵在背上，翻身的时候别压到管子。
en: The epidural analgesia catheter is in your back, so do not lie on the tubing.

zh: 连续神经阻滞用于下肢大手术，需观察肢体感觉与运动恢复。
en: Continuous nerve block is used for major lower limb surgery, watching sensory and motor recovery.

zh: 做了连续神经阻滞，这条腿会麻一阵子，别自己下地。
en: With a continuous nerve block the leg stays numb for a while, so do not get up alone.

zh: 阿片类药物须监测呼吸频率与镇静程度，警惕呼吸抑制。
en: Opioids require monitoring of respiratory rate and sedation level for respiratory depression.

zh: 阿片类药物别一次给太多，老人容易呼吸抑制。
en: Do not give too much opioid at once; elderly patients easily get respiratory depression.

zh: 非甾体抗炎药用于术后镇痛，但肾功能不全与消化道溃疡者慎用。
en: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs help postoperative pain but are used cautiously in renal impairment or ulcer disease.

zh: 非甾体抗炎药能减少阿片用量，但他肾功能不好，慎用。
en: The nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug spares opioid, but his kidneys are poor, so use it cautiously.

zh: 对乙酰氨基酚每日总量不超过三克，肝功能不全者减量。
en: Paracetamol is limited to three grams a day, with dose reduction in hepatic impairment.

zh: 先给对乙酰氨基酚，不够再加别的镇痛药。
en: Start with paracetamol and add another analgesic if it is not enough.

zh: 镇痛不足会导致活动延迟与肺部并发症，应及时调整方案。
en: Inadequate analgesia delays mobilisation and causes pulmonary complications, so the plan is adjusted promptly.

zh: 他镇痛不足，一动就疼，方案得改。
en: He has inadequate analgesia and it hurts to move, so the plan needs changing.

zh: 出现过度镇静应立即停用阿片类药物、给氧并监测血氧。
en: Oversedation calls for stopping the opioid, giving oxygen and monitoring saturation.

zh: 他过度镇静了，叫不太醒，先停阿片给药。
en: He is oversedated and hard to rouse, so hold the opioid.

zh: 镇痛泵报警时检查管路、电池与药液余量。
en: When the analgesia pump alarms, check the tubing, battery and remaining drug.

zh: 镇痛泵报警了，看看是不是管子打折。
en: The analgesia pump is alarming; check whether the tubing is kinked.

zh: 麻醉恢复室接收术后患者，监测血氧、血压与意识直至离室标准达标。
en: The postanesthesia care unit monitors saturation, blood pressure and consciousness until discharge criteria are met.

zh: 手术做完送麻醉恢复室，醒了、指标稳了才回病房。
en: After surgery you go to the postanesthesia care unit and return to the ward once awake and stable.

zh: 麻醉苏醒期重点观察气道、呼吸与循环，防止误吸与坠床。
en: During emergence from anesthesia the focus is airway, breathing and circulation, preventing aspiration and falls.

zh: 麻醉苏醒的时候他会有点躁，把床栏拉起来。
en: He will be restless during emergence from anesthesia, so put the bed rails up.

zh: 术后监护按手术级别设定频次，大手术后每小时记录一次。
en: Postoperative monitoring frequency follows the surgical grade, hourly after major operations.

zh: 术后监护不能松，前两个小时最关键。
en: Postoperative monitoring must not slip; the first two hours matter most.

zh: 术后拔管须满足自主呼吸恢复、呛咳有力与氧合达标。
en: Postoperative extubation requires spontaneous breathing, a strong cough and adequate oxygenation.

zh: 术后拔管前先吸痰，确认他自己能喘再拔。
en: Suction before postoperative extubation and confirm he breathes on his own first.

zh: 术后低体温需主动加温、监测核心体温并警惕寒战。
en: Postoperative hypothermia is managed with active warming, core temperature monitoring and attention to shivering.

zh: 体温三十五度五，术后低体温，赶紧用加温毯。
en: Temperature is thirty-five point five, so there is postoperative hypothermia; use the warming blanket.

zh: 术后寒战增加心肌耗氧，需保暖并排除低体温与感染。
en: Postoperative shivering raises myocardial oxygen demand, so warm the patient and exclude hypothermia or infection.

zh: 他术后寒战得厉害，先盖加温毯，再查体温。
en: He has severe postoperative shivering; use the warming blanket first, then check his temperature.

zh: 尿潴留常见于椎管内麻醉后，可先诱导排尿再考虑导尿。
en: Urinary retention is common after neuraxial anesthesia and is managed with voiding measures before catheterisation.

zh: 术后六小时没排尿，膀胱胀，是尿潴留。
en: No urine six hours after surgery and the bladder is distended, so it is urinary retention.

zh: 术后谵妄表现为波动性意识混乱，需排查疼痛、缺氧与药物因素。
en: Postoperative delirium shows fluctuating confusion, so pain, hypoxia and drugs are reviewed.

zh: 老人晚上突然不认识人，可能是术后谵妄。
en: The elderly patient suddenly did not recognise anyone at night, possibly postoperative delirium.

zh: 早期活动应在镇痛充分与血流动力学稳定前提下进行。
en: Early mobilisation proceeds once analgesia is adequate and haemodynamics are stable.

zh: 镇痛给够就早期活动，今天先在床边坐十分钟。
en: With adequate analgesia we start early mobilisation, sitting at the bedside for ten minutes today.

zh: 腹部手术后待排气再逐步恢复术后进食，从流质开始。
en: After abdominal surgery, resumption of oral intake waits for flatus and starts with fluids.

zh: 排气了，可以开始术后进食，先喝点米汤。
en: He has passed flatus, so resumption of oral intake can start with rice water.

zh: 引流管管理记录引流量、颜色与性状，异常时及时报告。
en: Drain management records volume, colour and character, reporting abnormalities promptly.

zh: 引流管管理要注意，量突然多了要报告。
en: Mind the drain management; report it if the output suddenly increases.

zh: 术后随访包括拆线、病理结果解读与功能评估。
en: Postoperative follow-up covers suture removal, pathology results and functional assessment.

zh: 术后随访约在两周后，来之前先拍张伤口照片。
en: Postoperative follow-up is in two weeks; take a photo of the wound beforehand.

zh: 日间手术要求患者一般状况好、有家属陪护与可靠联系方式。
en: Ambulatory surgery requires good general condition, a family escort and reliable contact details.

zh: 这个手术可以做日间手术，早上来晚上回家。
en: This can be done as ambulatory surgery: come in the morning and go home at night.

zh: 日间手术病房在术前完成核查、宣教与出院评估。
