en: The day surgery unit completes checking, education and discharge assessment preoperatively.

zh: 日间手术病房在二楼，办完手续直接上去。
en: The day surgery unit is on the second floor; go straight up after registration.

zh: 门诊手术适用于体表肿物切除、小面积清创等。
en: Outpatient surgery suits superficial mass excision and small wound debridement.

zh: 这个门诊手术半小时就完，做完回家。
en: This outpatient surgery takes half an hour and you go home afterwards.

zh: 当日出院须满足生命体征稳定、能进食排尿与疼痛可控。
en: Same-day discharge requires stable vital signs, ability to eat and void, and controlled pain.

zh: 当日出院前再评估一次，别到家就出血。
en: Assess again before same-day discharge; we do not want bleeding at home.

zh: 限期手术如恶性肿瘤根治术，应在诊断后数周内完成。
en: Urgent surgery such as cancer resection should be completed within weeks of diagnosis.

zh: 这是限期手术，尽量两周内做，不能拖太久。
en: This is urgent surgery; aim for within two weeks, not months.

zh: 急诊手术可先实施后补办手术审批，但须当日完成。
en: Emergency surgery may proceed first with surgical approval completed the same day.

zh: 手术审批还没签，先别排台，让主任补签。
en: Surgical approval is not signed yet, so hold the slot and have the director sign.

zh: 紧急救治须经医疗机构负责人或授权负责人批准并记录。
en: Emergency rescue requires approval from the institution's head or an authorised person, and is documented.

zh: 病人昏迷、家属联系不上，按紧急救治先做手术。
en: The patient is unconscious and the family unreachable, so proceed under emergency rescue.

zh: 术前等待时间过长会增加并发症，急诊手术应尽量缩短。
en: A long time to surgery raises complications, so it is shortened for emergency cases.

zh: 术前等待时间已经四个小时了，催一下手术室。
en: The time to surgery is already four hours, so chase the theatre.

zh: 手术取消须记录原因并重新评估安排，避免延误治疗。
en: Cancellation of surgery is documented with the reason and reassessed, so treatment is not delayed.

zh: 他早上发烧，手术取消，等体温正常再排。
en: He spiked a fever this morning, so cancellation of surgery; reschedule once afebrile.

zh: 急诊加台需协调麻醉、护理与血库资源并评估对择期手术的影响。
en: An emergency add-on case needs coordination of anesthesia, nursing and blood bank, plus review of elective impact.

zh: 急诊加台，把第三间的手术往后挪。
en: Emergency add-on case: move the list in theatre three back.

zh: 手术排程优先安排急诊与限期手术，择期手术按顺序排入。
en: Operating room scheduling prioritises emergency and urgent cases, with elective surgery slotted in order.

zh: 手术排程今天满了，只能加在最后一台。
en: Operating room scheduling is full today, so it can only go last.

zh: 严重腹腔感染常计划二次手术，在四十八小时后再次探查。
en: Severe abdominal sepsis often needs a planned reoperation, returning after forty-eight hours.

zh: 医生说了是计划二次手术，不是出问题才开的。
en: The doctor said this is a planned reoperation, not because something went wrong.

zh: 二次探查术用于判断肠管活力或清除残余感染。
en: Second-look laparotomy assesses bowel viability or clears residual infection.

zh: 明天做二次探查术，看看肠子活了没有。
en: Second-look laparotomy is tomorrow to see whether the bowel has recovered.

zh: 中转开腹不是手术失败，须向家属说明原因并记录。
en: Conversion to laparotomy is not a failure; the reason is explained and documented.

zh: 粘连太重，中转开腹，跟家属说一声。
en: Adhesions are too dense, so conversion to laparotomy; tell the family.

zh: 中转全身麻醉需重新评估气道并追加知情同意记录。
en: Conversion to general anesthesia requires airway reassessment and an added consent note.

zh: 麻醉效果不够，中转全身麻醉，家属同意了。
en: The block is inadequate, so conversion to general anesthesia, and the family has agreed.

zh: 非计划再次手术是手术质量监测指标，须上报并讨论原因。
en: Unplanned reoperation is a quality indicator and must be reported and reviewed.

zh: 吻合口瘘了，非计划再次手术，今晚就得进手术室。
en: The anastomosis has leaked, so unplanned reoperation; theatre tonight.

zh: 再手术指征包括持续出血、腹膜炎加重与引流液异常。
en: Indications for reoperation include ongoing bleeding, worsening peritonitis and abnormal drain output.

zh: 再手术指征明确了，别再等，安排手术。
en: The indication for reoperation is clear, so stop waiting and schedule it.

zh: 再次入院率是评价手术质量与出院准备充分性的指标。
en: Readmission rate reflects surgical quality and the adequacy of discharge preparation.

zh: 出院一周又回来了，这次是伤口感染，算再次入院。
en: He returned a week after discharge with a wound infection, which counts as readmission.

zh: 中转率用于评价病例选择与手术难度，应定期回顾分析。
en: Conversion rate reflects case selection and difficulty and is reviewed regularly.

zh: 这个月中转率有点高，得看看是不是选病例太激进。
en: The conversion rate is high this month, so check whether case selection is too aggressive.

zh: 中转决策由主刀与麻醉医师共同作出，并在记录中说明理由。
en: The conversion decision is made jointly by the surgeon and anesthesiologist and the reason recorded.

zh: 中转决策不能一个人拍板，叫上级一起看。
en: The conversion decision is not one person's call; bring the senior in.

zh: 再手术风险随手术次数与粘连程度增加，须充分告知。
en: Reoperation risk rises with the number of previous operations and adhesions, so full disclosure is needed.

zh: 再手术风险比第一次高，这些我都要写进同意书。
en: Reoperation risk is higher than the first time, and I will put all of it in the consent.

zh: 法定传染病须在规定时限内完成报告。
en: Notifiable infectious diseases must be reported within the prescribed time limit.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这个病是法定传染病，我们要按规定上报。
en: This is a notifiable infectious disease, so we must report it as required.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 甲类传染病病人须就地隔离治疗。
en: Patients with a Class A infectious disease must be isolated and treated on site.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 甲类传染病不能转院，先就地隔离。
en: A Class A infectious disease cannot be transferred; isolate on site first.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 乙类传染病按有关规定报告并管理。
en: Class B infectious diseases are reported and managed according to the relevant rules.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 肺结核是乙类传染病，报告别漏。
en: Tuberculosis is a Class B infectious disease, so do not miss the report.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 丙类传染病按监测方案登记报告。
en: Class C infectious diseases are registered and reported under the surveillance plan.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流感算丙类传染病，报卡要填全。
en: Influenza is a Class C infectious disease, so complete the reporting card fully.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传染病防治法规定医疗机构负有报告义务。
en: The Law on Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases obliges hospitals to report cases.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 按传染病防治法，这事必须报。
en: Under the Law on Prevention and Treatment of Infectious Diseases, this must be reported.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 该病按甲类管理，须两小时内报告。
en: This disease is managed as a Class A disease and must be reported within two hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这个病按甲类管理，防护要升级。
en: This disease is managed as a Class A disease, so upgrade protection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 调整为乙类乙管后，防控措施相应调整。
en: After the change to Class B disease under Class B measures, control measures were adjusted.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 现在是乙类乙管，不用按甲类那么严。
en: It is now managed as a Class B disease, so Class A measures are not required.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 检疫传染病包括鼠疫、霍乱与黄热病。
en: Quarantinable infectious diseases include plague, cholera and yellow fever.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这是检疫传染病，入境要隔离。
en: This is a quarantinable infectious disease, so quarantine is required on entry.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 监测传染病需填写健康申明并随访。
en: Infectious diseases under surveillance require a health declaration and follow-up.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这个属于监测传染病，登记一下就行。
en: This is an infectious disease under surveillance, so registration is enough.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 新发传染病早期识别依赖症候群监测。
en: Early identification of emerging infectious diseases relies on syndromic surveillance.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 新发传染病最怕漏诊，问清旅行史。
en: The main risk with an emerging infectious disease is missing it, so ask about travel.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 再发传染病提示免疫屏障出现缺口。
en: Re-emerging infectious diseases signal a gap in the immune barrier.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 麻疹又多了，再发传染病不能松。
en: Measles is rising again; re-emerging infectious diseases need attention.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 输入性传染病需核实航班与入境口岸。
en: For an imported infectious disease, check the flight and port of entry.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这是输入性传染病，先问从哪回来。
en: This is an imported infectious disease, so first ask where the patient came from.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 出现本土病例后启动应急响应。
en: An emergency response was launched after a locally acquired case appeared.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这例是本土病例，流调要扩大范围。
en: This is a locally acquired case, so expand the investigation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 该病区出现聚集性疫情，立即上报。
en: A cluster of cases appeared in the ward and was reported immediately.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 一个班好几个发烧，是聚集性疫情。
en: Several children in one class have fever, which is a cluster of cases.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传染病暴发需启动现场调查与处置。
en: An infectious disease outbreak requires field investigation and response.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 确诊多了就是传染病暴发，得报。
en: Many confirmed cases mean an infectious disease outbreak, which must be reported.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 大流行期间口岸检疫措施全面升级。
en: During a pandemic, port quarantine measures were fully upgraded.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 大流行那几年，发热门诊压力最大。
en: During the pandemic years the fever clinic was under the most pressure.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传染病报告须在规定时限内完成。
en: Infectious disease reporting must be completed within the prescribed time limit.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这个要传染病报告，快点卡别拖。
en: This needs infectious disease reporting, so submit the card without delay.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 两小时报告适用于鼠疫、霍乱等疾病。
en: Two-hour reporting applies to diseases such as plague and cholera.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这个必须两小时报告，别等到交班。
en: This requires two-hour reporting, so do not wait for handover.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 乙类传染病行二十四小时报告。
en: Class B infectious diseases require twenty-four-hour reporting.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 肺结核走二十四小时报告，今天报完就行。
en: Tuberculosis uses twenty-four-hour reporting, so report it today.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 网络直报后系统自动生成报告卡号。
en: After direct online reporting the system generates a report number automatically.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 网络直报我来做，你把信息给我。
en: I will do the direct online reporting; give me the details.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传染病报告卡须填写证件号与联系方式。
en: The infectious disease reporting card must include the ID number and contact details.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传染病报告卡填完再下班。
en: Finish the infectious disease reporting card before you leave.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 首诊负责制要求不得推诿传染病患者。
en: The first-visit responsibility system forbids refusing patients with infectious diseases.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 首诊负责制，病人到你手上就得管。
en: Under the first-visit responsibility system, the patient is yours once seen.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫情报告须经科室审核后提交。
en: Epidemic reporting must be reviewed by the department before submission.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫情报告走完流程才能收治。
en: Admission can proceed only after epidemic reporting is complete.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 节假日仍执行零报告制度。
en: The zero-report system still applies on public holidays.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 今天没病例也要零报告制度报一下。
en: Even with no cases today, make a zero-report submission.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 迟报将被通报并追究责任。
en: Late reporting is notified and accountability is pursued.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这份是迟报，系统会标红。
en: This one is late reporting, so the system will flag it in red.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 自查发现漏报三例肺结核。
en: Self-inspection found three cases of under-reported tuberculosis.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 别漏报，漏了要倒查。
en: Do not under-report; missed cases are traced back.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 瞒报疫情将依法追究责任。
en: Concealment of cases is pursued according to law.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 瞒报比迟报严重得多。
en: Concealment of cases is far more serious than late reporting.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 谎报疫情扰乱防控秩序。
en: False reporting of an epidemic disrupts control work.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 谎报是要担责的，数据必须真实。
en: False reporting carries liability, so the data must be accurate.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 突发公共卫生事件报告须在两小时内完成。
en: Public health emergency reporting must be completed within two hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 突发公共卫生事件报告赶紧走，别压着。
en: Send the public health emergency report now; do not hold it back.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 报告责任人须每日核对直报数据。
en: The person responsible for reporting checks the online data daily.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 报告责任人是谁？这个卡找他签。
en: Who is the person responsible for reporting? Find him to sign this card.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疾病预防控制机构接到报告后开展流调。
en: The disease prevention and control institution starts the investigation after the report.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疾病预防控制机构马上到，先留好资料。
en: The disease prevention and control institution is arriving; keep the records ready.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流行病学调查须在二十四小时内启动。
en: The epidemiological investigation must start within twenty-four hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流行病学调查会问得很细，您慢慢想。
en: The epidemiological investigation asks many details; take your time.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 现场流调同步采集环境样本。
en: The field epidemiological investigation collected environmental samples at the same time.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 现场流调队到了，带他们去病区。
en: The field epidemiological investigation team has arrived; take them to the ward.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流行病学史提示有境外旅行史。
en: The epidemiological history suggests recent overseas travel.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流行病学史再问一遍，有没有聚餐？
en: Ask about the epidemiological history again: was there a group meal?
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 活动轨迹已推送至协查平台。
en: The movement history was sent to the cross-regional tracing platform.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 把活动轨迹写清楚，几点到几点在哪。
en: Write the movement history clearly: where and at what times.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 开展病例搜索并扩大检测范围。
en: Case finding was carried out and testing was expanded.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 病例搜索做起来，同类症状都要查。
en: Start case finding and test anyone with similar symptoms.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 对陪护人员开展主动筛查。
en: Active screening was carried out for carers.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 主动筛查一轮，先把隐匿病例找出来。
en: Run one round of active screening to find hidden cases.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 核酸采样须双人核对身份。
en: Nucleic acid sampling requires two staff to verify identity.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 核酸采样有点恶心，忍一下就好。
en: Nucleic acid sampling is a bit uncomfortable, so bear with it.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 核酸检测结果四小时内回报。
en: The nucleic acid amplification test result is reported within four hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 核酸检测阴性也不能马上排除。
en: A negative nucleic acid amplification test does not rule it out immediately.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流行病学调查表须病例本人或家属确认。
en: The epidemiological investigation form must be confirmed by the patient or family.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流行病学调查表这几项我帮您填。
en: I will help you fill in these items on the epidemiological investigation form.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 该病潜伏期多为三至七天。
en: The incubation period of this disease is usually three to seven days.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 潜伏期还没过，先医学观察。
en: The incubation period has not passed, so keep under medical observation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传染期内须严格隔离。
en: Strict isolation is required during the infectious period.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传染期没过，不能解除隔离。
en: The infectious period is not over, so isolation cannot end.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 追查传染源是流调的核心任务。
en: Tracing the source of infection is the core task of the investigation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传染源没找到，防控就难做。
en: Without finding the source of infection, control is difficult.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传播途径以飞沫和接触为主。
en: The main routes of transmission are droplets and contact.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 传播途径不同，防护级别也不一样。
en: Different routes of transmission need different levels of protection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 易感人群应优先接种疫苗。
en: The susceptible population should be vaccinated first.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 老人和孩子是易感人群，要重点保护。
en: Older people and children are the susceptible population and need protection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 该病毒基本再生数约为三。
en: The basic reproduction number of the virus is about three.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 基本再生数大于一，疫情就会扩散。
en: If the basic reproduction number is above one, the outbreak will spread.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 密切接触者须集中隔离并每日测体温。
en: Close contacts must be centrally quarantined with daily temperature checks.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 您是密切接触者，得先隔离观察。
en: You are a close contact, so you must be isolated for observation first.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 密接判定由疾控机构统一完成。
en: Close contact identification is completed by the disease control agency.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 密接判定还没出，先别放人走。
en: Close contact identification is not done yet, so do not let anyone leave.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 次密切接触者参照密接管理。
en: Secondary close contacts are managed like close contacts.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 他是次密切接触者，也要做核酸。
en: He is a secondary close contact and also needs a nucleic acid test.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 一般接触者实施健康监测。
en: General contacts undergo health monitoring.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 您算一般接触者，注意监测体温。
en: You are a general contact, so monitor your temperature.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者追踪在二十四小时内完成。
en: Contact tracing is completed within twenty-four hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者追踪要快，晚一天就扩散。
en: Contact tracing must be fast; one day late means spread.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者管理实行属地负责。
en: Contact management is the responsibility of the local authority.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者管理按名单一个一个落实。
en: Contact management is carried out one by one from the list.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触时间超过十五分钟计为密接。
en: Contact longer than fifteen minutes counts as close contact.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触时间多久？几分钟和半小时不一样。
en: How long was the exposure time? A few minutes differs from half an hour.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触方式包括同餐、同住与同乘。
en: Modes of contact include shared meals, shared housing and shared transport.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触方式说清楚，是同桌吃饭吗？
en: Describe the mode of contact: did you share a table?
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者登记信息须注意隐私保护。
en: Contact registration data must be kept private.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者登记填手机号，方便通知。
en: Put a mobile number in the contact registration so we can notify you.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 已向邻市发出协查通报。
en: A cross-regional tracing notification was sent to the neighbouring city.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 协查通报发出去，等人回话。
en: The cross-regional tracing notification is out; wait for their reply.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 时空伴随者纳入健康监测范围。
en: Space-time overlap contacts are included in health monitoring.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 手机提示您是时空伴随者，先做核酸。
en: Your phone says you are a space-time overlap contact, so take a test first.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 风险人员名单由流调组汇总。
en: The list of persons at risk is compiled by the investigation team.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 风险人员都通知到了吗？
en: Has every person at risk been notified?
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 重点人群每周开展一次核酸检测。
en: Priority populations receive a nucleic acid test once a week.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 重点人群先打加强针。
en: Priority populations receive booster doses first.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者采样须在隔离点完成。
en: Contact sampling must be done at the quarantine site.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者采样今天下午统一做。
en: Contact sampling will be done for everyone this afternoon.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 健康监测期间不得外出聚餐。
en: No outings or group meals are allowed during health monitoring.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 健康监测十四天，每天报体温。
en: Health monitoring lasts fourteen days with daily temperature reports.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者告知须注意保护病例隐私。
en: Contact notification must protect the privacy of the case.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触者告知我来打电话，别透露是谁。
en: I will do the contact notification by phone; do not reveal who it was.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 确诊患者须立即隔离治疗。
en: Confirmed patients must be isolated and treated immediately.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这个要隔离，不能住普通病房。
en: This needs isolation, not a general ward.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医学观察期为十四天。
en: The medical observation period is fourteen days.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医学观察期间不能上班，每天报体温。
en: During medical observation you cannot work and must report temperature daily.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 居家隔离须单人单间并分餐。
en: Home isolation requires a separate room and separate meals.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 居家隔离期间别出门，家人都要戴口罩。
en: Do not go out during home isolation, and the family should wear masks.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 密切接触者实施集中隔离。
en: Close contacts undergo centralized quarantine.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 集中隔离有车来接，带好换洗衣服。
en: A vehicle will collect you for centralized quarantine, so bring clothes.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 患者转入隔离病房继续治疗。
en: The patient was transferred to the isolation ward for further treatment.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 送隔离病房，走专用通道。
en: Take him to the isolation ward through the dedicated route.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 负压病房收治空气传播疾病患者。
en: The negative-pressure room admits patients with airborne diseases.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 负压病房门要关严，别同时开两扇。
en: Keep the negative-pressure room doors shut; do not open two at once.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疑似病例先单间隔离待检。
en: A suspected case is placed in single-room isolation pending testing.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 先单间隔离，结果出来再定。
en: Keep him in single-room isolation and decide when the result comes.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 连续两次核酸阴性方可解除隔离。
en: Release from isolation requires two consecutive negative tests.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 解除隔离要等疾控通知。
en: Release from isolation waits for notice from disease control.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 隔离期为十四天，期满复查。
en: The isolation period is fourteen days, with a review at the end.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 隔离期没满，不能提前走。
en: The isolation period is not over, so you cannot leave early.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 甲类传染病患者须隔离治疗。
en: Patients with Class A infectious diseases must receive isolation treatment.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 先隔离治疗，别急着转院。
en: Start isolation treatment first; do not rush to transfer.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 拒绝隔离治疗的可由公安机关协助强制隔离治疗。
en: Those refusing isolation treatment may face compulsory isolation and treatment assisted by police.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 他跑了就得走强制隔离治疗程序。
en: If he runs away, compulsory isolation and treatment procedures apply.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医学观察期内出现症状立即转运。
en: Transfer immediately if symptoms appear during the medical observation period.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医学观察期还有五天，别松劲。
en: There are five days left in the medical observation period, so stay alert.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 居家健康监测期间每日报告体温。
en: Report your temperature daily during home health monitoring.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 居家健康监测，别去人多的地方。
en: During home health monitoring, avoid crowded places.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 集中隔离点须分区设置并配备医护。
en: A centralized quarantine facility needs separate zones and medical staff.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 集中隔离点在体育馆那边。
en: The centralized quarantine facility is over by the stadium.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 确诊病例闭环转运至定点医院。
en: The confirmed case was transferred to the designated hospital by closed-loop transfer.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 闭环转运，司机和医护都不下车。
en: For closed-loop transfer, neither the driver nor staff get out.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 期满且核酸阴性者解除医学观察。
en: Those with a negative test at the end of the period are released from medical observation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 今天解除医学观察，可以回家了。
en: You are released from medical observation today and can go home.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 进入隔离病区须规范穿戴个人防护装备。
en: Personal protective equipment must be worn correctly before entering the isolation ward.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 个人防护装备穿好再进去，别漏了护目镜。
en: Put on the personal protective equipment first, and do not forget the goggles.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 预检分诊岗位执行一级防护。
en: Staff at triage work under level one protection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 你在分诊台，一级防护就够了。
en: You are at the triage desk, so level one protection is enough.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 进入发热门诊须二级防护。
en: Level two protection is required to enter the fever clinic.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 发热门诊走二级防护，帽子口罩都要戴。
en: The fever clinic uses level two protection, so wear cap and mask.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 气管插管按三级防护执行。
en: Intubation is performed under level three protection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 插管是三级防护，正压头套别忘了。
en: Intubation needs level three protection, so do not forget the powered air hood.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 全程佩戴医用外科口罩。
en: Wear a surgical mask throughout.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医用外科口罩戴好，遮住鼻子。
en: Put the surgical mask on properly and cover your nose.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触疑似肺结核患者须戴医用防护口罩。
en: A medical protective respirator is required when seeing suspected tuberculosis.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医用防护口罩要做密合性检查。
en: Do a seal check on the medical protective respirator.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 脱防护服时避免污染内层衣物。
en: Avoid contaminating inner clothing when removing the protective suit.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 防护服穿反了不行，接缝朝外。
en: The protective suit cannot be worn inside out; seams must face outward.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 采样时须佩戴护目镜或面屏。
en: Wear protective goggles or a face shield during sampling.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 护目镜起雾了，擦一下再操作。
en: The protective goggles fogged up; wipe them before continuing.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 吸痰操作加戴防护面屏。
en: Add a face shield when performing suctioning.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 防护面屏戴上，别用手摸脸。
en: Put on the face shield and do not touch your face.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触患者前后更换乳胶手套。
en: Change latex gloves before and after contact with a patient.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 乳胶手套一人一换，别戴着乱走。
en: Change latex gloves for each patient; do not walk around wearing them.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 手卫生依从性纳入科室考核。
en: Hand hygiene compliance is included in departmental assessment.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 手卫生做到位，比多戴一层手套管用。
en: Good hand hygiene helps more than an extra pair of gloves.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 穿脱防护服须双人监督。
en: Donning and doffing of protective clothing requires a buddy to supervise.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 穿脱防护服有顺序，脱的时候更要慢。
en: Donning and doffing of protective clothing follows a sequence; slow down when removing.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 脱卸区分清洁区与污染区。
en: The doffing area is divided into clean and contaminated zones.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 到脱卸区再脱，别在走廊里脱。
en: Remove equipment in the doffing area, not in the corridor.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 戴医用防护口罩后行密合性检查。
en: Perform a mask seal check after putting on the respirator.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 密合性检查做一下，呼气看有没有漏。
en: Do a mask seal check and breathe out to see if air leaks.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 候诊区张贴呼吸道礼仪提示。
en: Respiratory hygiene notices are posted in the waiting area.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 咳嗽注意呼吸道礼仪，用纸巾捂住。
en: Mind your respiratory hygiene when coughing and cover with a tissue.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触耐药菌患者须穿隔离衣。
en: An isolation gown is required when caring for patients with resistant bacteria.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 隔离衣系紧后领，出来前脱掉。
en: Tie the isolation gown at the back of the neck and remove it before leaving.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 患者转出后对床单位进行消毒。
en: The bed unit is disinfected after the patient is transferred out.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这个床要消毒，先别收新病人。
en: This bed needs disinfection, so do not admit a new patient yet.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 手术器械须经高压蒸汽灭菌。
en: Surgical instruments must undergo autoclave sterilization.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这些器械要灭菌，不能只消毒。
en: These instruments need sterilization, not just disinfection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 患者死亡后行终末消毒。
en: Terminal disinfection was performed after the patient died.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 人走了做终末消毒，房间封两小时。
en: Do terminal disinfection after the patient leaves and seal the room for two hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 病室实行随时消毒并记录。
en: The room undergoes concurrent disinfection and it is documented.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 随时消毒跟上，别等出院才做。
en: Keep up concurrent disinfection; do not wait until discharge.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 门诊每日开展预防性消毒。
en: Preventive disinfection is carried out daily in the outpatient department.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 预防性消毒每天两次，别省。
en: Preventive disinfection is done twice a day; do not skip it.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 用含氯消毒剂擦拭地面与床栏。
en: Floors and bed rails were wiped with a chlorine-based disinfectant.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 含氯消毒剂现配现用，放久了失效。
en: Chlorine-based disinfectant must be freshly prepared; it loses potency.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 乙醇消毒剂用于体温计擦拭。
en: Ethanol disinfectant is used to wipe thermometers.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 乙醇消毒剂别喷空气，只擦表面。
en: Do not spray ethanol disinfectant into the air; wipe surfaces only.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 无人时开启紫外线消毒三十分钟。
en: Ultraviolet disinfection runs for thirty minutes when the room is empty.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 紫外线消毒时人不能在里面。
en: Nobody can stay inside during ultraviolet disinfection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 耐高温器械首选高压蒸汽灭菌。
en: Autoclave sterilization is preferred for heat-resistant instruments.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 高压蒸汽灭菌要贴指示胶带。
en: Put indicator tape on items for autoclave sterilization.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 按说明书配置消毒剂浓度。
en: Prepare the disinfectant concentration according to the instructions.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 消毒剂浓度不够，等于白擦。
en: If the disinfectant concentration is too low, wiping is useless.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 消毒作用时间不少于三十分钟。
en: The contact time must be at least thirty minutes.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 喷完要等够消毒作用时间再擦。
en: After spraying, wait the full contact time before wiping.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 每日两次物体表面消毒。
en: Surface disinfection is done twice daily.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 物体表面消毒重点擦门把手。
en: For surface disinfection, focus on door handles.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 病室每日通风并进行空气消毒。
en: The room is ventilated and air disinfection is performed daily.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 空气消毒加开窗通风，双管齐下。
en: Combine air disinfection with open-window ventilation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医疗废物按类别分袋收集。
en: Medical waste is collected in bags by category.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医疗废物别混进生活垃圾。
en: Do not mix medical waste with household rubbish.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 感染性废物使用黄色专用袋。
en: Infectious waste goes into yellow dedicated bags.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 感染性废物扎紧袋口再称重。
en: Tie the infectious waste bag tightly before weighing.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 每季度开展消毒效果监测。
en: Disinfection efficacy monitoring is carried out quarterly.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 消毒效果监测不合格就重做。
en: If disinfection efficacy monitoring fails, redo the disinfection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫苗接种须核对姓名与疫苗批号。
en: Vaccination requires checking the name and vaccine batch number.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫苗接种前先问有没有过敏史。
en: Before vaccination, ask about any history of allergy.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 该疫苗已纳入国家免疫规划。
en: This vaccine is included in the national immunization programme.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 免疫规划内的疫苗免费。
en: Vaccines in the immunization programme are free.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 按接种程序完成全程接种。
en: Complete the full course according to the vaccination schedule.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接种程序是零一二六个月，别记错。
en: The vaccination schedule is zero, one, two and six months; do not mix it up.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 灭活疫苗需多剂次完成基础免疫。
en: Inactivated vaccines need several doses to complete primary immunization.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 灭活疫苗打两针，间隔三周。
en: The inactivated vaccine is given in two doses three weeks apart.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 免疫缺陷者禁用减毒活疫苗。
en: Live attenuated vaccines are contraindicated in immunodeficient patients.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 减毒活疫苗孕妇不能打。
en: Pregnant women cannot receive live attenuated vaccines.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 重组蛋白疫苗需低温保存。
en: Recombinant protein vaccines require cold storage.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 重组蛋白疫苗三针，间隔一个月。
en: The recombinant protein vaccine is three doses one month apart.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 信使核糖核酸疫苗须超低温储运。
en: Messenger RNA vaccines require ultra-low temperature storage and transport.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 信使核糖核酸疫苗打完后胳膊会酸。
en: The arm aches after a messenger RNA vaccine.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 病毒载体疫苗接种一剂即可起效。
en: A single dose of viral vector vaccine is effective.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 病毒载体疫苗只打一针。
en: The viral vector vaccine is just one dose.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 严格按接种剂量抽取疫苗。
en: Draw the vaccine strictly according to the vaccination dose.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接种剂量别抽多，零点五毫升就够。
en: Do not draw more than the vaccination dose; half a millilitre is enough.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 发热者暂缓接种并另行预约。
en: Those with fever have temporary deferral of vaccination and a new appointment.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 今天发烧就暂缓接种，好了再来。
en: With fever today you need temporary deferral of vaccination; come back when well.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 完成基础免疫六个月后接种加强针。
en: A booster dose is given six months after completing primary immunization.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 加强针到时间了，记得来打。
en: The booster dose is due; remember to come.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接种率达到一定水平可形成群体免疫。
en: Herd immunity forms when coverage reaches a certain level.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 群体免疫要靠大家都去打疫苗。
en: Herd immunity depends on everyone getting vaccinated.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 该疫苗效力约为百分之九十。
en: The vaccine efficacy is about ninety percent.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫苗效力再高也不能百分百防住。
en: Even high vaccine efficacy does not guarantee full protection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 提高老年人疫苗覆盖率。
en: Increase vaccination coverage among older people.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫苗覆盖率上不去，疫情就难控。
en: If vaccination coverage stays low, the outbreak is hard to control.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 入托入学须查验预防接种证。
en: The immunization record booklet is checked at kindergarten and school entry.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 预防接种证带来，我登记一下。
en: Bring the immunization record booklet and I will register it.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 划定区域开展应急接种。
en: Emergency vaccination was carried out in the designated area.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 应急接种今天开始，先打重点人群。
en: Emergency vaccination starts today, beginning with key groups.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫苗不良反应须在系统内报告。
en: Adverse vaccine reactions must be reported in the system.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 打完后不舒服，可能是疫苗不良反应。
en: Feeling unwell afterwards may be an adverse vaccine reaction.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疑似预防接种异常反应须在四十八小时内报告。
en: An adverse event following immunization must be reported within forty-eight hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这个算疑似预防接种异常反应，先上报。
en: This counts as an adverse event following immunization, so report it first.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 一般反应无需特殊处理。
en: A common adverse reaction needs no specific treatment.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 一般反应就是胳膊酸、有点低烧。
en: A common adverse reaction is a sore arm and slight fever.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 异常反应需组织专家调查诊断。
en: An abnormal vaccination reaction requires expert investigation and diagnosis.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这种情况要按异常反应上报。
en: This case must be reported as an abnormal vaccination reaction.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接种部位红肿直径约三厘米。
en: The injection-site redness and swelling measured about three centimetres.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接种部位红肿别揉，冷敷就行。
en: Do not rub the injection-site redness and swelling; cold compress is enough.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 全身反应多在两天内缓解。
en: A systemic reaction usually resolves within two days.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 有全身反应就多喝水、多休息。
en: With a systemic reaction, drink more water and rest.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接种点须配备疫苗相关过敏性休克抢救药品。
en: Vaccination sites must stock drugs for vaccine-associated anaphylaxis.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫苗相关过敏性休克要马上打肾上腺素。
en: For vaccine-associated anaphylaxis give adrenaline immediately.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 晕针者平卧并观察生命体征。
en: A patient with needle syncope lies flat and vital signs are watched.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 他是晕针，不是过敏，先躺下。
en: He has needle syncope, not allergy, so lie him down first.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 局部反应一般三到五天消退。
en: A local reaction usually fades in three to five days.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 局部反应不用吃药，观察就行。
en: A local reaction needs no medicine, just observation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 不良反应监测覆盖所有接种单位。
en: Adverse reaction monitoring covers all vaccination units.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 不良反应监测数据每周汇总。
en: Adverse reaction monitoring data are summarised weekly.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 因果关联评估由专家组完成。
en: Causality assessment is completed by an expert panel.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 因果关联评估没出来，先别下结论。
en: Causality assessment is not out yet, so do not conclude.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 异常反应补偿按省级办法执行。
en: Compensation for abnormal reaction follows provincial rules.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 异常反应补偿要走鉴定程序。
en: Compensation for abnormal reaction requires the appraisal procedure.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 不良反应报告须填写发生时间与处理经过。
en: Adverse reaction reporting records the time of onset and treatment given.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 不良反应报告今天必须录完。
en: Adverse reaction reporting must be entered today.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接种后留观三十分钟方可离开。
en: Stay for post-vaccination observation for thirty minutes before leaving.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接种后留观半小时，不舒服马上说。
en: Stay for post-vaccination observation for half an hour and speak up if unwell.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接种点制定异常反应处置流程。
en: Vaccination sites set out a management of adverse reactions pathway.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 异常反应处置演练每半年一次。
en: Management of adverse reactions is drilled every six months.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 异常反应鉴定由市级医学会组织。
en: The appraisal of abnormal vaccination reaction is organised by the city medical association.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 异常反应鉴定结果出来再说赔偿。
en: Wait for the appraisal of abnormal vaccination reaction before discussing compensation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 口岸检疫发现一例发热旅客。
en: Port health quarantine identified one febrile traveller.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 口岸检疫会测体温，别紧张。
en: Port health quarantine will check your temperature, so do not worry.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 健康申报内容包括症状与接触史。
en: The health declaration covers symptoms and contact history.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 健康申报在手机上填，别漏项。
en: Fill in the health declaration on your phone and do not skip items.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 入境检疫须查验核酸检测证明。
en: Entry quarantine checks the nucleic acid test certificate.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 入境检疫排队先准备好护照。
en: Have your passport ready while queueing for entry quarantine.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 出境检疫发现疑似病例移交医疗机构。
en: Exit quarantine referred a suspected case to a medical institution.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 出境检疫也要填健康申报。
en: Exit quarantine also requires a health declaration.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 染疫嫌疑人送留验场所观察。
en: The person suspected of infection was sent to a quarantine site for observation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 他是染疫嫌疑人，先留验。
en: He is a person suspected of infection, so keep him under quarantine observation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 留验期限按该病潜伏期确定。
en: The quarantine observation period is set by the incubation period of the disease.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 留验期间不能离开指定场所。
en: You cannot leave the designated site during quarantine observation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 对就地诊验人员发放就诊方便卡。
en: Those under on-site medical examination receive a medical convenience card.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 就地诊验要去指定医院，别乱跑。
en: On-site medical examination must be at the designated hospital, so do not wander off.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医学排查发现体温三十八度以上旅客。
en: Medical screening at port found a traveller with a temperature above thirty-eight degrees.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医学排查就是问症状、测体温。
en: Medical screening at port means asking about symptoms and checking temperature.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 健康申明卡须本人签字。
en: The health declaration form must be signed by the traveller.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 健康申明卡填错要重填。
en: If the health declaration form is filled in wrongly, do it again.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 登机前须出示核酸检测证明。
en: A nucleic acid test certificate must be shown before boarding.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 核酸检测证明过期了，得重做。
en: The nucleic acid test certificate has expired, so a new test is needed.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 入境须查验疫苗接种证明。
en: Vaccination certificates are checked on entry.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫苗接种证明在手机里能查。
en: The vaccination certificate can be shown on your phone.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 染疫人由指定机构隔离治疗。
en: The infected person receives isolation treatment at a designated facility.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 染疫人要闭环转运，不能自行离开。
en: The infected person needs closed-loop transfer and cannot leave alone.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 对行李实施卫生处理后方可放行。
en: Luggage is released only after sanitary measures are applied.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 卫生处理完才能提货。
en: Goods can be collected only after sanitary measures are completed.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 交通工具检疫须查验旅客名单。
en: Conveyance quarantine requires checking the passenger list.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 交通工具检疫没放行，人不能下机。
en: Until conveyance quarantine clears, passengers cannot disembark.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 口岸突发公共卫生事件两小时内上报。
en: A public health emergency at a port of entry is reported within two hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 口岸突发公共卫生事件要马上启动预案。
en: Activate the plan at once for a public health emergency at a port of entry.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫情发布须经授权后统一进行。
en: Epidemic information release is carried out uniformly after authorisation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫情发布今天下午三点，别提前透消息。
en: Epidemic information release is at three this afternoon; do not leak it early.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 风险沟通要说明已知与未知，避免过度承诺。
en: Risk communication should state what is known and unknown and avoid overpromising.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 风险沟通别只讲数字，要告诉公众怎么做。
en: In risk communication do not just give numbers; tell the public what to do.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 已向相邻省份发出疫情通报。
en: An epidemic notification has been sent to neighbouring provinces.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 疫情通报发出后，各地开始排查。
en: After the epidemic notification went out, local areas began screening.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 新闻发布会通报了新增病例与防控措施。
en: The press conference reported new cases and control measures.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 新闻发布会别抢答，统一由发言人回应。
en: At the press conference do not answer out of turn; the spokesperson responds.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 该区调整为中风险等级。
en: The district was adjusted to a medium risk level.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 风险等级变了，防控措施也要跟着调。
en: When the risk level changes, control measures must change too.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 发布旅行风险提示，建议暂缓前往。
en: A travel risk alert advised postponing trips.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 门口贴了风险提示，就诊前先看。
en: A risk alert is posted at the entrance; read it before coming in.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 公众防护指南明确发热就诊流程。
en: The public protection guidance sets out the pathway for fever clinic visits.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 公众防护指南发到社区，人手一份。
en: Distribute the public protection guidance to the community, one per person.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 谣言称喝某药可预防，已紧急澄清。
en: A rumour claimed a certain drug prevents infection and was promptly clarified.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 群里传的谣言别转，等官方消息。
en: Do not forward rumours in group chats; wait for official information.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 当天辟谣三条不实信息。
en: Three pieces of misinformation were refuted the same day.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 谣言出来要及时辟谣，别拖着。
en: Refute misinformation promptly when it appears; do not delay.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 风险感知偏低导致防护措施执行不到位。
en: Low risk perception led to poor adherence to protective measures.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 风险感知因人而异，沟通要分层。
en: Risk perception varies, so communication must be tailored.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 启动应急响应，各工作组到位。
en: Emergency response was activated and all working groups assembled.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 应急响应一启动，全员取消休假。
en: Once emergency response starts, all leave is cancelled.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 应急响应级别由三级提升为二级。
en: The emergency response level was raised from three to two.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 应急响应级别没降，防控不能松。
en: The emergency response level has not been lowered, so control stays strict.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 舆情监测发现公众对隔离政策疑问较多。
en: Public opinion monitoring found many questions about isolation policy.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 舆情监测每天出一期简报。
en: Public opinion monitoring produces a daily briefing.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 术后出现医院感染，上报院感科。
en: A healthcare-associated infection appeared after surgery and was reported to infection control.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 这个算医院感染，别当成社区感染。
en: This counts as a healthcare-associated infection, not a community one.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 院感防控纳入医院年度考核。
en: Infection prevention and control is part of the annual hospital assessment.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 院感防控做不好，一次暴发全科停摆。
en: Poor infection prevention and control means one outbreak shuts the unit.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 手卫生依从性从六成提升到九成。
en: Hand hygiene compliance rose from sixty to ninety percent.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 手卫生依从性上不去，先查洗手液够不够。
en: If hand hygiene compliance is low, first check the supply of hand rub.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 所有患者均执行标准预防。
en: Standard precautions apply to all patients.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 标准预防是底线，不分有没有确诊。
en: Standard precautions are the baseline, whatever the diagnosis.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 耐药菌患者实施接触隔离。
en: Patients with resistant bacteria are managed under contact precautions.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 接触隔离要挂牌，进出都穿隔离衣。
en: Contact precautions need a door sign and a gown on entry.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流感患者执行飞沫隔离。
en: Influenza patients are managed under droplet precautions.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 飞沫隔离要求单间或床间距一米。
en: Droplet precautions require a single room or one metre between beds.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 肺结核活动期需空气隔离。
en: Active pulmonary tuberculosis requires airborne precautions.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 空气隔离必须进负压病房。
en: Airborne precautions require a negative-pressure room.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 隔离标识贴在门外醒目位置。
en: The isolation sign is posted prominently outside the door.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 隔离标识掉了要马上补。
en: Replace the isolation sign at once if it falls off.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医院感染监测每月汇总分析。
en: Healthcare-associated infection surveillance is summarised monthly.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医院感染监测发现某病区感染率上升。
en: Healthcare-associated infection surveillance found a rising infection rate in one ward.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 启动暴发调查，采集环境样本。
en: An outbreak investigation was launched and environmental samples collected.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴发调查期间暂停收新病人。
en: Suspend new admissions during the outbreak investigation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 换药须严格遵守无菌操作。
en: Dressing changes must strictly follow aseptic technique.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 无菌操作不过关，伤口就容易感染。
en: Poor aseptic technique leads to wound infection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医疗废物分类错误会被通报。
en: Wrong medical waste classification is reported as a breach.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 医疗废物分类按颜色分，别混。
en: Medical waste classification follows bag colour; do not mix them.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 病区出现院感暴发，立即封控。
en: A healthcare-associated outbreak in the ward triggered immediate closure.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 院感暴发要两小时内报院感科。
en: A healthcare-associated outbreak is reported to infection control within two hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 血源性病原体暴露需评估源患者。
en: Bloodborne pathogen exposure requires assessment of the source patient.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 血源性病原体里最怕的是乙肝。
en: Among bloodborne pathogens, hepatitis B is the biggest concern.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 锐器伤后立即挤出血液并消毒。
en: After a needlestick injury, squeeze out blood and disinfect at once.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 锐器伤先冲洗，别用力挤。
en: For a needlestick injury irrigate first; do not squeeze hard.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露源乙肝表面抗原阳性。
en: The exposure source was positive for hepatitis B surface antigen.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露源查清楚，才知道要不要用药。
en: Identify the exposure source to decide whether drugs are needed.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露评估为低风险，观察即可。
en: The exposure assessment was low risk, so observation suffices.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露评估没做完，先别停药。
en: Do not stop drugs until the exposure assessment is complete.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露登记须在二十四小时内完成。
en: Exposure registry entries must be completed within twenty-four hours.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露登记填全，随访才找得到人。
en: Complete the exposure registry so follow-up can reach you.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 未接种者需注射乙肝免疫球蛋白。
en: Those not vaccinated need hepatitis B immunoglobulin.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 乙肝免疫球蛋白越早打越好。
en: Hepatitis B immunoglobulin should be given as early as possible.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 基线检测今天抽血送检。
en: Baseline testing bloods were sent today.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 基线检测结果留底，后面要对比。
en: Keep the baseline testing results for later comparison.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 随访检测安排在六周、三个月与六个月。
en: Follow-up testing is scheduled at six weeks, three months and six months.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 随访检测别漏，最后一次最容易被忘。
en: Do not miss follow-up testing; the last one is easily forgotten.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 上报流程贴在治疗室墙上。
en: The reporting procedure is posted on the treatment room wall.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 上报流程走完，才算正式备案。
en: Only after the reporting procedure is complete is it formally recorded.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露后随访由感染科负责。
en: Post-exposure follow-up is managed by the infectious diseases department.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露后随访半年，期间可正常上班。
en: Post-exposure follow-up lasts six months, and normal work continues.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露档案保存不少于十年。
en: Exposure records are kept for at least ten years.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 暴露档案在院感科，调阅要登记。
en: The exposure record is held by infection control; access is logged.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 锐器盒装到四分之三就要更换。
en: The sharps container must be replaced when three-quarters full.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 锐器盒别用手掏，直接换新的。
en: Do not reach into the sharps container; replace it.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 安全注射要求一人一针一管。
en: Safe injection requires a new needle and syringe for each patient.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 安全注射做到位，锐器伤少一半。
en: Good safe injection halves needlestick injuries.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 痰涂片阳性肺结核需空气隔离。
en: Smear-positive pulmonary tuberculosis requires airborne precautions.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 肺结核要查痰，别只看胸片。
en: Pulmonary tuberculosis needs sputum tests, not just a chest film.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 耐多药结核病疗程长达十八个月。
en: Multidrug-resistant tuberculosis treatment lasts up to eighteen months.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 耐多药结核病要送药敏试验。
en: Multidrug-resistant tuberculosis needs drug susceptibility testing.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒抗体初筛阳性需确证。
en: A reactive human immunodeficiency virus antibody screen needs confirmation.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 人类免疫缺陷病毒检测要本人知情同意。
en: Human immunodeficiency virus testing requires the patient's informed consent.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 艾滋病患者机会性感染风险高。
en: Patients with acquired immunodeficiency syndrome are at high risk of opportunistic infection.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 艾滋病不是绝症，规范治疗能长期生存。
en: Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome is not a death sentence with proper treatment.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 病毒性肝炎分型靠血清学检测。
en: Viral hepatitis typing relies on serological tests.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 病毒性肝炎要注意休息和复查肝功能。
en: With viral hepatitis, rest and repeat liver function tests.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 乙型肝炎表面抗原阳性者需定期随访。
en: Those positive for hepatitis B surface antigen need regular follow-up.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 乙型肝炎疫苗三针打完才有保护。
en: Hepatitis B protection requires all three vaccine doses.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流行性感冒与普通感冒不同，需抗病毒治疗。
en: Influenza differs from the common cold and needs antiviral treatment.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 流行性感冒高发季节，发热病人要分流。
en: In influenza season, febrile patients need separate routing.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 新型冠状病毒感染按乙类传染病管理。
en: Coronavirus disease 2019 is managed as a Class B infectious disease.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 新型冠状病毒感染抗原阳性先居家监测。
en: A positive antigen test for coronavirus disease 2019 first means home monitoring.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 霍乱疑似病例须就地隔离并上报。
en: Suspected cholera requires on-site isolation and reporting.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 霍乱补液是关键，别等培养结果。
en: Fluid replacement is key in cholera; do not wait for culture.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 手足口病患儿需隔离至疱疹结痂。
en: Children with hand, foot and mouth disease are isolated until the vesicles crust.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 手足口病看手心脚心和口腔。
en: For hand, foot and mouth disease check palms, soles and mouth.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 丙型肝炎可经抗病毒治疗治愈。
en: Hepatitis C can be cured with antiviral treatment.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 丙型肝炎查抗体阳性还要查核酸。
en: For hepatitis C, a positive antibody test needs nucleic acid testing too.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 诺如病毒感染易在病区引起暴发。
en: Norovirus infection easily causes outbreaks in wards.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 诺如病毒感染要处理呕吐物，别干扫。
en: For norovirus infection clean vomit properly; do not dry sweep.
domain: 传染病与公共卫生应急

zh: 病历记录精神障碍诊断须由精神科执业医师作出
en: Diagnoses of mental disorder must be made by a licensed psychiatrist and recorded accordingly.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属问精神障碍是不是就是精神病，医生说明范围更宽
en: The family asked whether mental disorder means insanity, and the doctor explained the term is broader.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 严重精神障碍患者纳入社区随访管理
en: Patients with severe mental disorder are included in community follow-up programmes.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他这个严重精神障碍已经十年，一直规律服药
en: He has had severe mental disorder for ten years and has taken medication regularly throughout.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 精神分裂症患者自知力多不完整，需长期抗精神病药维持
en: Patients with schizophrenia usually have limited insight and need long-term antipsychotic maintenance.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他确诊精神分裂症八年，一停药就复发
en: He was diagnosed with schizophrenia eight years ago and relapses whenever he stops the medication.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 抑郁障碍的诊断需同时满足症状标准和病程标准
en: Diagnosing depressive disorder requires both symptom criteria and duration criteria.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 她说抑郁障碍不是想不开，是病，得治
en: She says depressive disorder is an illness rather than a bad attitude, and it needs treatment.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 双相障碍误用抗抑郁药可能诱发躁狂发作
en: Antidepressants used in bipolar disorder may trigger a manic episode.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家里人说双相障碍情绪一会儿高一会儿低，很难照顾
en: The family says bipolar disorder makes his mood swing between high and low, which is hard to manage.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 焦虑障碍需与甲状腺功能亢进、心律失常等躯体疾病鉴别
en: Anxiety disorder must be distinguished from physical conditions such as hyperthyroidism and arrhythmia.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他焦虑障碍发作时心慌手抖，以为是心脏病
en: When his anxiety disorder flares he has palpitations and tremors and thinks it is a heart problem.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 老年谵妄常被误认为痴呆或情绪问题
en: Delirium in older patients is often mistaken for dementia or an emotional problem.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 老爷子晚上突然谵妄，认不出人，还说看见虫子
en: The old man suddenly became delirious at night, did not recognise people, and said he saw insects.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 器质性精神障碍需先查头颅CT与代谢指标
en: Organic mental disorder requires brain imaging and metabolic tests first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 医生说要先排除器质性精神障碍，才考虑功能性的病
en: The doctor said organic mental disorder must be excluded before considering a functional illness.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 物质所致精神障碍须记录物质种类与末次使用时间
en: For substance-induced mental disorder, record the substance and the time of last use.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他这次幻觉是物质所致精神障碍，戒断后就清醒了
en: This episode of hallucinations was substance-induced mental disorder, and he cleared once he withdrew.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 强迫障碍患者明知不必要却无法控制反复检查的行为
en: Patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder know the repeated checking is unnecessary but cannot stop.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他强迫障碍，出门要反复回去看门锁
en: His obsessive-compulsive disorder makes him go back again and again to check the door lock.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 创伤后应激障碍多在创伤事件后数周至数月出现
en: Post-traumatic stress disorder usually emerges weeks to months after the traumatic event.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 车祸后他一直做噩梦，是创伤后应激障碍
en: He has had nightmares since the car crash, which is post-traumatic stress disorder.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 人格障碍的诊断需追溯至青少年期并排除其他精神障碍
en: Diagnosing personality disorder requires tracing onset to adolescence and excluding other disorders.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属说他人格障碍，跟谁都处不来，也不觉得自己有问题
en: The family says his personality disorder makes him fall out with everyone, and he sees no problem in himself.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 进食障碍患者常伴电解质紊乱与心律失常，需监测血钾
en: Patients with eating disorder often have electrolyte disturbance and arrhythmia, so potassium must be monitored.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 女孩进食障碍，瘦得厉害还说自己胖
en: The girl has an eating disorder and is dangerously thin yet still calls herself fat.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 睡眠障碍需先排除睡眠呼吸暂停等躯体原因
en: Sleep disorder requires exclusion of physical causes such as sleep apnoea first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他睡眠障碍两年，一晚上醒四五次
en: He has had a sleep disorder for two years and wakes four or five times a night.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 躯体形式障碍患者常多次就诊于多个科室
en: Patients with somatic symptom disorder often attend several departments repeatedly.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 她躯体形式障碍，查了半年都没查出毛病，人还是难受
en: She has somatic symptom disorder, and after six months of tests nothing was found yet she still feels unwell.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 孤独症谱系障碍应尽早开展行为干预与语言训练
en: Autism spectrum disorder should prompt early behavioural intervention and language training.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 孩子两岁还不会叫爸爸妈妈，查了是孤独症谱系障碍
en: The child could not say mummy or daddy at two, and testing showed autism spectrum disorder.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 幻觉需记录种类、内容和出现时间
en: For hallucinations, record the type, content, and time of occurrence.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他说晚上有人站床边说话，其实是幻觉
en: He says someone stands by his bed talking at night, which is a hallucination.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 患者诉听幻觉为命令性内容，需立即评估自伤风险
en: When auditory hallucinations are commanding in content, self-harm risk must be assessed at once.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他听幻觉里一直有人骂他，让他别信医生
en: In his auditory hallucinations someone keeps insulting him and telling him not to trust the doctor.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 妄想内容应原话记录，不要只写"有妄想"
en: Record delusional content in the patient's own words rather than writing only that delusions are present.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他坚信邻居要害他，这是妄想，怎么解释都不信
en: He is convinced the neighbour means to harm him, which is a delusion, and no explanation changes it.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 被害妄想患者可能因恐惧而先发制人，需注意环境安全
en: Patients with persecutory delusion may act first out of fear, so the environment must be kept safe.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他说饭菜被下毒，是典型被害妄想，不肯吃饭
en: He says the food is poisoned, a classic persecutory delusion, and refuses to eat.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 关系妄想常表现为认为电视和广播在暗示自己
en: Delusion of reference often appears as a belief that television and radio broadcasts hint at oneself.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他关系妄想，觉得路人咳嗽都是冲他来的
en: He has delusions of reference and thinks strangers cough because of him.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 思维散漫使病史采集困难，需记录原话示例
en: Loosening of associations makes history taking difficult, so verbatim examples should be recorded.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 跟他聊病情，他思维散漫，说三句就跑题
en: Talking about his illness shows loosening of associations, as he drifts off topic every few sentences.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 思维奔逸伴言语增多和睡眠减少，支持躁狂发作
en: Flight of ideas with increased speech and reduced sleep supports a diagnosis of mania.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他思维奔逸，一晚上写了几十页计划
en: His thoughts are racing so fast that he wrote dozens of pages of plans in one night.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 思维贫乏属精神分裂症阴性症状，需与抑郁鉴别
en: Poverty of thought is a negative symptom of schizophrenia and must be distinguished from depression.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 问一句答一句，思维贫乏很明显
en: He answers only what is asked, and the poverty of thought is obvious.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 情感淡漠影响康复训练参与度，需家属协助督促
en: Apathy reduces participation in rehabilitation, so families need to help with encouragement.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他情感淡漠，家里出事也没什么反应
en: He shows apathy and barely reacts even when something happens at home.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 情感高涨伴夸大观念时需评估冲动消费与出走风险
en: Elation with grandiose ideas requires assessment of impulsive spending and absconding risk.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他这几天情感高涨，觉得自己什么都能干
en: He has been elated for days and believes he can do anything.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 谈亲人去世时发笑属情感倒错，应如实记录
en: Laughing while discussing a relative's death is inappropriate affect and should be recorded as such.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 说到父亲去世他还笑，情感倒错很明显
en: He laughed while talking about his father's death, which is clearly inappropriate affect.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自知力缺乏者多拒绝服药，需与家属共同商定方案
en: Those lacking insight often refuse medication, so a plan must be agreed with the family.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他自知力很差，坚持说自己没病，不肯吃药
en: His insight is very poor, he insists he is not ill and refuses medication.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 蜡样屈曲是紧张症典型体征，须记录持续时间
en: Waxy flexibility is a typical catatonic sign and its duration should be recorded.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 抬起他胳膊，他就保持那个姿势，是蜡样屈曲
en: When his arm is lifted it stays in that position, which is waxy flexibility.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 缄默患者需先排除失语与喉部病变
en: In mutism, aphasia and laryngeal disease must be excluded first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 她一天不说一句话，缄默已经三天了
en: She has not said a word all day, and the mutism has lasted three days.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 入院风险评估须在规定时限内完成并记录
en: Admission risk assessment must be completed and documented within the required time.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 先做风险评估，看他有没有伤人风险再安排床位
en: Do the risk assessment first, then decide bed placement based on the risk of harming others.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀风险评估阳性者需专人看护并清除危险物品
en: Patients screening positive on suicide risk assessment need one-to-one observation and removal of dangerous items.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀风险评估还没做，别让他一个人待着
en: The suicide risk assessment is not done yet, so do not leave him alone.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 暴力风险评估提示高风险时，应提前呼叫安保支援
en: When violence risk assessment indicates high risk, security support should be called in advance.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 暴力风险评估做完了，这人暂时不能单独问诊
en: The violence risk assessment is done, and this patient cannot be seen alone for now.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 危险性评估达三级以上需加密随访
en: Follow-up must intensify once the dangerousness assessment reaches grade three or above.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 社区医生每季度做一次危险性评估
en: The community doctor carries out a dangerousness assessment every quarter.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 既往未遂史是最重要的危险因素之一
en: A history of previous attempts is one of the most important risk factors.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 问清危险因素，比如最近有没有失业、离婚这些事
en: Ask about risk factors such as recent job loss or divorce.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 保护性因素包括家庭支持和规律随访
en: Protective factors include family support and regular follow-up.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他有保护性因素，家里一直有人陪着
en: He has protective factors because someone in the family is always with him.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 既往自杀未遂史须在入院记录中单列
en: A history of suicide attempt must be recorded as a separate item in the admission note.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 问他既往自杀未遂史，他承认三年前割过腕
en: Asked about his history of suicide attempt, he admitted cutting his wrist three years ago.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀意念频繁出现者应转入观察区并制定安全计划
en: Frequent suicidal ideation warrants transfer to the observation area and a safety plan.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他说有自杀意念，但还没想好怎么做
en: He says he has suicidal ideation but has not decided how he would do it.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 有明确自杀计划者属高危，不宜居家观察
en: A clear suicide plan places the patient at high risk and rules out home observation.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他连自杀计划都写好了，必须留观
en: He has even written out a suicide plan, so observation is mandatory.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 冲动控制差的患者应减少环境刺激并加强观察
en: Patients with poor impulse control need reduced environmental stimulation and closer observation.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他冲动控制不行，一急就砸东西
en: His impulse control is poor and he smashes things when he gets agitated.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 激越加重时应先排除疼痛、缺氧和药物不良反应
en: When agitation worsens, exclude pain, hypoxia, and adverse drug reactions first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 病人越来越激越，先查血糖和血氧再考虑加药
en: The patient is increasingly agitated, so check glucose and oxygen before adding medication.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 敌意明显者问诊时应保持出口通畅
en: When hostility is marked, keep a clear exit during the interview.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他一进来就敌意很重，说谁也别碰他
en: He came in full of hostility and said nobody should touch him.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 评估量表结果须结合临床判断，不能只看分数
en: Rating scale results must be interpreted with clinical judgement and not by score alone.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 这个评估量表十分钟能做完，先测一遍
en: This rating scale takes ten minutes, so let us run it first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 用哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表筛查后记录分级
en: Screen with the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale and record the grade.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 按哥伦比亚自杀严重程度评定量表问，他属于四级
en: On the Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale he scores grade four.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 攻击行为发生后应记录诱因、经过与处置
en: After aggressive behaviour, record the trigger, course, and management.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 昨晚有攻击行为，把输液架推倒了
en: There was aggressive behaviour last night and he pushed over the drip stand.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 评估自杀手段可及性后应联系家属清理家中危险品
en: After assessing access to lethal means, contact the family to remove dangerous items at home.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家里有农药，自杀手段太容易拿到，得让家属收走
en: There is pesticide at home and lethal means are too easy to reach, so the family must lock it away.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀干预记录须包括风险等级与随访安排
en: Suicide intervention records must include the risk level and follow-up arrangements.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀干预先保证人不离开视线，再谈治疗方案
en: Suicide intervention starts with keeping the patient in sight, then moves to treatment planning.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀未遂患者离院前须完成风险评估与安全计划
en: Patients after a suicide attempt must have risk assessment and a safety plan before leaving.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 这次自杀未遂是服药，洗胃后情绪还很差
en: This suicide attempt was by overdose, and he was still low in mood after gastric lavage.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀既遂后应按规定报告并做好家属安抚
en: After a completed suicide, report as required and support the family.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属难以接受自杀既遂的结果，需要人一直陪着谈
en: The family cannot accept the completed suicide and needs someone to stay and talk with them.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀企图强烈而行为轻微者同样属高危
en: Strong suicidal intent with a medically minor act is still high risk.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他一直说不想活了，自杀企图很明显
en: He keeps saying he does not want to live, so suicidal intent is clear.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 安全计划须写明紧急联系人和就诊地点
en: The safety plan must name the emergency contact and where to seek care.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 安全计划我们一起写，发作时先打这个电话
en: We will write the safety plan together, and when it flares you call this number first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 分诊时完成自杀风险筛查，阳性者立即通知医生
en: Complete suicide risk screening at triage and alert the doctor immediately if positive.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀风险筛查问两句就行：有没有想过不活了
en: Suicide risk screening takes two questions, such as whether he has thought of not living on.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 密切观察每十五分钟巡视一次并记录
en: Under close observation, check and document every fifteen minutes.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 这个病人改密切观察，十五分钟看一次
en: Move this patient to close observation and check every fifteen minutes.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 专人看护期间不得让患者独处或独自进入卫生间
en: During one-to-one observation the patient must not be left alone, including in the bathroom.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 安排专人看护，吃饭上厕所都要跟着
en: Arrange one-to-one observation so someone follows him even to meals and the toilet.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 危险物品清理包括刀具、绳索、玻璃和多余药品
en: Removal of dangerous items covers knives, cords, glass, and surplus medication.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 危险物品清理做完再让家属进来
en: Finish removing dangerous items before letting the family in.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 不自杀承诺不能替代风险评估与随访
en: A no-suicide contract cannot replace risk assessment and follow-up.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 别只让他签不自杀承诺，那东西不保险
en: Do not rely on a no-suicide contract alone, because it does not make things safe.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀风险高危者完成处置后应办理精神科转介
en: After emergency care, high suicide risk patients are referred to the psychiatric clinic.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 这边处理完就精神科转介，别让他直接回家
en: Finish up here and make a psychiatric referral rather than sending him home.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 精神科会诊意见须记入病程记录
en: Psychiatric consultation advice must be entered in the progress notes.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 已经叫了精神科会诊，等他们来看能不能收
en: Psychiatric consultation has been called, so wait to see whether they will admit him.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 非自杀性自伤需与自杀未遂区分，两者处理路径不同
en: Non-suicidal self-injury must be distinguished from suicide attempt because management differs.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 孩子胳膊上的划痕是非自杀性自伤，不是想死
en: The cuts on the child's arm are non-suicidal self-injury, not a wish to die.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 发现遗书应交家属保管并记入病历
en: A suicide note should be given to the family for safekeeping and noted in the record.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他留了遗书，说明这次真下了决心
en: He left a suicide note, which shows he was truly determined this time.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 高危自杀风险患者不得独处，须留观或住院
en: Patients at high suicide risk must not be left alone and need observation or admission.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 评估是高危自杀风险，今晚不能让他走
en: The assessment is high suicide risk, so he cannot leave tonight.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自杀预防的重点之一是限制农药和药品的可及性
en: One focus of suicide prevention is restricting access to pesticides and medicines.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 医院的自杀预防培训每年都要做一次
en: The hospital runs suicide prevention training once a year.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 实施约束须在病历中记录理由、时间和观察结果
en: When restraint is used, record the reason, time, and observations in the medical record.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他要打人又要拔管，只能先约束
en: He was hitting people and pulling out his lines, so restraint was the only option.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 实施保护性医疗措施应遵循诊断标准和治疗规范
en: Protective medical measures must follow diagnostic standards and treatment norms.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 保护性医疗措施是保护他，不是惩罚他
en: Protective medical measures are there to protect him, not to punish him.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束带固定松紧以能插入一指为宜
en: A restraint belt should be tight enough that one finger can just fit underneath.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束带别绑太紧，隔一会儿要松一松
en: Do not tie the restraint belt too tight, and loosen it periodically.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束适应证须在医嘱和记录中写明
en: The indication for restraint must be stated in the order and the record.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 没到约束适应证就别绑，先试别的办法
en: Do not restrain him unless the indication for restraint is met; try other measures first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 有约束禁忌证时应改用其他保护方式
en: When a contraindication for restraint exists, use another protective approach.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他胳膊有伤口，属于约束禁忌证，换个办法
en: His arm has a wound, which is a contraindication for restraint, so use another method.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 按最小限制原则，能陪护就不选约束
en: Under the least restrictive principle, use accompaniment rather than restraint when possible.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 先按最小限制原则试陪护和改环境，再考虑约束
en: Under the least restrictive principle, try accompaniment and environmental change before restraint.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束期间定期巡视间隔不得超过十五分钟
en: During restraint, regular rounds must not be more than fifteen minutes apart.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 定期巡视别忘了签字，护理记录要能对上
en: Do not forget to sign after regular rounds, because the nursing record must match.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 解除约束后应评估皮肤和肢体活动情况
en: After discontinuation of restraint, assess the skin and limb movement.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他一安静下来就解除约束，别一直绑着
en: Discontinue restraint as soon as he settles, and do not keep him tied.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束记录须与护理记录时间一致
en: Restraint documentation must match the times in the nursing record.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束记录现在补，时间点要写清楚
en: Complete the restraint documentation now and make the times clear.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 采用约束前须记录已尝试的替代措施
en: Before restraint, record the alternative measures already tried.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 先想替代措施，家属陪护也算一种
en: Think of alternative measures first, and family accompaniment counts as one.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 实施约束后应履行告知义务并记录
en: After restraint, the duty to inform must be fulfilled and documented.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 告知义务别漏，家属要知道为什么绑
en: Do not skip the duty to inform, because the family must know why he was restrained.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束期间应遮挡隐私并维护人格尊严
en: During restraint, privacy should be screened and personal dignity maintained.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 绑可以，但不能让人围观，人格尊严要有
en: Restraint is acceptable, but do not let people stare, because personal dignity must be kept.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束时长超过规定须重新评估并记录
en: When the duration of restraint exceeds the limit, reassess and document.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束时长到了，先评估再决定要不要继续
en: The duration of restraint is up, so assess before deciding whether to continue.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 约束时避免俯卧位，警惕体位性窒息
en: Avoid prone positioning during restraint because of the risk of positional asphyxia.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 别让他趴着绑，会体位性窒息
en: Do not restrain him face down, because that can cause positional asphyxia.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自愿住院患者可随时提出出院
en: Patients admitted voluntarily may request discharge at any time.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他愿意住院，按自愿住院办手续
en: He is willing to stay, so process it as a voluntary admission.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 非自愿住院治疗须有明确诊断结论和病情评估依据
en: Involuntary inpatient treatment requires a clear diagnostic conclusion and documented assessment.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属问非自愿住院治疗要不要本人同意，医生解释了法定情形
en: The family asked whether involuntary inpatient treatment needs the patient's consent, and the doctor explained the statutory grounds.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 住院治疗期间应定期评估病情与风险
en: During inpatient treatment, the condition and risk must be reassessed regularly.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 医生建议住院治疗，门诊实在看不住
en: The doctor advised inpatient treatment because outpatient care cannot keep him safe.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 有伤害自身行为者应评估是否需要非自愿住院治疗
en: Patients who have harmed themselves need assessment for involuntary inpatient treatment.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他割过腕，属于伤害自身，不能让他自己走
en: He has cut his wrist, which counts as self-injury, so he cannot simply walk out.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 危害他人安全的认定须有病历和现场证据支持
en: Finding that a patient endangered others requires support from the record and on-scene evidence.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他拿刀追人，已经危害他人安全了
en: He chased people with a knife, which already endangered the safety of others.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 非自愿住院治疗以明确诊断结论为依据
en: Involuntary inpatient treatment rests on a clear diagnostic conclusion.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 诊断结论还没出，先按急诊观察处理
en: The diagnostic conclusion is not in yet, so manage him under emergency observation first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 病情评估应结合病史、精神检查和风险评估
en: Condition assessment combines the history, mental state examination, and risk assessment.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 病情评估写清楚，不然非自愿住院没依据
en: Document the condition assessment clearly, or involuntary admission has no basis.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 患者要求再次诊断期间不得停止必要的医疗处置
en: Necessary medical care must not stop while a re-diagnosis is being arranged.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属不同意，说要做再次诊断，我们配合安排
en: The family disagrees and asks for a re-diagnosis, so we help arrange it.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 精神障碍鉴定意见是处理住院争议的重要依据
en: The appraisal opinion is important evidence in resolving admission disputes.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属申请精神障碍鉴定，先告知流程和时间
en: The family is applying for a medical appraisal, so explain the process and timeline first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 对住院治疗提出异议的应告知救济途径
en: When an objection to admission is raised, the remedies must be explained.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他们有异议，把异议写进病历再上报
en: They have an objection, so record it in the chart and report it.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 非自愿住院治疗应书面告知诊断依据与救济途径
en: Involuntary inpatient treatment requires written notification of the diagnostic basis and remedies.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 口头说了不算，书面告知要签字
en: Saying it verbally is not enough, because written notification must be signed.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 近亲属的意见应记入病历，但不当然替代患者本人意愿
en: Close relatives' views are recorded but do not automatically replace the patient's own wishes.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 近亲属里谁来签字，先说清楚关系
en: Make clear which close relative will sign and what the relationship is.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 由公安机关协助送医的应记录出警单位和时间
en: When the police assist in transport, record the unit and time of attendance.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 打110让公安机关协助送医，我们别硬拦
en: Call the police for assistance with transport instead of trying to hold him ourselves.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 非自愿住院标准不满足时不得限制人身自由
en: Personal liberty must not be restricted when the criteria for involuntary admission are not met.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 对照非自愿住院标准看，他还差一条
en: Check the criteria for involuntary admission, because he does not meet one of them.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 住院治疗必要性应由精神科执业医师判断并记录
en: The necessity of inpatient treatment must be judged and documented by a licensed psychiatrist.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 住院治疗必要性不足，先门诊调整用药
en: The necessity of inpatient treatment is not established, so adjust medication as an outpatient first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 非自愿医疗须严格限于治疗所必需的范围
en: Involuntary medical treatment must be strictly limited to what treatment requires.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 非自愿医疗不是想用就用，得有法律依据
en: Involuntary medical treatment cannot be used at will, as there must be a legal basis.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 治疗措施调整应记录理由与效果
en: Changes to treatment measures must record the reason and the effect.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 治疗措施先按急诊方案来，明天再调整
en: Start with the emergency treatment measures and adjust tomorrow.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 拒绝治疗须记录告知内容和患者原话
en: For treatment refusal, record the information given and the patient's own words.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他拒绝治疗，先看有没有知情同意能力
en: He refuses treatment, so first assess whether he has capacity to consent.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 发现藏药应检查口腔并记录，必要时改用其他剂型
en: When medication concealment is found, check the mouth, document it, and consider another formulation.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他总藏药，吃完要张嘴看一下
en: He keeps hiding his tablets, so ask him to open his mouth after taking them.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 拒药原因应记录并先处理可逆因素
en: Record the reason for medication refusal and address reversible causes first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他拒药两天了，先问清是不是手抖得难受
en: He has refused medication for two days, so first ask whether the tremor is unbearable.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 改良电抽搐治疗前须完成麻醉评估和知情同意
en: Before modified electroconvulsive therapy, complete anaesthetic assessment and informed consent.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 药效不好就上改良电抽搐治疗，效果挺快
en: If medication fails, move to modified electroconvulsive therapy, which works quickly.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 电抽搐治疗对木僵和严重自杀风险起效较快
en: Electroconvulsive therapy acts relatively quickly in catatonia and severe suicide risk.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属一听电抽搐治疗就害怕，要解释清楚
en: The family is frightened by the mention of electroconvulsive therapy, so explain it clearly.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 剂量滴定期间应每周评估症状与不良反应
en: During dose titration, assess symptoms and side effects every week.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 剂量滴定慢慢加，别一次加太快
en: Titrate the dose slowly rather than increasing it too fast at once.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 治疗记录要写明调整依据，不能只写继续治疗
en: The treatment record must state the basis for changes rather than only noting that care continues.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 治疗记录今天补上，改了药要写原因
en: Complete the treatment record today, and note the reason when medication changes.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 监护人代为行使知情同意权时须核对身份与监护关系
en: When a guardian gives consent, verify identity and the guardianship relationship.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 监护人来了没有，签字得他签
en: Has the guardian arrived, because the signature has to be theirs.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 法定监护人身份以户口簿或出生证明为准
en: Legal guardian status is verified by the household register or birth certificate.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他是法定监护人，拿户口本就能办
en: He is the legal guardian, so the household register is enough.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 指定监护人应出具书面指定文件
en: A designated guardian should produce the written designation document.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家里争谁管，最后法院指定监护人
en: The family argued over who should take charge, and the court designated a guardian.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 监护职责包括人身照护、财产管理和医疗决定
en: Guardianship duties cover personal care, property management, and medical decisions.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 监护职责不是随便签个字，要真负责
en: Guardianship duties are not just signing papers but real responsibility.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 无人陪护的老年患者可申请临时监护
en: Unaccompanied older patients may need temporary guardianship.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属联系不上，先按临时监护走救助流程
en: The family cannot be reached, so start the assistance process under temporary guardianship.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 监护权不得滥用，不得损害被监护人利益
en: Guardianship rights must not be abused or used against the ward's interests.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 监护权在谁手里，得看法律文书
en: Who holds guardianship rights depends on the legal documents.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 发现监护人虐待患者应报告并申请撤销监护人资格
en: Suspected abuse by a guardian must be reported and revocation of guardianship sought.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他家人把补助全拿走，这种情况可以申请撤销监护人资格
en: His family took all the allowance, which is grounds to seek revocation of guardianship.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 无监护人的患者由民政部门协调安置
en: Patients without a guardian are placed through coordination with the civil affairs department.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 联系不上家属，报民政部门来处理
en: If the family cannot be reached, ask the civil affairs department to handle it.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 居民委员会可以出具监护情况证明
en: A residents' committee can issue proof of the guardianship situation.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 让居民委员会出个证明，说明他家里的情况
en: Ask the residents' committee for a certificate describing his family situation.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 村民委员会应协助落实精神障碍患者的监护责任
en: Villagers' committees should help secure guardianship for people with mental disorder.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 村里由村民委员会帮着联系监护人
en: In the village the villagers' committee helps contact the guardian.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 知情同意书由法定代理人签署并注明与被代理人关系
en: The consent form is signed by the legal representative, noting the relationship.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他不是法定代理人，签了也不算数
en: He is not the legal representative, so his signature does not count.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 民事行为能力受限时须由法定代理人代为决定

en: A person with limited civil capacity may perform acts suited to their condition.
