zh: 他是限制民事行为能力，签字要父母一起
en: He has limited civil capacity, so his parents must sign together.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 处分被监护人财产须为其利益并留存凭证
en: Dealing with a ward's property must serve the ward's interests and be documented.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他是被监护人，钱不能随便被拿走
en: He is a ward, so his money cannot simply be taken away.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 意定监护协议应明确医疗决定权限
en: An advance guardianship agreement should specify authority over medical decisions.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他提前做了意定监护，写明谁替他做医疗决定
en: He arranged an advance guardian in writing, naming who makes medical decisions for him.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 知情同意能力评估应在告知后当天完成并记录
en: Assess capacity to give informed consent on the day of disclosure and document it.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 先评知情同意能力，再决定找谁签字
en: Assess capacity to give informed consent before deciding who should sign.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 决策能力受损时可由监护人代为决定
en: When decision-making capacity is impaired, the guardian may decide.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他决策能力还在，别急着让家属替他做主
en: He still has decision-making capacity, so do not let the family decide for him.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 辨认能力严重受损是评定无刑事责任能力的依据
en: Severely impaired capacity to recognize supports a finding of no criminal responsibility.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 鉴定主要看他辨认能力还在不在
en: The appraisal turns mainly on whether his capacity to recognize is preserved.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 辨认能力存在而控制能力丧失时仍可评定为限定责任能力
en: Preserved recognition with impaired control can still support diminished responsibility.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他控制能力不行，一冲动就动手
en: His capacity to control is poor and he strikes out on impulse.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 意思表示不真实时同意可能无效
en: Consent may be invalid when the declaration of intention is not genuine.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他点头不算意思表示，得签字或者明确说
en: Nodding is not a declaration of intention, so he must sign or state it clearly.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 医疗告知应使用患者能够理解的语言
en: Medical disclosure should use language the patient can understand.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 医疗告知别用术语，说清楚开刀和不开刀的差别
en: Make the medical disclosure plain and explain the difference between surgery and no surgery.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 监护人代为决定应遵循最佳利益原则
en: Decisions made by a guardian should follow the best interests principle.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属决定也得按最佳利益来，不能图省事
en: The family's decision must still follow best interests rather than convenience.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 替代决定应参考患者既往意愿并记录依据
en: Substitute decision-making should reflect the patient's prior wishes and record the basis.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 替代决定不是家属想怎样就怎样
en: Substitute decision-making does not mean the family decides whatever it likes.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 患者意愿应写入病历供后续替代决定参考
en: The patient's preferences should be documented to guide later substitute decisions.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他清醒时说过不插管，患者意愿要尊重
en: While alert he said he did not want intubation, so his preferences must be respected.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 能力评估应针对具体决定，不作笼统结论
en: Capacity assessment should address a specific decision rather than a general conclusion.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 能力评估要具体，问的是这次手术他能不能决定
en: The capacity assessment must be specific, namely whether he can decide about this operation.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 简易精神状态检查得分低于二十四分提示认知损害
en: A Mini-Mental State Examination score below twenty four suggests cognitive impairment.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 简易精神状态检查做一下，得分很低
en: Do a Mini-Mental State Examination, because his score is low.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 蒙特利尔认知评估对轻度认知损害更敏感
en: The Montreal Cognitive Assessment is more sensitive to mild cognitive impairment.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 用蒙特利尔认知评估筛一下，他分数刚过线
en: Screen with the Montreal Cognitive Assessment, as his score only just passes.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 理解能力受损时应改用简单语言重复告知
en: When comprehension ability is impaired, repeat the information in simple language.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他理解能力差，得用大白话再说一遍
en: His comprehension ability is poor, so repeat it in plain language.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 知情同意书须双方签名并注明日期时间
en: The consent form must be signed by both parties with the date and time noted.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 知情同意书先给他看清楚再签
en: Let him read the consent form carefully before signing.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 自愿原则下患者有权随时提出出院
en: Under the voluntary principle the patient may request discharge at any time.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 按自愿原则，他本人不同意就不能硬留
en: Under the voluntary principle he cannot be kept against his will.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 司法精神病鉴定须在法定期限内出具鉴定意见
en: Forensic psychiatric assessment must produce an opinion within the statutory time limit.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 案子要做司法精神病鉴定，先封存病历
en: The case needs a forensic psychiatric assessment, so seal the records first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 刑事责任能力评定须结合案情材料与精神检查
en: Assessing criminal responsibility combines case materials and the mental state examination.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 鉴定结论是无刑事责任能力，案子要另作处理
en: The finding is no criminal responsibility, so the case must be handled differently.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 限定刑事责任能力可以从轻或者减轻处罚
en: Diminished criminal responsibility may lead to a lighter or reduced penalty.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 鉴定为限定刑事责任能力，量刑会考虑
en: The finding of diminished criminal responsibility will be weighed in sentencing.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 无刑事责任能力者应依法安排强制医疗或者监护
en: Those lacking criminal responsibility must be dealt with by compulsory care or guardianship as the law requires.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 判无刑事责任能力，家属得管起来
en: With a finding of no criminal responsibility, the family has to take charge.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 受审能力缺失时可以申请中止审理
en: When competency to stand trial is lacking, a suspension of proceedings may be sought.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他现在受审能力不行，庭都开不了
en: His competency to stand trial is lacking, so the hearing cannot proceed.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 服刑能力评估由监管机关提请鉴定
en: Assessment of capacity to serve sentence is requested by the correctional authority.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他服刑能力丧失，按程序办保外就医
en: His capacity to serve sentence is lost, so apply for medical release.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 性防卫能力评定是性侵案件定性的关键
en: Assessing capacity for sexual self-defence is key to characterising sexual assault cases.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 这个案子先评被害人性防卫能力
en: This case needs the victim's capacity for sexual self-defence assessed first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 精神伤残等级评定须依据鉴定标准条款
en: Mental disability grading must follow the clauses of the appraisal standard.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 赔偿要先出精神伤残等级结论
en: Compensation requires the mental disability grading first.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 鉴定意见须经质证才能作为定案依据
en: An expert opinion must be cross-examined before it can be used as a basis for judgment.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 鉴定意见出来了，双方都可能申请重新鉴定
en: The expert opinion is out, and either side may apply for re-appraisal.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 鉴定人应当在鉴定意见上签名
en: The appraiser must sign the expert opinion.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 鉴定人得出庭说明，不然结论有争议
en: The appraiser has to explain in court, otherwise the finding is disputed.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 委托鉴定机构应核对其资质与业务范围
en: Before commissioning an appraisal institution, check its licence and scope.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 找有资质的鉴定机构，别随便送
en: Use a licensed appraisal institution rather than sending it anywhere.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 精神状态鉴定应结合案卷材料与旁证
en: Mental state assessment should draw on case files and corroborating evidence.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 精神状态鉴定写得含糊，法官会要求补充
en: If the mental state assessment is vague, the judge will ask for clarification.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 民事行为能力鉴定用于确定监护人资格
en: Assessment of civil capacity is used to establish guardianship.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 要做民事行为能力鉴定，法院才认
en: An assessment of civil capacity is needed before the court will accept it.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 诈病与做作性障碍不同，前者有明确外部目的
en: Malingering differs from factitious disorder because it has a clear external goal.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 一看就是诈病，为了躲责任
en: It looks like malingering to avoid responsibility.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 鉴定材料须完整、真实并办理交接签收
en: Appraisal materials must be complete and genuine, with handover signed for.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 鉴定材料先复印齐全，缺一页都要补
en: Complete the appraisal materials first, as even a missing page must be replaced.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 危机干预应在接报后尽快启动并记录
en: Crisis intervention should start as soon as it is reported and be documented.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 先做危机干预，稳住情绪再谈别的
en: Do crisis intervention first to settle the emotions before anything else.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 心理危机评估应关注情绪、认知和躯体反应
en: Assessing a psychological crisis covers emotional, cognitive, and physical responses.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他现在是心理危机，别让他一个人扛着
en: He is in a psychological crisis now, so do not leave him to cope alone.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 心理援助热线应登记来电时间、风险和处理结果
en: The psychological support hotline must record call times, risk, and outcome.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 出院后打心理援助热线，二十四小时有人接
en: Call the psychological support hotline after discharge, as someone answers around the clock.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 现场干预应先确保人员安全再接近当事人
en: On-site intervention starts by securing staff safety before approaching the person.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 现场干预先清场，别一堆人围着
en: Clear the scene for on-site intervention instead of crowding round.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 心理疏导应与药物治疗同步进行
en: Psychological support should run alongside pharmacotherapy.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 先做心理疏导，家属别一直指责他
en: Give psychological support first, and the family should stop blaming him.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 稳定化技术包括深呼吸、接地和感官定向
en: Stabilization techniques include breathing, grounding, and sensory orientation.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 教他做稳定化技术，先数五个能看到的东西
en: Teach him a stabilization technique and start by naming five things he can see.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 急性应激反应多在数日内缓解，必要时短期用药
en: Acute stress reaction usually settles within days, with short-term medication if needed.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 车祸后他一直发抖，是急性应激反应
en: He has kept trembling since the crash, which is an acute stress reaction.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 灾难心理援助应分层开展，避免反复揭伤
en: Disaster mental health assistance should be tiered to avoid retraumatising people.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 灾难心理援助队到了，先做筛查再转介
en: The disaster mental health team has arrived, so screen first and refer afterwards.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属教育内容包括复发先兆和服药监督
en: Family education covers early warning signs of relapse and supervision of medication.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属教育做一遍，告诉他们复发有哪些前兆
en: Do family education and tell them which early signs predict relapse.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 严重精神障碍患者应定期随访并记录病情
en: Patients with severe mental disorder need regular follow-up with documented progress.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 出院后每月随访一次，电话也行
en: Follow up once a month after discharge, and by telephone is acceptable.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 识别应激源是危机干预的第一步
en: Identifying the stressor is the first step in crisis intervention.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 先问清应激源，是失业还是家里出事
en: Ask what the stressor is, whether job loss or a family crisis.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 哀伤辅导应在死亡告知后适时提供
en: Grief counselling should be offered at an appropriate time after breaking the news.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 家属情绪崩溃，安排哀伤辅导跟进
en: The family is overwhelmed, so arrange grief counselling to follow up.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 心理急救强调安全、稳定和连接资源
en: Psychological first aid emphasises safety, stabilisation, and connecting to resources.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 先做心理急救，别急着问细节
en: Give psychological first aid first and do not rush into the details.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 询问创伤性事件时避免诱导性提问
en: Avoid leading questions when asking about the traumatic event.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 他不愿提那次创伤性事件，先别追问
en: He will not discuss the traumatic event, so do not press him now.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 抗精神病药应从小剂量起始并监测不良反应
en: Antipsychotics start at a low dose with monitoring for adverse effects.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 抗精神病药吃了会困，先别开车
en: Antipsychotics make you sleepy, so do not drive for now.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 第二代抗精神病药需定期监测体重、血糖和血脂
en: Second-generation antipsychotics require regular checks of weight, glucose, and lipids.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 换成第二代抗精神病药，副作用会少些
en: Switch to a second-generation antipsychotic, which causes fewer side effects.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 氯氮平治疗前及治疗中须定期查血常规
en: Clozapine requires regular blood counts before and during treatment.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 用氯氮平要抽血查白细胞，别漏了
en: Clozapine needs blood tests for white cells, so do not skip them.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 奥氮平常见体重增加和嗜睡，应提前告知患者
en: Olanzapine commonly causes weight gain and drowsiness, which should be explained in advance.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 奥氮平吃了容易胖，饮食得控制
en: Olanzapine easily puts weight on, so diet needs watching.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 氟哌啶醇肌内注射后应监测锥体外系反应
en: After intramuscular haloperidol, monitor for extrapyramidal reactions.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 先给氟哌啶醇，注意别出现脖子歪
en: Give haloperidol first, and watch for neck twisting.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 抗抑郁药起效需两到四周，应提前说明
en: Antidepressants take two to four weeks to work, which should be explained in advance.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 抗抑郁药别吃两天没效就停
en: Do not stop antidepressants after two days just because nothing has changed.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂与其他升5-羟色胺药合用有风险
en: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors carry risks when combined with other serotonergic drugs.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 这类药是选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂，副作用相对轻
en: This drug is a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor with relatively mild side effects.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 心境稳定剂需监测血药浓度和肝肾功能
en: Mood stabilizers require monitoring of drug levels and liver and kidney function.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 心境稳定剂不能随便停，停了容易复发
en: Mood stabilizers must not be stopped casually, as relapse is likely.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 碳酸锂中毒早期表现为手抖、呕吐和腹泻
en: Early lithium carbonate toxicity shows tremor, vomiting, and diarrhoea.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 吃碳酸锂要多喝水，别大量出汗
en: Drink plenty of water on lithium carbonate and avoid heavy sweating.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 丙戊酸钠有致畸风险，育龄女性用药前须告知
en: Sodium valproate carries a teratogenic risk and must be discussed before use in women of childbearing age.
domain: 精神卫生与非自愿医疗

zh: 她还没结婚，开丙戊酸钠要讲清怀孕风险
en: She is not married, so explain the pregnancy risk before prescribing sodium valproate.

zh: 医疗意外保险不问过错，按约定补偿
en: Medical mishap insurance pays by agreement regardless of fault

zh: 单例赔偿限额为五十万元
en: The compensation limit per case is five hundred thousand yuan

zh: 赔偿限额不够的部分医院自己出
en: The hospital bears the amount above the compensation limit

zh: 保险理赔材料已提交保险公司
en: The insurance claim documents have been submitted to the insurer

zh: 保险理赔要走完调解或判决才行
en: Insurance claim settlement requires mediation or judgment first

zh: 医疗纠纷已登记并启动沟通程序
en: The medical dispute has been registered and the communication process started

zh: 医疗纠纷先谈，谈不成再调解
en: First negotiate the medical dispute; if that fails, go to mediation

zh: 双方同意协商解决并签署协议
en: Both sides agreed to a negotiated settlement and signed an agreement

zh: 协商解决快，但要写清一次性了结
en: A negotiated settlement is quick, but it must state it is final

zh: 本案已移交人民调解委员会
en: This case has been referred to the people's mediation committee

zh: 人民调解不收费，比打官司快
en: People's mediation is free and faster than litigation

zh: 医疗纠纷人民调解委员会已受理
en: The people's mediation committee for medical disputes has accepted the case

zh: 医疗纠纷人民调解委员会约了下周三调解
en: The mediation committee scheduled mediation for next Wednesday

zh: 调解协议已双方签字
en: The mediation agreement has been signed by both sides

zh: 调解协议要做司法确认才更稳
en: A mediation agreement is safer after judicial confirmation

zh: 调解协议已申请司法确认
en: The mediation agreement has been submitted for judicial confirmation

zh: 司法确认不用开庭，但要走程序
en: Judicial confirmation does not need a hearing but does follow procedure

zh: 患方已提起民事诉讼
en: The patient has filed civil litigation

zh: 民事诉讼周期长，先准备证据
en: Civil litigation takes time, so prepare the evidence first

zh: 对方已在属地法院起诉
en: The other party has filed a lawsuit in the local court

zh: 超过时效再起诉会败诉
en: Filing after the limitation period will lose the case

zh: 举证期限为收到通知后十五日
en: The time limit for evidence is fifteen days after notice

zh: 举证期限快到了，材料赶紧交
en: The deadline for evidence is near; submit the materials now

zh: 一审判决医院承担三成责任
en: The first-instance judgment held the hospital thirty percent liable

zh: 一审输了还可以上诉
en: If we lose at first instance, we can appeal

zh: 本案已进入二审程序
en: This case has entered second instance

zh: 二审一般三个月内审结
en: Second instance is usually concluded within three months

zh: 判决书已送达双方
en: The judgment has been served on both parties

zh: 判决生效后按判决履行
en: After the judgment takes effect, comply with it

zh: 死因鉴定结论为多器官功能衰竭
en: The cause-of-death appraisal concluded multiple organ failure

zh: 死因鉴定没出来，死亡证明先不开
en: The cause-of-death appraisal is pending, so the death certificate is on hold

zh: 法医病理医师到场后进行解剖
en: The forensic pathologist attended and performed the autopsy

zh: 法医病理报告要等两周
en: The forensic pathology report takes about two weeks

zh: 病理解剖需家属书面同意
en: Clinical autopsy requires written family consent

zh: 病理解剖能帮我们弄清治疗有没有问题
en: A clinical autopsy can show whether treatment had problems

zh: 非正常死亡依法进行法医解剖
en: An unnatural death requires a forensic autopsy by law

zh: 法医解剖不需要家属同意，但要告知
en: A forensic autopsy does not require family consent but must be notified

en: The autopsy report showed death from ruptured aortic dissection

zh: 尸检报告出来前先不要下结论
en: Do not conclude before the autopsy report is available

zh: 死亡时间推断为发现前六至八小时
en: The estimated time of death was six to eight hours before discovery

zh: 死亡时间推断有误差，不能精确到分钟
en: Estimation of time of death has a margin and cannot be exact

zh: 组织病理提示急性心肌梗死
en: Histopathology indicated acute myocardial infarction

zh: 组织病理结果还要等几天
en: Histopathology results take a few more days

zh: 已留取血样做毒物分析
en: Blood samples were retained for toxicological analysis

zh: 毒物分析结果阴性，排除中毒
en: Toxicological analysis was negative, excluding poisoning

zh: 尸体保存温度为四度并登记
en: The body was preserved at four degrees and logged

zh: 尸体保存要等家属来认领
en: Preservation of the body continues until the family identifies it

zh: 尸僵已遍及全身
en: Rigor mortis was generalized

zh: 尸僵还没完全形成，死亡时间不久
en: Rigor mortis was not fully established, so death was recent

zh: 死亡证明三个工作日内出具
en: The death certificate will be issued within three working days

zh: 死亡证明要多开两份，回国要用
en: Issue extra copies of the death certificate for use abroad

zh: 死亡方式勾选自然死亡，死亡原因是肺炎
en: The manner of death is natural, and the cause is pneumonia

zh: 死亡方式这一栏不能空着
en: The manner of death field cannot be left blank

zh: 本例属自然死亡，家属无异议
en: This was a natural death, and the family had no objection

zh: 自然死亡不用报公安
en: A natural death does not require police notification

zh: 这例属非正常死亡，已报公安
en: This is an unnatural death and has been reported to the police

zh: 非正常死亡不能马上开死亡证明
en: An unnatural death cannot get a death certificate immediately

zh: 死亡信息报告每月汇总上报
en: Death information reporting is summarized monthly

zh: 死亡信息报告漏报会被通报
en: Missing death information reporting will be notified

zh: 死因监测数据每季度分析一次
en: Cause-of-death surveillance data are analysed quarterly

zh: 死因监测要求根本死因填写准确
en: Cause-of-death surveillance requires an accurate underlying cause

zh: 家属申请死亡证明补办，已核验身份
en: The family applied for reissuance, and identity was verified

zh: 死亡证明补办要写遗失说明
en: Reissuance requires a statement of loss

zh: 死亡证明存根按年度装订保存
en: Death certificate stubs are bound and kept annually

zh: 死亡证明存根丢了就查不到签发记录
en: Without the stub the issuance record cannot be traced

zh: 遗体先送太平间，家属明天办手续
en: The remains go to the mortuary first; the family completes procedures tomorrow

zh: 遗体请家属先确认再送走
en: The family should confirm the remains before they are moved

zh: 遗体料理已完成，家属可以告别
en: Body preparation is complete, and the family may say goodbye

zh: 遗体料理麻烦轻一点，家属在外面
en: Please handle the body preparation gently; the family is outside

zh: 遗体防腐已完成并出具证明
en: Embalming has been completed and a certificate issued

zh: 遗体防腐不做，长途运不了
en: Without embalming, long-distance transport is not possible

zh: 遗体整容后家属情绪稳定一些
en: After body restoration the family calmed down somewhat

zh: 遗体整容要提前和家属沟通效果
en: Discuss the expected result with the family beforehand

zh: 遗体告别安排在明天上午九点
en: The viewing is scheduled for nine tomorrow morning

zh: 遗体告别时家属多，注意秩序
en: Many family members attend the viewing; keep order

zh: 殡仪馆的车已到门口
en: The funeral home vehicle has arrived at the entrance

zh: 殡仪馆电话我给您，直接联系
en: Here is the funeral home number; call them directly

zh: 家属选择火化，手续在殡仪馆办
en: The family chose cremation, handled at the funeral home

zh: 火化前要把死亡证明备齐
en: Have the death certificate ready before cremation

zh: 当地允许土葬，但要先开死亡证明
en: Local rules allow burial, but the death certificate is required first

zh: 土葬要看当地允不允许
en: Burial depends on local rules

zh: 遗体认领须带身份证和关系证明
en: Identification requires an ID and proof of relationship

zh: 遗体认领时家属情绪激动，安排单间
en: The family was distressed during identification, so a private room was arranged

zh: 遗物清点完毕，共五件，家属签字
en: The belongings inventory is complete with five items, signed by the family

zh: 遗物先封存，等家属到齐再清点
en: Seal the belongings and inventory them when the family arrives

zh: 丧葬费按实际支出凭票据计算
en: Funeral expenses are calculated from actual receipts

zh: 丧葬费不能乱报，要有票据
en: Funeral expenses need receipts

zh: 遗体运输需殡仪馆专用车辆
en: Transport of the body requires a funeral home vehicle

zh: 遗体运输不能随便找车
en: Transport cannot use an arbitrary vehicle

zh: 遗体跨境转运要提前一个月准备
en: Cross-border transport of remains takes about a month of preparation

zh: 遗体跨境转运手续不全，海关不放行
en: Without complete documents, customs will not release the remains

zh: 卫生检疫证明已办妥
en: The health quarantine certificate has been obtained

zh: 卫生检疫没过，遗体不能出境
en: Without quarantine clearance, the remains cannot leave

zh: 出境许可证三天内签发
en: The exit permit is issued within three days

zh: 出境许可证没下来，机票先别订
en: Do not book flights until the exit permit is issued

zh: 死亡证明领事认证需预约递交
en: Consular authentication requires an appointment

zh: 死亡证明领事认证一般要一周
en: Consular authentication usually takes a week

zh: 棺椁须符合航空运输标准
en: The coffin must meet air transport standards

zh: 棺椁不合格，航空公司不收运
en: Airlines will not accept a substandard coffin

zh: 防腐证明由殡葬服务机构出具
en: The embalming certificate is issued by the funeral service provider

zh: 防腐证明和检疫证明一起交
en: Submit the embalming and quarantine certificates together

zh: 航空运单上的品名写遗体运输
en: The air waybill lists the goods as transport of remains

zh: 航空运单信息错了要改单
en: An error on the air waybill requires an amendment

zh: 入境国检疫要求先查使馆公告
en: Check the embassy notice for entry quarantine requirements

zh: 入境国检疫要求变了，材料要重做
en: Requirements changed, so the documents must be redone

zh: 随附文件按清单逐项核对
en: Check accompanying documents against the list item by item

zh: 随附文件少一份都过不了关
en: Missing even one document blocks clearance

zh: 骨灰携带出境需火化证明
en: Carrying ashes abroad requires a cremation certificate

zh: 骨灰比遗体好运，手续简单些
en: Ashes are easier to transport than a body

zh: 熏蒸消毒完成后才能封箱
en: Fumigation must be completed before sealing the container

zh: 熏蒸消毒要有记录和证明
en: Fumigation needs records and certification

zh: 遗体转运许可由民政部门出具
en: The permit is issued by civil affairs

zh: 遗体转运许可没办，车不能上路
en: Without the permit the vehicle cannot proceed

zh: 已向使馆申请领事保护
en: We have applied to the embassy for consular protection

zh: 领事保护能帮联系律师，但替不了签字
en: Consular protection can help find a lawyer but cannot sign for you

zh: 我们请求领事协助联系家属
en: We requested consular assistance to contact the family

zh: 领事协助可以帮忙翻译和联络
en: Consular assistance can help with interpreting and contact

zh: 领事官员下午来医院探视
en: The consular officer will visit the hospital this afternoon

zh: 领事官员要求单独会见患者
en: The consular officer asked to meet the patient privately

zh: 该市属于驻本市领事馆辖区
en: The city falls within the consular district of the local consulate

zh: 不在辖区内的案件要转馆办理
en: Cases outside the district must be handled by another mission

zh: 先确认患者是否属于保护对象
en: First confirm whether the patient is entitled to protection

zh: 保护对象不符，领事馆无法介入
en: If the patient is not covered, the consulate cannot intervene

zh: 协助范围包括通知家属与推荐律师
en: The scope includes notifying family and recommending lawyers

zh: 超出协助范围的要求，领事馆会拒绝
en: Requests beyond the scope will be declined

zh: 患者需要法律协助，领事馆给了律师名单
en: The patient needs legal assistance and the consulate provided a list of lawyers

zh: 法律协助只是推荐，不保证结果
en: Legal assistance is only a referral and does not guarantee outcomes

zh: 领事探视安排在下午三点
en: The consular visit is scheduled for three in the afternoon

zh: 领事探视请提前告知患者
en: Please inform the patient of the consular visit in advance

zh: 涉外死亡已启动通报机制
en: The notification mechanism has been activated for the foreign death

zh: 通报机制走完，领事馆会回函
en: After the mechanism completes, the consulate will reply

zh: 已拨打领事保护热线求助
en: We called the consular protection hotline for help

zh: 领事保护热线二十四小时有人接
en: The consular protection hotline is staffed around the clock

zh: 家属已打12308热线登记
en: The family has called the 12308 hotline to register

zh: 12308热线可以协助转接使领馆
en: The 12308 hotline can connect callers to missions

zh: 按维也纳领事关系公约办理领事通知
en: Consular notification is handled under the Vienna Convention

zh: 领事通知要记录通知时间与接收人
en: Consular notification must record the time and recipient

zh: 医院应配合履行通知义务
en: The hospital should cooperate in fulfilling the notification obligation

zh: 通知义务不是可选项
en: The notification obligation is not optional

zh: 领事官员主张探视权
en: The consular officer asserted the right to visit

zh: 探视权被限制要有书面理由
en: Any restriction needs written reasons

zh: 会见安排在单独谈话室进行
en: The visit arrangement uses a separate interview room

zh: 会见安排变更要提前通知领馆
en: Changes must be notified to the mission in advance

zh: 患者要求行使通讯权联系家人
en: The patient asked to exercise the right to communicate

zh: 通讯权受限须有法律依据
en: Restricting the right to communicate needs a legal basis

zh: 领馆探视时我们提供了语言协助
en: We provided language assistance during the consular visit

zh: 语言协助不到位，探视效果差
en: Poor language assistance undermines the visit

zh: 家属通知已完成，配偶在赶来
en: Family notification is complete; the spouse is on the way

zh: 家属通知打了几次都没人接
en: Several attempts went unanswered

zh: 警方已办理拘留通知
en: The police have handled the detention notification

zh: 拘留通知超时会被质疑程序违法
en: Late detention notification invites challenge

zh: 因患者危重暂拒绝探视
en: The visit was refused for now because the patient is critical

zh: 拒绝探视要写理由，不能口头挡
en: Refusal must be justified in writing

zh: 领馆已提交探视申请
en: The mission has submitted an application for visit

zh: 探视申请按流程审批
en: Applications are approved through the process

zh: 护照遗失要先报警再办旅行证
en: For a lost passport, report to the police before a travel document

zh: 护照遗失没报案，领事馆办不了
en: Without a police report the consulate cannot process it

zh: 护照补发一般需十个工作日
en: Passport reissuance usually takes ten working days

zh: 护照补发太慢，先办旅行证回国
en: If too slow, get a travel document home first

zh: 旅行证明天可取
en: The travel document will be ready tomorrow

zh: 旅行证只能一次性使用
en: A travel document is valid for a single journey

zh: 出入境通行证不能用于国际航班
en: An exit-entry permit cannot be used for international flights

zh: 出入境通行证要看清有效期
en: Check the validity of the permit

zh: 护照复印件已留存并注明用途
en: The passport copy is retained with its purpose noted

zh: 护照复印件不能代替原件核验
en: A copy cannot replace the original

zh: 请提供身份证明以便开具诊断证明
en: Please provide an identity document to issue the certificate

zh: 身份证明缺失时先按无名氏登记
en: If documents are missing, register as unknown first

zh: 签证快到期，可开医疗证明延期
en: The visa is expiring; a medical certificate can support an extension

zh: 签证过期再办很麻烦
en: Overstaying makes the visa process much harder

zh: 停留期限还剩五天
en: The duration of stay has five days left

zh: 停留期限不够治病，马上办延期
en: If it is too short for treatment, apply for an extension now

zh: 因住院导致逾期停留，需出入境处理
en: Hospitalization caused the overstay, which needs immigration handling

zh: 逾期停留会有罚款，别拖
en: Overstaying incurs a fine, so do not delay

zh: 患者被采取出境限制，需核实文书
en: The patient is under an exit restriction; verify the document

zh: 出境限制没有文书就是违法
en: An exit restriction without documents is unlawful

zh: 临时身份证明已办，可先住院
en: The certificate is issued, so admission can proceed

zh: 临时身份证明有效期短，要尽快补证
en: It expires quickly, so get proper documents soon

zh: 患者具有中国国籍，无需领事介入
en: The patient has Chinese nationality, so no consular involvement is needed

zh: 中国国籍的认定要看父母与出生地
en: Chinese nationality depends on parents and place of birth

zh: 系统显示双重国籍，需核实
en: The system shows dual nationality, which must be verified

zh: 双重国籍在入境时会被要求选一个
en: Dual nationals are asked to choose at entry

zh: 国籍冲突导致无法确定领保归属
en: Nationality conflict makes consular responsibility unclear

zh: 国籍冲突先查两国法律
en: For nationality conflict, check both countries' laws first

zh: 该患者处于无国籍状态
en: The patient is in a state of statelessness

zh: 无国籍人员按特殊程序登记
en: Stateless persons are registered under special procedures

zh: 无国籍人急诊同样先救治
en: A stateless person receives emergency care first as well

zh: 无国籍人没有护照，只能临时登记
en: A stateless person has no passport and can only be registered temporarily

zh: 国籍认定结果出来了
en: The nationality determination result is out

zh: 国籍认定不清，先别办遣返
en: Do not proceed with removal before determination is clear

zh: 入籍申请已递交
en: The naturalization application has been submitted

zh: 入籍要住满年限，急不来
en: Naturalization requires a minimum residence period

zh: 患者已办理退籍
en: The patient has completed renunciation of nationality

zh: 退籍后就不是本国公民了
en: After renunciation the person is no longer a national

zh: 国籍证明由使领馆出具
en: The nationality certificate is issued by the mission

zh: 国籍证明要翻译公证才被承认
en: A nationality certificate needs translation and notarization

zh: 他持永久居留身份
en: He holds permanent residence status

zh: 永久居留不等于入籍
en: Permanent residence is not naturalization

zh: 永久居留身份证可以办理住院
en: The permanent residence identity card can be used for admission

zh: 永久居留身份证过期要先换证
en: Renew an expired card first

zh: 该患者为难民，需人道救治
en: The patient is a refugee and needs humanitarian care

zh: 难民同样享受急诊救治
en: Refugees receive the same emergency care

zh: 难民身份已获确认
en: Refugee status has been confirmed

zh: 难民身份没确认前按普通外国人登记
en: Before confirmation, register as an ordinary foreign national

zh: 患者提出庇护申请
en: The patient has applied for asylum

zh: 庇护申请期间不能遣返
en: No removal during an asylum application

zh: 遣返决定须符合不推回原则
en: Removal decisions must comply with the principle of non-refoulement

zh: 不推回原则是底线，不能突破
en: The principle of non-refoulement is a bottom line

zh: 已联系联合国难民署协助
en: UNHCR has been contacted for assistance

zh: 联合国难民署可以介入个案
en: UNHCR can intervene in individual cases

zh: 难民甄别已启动
en: Refugee status determination has started

zh: 难民甄别期间要给出临时证明
en: Provide temporary documents during determination

zh: 患者获得临时保护
en: The patient has been granted temporary protection

zh: 临时保护到期要重新申请
en: Temporary protection must be renewed on expiry

zh: 病情稳定后才能走遣返程序
en: Repatriation can only proceed once the condition is stable

zh: 遣返前要确认适合长途转运
en: Confirm fitness for long-distance transfer before repatriation

zh: 驱逐出境由出入境管理部门决定
en: Deportation is decided by the immigration authority

zh: 驱逐出境期间仍需救治
en: Care continues during deportation proceedings

zh: 患者签署自愿遣返同意书
en: The patient signed a voluntary repatriation consent

zh: 自愿遣返要本人愿意，不能强迫
en: Voluntary repatriation requires genuine willingness

zh: 转运需办过境签证
en: Transit requires a transit visa

zh: 过境手续不齐会被第三国拦下
en: Incomplete transit documents lead to interception

zh: 遣返前风险评估结果尚未出具
en: The pre-removal risk assessment is not yet available

zh: 遣返前风险评估没做就送人，风险很大
en: Removing without an assessment is very risky

zh: 患者为未成年人，需监护人签字
en: The patient is a minor, so a guardian must sign

zh: 未成年人就诊要监护人陪同
en: Minors must be accompanied by a guardian

zh: 未成年人医疗决定由监护人作出
en: The medical decision for the minor is made by the guardian

zh: 未成年人医疗决定要考虑孩子意愿
en: Consider the child's wishes in medical decisions

zh: 未成年人知情同意由母亲签署
en: Consent for the minor was signed by the mother

zh: 未成年人知情同意要同时告知孩子
en: Explain it to the child as well

zh: 儿童福利机构已接收该弃婴
en: The child welfare institution has taken in the abandoned infant

zh: 儿童福利机构接收要走手续
en: Handover to the institution requires paperwork

zh: 弃婴先救治再报公安
en: The abandoned infant is treated first, then reported

zh: 弃婴不能直接送福利院，要先报警
en: Do not send the infant to welfare directly; report to police first

zh: 亲子鉴定须双方同意或法院委托
en: Paternity testing requires consent or a court order

zh: 亲子鉴定结果影响监护权
en: Paternity testing affects guardianship

zh: 未成年人隐私不能随意告知他人
en: Minor privacy must not be disclosed casually

zh: 未成年人隐私在群里也不能说
en: Minor privacy cannot be shared in group chats either

zh: 祖父母受委托照护，签字仍需监护人授权
en: Grandparents provide entrusted care, but signing needs guardian authorization

zh: 委托照护要有书面委托
en: Entrusted care needs written authorization

zh: 收养登记已在民政部门办理
en: Adoption registration has been completed with civil affairs

zh: 收养登记没办，法律关系不成立
en: Without registration the legal relationship does not exist

zh: 患者隐私在查体时要注意遮挡
en: Protect patient privacy with screens during examination

zh: 床边讨论别说全名，保护患者隐私
en: Avoid full names at the bedside to protect patient privacy

zh: 个人信息收集要说明用途
en: Explain the purpose when collecting personal information

zh: 个人信息不能随便给第三方
en: Personal information must not be given to third parties casually

zh: 敏感个人信息要单独同意
en: Sensitive personal information requires separate consent

zh: 敏感个人信息不能一揽子授权
en: No blanket authorization for sensitive personal information

zh: 个人信息处理告知已随挂号发放
en: The notice of processing was given at registration

zh: 个人信息处理告知不能藏在长条款里
en: The notice must not be buried in long terms

zh: 科研数据先做去标识化
en: De-identify the data before research

zh: 去标识化不等于匿名化
en: De-identification is not anonymization

zh: 发生数据泄露先封账号再上报
en: For a data breach, freeze the account first, then report

zh: 数据泄露不能瞒，越瞒越大
en: A data breach cannot be concealed; it only grows

zh: 跨境传输前先做合规评估
en: Complete a compliance assessment before cross-border transfer

zh: 跨境传输要走流程，不能直接发邮件
en: Cross-border transfer follows procedure, not a direct email

zh: 按最小必要原则，这个字段可以不要
en: Under minimal necessity, this field can be dropped

zh: 最小必要原则能减少泄露风险
en: Minimal necessity reduces breach risk

zh: 个人信息保护影响评估已备案
en: The impact assessment has been filed

zh: 不做个人信息保护影响评估就上线，风险很大
en: Launching without an impact assessment is very risky

zh: 保密义务是法定的，亲属来问也不能随便说
en: The duty of confidentiality is legal; do not disclose even to relatives

zh: 保密义务在离职后仍然有效
en: The duty survives leaving the post

zh: 信息安全培训每年一次
en: Information security training is annual

zh: 信息安全不只是信息科的事
en: Information security is not only the IT department's job

zh: 器官捐献须家属书面同意
en: Organ donation requires written family consent

zh: 器官捐献完全自愿，不同意就停止
en: Organ donation is voluntary; if you decline we stop

zh: 人体器官移植条例对活体移植有严格限制
en: The regulation strictly limits living donor transplantation

zh: 人体器官移植条例不允许任何买卖
en: The regulation prohibits any sale of organs

zh: 自愿无偿原则写在同意书第一页
en: The voluntary and unpaid principle is on page one

zh: 自愿无偿原则没有例外
en: There is no exception to the voluntary and unpaid principle

zh: 捐献同意须单独签署并记录
en: Donation consent must be signed and documented separately

zh: 捐献同意可以撤回
en: Donation consent may be withdrawn

zh: 家属同意需所有直系亲属签字
en: Family consent requires all immediate relatives to sign

zh: 家属同意前要讲清流程
en: Explain the process before family consent

zh: 器官分配结果由系统生成
en: The allocation result is generated by the system

zh: 器官分配看病情和配型，不看关系
en: Allocation depends on urgency and matching, not connections

zh: 活体移植须伦理委员会审批
en: Living donor transplantation requires ethics committee approval

zh: 活体移植对供者有风险，必须单独告知
en: Living donation carries donor risk and must be disclosed separately

zh: 脑死亡判定由两位医师完成
en: Brain death determination is performed by two physicians

zh: 脑死亡判定要两次，间隔十二小时
en: Two determinations are required, twelve hours apart

zh: 任何器官买卖提法都要立即上报
en: Any mention of organ trafficking must be reported immediately

zh: 器官买卖是犯罪，不能碰
en: Organ trafficking is a crime and must be refused

zh: 移植伦理委员会已开会讨论
en: The transplant ethics committee has met to discuss it

zh: 移植伦理委员会不通过就不能做
en: Without committee approval it cannot proceed

zh: 捐献者登记信息可在系统查询
en: Donor registry information can be checked in the system

zh: 捐献者登记是自愿的，随时可撤
en: Registration is voluntary and may be revoked

zh: 该院具备肝脏移植资质
en: The hospital holds liver transplant qualification

zh: 移植资质要定期复核
en: Transplant qualification is reviewed periodically

zh: 这例属于强制报告情形
en: This case falls under mandatory reporting

zh: 强制报告是义务，不是选择
en: Mandatory reporting is a duty, not a choice

zh: 报告义务由首诊医师履行
en: The reporting duty is performed by the first treating physician

zh: 报告义务不因家属反对而免除
en: The reporting duty is not waived by family objection

zh: 疑似病例报告已提交疾控
en: The suspected case report has been submitted to the CDC

zh: 疑似病例报告不能等确诊再做
en: Do not wait for confirmation to report a suspected case

zh: 非正常死亡报告已提交公安
en: The unnatural death report has been filed with the police

zh: 非正常死亡报告不及时会破坏证据
en: Delayed reporting destroys evidence

zh: 疑似虐待已按程序虐待报告
en: Suspected abuse has been reported through procedure

zh: 虐待报告要留证据，别只口头说
en: Abuse reporting needs evidence, not just words

zh: 未成年人受侵害报告已提交民政与公安
en: The report on harm to a minor has been submitted

zh: 未成年人受侵害报告不能瞒着
en: Reports on harm to minors must not be withheld

zh: 严重精神障碍报告已录入系统
en: The severe mental disorder report has been entered

zh: 严重精神障碍报告用于随访，不是歧视
en: The report supports follow-up, not discrimination

zh: 职业暴露报告当天提交
en: The occupational exposure report was submitted the same day

zh: 职业暴露报告拖到下班就违规
en: Delaying it until after the shift breaches the rules

zh: 药品不良反应报告已提交监测中心
en: The ADR report has been submitted to the monitoring centre

zh: 药品不良反应报告不能漏，严重的有时限
en: ADR reports cannot be skipped; serious ones have deadlines

zh: 医疗质量安全事件报告已上报卫健部门
en: The event report has been submitted to the health authority

zh: 医疗质量安全事件报告不能压着
en: Quality and safety event reports must not be suppressed
